    9: 
   10: function stringifyValue(value: unknown) {
   11:   if (value === null || value === undefined) {
   12:     return "";
   13:   }
   14: 
   15:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   16:     return value;
   17:   }
   18: 
   19:   if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
   20:     return String(value);
   21:   }
   22: 
   23:   try {
   24:     return JSON.stringify(value);
   25:   } catch {
   26:     return String(value);
   27:   }
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function hasTextValue(value: unknown) {
   31:   return typeof value === "string" && value.trim().length > 0;
   32: }
   33: 
   34: function normalizeCaseValues(caseEntry: {
   35:   values?: Array<{
   36:     fieldKey: string;
   37:     value?: string | null;
   38:     jsonValue?: unknown;
   39:     field?: {
   40:       key?: string | null;
   41:       label?: string | null;
   42:     } | null;
   43:   }>;
   44: }): RuntimePreviewCaseValue[] {
   45:   return (caseEntry.values || []).map((item: any) => ({
   46:     fieldKey: item.field?.key || item.fieldKey || "unknown",
   47:     fieldLabel: item.field?.label || item.fieldKey || "حقل بدون اسم",
   48:     value: stringifyValue(hasTextValue(item.value) ? item.value : item.jsonValue),
   49:   }));
   50: }
   51: 
   52: function normalizeEvidences(caseEntry: {
   53:   evidences?: Array<{
   54:     id: string;
   55:     fileName?: string | null;
   56:     fileUrl?: string | null;
   57:     note?: string | null;
   58:   }>;
   59:   caseEvidences?: Array<{
   60:     id: string;
   61:     fileName: string;
   62:     fileUrl: string;
   63:   }>;
   64: }): RuntimePreviewEvidence[] {
   65:   const normalEvidences: RuntimePreviewEvidence[] = (caseEntry.evidences || [])
   66:     .filter((item: any) => Boolean(item.fileUrl))
   67:     .map((item: any) => ({
   68:       id: item.id,
   69:       title: item.fileName || item.note || "شاهد",
   70:       fileUrl: item.fileUrl || undefined,
   71:       imageUrl: item.fileUrl || undefined,
   72:       caption: item.note || undefined,
   73:     }));
   74: 
   75:   const caseEvidences: RuntimePreviewEvidence[] = (
   76:     caseEntry.caseEvidences || []
   77:   )
   78:     .filter((item: any) => Boolean(item.fileUrl))
   79:     .map((item: any) => ({
   80:       id: item.id,
   81:       title: item.fileName || "شاهد",
   82:       fileUrl: item.fileUrl,
   83:       imageUrl: item.fileUrl,
   84:     }));
   85: 
   86:   return [...normalEvidences, ...caseEvidences];
   87: }
   88: 
   89: export async function GET(request: Request) {
   90:   try {
   91:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
   92:     const caseId = searchParams.get("caseId")?.trim();
   93: 
   94:     if (!caseId) {
   95:       return NextResponse.json({
   96:         ok: true,
   97:         mode: "sample",
   98:         message: "لم يتم إدخال Case ID، سيتم استخدام بيانات تجريبية.",
   99:       });
  100:     }
  101: 
  102:     const caseEntry = await prisma.caseEntry.findUnique({
  103:       where: {
  104:         id: caseId,
  105:       },
  106:       include: {
  107:         service: true,
  108:         workflow: true,
  109:         student: {
  110:           include: {
  111:             guardian: true,
  112:           },
  113:         },
  114:         values: {
  115:           include: {
  116:             field: true,
  117:           },
  118:           orderBy: {
  119:             createdAt: "asc",
  120:           },
  121:         },
  122:         evidences: {
  123:           orderBy: {
  124:             createdAt: "asc",
  125:           },
  126:         },
  127:         caseEvidences: {
  128:           orderBy: {
  129:             createdAt: "asc",
  130:           },
  131:         },
  132:       },
  133:     });
  134: 
  135:     if (!caseEntry) {
  136:       return NextResponse.json({
  137:         ok: true,
  138:         mode: "sample",
  139:         message: "لم يتم العثور على الحالة، سيتم استخدام بيانات تجريبية.",
  140:       });
  141:     }
  142: 
  143:     const data: RuntimePreviewCaseData = {
  144:       found: true,
  145:       caseId: caseEntry.id,
  146:       serviceSlug: caseEntry.service.slug,
  147:       serviceName: caseEntry.service.name,
  148:       title: caseEntry.title || caseEntry.service.name,
  149:       status: caseEntry.status,
  150:       createdAt: caseEntry.createdAt.toISOString(),
  151:       updatedAt: caseEntry.updatedAt.toISOString(),
  152: 
  153:       student: caseEntry.student
  154:         ? {
  155:             id: caseEntry.student.id,
  156:             name: caseEntry.student.fullName,
  157:             nationalId: caseEntry.student.nationalId || undefined,
  158:             grade: caseEntry.student.grade || undefined,
  159:             classroom: caseEntry.student.classroom || undefined,
  160:             stage: caseEntry.student.stage || undefined,
  161:             guardianName: caseEntry.student.guardian?.name || undefined,
  162:             guardianPhone: caseEntry.student.guardian?.phone || undefined,
  163:           }
  164:         : undefined,
  165: 
  166:       values: filterPrivateReportValues(normalizeCaseValues(caseEntry)),
  167:       evidences: normalizeEvidences(caseEntry),
  168:     };
  169: 
  170:     return NextResponse.json({
  171:       ok: true,
  172:       mode: "case",
  173:       message: "تم جلب بيانات الحالة للمعاينة.",
  174:       data,
  175:     });
  176:   } catch (error) {
  177:     console.error("preview-case error:", error);
  178: 
  179:     return NextResponse.json(
  180:       {
  181:         ok: true,
  182:         mode: "sample",
  183:         message:
  184:           "تعذر جلب بيانات الحالة بسبب خطأ مؤقت، سيتم استخدام بيانات تجريبية.",
  185:       },
  186:       { status: 200 }
  187:     );
  188:   }
  189: }

    5: const fallbackFields: RuntimeWorkflowFieldOption[] = [

   47: 
   48: export async function GET(request: Request) {
   49:   try {
   50:     const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);
   51:     const serviceSlug = searchParams.get("serviceSlug")?.trim();
   52: 
   53:     if (!serviceSlug) {
   54:       return NextResponse.json({
   55:         ok: true,
   56:         source: "fallback",
   57:         message: "لم يتم تحديد خدمة، تم استخدام الحقول الافتراضية.",
   58:         fields: fallbackFields,
   59:       });
   60:     }
   61: 
   62:     const service = await prisma.service.findUnique({
   63:       where: {
   64:         slug: serviceSlug,
   65:       },
   66:       include: {
   67:         workflows: {
   68:           where: {
   69:             status: "ACTIVE",
   70:           },
   71:           orderBy: [
   72:             {
   73:               isActive: "desc",
   74:             },
   75:             {
   76:               updatedAt: "desc",
   77:             },
   78:           ],
   79:           take: 1,
   80:           include: {
   81:             steps: {
   82:               orderBy: {
   83:                 order: "asc",
   84:               },
   85:               include: {
   86:                 fields: {
   87:                   orderBy: {
   88:                     order: "asc",
   89:                   },
   90:                 },
   91:               },
   92:             },
   93:           },
   94:         },
   95:       },
   96:     });
   97: 
   98:     const workflow = service?.workflows[0];
   99: 
  100:     if (!service || !workflow) {
  101:       return NextResponse.json({
  102:         ok: true,
  103:         source: "fallback",
  104:         message:
  105:           "لم يتم العثور على Workflow نشط لهذه الخدمة، تم استخدام الحقول الافتراضية.",
  106:         fields: fallbackFields,
  107:       });
  108:     }
  109: 
  110:     const fields: RuntimeWorkflowFieldOption[] = workflow.steps.flatMap((step: any) =>
  111: step.fields.map((field: any) => ({
  112:   
  113:   
  114:   key: field.key,
  115:         label: field.label,
  116:         type: field.type,
  117:         source: "workflow" as const,
  118:         stepTitle: step.title,
  119:       }))
  120:     );
  121: 
  122:     return NextResponse.json({
  123:       ok: true,
  124:       source: fields.length ? "workflow" : "fallback",
  125:       serviceSlug,
  126:       serviceName: service.name,
  127:       workflowId: workflow.id,
  128:       workflowName: workflow.name,
  129:       message: fields.length
  130:         ? "تم جلب حقول الـ Workflow النشط."
  131:         : "الـ Workflow النشط لا يحتوي على حقول، تم استخدام الحقول الافتراضية.",
  132:       fields: fields.length ? fields : fallbackFields,
  133:     });
  134:   } catch (error) {
  135:     console.error("workflow-fields error:", error);
  136: 
  137:     return NextResponse.json(
  138:       {
  139:         ok: true,
  140:         source: "fallback",
  141:         message:
  142:           "تعذر جلب حقول الـ Workflow بسبب خطأ مؤقت، تم استخدام الحقول الافتراضية.",
  143:         fields: fallbackFields,
  144:       },
  145:       { status: 200 }
  146:     );
  147:   }
  148: }

   87: function dedupeOptions(options: CustomReportOption[]) {

   96:     }
   97: 
   98:     const dedupeKey = `${label.toLowerCase()}::${value.toLowerCase()}`;
   99: 
  100:     if (seen.has(dedupeKey)) {
  101:       return false;
  102:     }
  103: 
  104:     seen.add(dedupeKey);
  105:     return true;
  106:   });
  107: }
  108: 
  109: function normalizeOptions(value: unknown) {
  110:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
  111:     return [];
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return dedupeOptions(
  115:     value
  116:       .map((item, index) => {
  117:         if (typeof item === "string") {
  118:           const label = cleanText(item);
  119: 
  120:           if (!label) {
  121:             return null;
  122:           }
  123: 
  124:           return {
  125:             label,
  126:             value: normalizeOptionValue(label, index),
  127:           };
  128:         }
  129: 
  130:         if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
  131:           return null;
  132:         }
  133: 
  134:         const record = item as Record<string, unknown>;
  135:         const label = cleanText(record.label);
  136: 
  137:         if (!label) {
  138:           return null;
  139:         }
  140: 
  141:         const value = cleanText(record.value) || normalizeOptionValue(label, index);
  142: 
  143:         return {
  144:           label,
  145:           value,
  146:         };
  147:       })
  148:       .filter(Boolean) as CustomReportOption[],
  149:   ).slice(0, 8);
  150: }
  151: 
  152: function buildContextPrompt(schema: CustomReportSchema, fieldLabel: string) {
  153:   const fieldLabels = schema.sections
  154:     .flatMap((section) => section.fields)
  155:     .map((field) => field.label)
  156:     .filter(Boolean)
  157:     .slice(0, 18);
  158: 
  159:   return [
  160:     schema.title,
  161:     schema.description || "",
  162:     fieldLabel,
  163:     fieldLabels.join(" "),
  164:   ]
  165:     .join(" ")
  166:     .trim();
  167: }
  168: 
  169: function buildKnowledgeOptions(schema: CustomReportSchema, fieldLabel: string) {
  170:   const knowledge = findRelevantAiReportKnowledge({
  171:     prompt: buildContextPrompt(schema, fieldLabel),
  172:     limit: 140,
  173:   });
  174:   const normalizedFieldLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(fieldLabel);
  175: 
  176:   const directMatches = knowledge.items
  177:     .filter((item) => {
  178:       const itemFieldLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(item.fieldLabel);
  179: 
  180:       return (
  181:         itemFieldLabel === normalizedFieldLabel ||
  182:         itemFieldLabel.includes(normalizedFieldLabel) ||
  183:         normalizedFieldLabel.includes(itemFieldLabel)
  184:       );
  185:     })
  186:     .map((item) => cleanText(item.optionLabel))
  187:     .filter(Boolean);
  188: 
  189:   const generalMatches = knowledge.items
  190:     .map((item) => cleanText(item.optionLabel))
  191:     .filter(Boolean);
  192: 
  193:   const labels = Array.from(new Set([...directMatches, ...generalMatches])).slice(0, 8);
  194: 
  195:   return labels.map((label, index) => ({
  196:     label,
  197:     value: normalizeOptionValue(label, index),
  198:   }));
  199: }
  200: 
  201: function buildFallbackOptions(fieldLabel: string) {
  202:   const normalizedFieldLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(fieldLabel);
  203:   const fallback = FIELD_OPTION_FALLBACKS.find((entry) =>
  204:     entry.matchers.some((matcher) =>
  205:       normalizedFieldLabel.includes(normalizeAiReportArabicText(matcher)),
  206:     ),
  207:   );
  208: 
  209:   if (!fallback) {
  210:     return [];
  211:   }
  212: 
  213:   return fallback.options.map((label, index) => ({
  214:     label,
  215:     value: normalizeOptionValue(label, index),
  216:   }));
  217: }

  219: async function buildAiSuggestedOptions(
  220:   schema: CustomReportSchema,
  221:   fieldLabel: string,
  222:   seedOptions: CustomReportOption[],
  223: ) {
  224:   const content = await callDeepSeekChat({
  225:     temperature: 0.1,
  226:     maxTokens: 500,
  227:     messages: [
  228:       {
  229:         role: "system",
  230:         content:
  231:           "أنت مساعد يصمم خيارات حقول تقارير تعليمية. أعد JSON فقط بالشكل {\"options\":[{\"label\":\"...\",\"value\":\"...\"}]}. يجب أن تكون الخيارات بالعربية الواضحة، من 4 إلى 8 خيارات فقط، مناسبة للحقل نفسه، وغير عامة. لا تضف حقل شواهد، ولا تضف الشواهد المقترحة، ولا تستخدم نصوصًا مشوشة.",
  232:       },
  233:       {
  234:         role: "user",
  235:         content: `
  236: عنوان التقرير: ${schema.title}
  237: وصف التقرير: ${schema.description || "لا يوجد وصف إضافي."}
  238: الحقل المطلوب: ${fieldLabel}
  239: الحقول الحالية في التقرير:
  240: ${schema.sections
  241:   .flatMap((section) => section.fields)
  242:   .map((field, index) => `${index + 1}. ${field.label}`)
  243:   .join("\n")}
  244: 
  245: الخيارات المرشحة من بنك المعرفة:
  246: ${seedOptions.map((option, index) => `${index + 1}. ${option.label}`).join("\n") || "لا توجد مرشحات كافية."}
  247: 
  248: قواعد صارمة:
  249: - أعد 4 إلى 8 خيارات فقط.
  250: - إذا استخدمت قيمة option.value فلتكن english_snake_case.
  251: - يجب أن تكون الخيارات مرتبطة بالحقل "${fieldLabel}" نفسه.
  252: - لا تضف "الشواهد المقترحة".
  253: - لا تضف خيارات فارغة أو مكررة.
  254:         `.trim(),
  255:       },
  256:     ],
  257:   });
  258: 
  259:   const parsed = extractJsonObject(content) as { options?: unknown };
  260:   return normalizeOptions(parsed.options);
  261: }
  262: 
  263: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  264:   const context = await requireCustomReportContext();
  265: 
  266:   if (!context.ok) {
  267:     return NextResponse.json(
  268:       { success: false, error: context.message },
  269:       { status: context.status },
  270:     );
  271:   }
  272: 
  273:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
  274:   const schema =
  275:     body?.schema && typeof body.schema === "object"
  276:       ? (body.schema as CustomReportSchema)
  277:       : null;
  278:   const fieldLabel = cleanText(body?.fieldLabel);
  279:   const fieldType = cleanText(body?.fieldType);
  280: 
  281:   if (!schema || !fieldLabel || fieldType !== "multi_select") {
  282:     return NextResponse.json(
  283:       {
  284:         success: false,
  285:         error: "بيانات اقتراح الخيارات غير صالحة.",
  286:       },
  287:       { status: 400 },
  288:     );
  289:   }
  290: 
  291:   const knowledgeOptions = buildKnowledgeOptions(schema, fieldLabel);
  292:   const fallbackOptions = buildFallbackOptions(fieldLabel);
  293: 
  294:   try {
  295:     const aiOptions = await buildAiSuggestedOptions(schema, fieldLabel, [
  296:       ...knowledgeOptions,
  297:       ...fallbackOptions,
  298:     ]);
  299:     const options = dedupeOptions(aiOptions).slice(0, 8);
  300: 
  301:     if (options.length >= 4) {
  302:       return NextResponse.json({ success: true, options });
  303:     }
  304:   } catch {
  305:     // Fall back safely to grounded options below.
  306:   }
  307: 
  308:   const options = dedupeOptions([...knowledgeOptions, ...fallbackOptions]).slice(0, 8);
  309: 
  310:   if (options.length < 4) {
  311:     return NextResponse.json(
  312:       {
  313:         success: false,
  314:         error: "تعذر اقتراح خيارات كافية لهذا الحقل. اكتبها يدويًا أو جرّب اسم حقل أوضح.",
  315:       },
  316:       { status: 422 },
  317:     );
  318:   }
  319: 
  320:   return NextResponse.json({ success: true, options });
  321: }

  181: function clampConfidence(value: unknown, fallback = 0.58) {

  383:       ? `- المراحل التعليمية في ملف المستخدم: ${stages.join("، ")}`
  384:       : "",
  385:     specialties.length
  386:       ? `- التخصصات في ملف المستخدم: ${specialties.join("، ")}`
  387:       : "",
  388:     subjects.length
  389:       ? `- المواد في ملف المستخدم: ${subjects.join("، ")}`
  390:       : "",
  391:   ].filter(Boolean);
  392: 
  393:   return {
  394:     stages,
  395:     specialties,
  396:     subjects,
  397:     block: lines.join("\n") || "لا توجد بيانات إضافية في ملف المستخدم.",
  398:   };
  399: }
  400: 
  401: function buildCombinedPrompt(prompt: string, clarificationAnswers: Record<string, string>) {
  402:   const answers = Object.entries(clarificationAnswers)
  403:     .map(([key, value]) =>
  404:       !value.trim() || isSuggestiveAnswer(value)
  405:         ? `- ${key}: المعلم طلب من النظام اقتراح القيمة المناسبة لهذا السؤال.`
  406:         : `- ${key}: ${value}`,
  407:     )
  408:     .join("\n");
  409: 
  410:   if (!answers) {
  411:     return prompt;
  412:   }
  413: 
  414:   return `${prompt}\n\nإجابات التوضيح:\n${answers}`;
  415: }
  416: 
  417: function isEvidenceLikeLabel(value: string) {
  418:   const normalized = normalizeAiReportArabicText(value);
  419:   return EVIDENCE_TEXT_MARKERS.some((marker) =>
  420:     normalized.includes(normalizeAiReportArabicText(marker)),
  421:   );
  422: }

  424: function buildFallbackClarificationQuestions(
  425:   analysis: Pick<IntentAnalysis, "missingContext" | "reportFamily">,
  426:   lowConfidence: boolean,
  427: ) {
  428:   const questions: ClarificationQuestion[] = [];
  429:   const missing = new Set(analysis.missingContext);
  430: 
  431:   const pushQuestion = (question: ClarificationQuestion) => {
  432:     if (questions.some((item) => item.id === question.id)) {
  433:       return;
  434:     }
  435: 
  436:     questions.push(question);
  437:   };
  438: 
  439:   if (missing.has("scope") || lowConfidence) {
  440:     pushQuestion({
  441:       id: "report_scope",
  442:       label: "ما نطاق التقرير؟",
  443:       placeholder: "مثال: درس، وحدة، اجتماع، نتائج، خطة...",
  444:       type: "select",
  445:       options: buildClarificationQuestionOptions("ما نطاق التقرير؟"),
  446:     });
  447:   }
  448: 
  449:   if (missing.has("focus") || lowConfidence) {
  450:     pushQuestion({
  451:       id: "report_focus",
  452:       label: "ما أهم المحاور التي يجب أن يغطيها التقرير؟",
  453:       placeholder: "مثال: التنفيذ، النتائج، الفجوات، التوصيات...",
  454:       type: "textarea",
  455:     });
  456:   }
  457: 
  458:   if (missing.has("timeframe") || lowConfidence) {
  459:     pushQuestion({
  460:       id: "report_context",
  461:       label: "ما المناسبة أو الفترة المرتبطة بالتقرير؟",
  462:       placeholder: "مثال: نهاية وحدة، لقاء مهني، زيارة صفية...",
  463:       type: "text",
  464:     });
  465:   }
  466: 
  467:   if (missing.has("audience") || questions.length < 2) {
  468:     pushQuestion({
  469:       id: "report_audience",
  470:       label: "لمن أو عن من يدور التقرير؟",
  471:       placeholder: "مثال: الطلاب، المعلمون، أولياء الأمور، تنفيذ نشاط...",
  472:       type: "text",
  473:     });
  474:   }
  475: 
  476:   if (questions.length < 2) {
  477:     pushQuestion({
  478:       id: "report_goal",
  479:       label: "ما النتيجة التي تريد إبرازها في التقرير؟",
  480:       placeholder: `مثال: خلاصة ${analysis.reportFamily || "التقرير"} أو توصياته الرئيسة`,
  481:       type: "text",
  482:     });
  483:   }
  484: 
  485:   return questions.slice(0, lowConfidence ? 3 : 4);
  486: }
  487: 
  488: function buildFallbackIntentAnalysis({
  489:   prompt,
  490:   knowledge,
  491: }: {
  492:   prompt: string;
  493:   knowledge: ReturnType<typeof findRelevantAiReportKnowledge>;
  494: }): IntentAnalysis {
  495:   const normalizedPrompt = cleanText(prompt);
  496:   const tokens = normalizedPrompt.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  497:   const hasScopeWord =
  498:     /درس|وحدة|خطة|تقييم|تقويم|تحليل|نتائج|اجتماع|جلسة|لقاء|نشاط|مبادرة|أولياء|طلاب|تعلم|بيئة|تقنية|زيارة|متابعة|توصية/i.test(
  499:       normalizedPrompt,
  500:     );
  501:   const hasFocusWord =
  502:     /يتضمن|يشمل|محور|فجوات|توصيات|تنفيذ|أثر|مستوى|خلاصة|ملخص|تحسين|مستهدف|مؤشر/i.test(
  503:       normalizedPrompt,
  504:     );
  505:   const hasTimeWord =
  506:     /اليوم|الأسبوع|الفصل|الوحدة|الحصة|العام|الفترة|اللقاء|الاجتماع|البرنامج|النشاط|الدرس/i.test(
  507:       normalizedPrompt,
  508:     );
  509:   const topScore = knowledge.topReports[0]?.score ?? 0;
  510: 
  511:   let confidence = 0.34;
  512: 
  513:   if (normalizedPrompt.length >= 24) confidence += 0.16;
  514:   if (tokens.length >= 5) confidence += 0.12;
  515:   if (hasScopeWord) confidence += 0.14;
  516:   if (hasFocusWord) confidence += 0.12;
  517:   if (knowledge.topReports.length > 0) confidence += 0.08;
  518:   if (knowledge.items.length >= 15) confidence += 0.08;
  519:   if (topScore >= 24) confidence += 0.06;
  520:   if (normalizedPrompt.length < 14) confidence -= 0.14;
  521:   if (!hasScopeWord) confidence -= 0.1;
  522:   if (!hasFocusWord) confidence -= 0.08;
  523: 
  524:   const finalConfidence = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(0.9, confidence));
  525:   const reportFamily = inferReportFamily(prompt, knowledge);
  526:   const missingContext = [
  527:     !hasScopeWord ? "scope" : "",
  528:     !hasFocusWord ? "focus" : "",
  529:     !hasTimeWord ? "timeframe" : "",
  530:     !/طلاب|معلمين|أولياء|مجتمع|إدارة|صف|فصل|مادة|وحدة|نشاط/i.test(normalizedPrompt)
  531:       ? "audience"
  532:       : "",
  533:   ].filter(Boolean);
  534:   const needsClarification = finalConfidence < 0.75;
  535: 
  536:   const coreFieldHints = Array.from(
  537:     new Set(
  538:       knowledge.items
  539:         .map((item) => sanitizeAiReportText(item.fieldLabel))
  540:         .filter(Boolean),
  541:     ),
  542:   ).slice(0, 8);
  543: 
  544:   return {
  545:     confidence: finalConfidence,
  546:     reportIntent: normalizedPrompt || "إنشاء تقرير مخصص",
  547:     reportFamily,
  548:     reasoningSummary:
  549:       finalConfidence >= 0.75
  550:         ? "وصف التقرير واضح بدرجة كافية ويمكن توليد نموذج عملي مباشر."
  551:         : "الوصف يحتاج بعض التحديد حتى تظهر الحقول الأقرب لطبيعة التقرير.",
  552:     missingContext,
  553:     coreFieldHints,
  554:     needsClarification,
  555:     questions: buildFallbackClarificationQuestions(
  556:       { missingContext, reportFamily },
  557:       finalConfidence < 0.45,
  558:     ),
  559:   };
  560: }
  561: 
  562: function normalizeIntentAnalysis(
  563:   value: unknown,
  564:   fallback: IntentAnalysis,
  565: ): IntentAnalysis {
  566:   const record = value && typeof value === "object" ? (value as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  567:   const confidence = clampConfidence(record.confidence, fallback.confidence);
  568:   const reportIntent = cleanText(record.reportIntent) || fallback.reportIntent;
  569:   const reportFamily = cleanText(record.reportFamily) || fallback.reportFamily;
  570:   const reasoningSummary =
  571:     cleanText(record.reasoningSummary) || fallback.reasoningSummary;
  572:   const missingContext = normalizeStringArray(record.missingContext);
  573:   const coreFieldHints = normalizeStringArray(record.coreFieldHints).slice(0, 10);
  574:   const derivedNeedsClarification = confidence < 0.75;
  575:   const needsClarification =
  576:     confidence >= 0.75
  577:       ? false
  578:       : typeof record.needsClarification === "boolean"
  579:         ? record.needsClarification || derivedNeedsClarification
  580:         : derivedNeedsClarification;
  581:   const normalizedQuestions = Array.isArray(record.questions)
  582:     ? record.questions
  583:         .map((question, index) => normalizeClarificationQuestion(question, index))
  584:         .filter(Boolean) as ClarificationQuestion[]
  585:     : [];
  586: 
  587:   const questions =
  588:     needsClarification && normalizedQuestions.length
  589:       ? normalizedQuestions.slice(0, confidence < 0.45 ? 3 : 4)
  590:       : needsClarification
  591:         ? buildFallbackClarificationQuestions(
  592:             {
  593:               missingContext: missingContext.length
  594:                 ? missingContext
  595:                 : fallback.missingContext,
  596:               reportFamily,
  597:             },
  598:             confidence < 0.45,
  599:           )
  600:         : [];
  601: 
  602:   return {
  603:     confidence,
  604:     reportIntent,
  605:     reportFamily,
  606:     reasoningSummary,
  607:     missingContext: missingContext.length ? missingContext : fallback.missingContext,
  608:     coreFieldHints: coreFieldHints.length ? coreFieldHints : fallback.coreFieldHints,
  609:     needsClarification,
  610:     questions,
  611:   };
  612: }
  613: 
  614: function resolveAnalysisForGeneration({
  615:   previousAnalysis,
  616:   fallback,
  617: }: {
  618:   previousAnalysis: unknown;
  619:   fallback: IntentAnalysis;
  620: }) {
  621:   if (!previousAnalysis || typeof previousAnalysis !== "object") {
  622:     return {
  623:       ...fallback,
  624:       needsClarification: false,
  625:       questions: [],
  626:     };
  627:   }
  628: 
  629:   const record = previousAnalysis as Record<string, unknown>;
  630: 
  631:   return {
  632:     ...fallback,
  633:     confidence: clampConfidence(record.confidence, fallback.confidence),
  634:     reportIntent: cleanText(record.reportIntent) || fallback.reportIntent,
  635:     reportFamily: cleanText(record.reportFamily) || fallback.reportFamily,
  636:     reasoningSummary:
  637:       cleanText(record.reasoningSummary) || fallback.reasoningSummary,
  638:     missingContext: normalizeStringArray(record.missingContext).length
  639:       ? normalizeStringArray(record.missingContext)
  640:       : fallback.missingContext,
  641:     coreFieldHints: normalizeStringArray(record.coreFieldHints).length
  642:       ? normalizeStringArray(record.coreFieldHints)
  643:       : fallback.coreFieldHints,
  644:     needsClarification: false,
  645:     questions: [],
  646:   };
  647: }

  756: function buildSchemaPrompt({
  757:   prompt,
  758:   clarificationAnswers,
  759:   hasClarificationRound,
  760:   analysis,
  761:   knowledge,
  762:   profileContext,
  763: }: {
  764:   prompt: string;
  765:   clarificationAnswers: Record<string, string>;
  766:   hasClarificationRound: boolean;
  767:   analysis: IntentAnalysis;
  768:   knowledge: ReturnType<typeof findRelevantAiReportKnowledge>;
  769:   profileContext: ReturnType<typeof buildProfileContext>;
  770: }) {
  771:   const knowledgeSummary = buildKnowledgeSummary(knowledge);
  772:   const clarificationBlock = Object.keys(clarificationAnswers).length
  773:     ? Object.entries(clarificationAnswers)
  774:         .map(([key, value]) =>
  775:           !value.trim() || isSuggestiveAnswer(value)
  776:             ? `- ${key}: المعلم طلب من النظام اقتراح القيمة المناسبة لهذا السؤال.`
  777:             : `- ${key}: ${value}`,
  778:         )
  779:         .join("\n")
  780:     : "لا توجد إجابات توضيح إضافية.";
  781:   const topFieldHints =
  782:     analysis.coreFieldHints.length > 0
  783:       ? analysis.coreFieldHints.map((item, index) => `${index + 1}. ${item}`).join("\n")
  784:       : "لا توجد تلميحات حاسمة إضافية.";
  785: 
  786:   return `
  787: الوصف الأساسي للمستخدم:
  788: ${prompt}
  789: 
  790: إجابات التوضيح - إن وجدت:
  791: ${clarificationBlock}
  792: 
  793: تحليل النية:
  794: - نية التقرير: ${analysis.reportIntent}
  795: - عائلة التقرير: ${analysis.reportFamily}
  796: - ملخص الاستدلال: ${analysis.reasoningSummary}
  797: 
  798: تلميحات الحقول الأساسية:
  799: ${topFieldHints}
  800: 
  801: سياق ملف المستخدم:
  802: ${profileContext.block}
  803: 
  804: أقرب التقارير في بنك المعرفة:
  805: ${knowledgeSummary.topReportsBlock}
  806: 
  807: الحقول المرشحة من بنك المعرفة:
  808: ${knowledgeSummary.fieldHintsBlock}
  809: 
  810: القيم والخيارات المرشحة من بنك المعرفة:
  811: ${knowledgeSummary.optionHintsBlock}
  812: 
  813: تعليمات صارمة:
  814: - أنشئ نموذج تقرير عمليًا ومناسبًا للمعلمين داخل المنصة.
  815: - أنشئ قسمًا واحدًا فقط بعنوان "بيانات التقرير المخصص".
  816: - اجعل النموذج في خطوة واحدة فقط.
  817: - اجعل عدد الحقول بين 6 و14 بحسب تعقيد التقرير.
  818: - جميع الحقول اختيارية بالكامل. required=false دائمًا.
  819: - أي حقل من النوع select أو multi_select أو radio يجب أن يحتوي على 4 إلى 8 خيارات مفيدة ومرتبطة بالحقل نفسه.
  820: - فضّل بناء الخيارات من قيم بنك المعرفة المرشحة أولًا.
  821: - إذا لم تكفِ قيم بنك المعرفة، يمكنك إضافة خيارات تعليمية منطقية خاصة بالحقل نفسه، وليست عامة أو سطحية.
  822: - لا تترك أي حقل select أو multi_select أو radio بدون خيارات.
  823: - إذا لم تستطع توليد 4 خيارات ذات معنى على الأقل، فحوّل الحقل إلى textarea بدل select.
  824: - لا تتجاوز 8 خيارات لأي حقل اختياري.
  825: - لا تنشئ أي حقل شواهد أو مرفقات أو رفع ملفات أو صور.
  826: - لا تنشئ الحقل "الشواهد المقترحة" ولا أي حقل بالمعنى نفسه.
  827: - الشواهد مدعومة في المنصة بشكل منفصل، لذلك لا تمثلها داخل الـ schema.
  828: - لا تنشئ حقولًا غير مرتبطة بعائلة التقرير أو بنيته الطبيعية.
  829: - لا تفرض المادة أو الصف أو الحضور أو التوقيع إلا إذا كانت النية تستدعيها بوضوح.
  830: - استخدم select أو multi_select أو radio فقط عندما تكون الخيارات مفيدة ومسنودة من المرشحات أو بالاستدلال التعليمي الواضح.
  831: - إذا احتجت خيارًا مفتوحًا فأضف "أخرى" مرة واحدة فقط بقيمة other.
  832: - استخدم text وtextarea وdate وnumber وselect وmulti_select فقط عند الحاجة الطبيعية.
  833: - استخدم أسماء عربية واضحة للحقول، ومفاتيح english_snake_case.
  834: - ${hasClarificationRound ? "بعد مرحلة التوضيح ممنوع طلب توضيح إضافي. يجب توليد نموذج عملي بأفضل استنتاج." : "إذا ظهرت حاجة حقيقية للتوضيح فهي تُعالج قبل هذه المرحلة."}
  835: - اجعل المخرجات JSON فقط.
  836:   `.trim();
  837: }

  839: function countSchemaFields(schema: CustomReportSchema) {
  840:   return schema.sections.reduce(
  841:     (total, section) => total + section.fields.length,
  842:     0,
  843:   );
  844: }
  845: 
  846: function buildFallbackOptions(
  847:   label: string,
  848:   knowledge: ReturnType<typeof findRelevantAiReportKnowledge>,
  849: ) {
  850:   const normalizedLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(label);
  851:   const options = Array.from(
  852:     new Set(
  853:       knowledge.items
  854:         .filter((item) => {
  855:           const itemLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(item.fieldLabel);
  856:           return (
  857:             itemLabel === normalizedLabel ||
  858:             itemLabel.includes(normalizedLabel) ||
  859:             normalizedLabel.includes(itemLabel)
  860:           );
  861:         })
  862:         .map((item) => sanitizeAiReportText(item.optionLabel))
  863:         .filter(Boolean)
  864:         .filter((option) => !isEvidenceLikeLabel(option)),
  865:     ),
  866:   ).slice(0, 5);
  867: 
  868:   return options.map((option, index) => ({
  869:     label: option,
  870:     value: normalizeSnakeCase(option, `option_${index + 1}`),
  871:   }));
  872: }
  873: 
  874: function pickFallbackFieldKey(label: string, index: number) {
  875:   const normalizedLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(label);
  876: 
  877:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("تاريخ")) return "report_date";
  878:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("عنوان") || normalizedLabel.includes("اسم")) {
  879:     return "report_subject";
  880:   }
  881:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("هدف")) return "report_goal";
  882:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("تنفيذ") || normalizedLabel.includes("اجراء")) {
  883:     return "implemented_actions";
  884:   }
  885:   if (
  886:     normalizedLabel.includes("نتائج") ||
  887:     normalizedLabel.includes("مخرجات") ||
  888:     normalizedLabel.includes("اثر")
  889:   ) {
  890:     return "results_summary";
  891:   }
  892:   if (
  893:     normalizedLabel.includes("فجوات") ||
  894:     normalizedLabel.includes("تحديات") ||
  895:     normalizedLabel.includes("معوقات")
  896:   ) {
  897:     return "gaps_or_challenges";
  898:   }
  899:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("توصيات")) return "recommendations";
  900:   if (normalizedLabel.includes("ملاحظات")) return "additional_notes";
  901: 
  902:   return `custom_field_${index + 1}`;
  903: }
  904: 
  905: function pickFallbackFieldType(label: string, options: Array<{ label: string; value: string }>) {
  906:   const normalizedLabel = normalizeAiReportArabicText(label);
  907: 
  908:   if (
  909:     normalizedLabel.includes("تاريخ") ||
  910:     normalizedLabel.includes("موعد") ||
  911:     normalizedLabel.includes("يوم")
  912:   ) {
  913:     return "date" as const;
  914:   }
  915: 
  916:   if (
  917:     normalizedLabel.includes("نسبة") ||
  918:     normalizedLabel.includes("عدد") ||
  919:     normalizedLabel.includes("درجة") ||
  920:     normalizedLabel.includes("متوسط")
  921:   ) {
  922:     return "number" as const;
  923:   }
  924: 
  925:   if (
  926:     options.length >= 4 &&
  927:     /محاور|محور|مجالات|اجراءات|إجراءات|توصيات|اسباب|أسباب|أهداف|اهداف/.test(label)
  928:   ) {
  929:     return "multi_select" as const;
  930:   }
  931: 
  932:   if (options.length >= 4) {
  933:     return "select" as const;
  934:   }
  935: 
  936:   if (
  937:     /وصف|ملخص|خلاصة|نتائج|توصيات|ملاحظات|إجراءات|تنفيذ|فجوات|تحديات|مقترحات/.test(
  938:       label,
  939:     )
  940:   ) {
  941:     return "textarea" as const;
  942:   }
  943: 
  944:   return "text" as const;
  945: }
  946: 
  947: function buildHeuristicFallbackSchema({
  948:   prompt,
  949:   analysis,
  950:   knowledge,
  951: }: {
  952:   prompt: string;
  953:   analysis: IntentAnalysis;
  954:   knowledge: ReturnType<typeof findRelevantAiReportKnowledge>;
  955: }): CustomReportSchema {
  956:   const candidateLabels = Array.from(
  957:     new Set(
  958:       knowledge.items
  959:         .map((item) => sanitizeAiReportText(item.fieldLabel))
  960:         .filter(Boolean)
  961:         .filter((label) => !isEvidenceLikeLabel(label)),
  962:     ),
  963:   ).slice(0, 8);
  964: 
  965:   const genericLabels = [
  966:     "موضوع التقرير",
  967:     "الهدف من التقرير",
  968:     "تاريخ التقرير",
  969:     "وصف التنفيذ أو الحدث",
  970:     "أبرز النتائج أو المخرجات",
  971:     "التحديات أو الفجوات",
  972:     "التوصيات",
  973:     "ملاحظات إضافية",
  974:   ];
  975: 
  976:   const mergedLabels = Array.from(
  977:     new Set([...candidateLabels, ...genericLabels]),
  978:   ).slice(0, 8);
  979: 
  980:   return {
  981:     title:
  982:       sanitizeAiReportText(analysis.reportIntent) ||
  983:       `تقرير ${sanitizeAiReportText(analysis.reportFamily) || "مخصص"}`,
  984:     description: prompt,
  985:     version: 1,
  986:     sections: [
  987:       {
  988:         id: "ai_report_section_1",
  989:         title: "بيانات التقرير المخصص",
  990:         description: analysis.reasoningSummary || "",
  991:         order: 1,
  992:         fields: (() => {
  993:           const usedKeys = new Set<string>();
  994: 
  995:           return mergedLabels.map((label, index) => {
  996:             const options = buildFallbackOptions(label, knowledge);
  997:             const type = pickFallbackFieldType(label, options);
  998:             const baseKey = pickFallbackFieldKey(label, index);
  999:             let key = baseKey;
 1000: 
 1001:             while (usedKeys.has(key)) {
 1002:               key = `${baseKey}_${usedKeys.size + 1}`;
 1003:             }
 1004: 
 1005:             usedKeys.add(key);
 1006: 
 1007:             return {
 1008:               key,
 1009:               label,
 1010:               type,
 1011:               required: false,
 1012:               placeholder:
 1013:                 type === "textarea"
 1014:                   ? `اكتب ${label} هنا`
 1015:                   : type === "date"
 1016:                     ? ""
 1017:                     : `أدخل ${label}`,
 1018:               helpText: "",
 1019:               reportLabel: label,
 1020:               showInReport: true,
 1021:               order: index + 1,
 1022:               options:
 1023:                 type === "select" || type === "multi_select" ? options : [],
 1024:             };
 1025:           });
 1026:         })(),
 1027:       },
 1028:     ],
 1029:   };
 1030: }
 1031: 
 1032: function buildGenerationContext(
 1033:   prompt: string,
 1034:   profileContext: ReturnType<typeof buildProfileContext>,
 1035: ): CustomReportGenerationContext {
 1036:   return {
 1037:     mode: "create",
 1038:     previousPrompt: prompt,
 1039:     stages: profileContext.stages,
 1040:     specialties: profileContext.specialties,
 1041:     subjects: profileContext.subjects,
 1042:   };
 1043: }
 1044: 
 1045: export async function POST(request: Request) {
 1046:   const authContext = await requireCustomReportContext();
 1047: 
 1048:   if (!authContext.ok) {
 1049:     return NextResponse.json(
 1050:       { success: false, error: authContext.message },
 1051:       { status: authContext.status },
 1052:     );
 1053:   }
 1054: 
 1055:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
 1056:   const prompt = cleanText(body?.prompt);
 1057: 
 1058:   if (prompt.length < 3) {
 1059:     return NextResponse.json(
 1060:       {
 1061:         success: false,
 1062:         error: "اكتب وصفًا مختصرًا للتقرير حتى يتمكن النظام من مساعدتك.",
 1063:       },
 1064:       { status: 400 },
 1065:     );
 1066:   }
 1067: 
 1068:   const clarificationAnswers = normalizeClarificationAnswers(
 1069:     body?.clarificationAnswers,
 1070:   );
 1071:   const previousAnalysis = body?.previousAnalysis;
 1072:   const hasClarificationRound =
 1073:     Object.keys(clarificationAnswers).length > 0 || Boolean(previousAnalysis);
 1074:   const effectivePrompt = buildCombinedPrompt(prompt, clarificationAnswers);
 1075:   const knowledge = findRelevantAiReportKnowledge({
 1076:     prompt: effectivePrompt,
 1077:     limit: 150,
 1078:   });
 1079:   const profileContext = buildProfileContext(authContext.user);
 1080:   const analysis = hasClarificationRound
 1081:     ? resolveAnalysisForGeneration({
 1082:         previousAnalysis,
 1083:         fallback: buildFallbackIntentAnalysis({
 1084:           prompt: effectivePrompt,
 1085:           knowledge,
 1086:         }),
 1087:       })
 1088:     : await analyzeIntent({
 1089:         prompt,
 1090:         effectivePrompt,
 1091:         previousAnalysis,
 1092:         knowledge,
 1093:         profileContext,
 1094:       });
 1095: 
 1096:   if (!hasClarificationRound && analysis.needsClarification) {
 1097:     return NextResponse.json({
 1098:       success: true,
 1099:       needsClarification: true,
 1100:       confidence: analysis.confidence,
 1101:       reportIntent: analysis.reportIntent,
 1102:       reportFamily: analysis.reportFamily,
 1103:       reasoningSummary: analysis.reasoningSummary,
 1104:       missingContext: analysis.missingContext,
 1105:       coreFieldHints: analysis.coreFieldHints,
 1106:       questions: analysis.questions,
 1107:     });
 1108:   }
 1109: 
 1110:   const guidedPrompt = buildSchemaPrompt({
 1111:     prompt,
 1112:     clarificationAnswers,
 1113:     hasClarificationRound,
 1114:     analysis,
 1115:     knowledge,
 1116:     profileContext,
 1117:   });
 1118: 
 1119:   const result = await generateCustomReportSchema(
 1120:     guidedPrompt,
 1121:     buildGenerationContext(effectivePrompt, profileContext),
 1122:   );
 1123:   const nextSchema =
 1124:     result.source === "FALLBACK" || countSchemaFields(result.schema) < 4
 1125:       ? buildHeuristicFallbackSchema({
 1126:           prompt,
 1127:           analysis,
 1128:           knowledge,
 1129:         })
 1130:       : result.schema;
 1131:   const sanitizedSchema = normalizeAiReportSchema(
 1132:     sanitizeAiReportSchema(nextSchema),
 1133:   );
 1134: 
 1135:   return NextResponse.json({
 1136:     success: true,
 1137:     needsClarification: false,
 1138:     confidence: analysis.confidence,
 1139:     reportIntent: analysis.reportIntent,
 1140:     reportFamily: analysis.reportFamily,
 1141:     reasoningSummary: analysis.reasoningSummary,
 1142:     missingContext: analysis.missingContext,
 1143:     coreFieldHints: analysis.coreFieldHints,
 1144:     schema: sanitizedSchema,
 1145:   });
 1146: }

   91: function normalizeKeyCandidate(value: string) {
   92:   return value
   93:     .trim()
   94:     .toLowerCase()
   95:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9_]+/g, "_")
   96:     .replace(/^_+|_+$/g, "");

   99: function uniqueFieldKey(label: string, index: number, usedKeys: Set<string>) {
  100:   const candidate = normalizeKeyCandidate(label);
  101:   const base = candidate || `ai_report2_field_${index + 1}`;
  102: 
  103:   let nextKey = base;
  104:   let suffix = 2;
  105: 
  106:   while (usedKeys.has(nextKey)) {
  107:     nextKey = `${base}_${suffix}`;
  108:     suffix += 1;
  109:   }
  110: 
  111:   usedKeys.add(nextKey);
  112:   return nextKey;
  113: }

  152: function normalizeFieldsToSchema({
  153:   prompt,
  154:   result,
  155: }: {
  156:   prompt: string;
  157:   result: AiReport2ModelResult;
  158: }): CustomReportSchema | null {
  159:   const rawSchema =
  160:     result.schema && typeof result.schema === "object"
  161:       ? (result.schema as Record<string, unknown>)
  162:       : null;
  163: 
  164:   const rawFields = Array.isArray(result.fields)
  165:     ? result.fields
  166:     : rawSchema && Array.isArray(rawSchema.fields)
  167:       ? rawSchema.fields
  168:       : rawSchema &&
  169:           Array.isArray(rawSchema.sections) &&
  170:           rawSchema.sections[0] &&
  171:           typeof rawSchema.sections[0] === "object" &&
  172:           Array.isArray((rawSchema.sections[0] as Record<string, unknown>).fields)
  173:         ? ((rawSchema.sections[0] as Record<string, unknown>).fields as unknown[])
  174:         : [];
  175: 
  176:   if (!rawFields.length) {
  177:     return null;
  178:   }
  179: 
  180:   const usedKeys = new Set<string>();
  181:   const fields = rawFields
  182:     .map<CustomReportField | null>((field, index) => {
  183:       if (!field || typeof field !== "object") {
  184:         return null;
  185:       }
  186: 
  187:       const record = field as AiReport2FieldSuggestion;
  188:       const label = cleanText(record.label);
  189: 
  190:       if (!label) {
  191:         return null;
  192:       }
  193: 
  194:       const options = normalizeTeacherOptions(record.options, MAX_OPTIONS_PER_FIELD);
  195:       const type = classifyTeacherFieldType(label, options.length);
  196:       const finalOptions: CustomReportOption[] =
  197:         type === "multi_select" ? options : [];
  198: 
  199:       return {
  200:         key: uniqueFieldKey(cleanText(record.key) || label, index, usedKeys),
  201:         label,
  202:         type,
  203:         required: false,
  204:         placeholder:
  205:           type === "date"
  206:             ? ""
  207:             : type === ("number" as CustomReportField["type"])
  208:               ? "أدخل الرقم فقط"
  209:               : type === "textarea"
  210:                 ? cleanText(record.placeholder) || `اكتب ${label}`
  211:                 : "",
  212:         helpText:
  213:           type === "multi_select"
  214:             ? "يمكن اختيار أكثر من قيمة، وجميع الحقول اختيارية."
  215:             : cleanText(record.helpText) || "حقل اختياري يعبئه المعلم حسب سياق التقرير.",
  216:         reportLabel: label,
  217:         showInReport: true,
  218:         order: index + 1,
  219:         options: finalOptions,
  220:       };
  221:     })
  222:     .filter((field): field is CustomReportField => field !== null)
  223:     .slice(0, MAX_FIELDS);
  224: 
  225:   if (fields.length < 2) {
  226:     return null;
  227:   }
  228: 
  229:   const title =
  230:     rawSchema && cleanText(rawSchema.title)
  231:       ? cleanText(rawSchema.title)
  232:       : `تقرير ذكي تجريبي - ${prompt.slice(0, 45)}`;
  233: 
  234:   const description =
  235:     rawSchema && cleanText(rawSchema.description)
  236:       ? cleanText(rawSchema.description)
  237:       : "نموذج تجريبي مبني بواسطة محرك فهم نية المعلم.";
  238: 
  239:   return {
  240:     title,
  241:     description,
  242:     version: 1,
  243:     sections: [
  244:       {
  245:         id: "ai_report2_section_1",
  246:         title: "بيانات التقرير الذكي التجريبي",
  247:         description,
  248:         order: 1,
  249:         fields,
  250:       },
  251:     ],
  252:   };
  253: }
  254: 
  255: function groupKnowledgeForModel(knowledge: AiReportKnowledgeSearchResult) {
  256:   const map = new Map<
  257:     string,
  258:     {
  259:       reportSlug: string;
  260:       reportName: string;
  261:       performanceElement: string;
  262:       reportCategory: string;
  263:       category: string;
  264:       fieldKey: string;
  265:       fieldLabel: string;
  266:       inputType: string;
  267:       options: string[];
  268:     }
  269:   >();
  270: 
  271:   for (const item of knowledge.items.slice(0, MAX_KNOWLEDGE_ITEMS_FOR_MODEL)) {
  272:     const fieldLabel = cleanText(item.fieldLabel || item.category || "حقل");
  273:     const fieldKey = cleanText(item.fieldKey || fieldLabel);
  274:     const key = `${item.reportSlug}::${fieldKey}::${fieldLabel}`;
  275: 
  276:     const existing =
  277:       map.get(key) ||
  278:       {
  279:         reportSlug: item.reportSlug,
  280:         reportName: item.reportName,
  281:         performanceElement: item.performanceElement,
  282:         reportCategory: item.reportCategory,
  283:         category: item.category,
  284:         fieldKey,
  285:         fieldLabel,
  286:         inputType: item.inputType,
  287:         options: [],
  288:       };
  289: 
  290:     const option = cleanText(item.optionLabel);
  291: 
  292:     if (
  293:       item.sourceType === "value_bank" &&
  294:       option &&
  295:       !existing.options.includes(option)
  296:     ) {
  297:       existing.options.push(option);
  298:     }
  299: 
  300:     map.set(key, existing);
  301:   }
  302: 
  303:   return Array.from(map.values()).slice(0, 120);
  304: }

  350:       options: field.options.slice(0, MAX_OPTIONS_PER_FIELD),

  352:   };

  491: function countBankAndCustomUsage(schema: CustomReportSchema) {
  492:   let bankValuesUsed = 0;
  493:   let customValuesUsed = 0;
  494: 
  495:   for (const field of schema.sections.flatMap((section) => section.fields)) {
  496:     if (field.options?.length) {
  497:       bankValuesUsed += field.options.length;
  498:     } else {
  499:       customValuesUsed += 1;
  500:     }
  501:   }
  502: 
  503:   return {
  504:     bankValuesUsed,
  505:     customValuesUsed,
  506:   };
  507: }

  509: async function buildBestSchema({
  510:   prompt,
  511:   knowledge,
  512:   analysis,
  513:   clarificationContext,
  514: }: {
  515:   prompt: string;
  516:   knowledge: AiReportKnowledgeSearchResult;
  517:   analysis: TeacherIntentAnalysis;
  518:   clarificationContext?: string;
  519: }) {
  520:   let modelResult: AiReport2ModelResult | null = null;
  521:   let schema: CustomReportSchema | null = null;
  522: 
  523:   try {
  524:     modelResult = await buildDeepSeekLedSchema({
  525:       prompt,
  526:       knowledge,
  527:       analysis,
  528:       clarificationContext,
  529:     });
  530: 
  531:     schema = normalizeFieldsToSchema({
  532:       prompt,
  533:       result: modelResult,
  534:     });
  535:   } catch {
  536:     modelResult = null;
  537:     schema = null;
  538:   }
  539: 
  540:   let nextSchema =
  541:     schema && countSchemaFields(schema) >= 2
  542:       ? schema
  543:       : buildFallbackSchemaFromTeacherIntent({
  544:           prompt,
  545:           knowledge,
  546:           analysis,
  547:         });
  548: 
  549:   nextSchema = enforceTeacherIntentSchema({
  550:     schema: nextSchema,
  551:     prompt,
  552:     knowledge,
  553:     analysis,
  554:   });
  555: 
  556:   let quality = evaluateTeacherSchemaFit({
  557:     schema: nextSchema,
  558:     analysis,
  559:   });
  560: 
  561:   if (!quality.passed) {
  562:     try {
  563:       const retryResult = await buildDeepSeekLedSchema({
  564:         prompt,
  565:         knowledge,
  566:         analysis,
  567:         clarificationContext,
  568:         repairInstruction: buildTeacherRepairInstruction({
  569:           score: quality.score,
  570:           issues: quality.issues,
  571:           analysis,
  572:         }),
  573:       });
  574: 
  575:       const retrySchema = normalizeFieldsToSchema({
  576:         prompt,
  577:         result: retryResult,
  578:       });
  579: 
  580:       if (retrySchema) {
  581:         const guardedRetrySchema = enforceTeacherIntentSchema({
  582:           schema: retrySchema,
  583:           prompt,
  584:           knowledge,
  585:           analysis,
  586:         });
  587: 
  588:         const retryQuality = evaluateTeacherSchemaFit({
  589:           schema: guardedRetrySchema,
  590:           analysis,
  591:         });
  592: 
  593:         if (retryQuality.score >= quality.score) {
  594:           modelResult = retryResult;
  595:           nextSchema = guardedRetrySchema;
  596:           quality = retryQuality;
  597:         }
  598:       }
  599:     } catch {
  600:       // يبقى النموذج الأول بعد الحراسة.
  601:     }
  602:   }
  603: 
  604:   return {
  605:     modelResult,
  606:     schema: nextSchema,
  607:     quality,
  608:   };
  609: }
  610: 
  611: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  612:   const authContext = await requireCustomReportContext();
  613: 
  614:   if (!authContext.ok) {
  615:     return NextResponse.json(
  616:       { success: false, error: authContext.message },
  617:       { status: authContext.status },
  618:     );
  619:   }
  620: 
  621:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
  622:   const prompt = cleanText(body?.prompt);
  623:   const performanceElementScope = cleanText(body?.performanceElementScope);
  624:   const clarificationAnswers = normalizeTeacherClarificationAnswers(
  625:     body?.clarificationAnswers,
  626:   );
  627:   const clarificationContext = formatTeacherClarificationAnswers(
  628:     clarificationAnswers,
  629:   );
  630: 
  631:   if (prompt.length < 3) {
  632:     return NextResponse.json(
  633:       {
  634:         success: false,
  635:         error: "اكتب وصفًا مختصرًا للتقرير المطلوب.",
  636:       },
  637:       { status: 400 },
  638:     );
  639:   }
  640: 
  641:   const analysis = analyzeTeacherIntent({
  642:     prompt,
  643:     performanceElementScope,
  644:   });
  645: 
  646:   const retrievalPrompt = buildTeacherRetrievalPrompt(analysis);
  647: 
  648:   const knowledge = findRelevantAiReportKnowledge({
  649:     prompt: retrievalPrompt,
  650:     limit: 520,
  651:   });
  652: 
  653:   const { modelResult, schema, quality } = await buildBestSchema({
  654:     prompt,
  655:     knowledge,
  656:     analysis,
  657:     clarificationContext,
  658:   });
  659: 
  660:   const selectedReports =
  661:     normalizeSelectedReports(modelResult?.selectedReports).length > 0
  662:       ? normalizeSelectedReports(modelResult?.selectedReports)
  663:       : knowledge.topReports.slice(0, 3).map((report) => ({
  664:           reportSlug: report.reportSlug,
  665:           reportName: report.reportName,
  666:           reason: "أقرب تقرير حسب نية المعلم وعنصر الأداء.",
  667:           confidence: 0.66,
  668:         }));
  669: 
  670:   const valueJudgment = await judgeTeacherSchemaValues({
  671:     schema,
  672:     analysis,
  673:   });
  674: 
  675:   const polishedSchema = polishTeacherSchemaSemantics({
  676:     schema: valueJudgment.schema,
  677:     analysis,
  678:   });
  679: 
  680:   const sanitizedSchema = normalizeAiReportSchema(
  681:     sanitizeAiReportSchema(polishedSchema),
  682:   );
  683: 
  684:   const usage = countBankAndCustomUsage(sanitizedSchema);
  685: 
  686:   return NextResponse.json({
  687:     success: true,
  688:     confidence: Math.max(
  689:       toConfidence(modelResult?.confidence, selectedReports[0]?.confidence || 0.66),
  690:       analysis.confidence,
  691:     ),
  692:     intentFamily: cleanText(modelResult?.intentFamily) || analysis.primaryIntent.family,
  693:     teacherIntent:
  694:       cleanText(modelResult?.teacherIntent) || analysis.primaryIntent.label,
  695:     performanceElementScope: analysis.performanceElementScope,
  696:     performanceElement:
  697:       cleanText(modelResult?.performanceElement) ||
  698:       analysis.resolvedPerformanceElementLabel,
  699:     reportIntent:
  700:       cleanText(modelResult?.reportIntent) ||
  701:       `تقرير ${analysis.primaryIntent.label}`,
  702:     reasoningSummary:
  703:       cleanText(modelResult?.reasoningSummary) ||
  704:       "تم بناء النموذج بناءً على فهم نية المعلم، وعنصر الأداء، والقيم الأقرب من البنك.",
  705:     teacherIntentAnalysis: {
  706:       action: analysis.teacherAction,
  707:       audience: analysis.teacherAudience,
  708:       purpose: analysis.teacherPurpose,
  709:       selectedPerformanceElementLabel: analysis.selectedPerformanceElementLabel,
  710:       resolvedPerformanceElementLabel: analysis.resolvedPerformanceElementLabel,
  711:       candidateIntents: analysis.candidateIntents,
  712:     },
  713:     satisfactionScore: Math.round(quality.score * 100),
  714:     satisfactionIssues: quality.issues,
  715:     valueJudgeApplied: valueJudgment.applied,
  716:     valueJudgeSummary: valueJudgment.summary,
  717:     rejectedValues: valueJudgment.rejectedValues,
  718:     clarificationAnswersApplied: clarificationAnswers.length,
  719:     selectedReports,
  720:     bankValuesUsed: usage.bankValuesUsed,
  721:     customValuesUsed: usage.customValuesUsed,
  722:     schema: sanitizedSchema,
  723:   });
  724: }

   21: function toRuntimeFieldType(type: string): FieldType {
   22:   const map: Record<string, FieldType> = {
   23:     text: FieldType.TEXT,
   24:     textarea: FieldType.TEXTAREA,
   25:     number: FieldType.NUMBER,
   26:     date: FieldType.DATE,
   27:     select: FieldType.SELECT,
   28:     multi_select: FieldType.MULTI_SELECT,
   29:     checkbox: FieldType.CHECKBOX,
   30:     radio: FieldType.RADIO,
   31:   };
   32: 
   33:   return map[type] || FieldType.TEXT;
   34: }
   35: 
   36: function optionLabel(field: CustomReportField, value: string) {
   37:   return field.options?.find((option) => option.value === value)?.label || value;
   38: }
   39: 
   40: function buildCaseValue(
   41:   field: CustomReportField,
   42:   values: CustomReportValues,
   43:   fieldIdByKey: Map<string, string>,
   44: ) {
   45:   const rawValue = values[field.key];
   46:   const otherValue = values[`${field.key}__other`];
   47:   const fieldId = fieldIdByKey.get(field.key) || undefined;
   48: 
   49:   if (Array.isArray(rawValue)) {
   50:     const labels = rawValue.map((item) =>
   51:       item === "other" && otherValue
   52:         ? `أخرى: ${String(otherValue)}`
   53:         : optionLabel(field, item),
   54:     );
   55: 
   56:     return {
   57:       fieldId,
   58:       fieldKey: field.key,
   59:       value: labels.length ? labels.join("، ") : null,
   60:       jsonValue: labels.length ? labels : undefined,
   61:     };
   62:   }
   63: 
   64:   if (typeof rawValue === "boolean") {
   65:     return {
   66:       fieldId,
   67:       fieldKey: field.key,
   68:       value: rawValue ? "نعم" : "لا",
   69:       jsonValue: undefined,
   70:     };
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   if (rawValue === "other" && otherValue) {
   74:     return {
   75:       fieldId,
   76:       fieldKey: field.key,
   77:       value: `أخرى: ${String(otherValue)}`,
   78:       jsonValue: {
   79:         value: "أخرى",
   80:         other: String(otherValue),
   81:       },
   82:     };
   83:   }
   84: 
   85:   if (typeof rawValue === "string") {
   86:     const value = rawValue ? optionLabel(field, rawValue) : null;
   87: 
   88:     return {
   89:       fieldId,
   90:       fieldKey: field.key,
   91:       value,
   92:       jsonValue: undefined,
   93:     };
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   if (typeof rawValue === "number") {
   97:     return {
   98:       fieldId,
   99:       fieldKey: field.key,
  100:       value: String(rawValue),
  101:       jsonValue: undefined,
  102:     };
  103:   }
  104: 
  105:   return {
  106:     fieldId,
  107:     fieldKey: field.key,
  108:     value: null,
  109:     jsonValue: undefined,
  110:   };
  111: }
  112: 
  113: function flattenCaseValues(
  114:   schema: CustomReportSchema,
  115:   values: CustomReportValues,
  116:   fieldIdByKey: Map<string, string>,
  117: ) {
  118:   return schema.sections
  119:     .flatMap((section) => section.fields)
  120:     .map((field) => buildCaseValue(field, values, fieldIdByKey))
  121:     .filter((item) => item.value !== null || item.jsonValue !== undefined);
  122: }
  123: 
  124: async function getCustomReportService() {
  125:   await ensureDefaultPlatformServices();
  126: 
  127:   return prisma.service.findUnique({
  128:     where: {
  129:       slug: CUSTOM_REPORT_SERVICE_SLUG,
  130:     },
  131:     select: {
  132:       id: true,
  133:       slug: true,
  134:     },
  135:   });
  136: }
  137: 
  138: async function createRuntimeWorkflow(
  139:   tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
  140:   serviceId: string,
  141:   schema: CustomReportSchema,
  142: ) {
  143:   return tx.workflow.create({
  144:     data: {
  145:       serviceId,
  146:       name: schema.title,
  147:       version: 1,
  148:       status: WorkflowStatus.ACTIVE,
  149:       isActive: false,
  150:       workflowType: "custom-report",
  151:       studentPickerMode: StudentPickerMode.DISABLED,
  152:       evidenceMode: WorkflowEvidenceMode.DISABLED,
  153:       steps: {
  154:         create: schema.sections.map((section, sectionIndex) => ({
  155:           title: section.title,
  156:           description: section.description || null,
  157:           order: section.order || sectionIndex + 1,
  158:           fields: {
  159:             create: section.fields.map((field, fieldIndex) => ({
  160:               key: field.key,
  161:               label: field.label,
  162:               type: toRuntimeFieldType(field.type),
  163:               placeholder: field.placeholder || null,
  164:               helpText: field.helpText || null,
  165:               isRequired: Boolean(field.required),
  166:               order: field.order || fieldIndex + 1,
  167:               dependsOnFieldKey: null,
  168:               linkedToValue: null,
  169:               allowOther: Boolean(field.options?.some((option) => option.value === "other")),
  170:               isRepeater: false,
  171:               options: {
  172:                 create: (field.options || []).map((option, optionIndex) => ({
  173:                   label: option.label,
  174:                   value: option.value,
  175:                   order: optionIndex + 1,
  176:                   linkedToValue: null,
  177:                 })),
  178:               },
  179:             })),
  180:           },
  181:         })),
  182:       },
  183:     },
  184:     include: {
  185:       service: true,
  186:       steps: {
  187:         orderBy: {
  188:           order: "asc",
  189:         },
  190:         include: {
  191:           fields: {
  192:             orderBy: {
  193:               order: "asc",
  194:             },
  195:             include: {
  196:               options: {
  197:                 orderBy: {
  198:                   order: "asc",
  199:                 },
  200:               },
  201:             },
  202:           },
  203:         },
  204:       },
  205:     },
  206:   });
  207: }
  208: 
  209: function buildWorkflowSnapshot(workflow: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createRuntimeWorkflow>>) {
  210:   return {
  211:     id: workflow.id,
  212:     name: workflow.name,
  213:     serviceSlug: workflow.service.slug,
  214:     studentPickerMode: workflow.studentPickerMode || "DISABLED",
  215:     evidenceMode: workflow.evidenceMode || "DISABLED",
  216:     steps: workflow.steps.map((step) => ({
  217:       id: step.id,
  218:       title: step.title,
  219:       description: step.description,
  220:       order: step.order,
  221:       fields: step.fields.map((field) => ({
  222:         id: field.id,
  223:         key: field.key,
  224:         label: field.label,
  225:         type: field.type,
  226:         placeholder: field.placeholder,
  227:         helpText: field.helpText,
  228:         isRequired: field.isRequired,
  229:         order: field.order,
  230:         dependsOnFieldKey: field.dependsOnFieldKey,
  231:         linkedToValue: field.linkedToValue,
  232:         allowOther: field.allowOther,
  233:         isRepeater: field.isRepeater,
  234:         options: field.options.map((option) => ({
  235:           id: option.id,
  236:           label: option.label,
  237:           value: option.value,
  238:           order: option.order,
  239:           linkedToValue: option.linkedToValue,
  240:         })),
  241:       })),
  242:     })),
  243:   };
  244: }
  245: 
  246: function buildFieldIdMap(workflow: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createRuntimeWorkflow>>) {
  247:   const map = new Map<string, string>();
  248: 
  249:   for (const step of workflow.steps) {
  250:     for (const field of step.fields) {
  251:       map.set(field.key, field.id);
  252:     }
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   return map;
  256: }
  257: 
  258: export async function GET() {
  259:   const context = await requireCustomReportContext();
  260: 
  261:   if (!context.ok) {
  262:     return NextResponse.json({ error: context.message }, { status: context.status });
  263:   }
  264: 
  265:   const service = await getCustomReportService();
  266: 
  267:   if (!service) {
  268:     return NextResponse.json({ entries: [] });
  269:   }
  270: 
  271:   const entries = await prisma.caseEntry.findMany({
  272:     where: {
  273:       serviceId: service.id,
  274:       createdById: context.user.id,
  275:       ...(context.schoolAccountId
  276:         ? {
  277:             schoolAccountId: context.schoolAccountId,
  278:           }
  279:         : {}),
  280:     },
  281:     orderBy: {
  282:       updatedAt: "desc",
  283:     },
  284:     take: 20,
  285:     select: {
  286:       id: true,
  287:       title: true,
  288:       status: true,
  289:       createdAt: true,
  290:       updatedAt: true,
  291:     },
  292:   });
  293: 
  294:   return NextResponse.json({ entries });
  295: }
  296: 
  297: export async function POST(request: Request) {
  298:   const context = await requireCustomReportContext();
  299: 
  300:   if (!context.ok) {
  301:     return NextResponse.json({ error: context.message }, { status: context.status });
  302:   }
  303: 
  304:   if (!context.schoolAccountId) {
  305:     return NextResponse.json(
  306:       { error: "أكمل بيانات المدرسة قبل إنشاء تقرير خاص." },
  307:       { status: 400 },
  308:     );
  309:   }
  310: 
  311:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
  312:   const values = body?.values && typeof body.values === "object" ? body.values : {};
  313:   const schema = normalizeCustomReportSchema(body?.schema);
  314:   const status = body?.status === "SUBMITTED" ? "SUBMITTED" : "DRAFT";
  315:   const service = await getCustomReportService();
  316: 
  317:   if (!service) {
  318:     return NextResponse.json(
  319:       { error: "تعذر تجهيز خدمة التقرير المخصص." },
  320:       { status: 500 },
  321:     );
  322:   }
  323: 
  324:   const caseEntry = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
  325:     const workflow = await createRuntimeWorkflow(tx, service.id, schema);
  326:     const fieldIdByKey = buildFieldIdMap(workflow);
  327:     const workflowSnapshot = buildWorkflowSnapshot(workflow);
  328:     const caseValues = flattenCaseValues(schema, values, fieldIdByKey);
  329: 
  330:     const createdCase = await tx.caseEntry.create({
  331:       data: {
  332:         schoolAccountId: context.schoolAccountId!,
  333:         serviceId: service.id,
  334:         workflowId: workflow.id,
  335:         workflowSnapshot,
  336:         createdById: context.user.id,
  337:         title: schema.title,
  338:         status,
  339:         submittedAt: status === "SUBMITTED" ? new Date() : null,
  340:       },
  341:       select: {
  342:         id: true,
  343:       },
  344:     });
  345: 
  346:     if (caseValues.length > 0) {
  347:       const valueRows: Prisma.CaseValueCreateManyInput[] = caseValues.map((item) => ({
  348:         caseEntryId: createdCase.id,
  349:         fieldId: item.fieldId,
  350:         fieldKey: item.fieldKey,
  351:         value: item.value,
  352:         ...(item.jsonValue === undefined
  353:           ? {}
  354:           : {
  355:               jsonValue: item.jsonValue as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
  356:             }),
  357:       }));
  358: 
  359:       await tx.caseValue.createMany({
  360:         data: valueRows,
  361:       });
  362:     }
  363: 
  364:     return createdCase;
  365:   });
  366: 
  367:   return NextResponse.json({
  368:     caseId: caseEntry.id,
  369:     redirectTo: `/dashboard/cases/${caseEntry.id}`,
  370:   });
  371: }

    1: import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
    2: import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
    3: import {
    4:   generateCustomReportSchema,
    5:   type CustomReportGenerationContext,
    6: } from "@/lib/custom-report/custom-report-ai-generator";
    7: import { requireCustomReportContext } from "@/lib/custom-report/custom-report-auth";
    8: import type { CustomReportSchema } from "@/lib/custom-report/custom-report-types";
    9: 
   10: function normalizeList(value: unknown) {
   11:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
   12: 
   13:   const seen = new Set<string>();
   14: 
   15:   return value
   16:     .map((item) => String(item || "").trim())
   17:     .filter(Boolean)
   18:     .filter((item) => {
   19:       if (seen.has(item)) return false;
   20:       seen.add(item);
   21:       return true;
   22:     })
   23:     .slice(0, 30);
   24: }
   25: 
   26: function readBodyContext(value: unknown): CustomReportGenerationContext | undefined {
   27:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return undefined;
   28: 
   29:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
   30: 
   31:   return {
   32:     subject: typeof record.subject === "string" ? record.subject : "",
   33:     stage: typeof record.stage === "string" ? record.stage : "",
   34:     reportType: typeof record.reportType === "string" ? record.reportType : "",
   35:     targetAudience: typeof record.targetAudience === "string" ? record.targetAudience : "",
   36:   };
   37: }
   38: 
   39: function getUserIdFromContext(context: unknown) {
   40:   const record = context as any;
   41: 
   42:   return (
   43:     record?.current?.user?.id ||
   44:     record?.user?.id ||
   45:     record?.currentUser?.id ||
   46:     null
   47:   );
   48: }
   49: 
   50: function readPreviousSchema(value: unknown): CustomReportSchema | null {
   51:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return null;
   52:   return value as CustomReportSchema;
   53: }
   54: 
   55: export async function POST(request: Request) {
   56:   const authContext = await requireCustomReportContext();
   57: 
   58:   const body = await request.json().catch(() => null);
   59: 
   60:   const prompt = typeof body?.prompt === "string" ? body.prompt.trim() : "";
   61:   const mode = body?.mode === "regenerate" ? "regenerate" : "create";
   62:   const regenerationInstruction =
   63:     typeof body?.regenerationInstruction === "string"
   64:       ? body.regenerationInstruction.trim()
   65:       : "";
   66:   const previousPrompt =
   67:     typeof body?.previousPrompt === "string" ? body.previousPrompt.trim() : "";
   68:   const previousSchema = readPreviousSchema(body?.previousSchema);
   69: 
   70:   const effectivePrompt =
   71:     prompt ||
   72:     previousPrompt ||
   73:     regenerationInstruction ||
   74:     previousSchema?.description ||
   75:     previousSchema?.title ||
   76:     "";
   77: 
   78:   if (effectivePrompt.trim().length < 15) {
   79:     return NextResponse.json(
   80:       {
   81:         success: false,
   82:         error: "اكتب وصفًا أوضح للتقرير لا يقل عن 15 حرفًا.",
   83:       },
   84:       { status: 400 },
   85:     );
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (mode === "regenerate" && !previousSchema) {
   89:     return NextResponse.json(
   90:       {
   91:         success: false,
   92:         error: "لا يمكن إعادة التوليد بدون الحقول السابقة.",
   93:       },
   94:       { status: 400 },
   95:     );
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   const userId = getUserIdFromContext(authContext);
   99: 
  100:   const profile = userId
  101:     ? await prisma.user.findUnique({
  102:         where: {
  103:           id: userId,
  104:         },
  105:         select: {
  106:           teachingStages: true,
  107:           teachingSpecialties: true,
  108:           teachingSubjects: true,
  109:         },
  110:       })
  111:     : null;
  112: 
  113:   const bodyContext = readBodyContext(body?.context);
  114: 
  115:   const generationContext: CustomReportGenerationContext = {
  116:     ...bodyContext,
  117:     mode,
  118:     previousPrompt: previousPrompt || prompt,
  119:     regenerationInstruction,
  120:     previousSchema,
  121:     stages: normalizeList(profile?.teachingStages),
  122:     specialties: normalizeList(profile?.teachingSpecialties),
  123:     subjects: normalizeList(profile?.teachingSubjects),
  124:   };
  125: 
  126:   const result = await generateCustomReportSchema(effectivePrompt, generationContext);
  127: 
  128:   return NextResponse.json({
  129:     success: true,
  130:     schema: result.schema,
  131:     source: result.source,
  132:   });
  133: }

  301: function resolveWorkflowReportItemLabel(
  302:   value: unknown,
  303:   optionLabels: Map<string, string>
  304: ): string {
  305:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
  306:     return "";

  309:   if (typeof value === "boolean") {
  310:     return value ? "نعم" : "لا";

  313:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  314:     return value

  316:       .filter(Boolean)

  320:   if (typeof value === "object") {

  324:       resolveWorkflowReportItemLabel(record.label, optionLabels) ||
  325:       resolveWorkflowReportItemLabel(record.name, optionLabels) ||

  327:       resolveWorkflowReportItemLabel(record.key, optionLabels) ||
  328:       resolveWorkflowReportItemLabel(record.id, optionLabels)
  329:     );
  330:   }

  332:   const text = cleanWorkflowReportValueText(value);
  333: 
  334:   return optionLabels.get(text) || text;

   15: type SpecialReportTemplateConfig = {
   16:   kind: "SPECIAL_REPORT_TEMPLATE";
   17:   version: 1;
   18:   performanceElement: string;
   19:   fieldKeys: string[];
   20: };
   21: 
   22: function parseTemplateConfig(
   23:   content: string | null
   24: ): SpecialReportTemplateConfig | null {
   25:   if (!content) {
   26:     return null;
   27:   }
   28: 
   29:   try {
   30:     const parsed = JSON.parse(content) as Partial<SpecialReportTemplateConfig>;
   31: 
   32:     if (
   33:       parsed.kind !== "SPECIAL_REPORT_TEMPLATE" ||
   34:       parsed.version !== 1 ||
   35:       typeof parsed.performanceElement !== "string" ||
   36:       !Array.isArray(parsed.fieldKeys)
   37:     ) {
   38:       return null;
   39:     }
   40: 
   41:     return {
   42:       kind: "SPECIAL_REPORT_TEMPLATE",
   43:       version: 1,
   44:       performanceElement: parsed.performanceElement,
   45:       fieldKeys: parsed.fieldKeys.map(String),
   46:     };
   47:   } catch {
   48:     return null;
   49:   }
   50: }
   51: 
   52: export async function GET() {
   53:   const currentUser = await requireDashboardUser();

   55:   const templates = await prisma.reportTemplate.findMany({
   56:     where: {
   57:       createdById: currentUser.user.id,
   58:       serviceSlug: SPECIAL_REPORT_SERVICE_SLUG,
   59:       type: "PERSONAL",
   60:       isActive: true,
   61:     },
   62: 
   63:     orderBy: {
   64:       updatedAt: "desc",
   65:     },
   66:   });
   67: 
   68:   return NextResponse.json({
   69:     templates: templates
   70:       .map((template) => {
   71:         const config = parseTemplateConfig(template.content);
   72: 
   73:         if (!config) {
   74:           return null;
   75:         }
   76: 
   77:         return {
   78:           id: template.id,
   79:           name: template.name,
   80:           config,
   81:           updatedAt: template.updatedAt,
   82:         };
   83:       })
   84:       .filter(Boolean),
   85:   });
   86: }
   87: 
   88: export async function POST(request: Request) {
   89:   const currentUser = await requireDashboardUser();
   90: 
   91:   try {
   92:     const body = (await request.json()) as {
   93:       name?: unknown;
   94:       performanceElement?: unknown;
   95:       fieldKeys?: unknown;
   96:     };
   97: 
   98:     const name = String(body.name ?? "").trim();
   99: 
  100:     const performanceElement = String(
  101:       body.performanceElement ?? ""
  102:     ).trim();
  103: 
  104:     const fieldKeys = Array.isArray(body.fieldKeys)
  105:       ? body.fieldKeys.map(String)
  106:       : [];
  107: 
  108:     if (name.length < 3 || name.length > 100) {
  109:       return NextResponse.json(
  110:         {
  111:           error:
  112:             "اسم القالب يجب أن يكون بين 3 و100 حرف.",
  113:         },
  114:         {
  115:           status: 400,
  116:         }
  117:       );
  118:     }
  119:

  121:       return NextResponse.json(

  123:           error: "عنصر الأداء غير صالح.",
  124:         },
  125:         {
  126:           status: 400,
  127:         }
  128:       );

    1: import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
