    9: function parseOptionalDate(value: string | null) {
   10:   if (!value) {
   11:     return null;
   12:   }
   13: 
   14:   const date = new Date(value);
   15:   return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
   16: }
   17: 
   18: export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
   19:   const { context, error } = await requireSurveyServiceContext();
   20: 
   21:   if (error || !context) {
   22:     return error ?? NextResponse.json({ error: "غير مصرح." }, { status: 401 });
   23:   }
   24: 
   25:   const searchParams = request.nextUrl.searchParams;
   26:   const ownerRole = searchParams.get("ownerRole");
   27:   const boardPath = searchParams.get("boardPath");
   28: 
   29:   const where: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   30: 
   31:   if (!context.isAdmin) {
   32:     where.schoolAccountId = context.schoolAccountId;
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (ownerRole) {
   36:     where.ownerRole = ownerRole;
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   if (boardPath) {
   40:     where.boardPath = boardPath;
   41:   }
   42: 
   43:   const surveys = await prisma.survey.findMany({
   44:     where,
   45:     orderBy: {
   46:       updatedAt: "desc",
   47:     },
   48:     include: {
   49:       service: true,
   50:       createdBy: {
   51:         select: {
   52:           id: true,
   53:           name: true,
   54:           role: true,
   55:         },
   56:       },
   57:       questions: {
   58:         orderBy: {
   59:           order: "asc",
   60:         },
   61:         include: {
   62:           options: {
   63:             orderBy: {
   64:               order: "asc",
   65:             },
   66:           },
   67:         },
   68:       },
   69:       responses: {
   70:         select: {
   71:           id: true,
   72:           submittedAt: true,
   73:         },
   74:         orderBy: {
   75:           submittedAt: "desc",
   76:         },
   77:         take: 5,
   78:       },
   79:       _count: {
   80:         select: {
   81:           questions: true,
   82:           responses: true,
   83:         },
   84:       },
   85:     },
   86:   });
   87: 
   88:   return NextResponse.json({ surveys });
   89: }
   90: 
   91: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   92:   const { context, error } = await requireSurveyServiceContext();
   93: 
   94:   if (error || !context) {
   95:     return error ?? NextResponse.json({ error: "غير مصرح." }, { status: 401 });
   96:   }
   97: 
   98:   if (!context.schoolAccountId) {
   99:     return NextResponse.json(
  100:       {
  101:         error:
  102:           "إنشاء الاستبيانات يحتاج حساب مدرسة مرتبط. يمكن لاحقًا إضافة استبيانات منصة عامة للأدمن.",
  103:       },
  104:       { status: 400 },
  105:     );
  106:   }
  107: 
  108:   const rawPayload = await request.json().catch(() => null);
  109:   const payloadResult = surveyCreatePayloadSchema.safeParse(rawPayload);
  110: 
  111:   if (!payloadResult.success) {
  112:     return NextResponse.json(
  113:       {
  114:         error: payloadResult.error.issues[0]?.message || "بيانات الاستبيان غير صالحة.",
  115:       },
  116:       { status: 400 },
  117:     );
  118:   }
  119: 
  120:   const payload = payloadResult.data;
  121:   const opensAt = parseOptionalDate(payload.opensAt);
  122:   const endsAt = parseOptionalDate(payload.endsAt);
  123: 
  124:   if (payload.opensAt && !opensAt) {
  125:     return NextResponse.json(
  126:       { error: "تاريخ بداية الاستقبال غير صالح." },
  127:       { status: 400 },
  128:     );
  129:   }
  130: 
  131:   if (payload.endsAt && !endsAt) {
  132:     return NextResponse.json(
  133:       { error: "تاريخ نهاية الاستقبال غير صالح." },
  134:       { status: 400 },
  135:     );
  136:   }
  137: 
  138:   if (opensAt && endsAt && endsAt.getTime() < opensAt.getTime()) {
  139:     return NextResponse.json(
  140:       {
  141:         error: "تاريخ نهاية الاستقبال يجب أن يكون بعد تاريخ البداية.",
  142:       },
  143:       { status: 400 },
  144:     );
  145:   }
  146: 
  147:   const ownerRole = payload.ownerRole ?? context.user.role;
  148: 
  149:   const survey = await prisma.survey.create({
  150:     data: {
  151:       schoolAccountId: context.schoolAccountId,
  152:       createdById: context.user.id,
  153:       title: payload.title,
  154:       description: payload.description,
  155:       audienceType: payload.audienceType,
  156:       ownerRole,
  157:       boardPath: payload.boardPath,
  158:       isAnonymous: payload.isAnonymous,
  159:       opensAt,
  160:       endsAt,
  161:       token: createSurveyToken(),
  162:       status: "DRAFT",
  163:       questions: {
  164:         create: payload.questions.map((question, index) => ({
  165:           key: `q_${index + 1}`,
  166:           label: question.label,
  167:           type: question.type,
  168:           helpText: question.helpText,
  169:           isRequired: question.isRequired,
  170:           order: index + 1,
  171:           scaleMin: question.scaleMin ?? null,
  172:           scaleMax: question.scaleMax ?? null,
  173:           options: {
  174:             create: question.options.map((option, optionIndex) => ({
  175:               label: option,
  176:               value: `option_${optionIndex + 1}`,
  177:               order: optionIndex + 1,
  178:             })),
  179:           },
  180:         })),
  181:       },
  182:     },
  183:     include: {
  184:       questions: {
  185:         orderBy: {
  186:           order: "asc",
  187:         },
  188:         include: {
  189:           options: {
  190:             orderBy: {
  191:               order: "asc",
  192:             },
  193:           },
  194:         },
  195:       },
  196:       _count: {
  197:         select: {
  198:           questions: true,
  199:           responses: true,
  200:         },
  201:       },
  202:     },
  203:   });
  204: 
  205:   return NextResponse.json({
  206:     message: "تم إنشاء الاستبيان كمسودة.",
  207:     survey,
  208:   });
  209: }

   22: async function createUniqueToken() {
   23:   for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt++) {
   24:     const token = createSurveyToken();
   25: 
   26:     const existing = await prisma.survey.findUnique({
   27:       where: {
   28:         token,
   29:       },
   30:       select: {
   31:         id: true,
   32:       },
   33:     });
   34: 
   35:     if (!existing) {
   36:       return token;
   37:     }
   38:   }
   39: 
   40:   throw new Error("تعذر إنشاء رابط فريد للاستبيان.");
   41: }

   49: export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {

   57:     return NextResponse.json(

   61:       { status: 403 },
   62:     );
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   const rawPayload = await request.json().catch(() => null);
   66:   const payloadResult = surveyTemplateCreatePayloadSchema.safeParse(rawPayload);
   67: 
   68:   if (!payloadResult.success) {
   69:     return NextResponse.json(
   70:       {
   71:         error:
   72:           payloadResult.error.issues[0]?.message ||
   73:           "بيانات قالب الاستبيان غير صالحة.",
   74:       },
   75:       { status: 400 },
   76:     );
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   const payload = payloadResult.data;
   80:   const ownerRole =
   81:     context.user.role === "ADMIN"
   82:       ? payload.ownerRole ?? context.user.role
   83:       : context.user.role === "ACTIVITY_LEADER"
   84:         ? "ACTIVITY_LEADER"
   85:         : context.user.role === "TEACHER"
   86:           ? "TEACHER"
   87:           : "COUNSELOR";

  106:     return NextResponse.json(
  107:       {
  108:         error:
  109:           templateQuestionsResult.error.issues[0]?.message ||

  111:       },
  112:       { status: 500 },

  114:   }

  120:     where: {
  121:       slug: SURVEY_SERVICE_SLUG,

  123:     select: {
  124:       id: true,
  125:     },
  126:   });

    1: import Link from "next/link";
    2: import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
    3: import type { Prisma } from "@prisma/client";
    4: 
    5: import { requireAdminPage } from "@/lib/admin/admin-page-guard";
    6: import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
    7: import {
    8:   activityLeaderReportTemplates,
    9:   buildActivityLeaderReportTemplateJson,
   10:   getActivityLeaderReportTemplateConfig,
   11:   getActivityLeaderTemplateIdFromJson,
   12:   getActivityLeaderTemplateSortOrder,
   13:   isActivityLeaderReportTemplateJson,
   14:   parseJsonRecord,
   15:   type ActivityLeaderReportTemplateConfig,
   16: } from "@/lib/activity-programs/activity-report-templates";
   17: 
   18: const PAGE_PATH = "/dashboard/admin/report-templates/activity-leader";
   19: 
   20: type StoredTemplate = {
   21:   id: string;
   22:   name: string;
   23:   description: string | null;
   24:   isActive: boolean;
   25:   templateJson: Prisma.JsonValue | null;
   26:   content: string | null;
   27:   updatedAt: Date;
   28: };
   29: 
   30: function readTemplateJson(template: StoredTemplate) {
   31:   const fromJson = parseJsonRecord(template.templateJson);
   32: 
   33:   if (Object.keys(fromJson).length) {
   34:     return fromJson;
   35:   }
   36: 
   37:   return parseJsonRecord(template.content);
   38: }
   39: 
   40: async function getActivityLeaderStoredTemplates() {
   41:   const rows = await prisma.reportTemplate.findMany({
   42:     where: {
   43:       serviceSlug: "activity-programs",
   44:     },
   45:     orderBy: {
   46:       updatedAt: "desc",
   47:     },
   48:     select: {
   49:       id: true,
   50:       name: true,
   51:       description: true,
   52:       isActive: true,
   53:       templateJson: true,
   54:       content: true,
   55:       updatedAt: true,
   56:     },
   57:   });
   58: 
   59:   const map = new Map<string, StoredTemplate>();
   60: 
   61:   for (const row of rows) {
   62:     const json = readTemplateJson(row);
   63: 
   64:     if (!isActivityLeaderReportTemplateJson(json)) {
   65:       continue;
   66:     }
   67: 
   68:     const templateId = getActivityLeaderTemplateIdFromJson(json);
   69: 
   70:     if (templateId && !map.has(templateId)) {
   71:       map.set(templateId, row);
   72:     }
   73:   }
   74: 
   75:   return map;
   76: }
   77: 
   78: async function upsertActivityLeaderTemplate(input: {
   79:   config: ActivityLeaderReportTemplateConfig;
   80:   isActive: boolean;
   81:   sortOrder: number;
   82: }) {
   83:   const existingMap = await getActivityLeaderStoredTemplates();
   84:   const existing = existingMap.get(input.config.id);
   85: 
   86:   const templateJson = buildActivityLeaderReportTemplateJson(input.config, {
   87:     isActive: input.isActive,
   88:     sortOrder: input.sortOrder,
   89:   });
   90: 
   91:   const data = {
   92:     name: input.config.name,
   93:     description: input.config.description,
   94:     serviceSlug: input.config.serviceSlug,
   95:     type: "SYSTEM" as const,
   96:     content: JSON.stringify(templateJson),
   97:     templateJson: templateJson as Prisma.InputJsonValue,
   98:     genderAware: true,
   99:     isActive: input.isActive,
  100:   };
  101: 
  102:   if (existing) {
  103:     await prisma.reportTemplate.update({
  104:       where: {
  105:         id: existing.id,
  106:       },
  107:       data: {
  108:         ...data,
  109:         version: {
  110:           increment: 1,
  111:         },
  112:       },
  113:     });
  114: 
  115:     return;
  116:   }
  117: 
  118:   await prisma.reportTemplate.create({
  119:     data,
  120:   });
  121: }
  122: 
  123: async function seedActivityLeaderReportTemplates() {
  124:   "use server";
  125: 
  126:   await requireAdminPage();
  127: 
  128:   const existingMap = await getActivityLeaderStoredTemplates();
  129: 
  130:   for (const config of activityLeaderReportTemplates) {
  131:     if (existingMap.has(config.id)) {
  132:       continue;
  133:     }
  134: 
  135:     await upsertActivityLeaderTemplate({
  136:       config,
  137:       isActive: config.defaultEnabled,
  138:       sortOrder: config.defaultSortOrder,
  139:     });
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   revalidatePath(PAGE_PATH);
  143: }

  145: async function toggleActivityLeaderReportTemplate(formData: FormData) {
  146:   "use server";
  147: 
  148:   await requireAdminPage();
  149: 
  150:   const templateId = String(formData.get("templateId") || "");
  151:   const nextActive = String(formData.get("nextActive") || "") === "true";
  152: 
  153:   const config = getActivityLeaderReportTemplateConfig(templateId);
  154: 
  155:   if (!config) {
  156:     return;
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   const existingMap = await getActivityLeaderStoredTemplates();
  160:   const existing = existingMap.get(config.id);
  161:   const existingJson = existing ? readTemplateJson(existing) : {};
  162:   const sortOrder = getActivityLeaderTemplateSortOrder(
  163:     existingJson,
  164:     config.defaultSortOrder,
  165:   );
  166: 
  167:   await upsertActivityLeaderTemplate({
  168:     config,
  169:     isActive: nextActive,
  170:     sortOrder,
  171:   });
  172: 
  173:   revalidatePath(PAGE_PATH);
  174: }

  176: async function moveActivityLeaderReportTemplate(formData: FormData) {
  177:   "use server";
  178: 
  179:   await requireAdminPage();
  180: 
  181:   const templateId = String(formData.get("templateId") || "");
  182:   const direction = String(formData.get("direction") || "");
  183: 
  184:   const existingMap = await getActivityLeaderStoredTemplates();
  185: 
  186:   const items = activityLeaderReportTemplates
  187:     .map((config) => {
  188:       const existing = existingMap.get(config.id);
  189:       const json = existing ? readTemplateJson(existing) : {};
  190: 
  191:       return {
  192:         config,
  193:         existing,
  194:         isActive: existing ? existing.isActive : config.defaultEnabled,
  195:         sortOrder: getActivityLeaderTemplateSortOrder(
  196:           json,
  197:           config.defaultSortOrder,
  198:         ),
  199:       };
  200:     })
  201:     .sort((first, second) => first.sortOrder - second.sortOrder);
  202: 
  203:   const index = items.findIndex((item) => item.config.id === templateId);
  204: 
  205:   if (index === -1) {
  206:     return;
  207:   }
  208: 
  209:   const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  210: 
  211:   if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= items.length) {
  212:     return;
  213:   }
  214: 
  215:   const current = items[index];
  216:   const target = items[targetIndex];
  217: 
  218:   await Promise.all([
  219:     upsertActivityLeaderTemplate({
  220:       config: current.config,
  221:       isActive: current.isActive,
  222:       sortOrder: target.sortOrder,
  223:     }),
  224:     upsertActivityLeaderTemplate({
  225:       config: target.config,
  226:       isActive: target.isActive,
  227:       sortOrder: current.sortOrder,
  228:     }),
  229:   ]);
  230: 
  231:   revalidatePath(PAGE_PATH);
  232: }
  233: 
  234: function formatDate(value: Date) {
  235:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA", {
  236:     dateStyle: "medium",
  237:   }).format(value);
  238: }

    1: import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
    2: 
    3: import { SavedReportsListPage } from "@/components/report-engine/saved-reports-list-page";
    4: import { requireDashboardUser } from "@/lib/auth/require-auth";
    5: import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
    6: import { getSchoolSubscriptionOverview } from "@/lib/subscription/subscription-service";
    7: import { buildGuidanceReportWhereForUser } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-access-scope";
    8: 
    9: export default async function SavedReportsRoutePage() {
   10:   const current = await requireDashboardUser();
   11: 
   12:   if (current.user.role !== "ADMIN") {
   13:     if (!current.user.schoolAccountId) {
   14:       redirect("/dashboard/plans?reason=activation-required");
   15:     }
   16: 
   17:     const overview = await getSchoolSubscriptionOverview(
   18:       current.user.schoolAccountId,
   19:     );
   20: 
   21:     if (!overview.usable) {
   22:       redirect("/dashboard/plans?reason=activation-required");
   23:     }
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   const reports = await prisma.guidanceReport.findMany({
   27:     where: buildGuidanceReportWhereForUser(current.user),
   28:     include: {
   29:       caseEntry: {
   30:         include: {
   31:           service: true,
   32:           student: true,
   33:         },
   34:       },
   35:     },
   36:     orderBy: [
   37:       {
   38:         generatedAt: "desc",
   39:       },
   40:       {
   41:         createdAt: "desc",
   42:       },
   43:     ],
   44:     take: 80,
   45:   });
   46: 
   47:   return (
   48:     <SavedReportsListPage
   49:       reports={reports.map((report) => ({
   50:         id: report.id,
   51:         title: report.title,
   52:         status: report.status,
   53:         serviceSlug: report.serviceSlug,
   54:         generatedAt: report.generatedAt?.toISOString() || "",
   55:         createdAt: report.createdAt.toISOString(),
   56:         templateSnapshot: report.templateSnapshot,
   57:         caseEntry: report.caseEntry
   58:           ? {
   59:               id: report.caseEntry.id,
   60:               title: report.caseEntry.title,
   61:               service: report.caseEntry.service
   62:                 ? {
   63:                     name: report.caseEntry.service.name,
   64:                     slug: report.caseEntry.service.slug,
   65:                   }
   66:                 : null,
   67:               student: report.caseEntry.student
   68:                 ? {
   69:                     fullName: report.caseEntry.student.fullName,
   70:                     grade: report.caseEntry.student.grade,
   71:                     classroom: report.caseEntry.student.classroom,
   72:                   }
   73:                 : null,
   74:             }
   75:           : null,
   76:       }))}
   77:     />
   78:   );
   79: }

   38: function formatDate(value: string | null | undefined) {
   39:   if (!value) return "غير محدد";
   40: 
   41:   try {
   42:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA", {
   43:       dateStyle: "medium",

   51: function getUniqueValues(
   52:   items: SnapshotItem[],
   53:   key: "serviceName" | "approvedByName",
   54: ) {
   55:   const values = new Set<string>();
   56: 
   57:   for (const item of items) {
   58:     const value = item[key];
   59: 
   60:     if (value) {
   61:       values.add(value);
   62:     }
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   return Array.from(values).sort();
   66: }

   68: export function ReportTwoArchiveClient({
   69:   snapshots,
   70:   readOnly = false,
   71: }: ReportTwoArchiveClientProps) {
   72:   const [items, setItems] = useState(snapshots);
   73:   const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
   74:   const [filterService, setFilterService] = useState("");
   75:   const [filterApprovedBy, setFilterApprovedBy] = useState("");
   76:   const [sortKey, setSortKey] = useState<SortKey>("newest");
   77: 
   78:   const services = useMemo(
   79:     () => getUniqueValues(items, "serviceName"),
   80:     [items],
   81:   );
   82:   const approvedByNames = useMemo(
   83:     () => getUniqueValues(items, "approvedByName"),
   84:     [items],
   85:   );
   86: 
   87:   const filtered = useMemo(() => {
   88:     let list = [...items];
   89:     const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
   90: 
   91:     if (query) {
   92:       list = list.filter((snapshot) => {
   93:         const reportTitle = (snapshot.reportTitle || "").toLowerCase();
   94:         const serviceName = (snapshot.serviceName || "").toLowerCase();
   95:         const approvedByName = (snapshot.approvedByName || "").toLowerCase();
   96: 
   97:         return (
   98:           reportTitle.includes(query) ||
   99:           serviceName.includes(query) ||
  100:           approvedByName.includes(query)
  101:         );
  102:       });
  103:     }
  104: 
  105:     if (filterService) {
  106:       list = list.filter((snapshot) => snapshot.serviceName === filterService);
  107:     }
  108: 
  109:     if (filterApprovedBy) {
  110:       list = list.filter(
  111:         (snapshot) => snapshot.approvedByName === filterApprovedBy,
  112:       );
  113:     }
  114: 
  115:     list.sort((a, b) => {
  116:       const aDate = a.approvedAt ? new Date(a.approvedAt).getTime() : 0;
  117:       const bDate = b.approvedAt ? new Date(b.approvedAt).getTime() : 0;
  118: 
  119:       switch (sortKey) {
  120:         case "oldest":
  121:           return aDate - bDate;
  122:         case "title":
  123:           return (a.reportTitle || "").localeCompare(b.reportTitle || "", "ar");
  124:         case "service":
  125:           return (a.serviceName || "").localeCompare(b.serviceName || "", "ar");
  126:         case "newest":
  127:         default:
  128:           return bDate - aDate;
  129:       }
  130:     });
  131: 
  132:     return list;
  133:   }, [filterApprovedBy, filterService, search, items, sortKey]);
  134: 
  135:   const hasActiveFilters =
  136:     search || filterService || filterApprovedBy || sortKey !== "newest";
  137: 
  138:   function resetFilters() {

  142:     setSortKey("newest");
  143:   }

  150:             type="text"

  153:             placeholder="ابحث باسم التقرير أو الخدمة أو المعتمد"
  154:             className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-emerald-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-100 dark:border-slate-700 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-white dark:placeholder:text-slate-500 dark:focus:ring-emerald-800"
  155:           />
  156:

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { type ReactNode, useCallback, useState } from "react";
    4: import { isReportDesignId } from "@/components/report-engine/design-renderers/report-design-registry";
    5: 
    6: type SnapshotInfo = {
    7:   caseEntryId: string;
    8:   reportTitle: string;
    9:   snapshotTemplateJson?: unknown;
   10:   snapshotPagesJson?: unknown;
   11:   renderContext?: unknown;
   12:   previewCase?: unknown;
   13:   snapshotPayload?: unknown;
   14:   variantId?: string | null;
   15: };
   16: 
   17: type PdfDownloadButtonProps = {
   18:   snapshot: SnapshotInfo;
   19:   className?: string;
   20:   label?: string;
   21:   children?: ReactNode;
   22: };
   23: 
   24: function formatFileName(value: string) {
   25:   return (
   26:     value
   27:       .replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]+/g, "-")
   28:       .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   29:       .trim()
   30:       .slice(0, 150) || "report"
   31:   );
   32: }
   33: 
   34: function getPrintableTemplate(
   35:   templateJson: unknown,
   36:   pagesJson: unknown,
   37: ): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   38:   if (templateJson && typeof templateJson === "object") {
   39:     const obj = templateJson as Record<string, unknown>;
   40:     const pages =
   41:       Array.isArray(obj.pages) && obj.pages.length > 0
   42:         ? obj.pages
   43:         : Array.isArray(pagesJson) && pagesJson.length > 0
   44:           ? pagesJson
   45:           : null;
   46: 
   47:     if (
   48:       isReportDesignId(obj.designTemplateId) &&
   49:       pages
   50:     ) {
   51:       return {
   52:         ...obj,
   53:         pages,
   54:       };
   55:     }
   56:   }
   57: 
   58:   return null;
   59: }
   60: 
   61: export function ReportTwoPdfDownloadButton({
   62:   snapshot,
   63:   className = "",
   64:   label,
   65:   children,
   66: }: PdfDownloadButtonProps) {
   67:   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
   68:   const [fallbackState, setFallbackState] = useState<{
   69:     message: string;
   70:     previewUrl?: string;
   71:   } | null>(null);
   72: 
   73:   const openPreviewWindow = useCallback((previewUrl: string) => {
   74:     const popup = window.open(previewUrl, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
   75: 
   76:     if (popup) {
   77:       setFallbackState(null);
   78:     } else {
   79:       setFallbackState({
   80:         message:
   81:           "تم حظر فتح معاينة الطباعة تلقائياً. استخدم الزر أدناه لفتح المعاينة في نافذة جديدة.",
   82:         previewUrl,
   83:       });
   84:     }
   85: 
   86:     return popup;
   87:   }, []);
   88: 
   89:   const handleDownload = useCallback(async () => {
   90:     if (loading) return;
   91: 
   92:     setLoading(true);
   93:     setFallbackState(null);
   94: 
   95:     try {
   96:       const printableTemplate = getPrintableTemplate(
   97:         snapshot.snapshotTemplateJson,
   98:         snapshot.snapshotPagesJson,
   99:       );
  100: 
  101:       if (!printableTemplate) {
  102:         setFallbackState({
  103:           message: "تعذر إنشاء معاينة الطباعة لهذا التقرير. حاول مرة أخرى.",
  104:         });
  105:         return;
  106:       }
  107: 
  108:       const exportSnapshot: Record<string, unknown> = {
  109:         template: printableTemplate,
  110:         context: snapshot.renderContext || {},
  111:         previewCase: snapshot.previewCase || null,
  112:         sourcePayload: snapshot.snapshotPayload,
  113:         designTemplateId: printableTemplate.designTemplateId,
  114:         variantId: snapshot.variantId || null,
  115:       };
  116: 
  117:       const response = await fetch(
  118:         `/api/dashboard/report-2/cases/${encodeURIComponent(snapshot.caseEntryId)}/export/pdf`,
  119:         {
  120:           method: "POST",
  121:           headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  122:           body: JSON.stringify({
  123:             fileName: formatFileName(snapshot.reportTitle),
  124:             snapshot: exportSnapshot,
  125:           }),
  126:         },
  127:       );
  128: 
  129:       const contentType = response.headers.get("content-type") || "";
  130: 
  131:       if (contentType.includes("application/pdf")) {
  132:         const blob = await response.blob();
  133:         const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  134:         const a = document.createElement("a");
  135: 
  136:         a.href = url;
  137:         a.download = `${formatFileName(snapshot.reportTitle)}.pdf`;
  138:         document.body.appendChild(a);
  139:         a.click();
  140:         a.remove();
  141:         URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  142:         return;
  143:       }
  144: 
  145:       let data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  146: 
  147:       try {
  148:         data = await response.json();
  149:       } catch {
  150:         setFallbackState({
  151:           message: "تعذر فتح معاينة الطباعة تلقائياً. حاول مرة أخرى.",
  152:         });
  153:         return;
  154:       }
  155: 
  156:       if (
  157:         data.fallback === "PRINT_PREVIEW" &&
  158:         typeof data.previewUrl === "string"
  159:       ) {
  160:         openPreviewWindow(data.previewUrl);
  161:         return;
  162:       }
  163: 
  164:       setFallbackState({
  165:         message: "تعذر فتح معاينة الطباعة لهذا التقرير. حاول مرة أخرى.",
  166:       });
  167:     } catch {
  168:       setFallbackState({
  169:         message: "تعذر تنزيل PDF أو فتح معاينة الطباعة. حاول مرة أخرى.",
  170:       });
  171:     } finally {
  172:       setLoading(false);
  173:     }
  174:   }, [loading, openPreviewWindow, snapshot]);
  175: 
  176:   return (
  177:     <>
  178:       <button
  179:         type="button"
  180:         onClick={handleDownload}
  181:         disabled={loading}
  182:         className={className}
  183:       >
  184:         {children ? (loading ? "..." : children) : loading ? "... جارٍ التحميل" : label || "تحميل PDF"}
  185:       </button>
  186: 
  187:       {fallbackState ? (
  188:         <div
  189:           className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/45 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm"
  190:           dir="rtl"
  191:         >
  192:           <section className="w-full max-w-md overflow-hidden rounded-[2rem] bg-white shadow-2xl">
  193:             <header className="border-b border-slate-100 px-6 py-5">
  194:               <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-950">
  195:                 معاينة الطباعة
  196:               </h2>
  197:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-500">
  198:                 {fallbackState.message}
  199:               </p>
  200:               {fallbackState.previewUrl ? (
  201:                 <button
  202:                   type="button"
  203:                   onClick={() => openPreviewWindow(fallbackState.previewUrl!)}
  204:                   className="mt-4 inline-flex rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black text-emerald-700 transition hover:bg-emerald-100"
  205:                 >
  206:                   فتح معاينة الطباعة
  207:                 </button>
  208:               ) : null}
  209:             </header>
  210: 
  211:             <footer className="flex justify-end px-6 py-4">
  212:               <button
  213:                 type="button"
  214:                 onClick={() => setFallbackState(null)}
  215:                 className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-700 px-5 py-2 text-xs font-black text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-800"
  216:               >
  217:                 حسنًا
  218:               </button>
  219:             </footer>
  220:           </section>
  221:         </div>
  222:       ) : null}
  223:     </>
  224:   );
  225: }

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useEffect } from "react";
    4: 
    5: function sleep(ms: number) {
    6:   return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, ms));
    7: }
    8: 
    9: async function waitForWindowLoad() {
   10:   if (document.readyState === "complete") return;
   11: 
   12:   await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   13:     window.addEventListener("load", () => resolve(), { once: true });
   14:   });
   15: }
   16: 
   17: async function waitForFonts() {
   18:   try {
   19:     const fonts = (document as unknown as { fonts?: { ready?: Promise<unknown> } }).fonts;
   20: 
   21:     if (fonts?.ready) {
   22:       await fonts.ready;
   23:     }
   24:   } catch {
   25:     // تجاهل فشل جاهزية الخطوط
   26:   }
   27: }
   28: 
   29: async function waitForFinalizedPhysicalPages(timeoutMs = 30000) {
   30:   if (!document.querySelector(".report-two-print-document")) {
   31:     return true;
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   const startedAt = Date.now();
   35: 
   36:   while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
   37:     const composers = Array.from(
   38:       document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
   39:         "[data-report-smart-physical-pages]",
   40:       ),
   41:     );
   42: 
   43:     if (
   44:       composers.length > 0 &&
   45:       composers.every((composer) => {
   46:         const phase = composer.dataset.reportPhysicalPlanningPhase;
   47:         return phase === "READY" || phase === "FROZEN";
   48:       })
   49:     ) {
   50:       return true;
   51:     }
   52: 
   53:     await sleep(50);
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   return false;
   57: }
   58: 
   59: async function waitForImages(timeoutMs = 10000) {
   60:   const images = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll<HTMLImageElement>("img"));
   61:   const pending = images.filter((image) => !image.complete);
   62: 
   63:   if (!pending.length) return;
   64: 
   65:   await Promise.race([
   66:     Promise.all(
   67:       pending.map(
   68:         (image) =>
   69:           new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   70:             const settle = () => resolve();
   71:             image.addEventListener("load", settle, { once: true });
   72:             image.addEventListener("error", settle, { once: true });
   73:           }),
   74:       ),
   75:     ),
   76:     sleep(timeoutMs),
   77:   ]);
   78: }
   79: 
   80: function areLinkedFramesReady() {
   81:   const frames = Array.from(
   82:     document.querySelectorAll<HTMLIFrameElement>(
   83:       [
   84:         "iframe[data-report-linked-assessment-frame='1']",
   85:         "iframe[data-report-linked-survey-frame='1']",
   86:         ".linked-assessment-official-frame",
   87:         ".linked-survey-official-frame",
   88:         ".report-linked-assessment-frame",
   89:         ".report-linked-survey-frame",
   90:       ].join(","),
   91:     ),
   92:   );
   93: 
   94:   if (!frames.length) return true;
   95: 
   96:   return frames.every((frame) => {
   97:     try {
   98:       const doc = frame.contentDocument;
   99: 
  100:       return !doc || doc.readyState === "complete";
  101:     } catch {
  102:       return true;
  103:     }
  104:   });
  105: }
  106: 
  107: async function waitForLinkedFrames(timeoutMs = 9000) {
  108:   const startedAt = Date.now();
  109: 
  110:   while (Date.now() - startedAt < timeoutMs) {
  111:     if (areLinkedFramesReady()) return;
  112: 
  113:     await sleep(150);
  114:   }
  115: }
  116: 
  117: async function waitForFrameFonts() {
  118:   const frames = Array.from(
  119:     document.querySelectorAll<HTMLIFrameElement>(
  120:       [
  121:         "iframe[data-report-linked-assessment-frame='1']",
  122:         "iframe[data-report-linked-survey-frame='1']",
  123:         ".linked-assessment-official-frame",
  124:         ".linked-survey-official-frame",
  125:         ".report-linked-assessment-frame",
  126:         ".report-linked-survey-frame",
  127:       ].join(","),
  128:     ),
  129:   );
  130: 
  131:   await Promise.all(
  132:     frames.map(async (frame) => {
  133:       try {
  134:         const fonts = (
  135:           frame.contentDocument as unknown as {
  136:             fonts?: { ready?: Promise<unknown> };
  137:           }
  138:         )?.fonts;
  139: 
  140:         if (fonts?.ready) {
  141:           await fonts.ready;
  142:         }
  143:       } catch {
  144:         // تجاهل فشل جاهزية خطوط الإطار
  145:       }
  146:     }),
  147:   );
  148: }
  149: 
  150: export function ReportTwoSnapshotPrintController() {
  151:   useEffect(() => {
  152:     let cancelled = false;
  153: 
  154:     async function triggerPrint() {
  155:       await waitForWindowLoad();
  156:       await waitForFonts();
  157:       const physicalPagesReady = await waitForFinalizedPhysicalPages();
  158: 
  159:       if (!physicalPagesReady || cancelled) {
  160:         return;
  161:       }
  162:       await waitForImages();
  163:       await waitForLinkedFrames();
  164:       await waitForFrameFonts();
  165:       await sleep(500);
  166: 
  167:       if (!cancelled) {
  168:         window.print();
  169:       }
  170:     }
  171: 
  172:     void triggerPrint();
  173: 
  174:     return () => {
  175:       cancelled = true;
  176:     };
  177:   }, []);
  178: 
  179:   return null;
  180: }

  320: function readReportTwoSavedTemplates(
  321:   serviceSlug: string,
  322: ): ReportTwoSavedRuntimeTemplate[] {
  323:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  324: 
  325:   try {
  326:     const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(
  327:       getReportTwoSavedTemplatesStorageKey(serviceSlug),
  328:     );
  329: 
  330:     if (!raw) return [];
  331: 
  332:     const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  333: 
  334:     return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : [];
  335:   } catch {
  336:     return [];
  337:   }
  338: }
  339: 
  340: function getReportTwoSavedTemplatesStoragePrefix() {
  341:   return "report-2:saved-runtime-templates:";
  342: }
  343: 
  344: function readAllReportTwoSavedTemplates() {
  345:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  346: 
  347:   const prefix = getReportTwoSavedTemplatesStoragePrefix();
  348:   const items: ReportTwoSavedRuntimeTemplate[] = [];
  349: 
  350:   for (let index = 0; index < window.localStorage.length; index += 1) {
  351:     const key = window.localStorage.key(index);
  352: 
  353:     if (!key || !key.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
  354: 
  355:     const serviceSlug = key.slice(prefix.length);
  356:     const templates = readReportTwoSavedTemplates(serviceSlug);
  357: 
  358:     templates.forEach((template) => {
  359:       items.push({
  360:         ...template,
  361:         serviceSlug: (template as any).serviceSlug || serviceSlug,
  362:       } as ReportTwoSavedRuntimeTemplate);
  363:     });
  364:   }
  365: 
  366:   return items.sort((a, b) => {
  367:     return String((b as any).updatedAt || (b as any).createdAt || "").localeCompare(
  368:       String((a as any).updatedAt || (a as any).createdAt || ""),
  369:     );
  370:   });
  371: }
  372: 
  373: function deleteReportTwoSavedTemplateFromAllServices(templateId: string) {
  374:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return [];
  375: 
  376:   const prefix = getReportTwoSavedTemplatesStoragePrefix();
  377: 
  378:   for (let index = window.localStorage.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
  379:     const key = window.localStorage.key(index);
  380: 
  381:     if (!key || !key.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
  382: 
  383:     const serviceSlug = key.slice(prefix.length);
  384:     const templates = readReportTwoSavedTemplates(serviceSlug);
  385:     const nextTemplates = templates.filter((template) => template.id !== templateId);
  386: 
  387:     if (nextTemplates.length !== templates.length) {
  388:       writeReportTwoSavedTemplates(serviceSlug, nextTemplates);
  389:     }
  390:   }
  391: 
  392:   return readAllReportTwoSavedTemplates();
  393: }
  394: function writeReportTwoSavedTemplates(
  395:   serviceSlug: string,
  396:   items: ReportTwoSavedRuntimeTemplate[],
  397: ) {
  398:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
  399: 
  400:   window.localStorage.setItem(
  401:     getReportTwoSavedTemplatesStorageKey(serviceSlug),
  402:     JSON.stringify(items),
  403:   );
  404: }

  606: function normalizeBlock(value: any, index: number): StudioBlock {
  607:   const kind = cleanText(value?.kind || value?.settings?.smartBlockKind || "section-text") as StudioBlockKind;
  608: 
  609:   return {
  610:     ...createBlock(kind),
  611:     ...value,
  612:     id: cleanText(value?.id) || makeId(`block-${index + 1}`),
  613:     kind,
  614:     title: cleanText(value?.title) || `بلوك ${index + 1}`,
  615:     content: cleanText(value?.content ?? value?.defaultContent ?? value?.customContent ?? ""),
  616:     showTitle: value?.showTitle !== false,
  617:     showMeta: Boolean(value?.showMeta),
  618:     align: value?.align === "center" ? "center" : "right",
  619:     placement: cleanText(value?.placement) || "flow",
  620:   };
  621: }
  622: 
  623: function normalizePage(value: any, index: number): StudioPage {
  624:   const rawBlocks = asArray(value?.blocks);
  625: 
  626:   return {
  627:     id: cleanText(value?.id) || makeId(`page-${index + 1}`),
  628:     kind: cleanText(value?.kind || "content") as StudioPageKind,
  629:     title: cleanText(value?.title) || `صفحة ${index + 1}`,
  630:     description: cleanText(value?.description),
  631:     blocks: rawBlocks.length
  632:       ? rawBlocks.map(normalizeBlock)
  633:       : [createBlock("section-text")],
  634:   };
  635: }

  637: function hydrateTemplate(template: TemplateOption | null): StudioTemplate {
  638:   const raw = asRecord(template?.templateJson);
  639:   const smartStudio = asRecord(raw.smartStudio);
  640:   const source = asArray(smartStudio.pages).length ? smartStudio : raw;
  641:   const pages = asArray(source.pages);
  642: 
  643:   return {
  644:     id: template?.id || "report-2-empty-template",
  645:     name: template?.name || "قالب report-2",
  646:     description: template?.description || "",
  647:     designTemplateId: normalizeDesignId(source.designTemplateId || raw.designTemplateId),
  648:     designConfig: asRecord(source.designConfig).header
  649:       ? {
  650:           header: asRecord(source.designConfig)
  651:             .header as unknown as ReportHeaderSettings,
  652:         }
  653:       : asRecord(raw.designConfig).header
  654:         ? {
  655:             header: asRecord(raw.designConfig)
  656:               .header as unknown as ReportHeaderSettings,
  657:           }
  658:         : undefined,
  659:     pages: pages.length
  660:       ? pages.map(normalizePage)
  661:       : [
  662:           {
  663:             id: "report-2-fallback-page",
  664:             kind: "content",
  665:             title: "صفحة التقرير",
  666:             description: "",
  667:             blocks: [
  668:               createBlock("hero-title"),
  669:               createBlock("dynamic-fields"),
  670:               createBlock("section-text"),
  671:             ],
  672:           },
  673:         ],
  674:   };
  675: }

  877: function getReportTwoFieldLabel(key: string, label: string): string {
  878:   if (!key && !label) return "";
  879:   const trimmed = label?.trim();
  880:   if (trimmed && trimmed !== key && !/^[a-z0-9_./-]+$/i.test(trimmed)) {
  881:     return trimmed;
  882:   }
  883:   return REPORT_TWO_FIELD_LABELS[key] || REPORT_TWO_FIELD_LABELS[label] || trimmed || key || "";
  884: }
  885: 
  886: function getReportTwoFieldValue(value: unknown): string {
  887:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
  888:   const raw = String(value).trim();
  889:   if (!raw) return "";
  890:   const lower = raw.toLowerCase();
  891:   const direct = REPORT_TWO_VALUE_LABELS[lower] || REPORT_TWO_VALUE_LABELS[raw];
  892:   if (direct) return direct;
  893:   const programMatch = lower.match(/^program_(\d+)$/);
  894:   if (programMatch) return `برنامج النشاط رقم ${programMatch[1]}`;
  895:   if (/^[a-z0-9_./-]+$/i.test(raw) && /[a-z_]/i.test(raw)) return raw;
  896:   return raw;
  897: }

  947: function normalizeEvidenceUrl(value: unknown) {
  948:   const url = cleanText(value).replaceAll("\\", "/");
  949: 
  950:   if (!url) return "";
  951:   if (url.startsWith("http://")) return url;
  952:   if (url.startsWith("https://")) return url;
  953:   if (url.startsWith("data:")) return url;
  954:   if (url.startsWith("/")) return url;
  955: 
  956:   return `/${url.replace(/^public\//, "")}`;
  957: }

  960:   /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;

  962: function hasReportTwoImageEvidenceExtension(value: unknown) {
  963:   const text = cleanText(value).replaceAll("\\", "/");
  964: 
  965:   if (!text) return false;
  966: 
  967:   return REPORT_TWO_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.test(text);
  968: }

  970: function isReportTwoImageEvidence(item: any) {
  971:   const evidenceType = cleanText(item?.type).toUpperCase();
  972:   const mimeType = cleanText(item?.mimeType).toLowerCase();
  973: 
  974:   if (evidenceType === "IMAGE") return true;
  975:   if (mimeType.startsWith("image/")) return true;
  976: 
  977:   return [
  978:     item?.imageUrl,
  979:     item?.fileUrl,
  980:     item?.url,
  981:     item?.publicUrl,
  982:     item?.thumbnailUrl,
  983:     item?.previewUrl,
  984:     item?.fileName,
  985:     item?.originalName,
  986:     item?.name,
  987:   ].some((value) => hasReportTwoImageEvidenceExtension(value));
  988: }

  990: function collectEvidences(payload: SmartReportPayload) {
  991:   const data = getPayloadAny(payload);
  992: 
  993:   const candidates = [
  994:     data.evidence,
  995:     data.evidence?.items,
  996:     data.evidence?.evidences,
  997:     data.evidence?.files,
  998:     data.evidence?.attachments,
  999:     data.evidenceItems,
 1000:     data.evidences,
 1001:     data.attachments,

 1005:     data.caseInfo?.evidence?.evidences,

 1007:     data.caseInfo?.evidence?.attachments,
 1008:     data.caseInfo?.evidenceItems,
 1009:     data.caseInfo?.evidences,
 1010:     data.caseInfo?.attachments,
 1011:     data.caseInfo?.files,
 1012:   ];
 1013: 
 1014:   const collected: any[] = [];
 1015: 
 1016:   candidates.forEach((candidate) => {
 1017:     if (Array.isArray(candidate)) {
 1018:       collected.push(...candidate);
 1019:       return;
 1020:     }
 1021: 
 1022:     if (candidate && typeof candidate === "object") {
 1023:       const record = candidate as Record<string, any>;
 1024: 
 1025:       [
 1026:         record.items,
 1027:         record.evidences,
 1028:         record.files,
 1029:         record.attachments,
 1030:         record.data,
 1031:       ].forEach((value) => {
 1032:         if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 1033:           collected.push(...value);
 1034:         }
 1035:       });
 1036:     }
 1037:   });
 1038: 
 1039:   const seen = new Set<string>();
 1040: 
 1041:   return filterValidReportEvidenceItems(collected)
 1042:     .map((item, index) => {
 1043:       const rawUrl =
 1044:         item.fileUrl ||
 1045:         item.url ||
 1046:         item.imageUrl ||
 1047:         item.publicUrl ||
 1048:         item.path ||
 1049:         item.filePath ||
 1050:         item.storagePath ||
 1051:         item.thumbnailUrl ||
 1052:         item.previewUrl ||
 1053:         item.downloadUrl ||
 1054:         item.secureUrl ||
 1055:         item.src ||
 1056:         "";
 1057: 
 1058:       const fileUrl = normalizeEvidenceUrl(rawUrl);
 1059:       const normalizedUrl = normalizeEvidenceUrl(item.url || "");
 1060:       const imageUrlCandidate = normalizeEvidenceUrl(
 1061:         item.imageUrl ||
 1062:           item.thumbnailUrl ||
 1063:           item.previewUrl ||
 1064:           item.publicUrl ||
 1065:           item.url ||
 1066:           item.fileUrl ||
 1067:           rawUrl,
 1068:       );
 1069:       const imageUrl = isReportTwoImageEvidence(item)
 1070:         ? imageUrlCandidate || fileUrl || normalizedUrl
 1071:         : "";
 1072:       const evidenceType: "IMAGE" | "FILE" = isReportTwoImageEvidence(item)
 1073:         ? "IMAGE"
 1074:         : "FILE";
 1075: 
 1076:       const id =
 1077:         cleanText(item.id) ||
 1078:         cleanText(item.evidenceId) ||
 1079:         cleanText(item.fileId) ||
 1080:         fileUrl ||
 1081:         imageUrl ||
 1082:         `evidence-${index + 1}`;
 1083: 
 1084:       return {
 1085:         id,
 1086:         title:
 1087:           cleanText(item.title || item.fileName || item.originalName || item.name) ||
 1088:           `شاهد ${index + 1}`,
 1089:         url: normalizedUrl || undefined,
 1090:         fileUrl,
 1091:         imageUrl,
 1092:         attachmentId: cleanText(item.attachmentId || item.fileId || item.evidenceId) || undefined,
 1093:         storagePath: cleanText(item.storagePath) || undefined,
 1094:         type: evidenceType,
 1095:         mimeType: cleanText(item.mimeType) || undefined,
 1096:         caption: cleanText(
 1097:           item.caption ||
 1098:             item.note ||
 1099:             item.description ||
 1100:             item.title ||
 1101:             item.fileName ||
 1102:             item.originalName,
 1103:         ),
 1104:       };
 1105:     })
 1106:     .filter((item) => filterValidReportEvidenceItems([item]).length > 0)
 1107:     .filter((item) => {
 1108:       const key = `${item.id}|${item.fileUrl}|${item.imageUrl}|${item.attachmentId || ""}`;
 1109: 
 1110:       if (seen.has(key)) {
 1111:         return false;
 1112:       }
 1113: 
 1114:       seen.add(key);
 1115:       return true;

 1249: function getReportTwoOrderedSignatureCards(
 1250:   signatures: ReturnType<typeof getReportTwoSignatureCardsFromPayload>,
 1251:   block: StudioBlock | null | undefined,
 1252: ) {
 1253:   const order = Array.isArray((block as any)?.signatureOrder)

 1255:     : [];

 1285: function moveReportTwoSignatureOrder(
 1286:   currentOrder: unknown,
 1287:   allKeys: string[],
 1288:   key: string,
 1289:   direction: -1 | 1,
 1290: ) {
 1291:   const normalizedKeys = allKeys.map((item) => cleanText(item)).filter(Boolean);
 1292:   const current = Array.isArray(currentOrder)
 1293:     ? currentOrder.map((item) => cleanText(item)).filter(Boolean)
 1294:     : [];
 1295: 
 1296:   const order = [
 1297:     ...current.filter((item) => normalizedKeys.includes(item)),
 1298:     ...normalizedKeys.filter((item) => !current.includes(item)),
 1299:   ];
 1300: 
 1301:   const index = order.indexOf(key);
 1302:   const targetIndex = index + direction;
 1303: 
 1304:   if (index < 0 || targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= order.length) {
 1305:     return order;
 1306:   }
 1307: 
 1308:   const next = [...order];
 1309:   const currentItem = next[index];
 1310: 
 1311:   next[index] = next[targetIndex];
 1312:   next[targetIndex] = currentItem;
 1313: 
 1314:   return next;
 1315: }

 1317: function toggleReportTwoSignatureHiddenKey(currentHiddenKeys: unknown, key: string) {

 1319:     Array.isArray(currentHiddenKeys)
 1320:       ? currentHiddenKeys.map((item) => cleanText(item)).filter(Boolean)
 1321:       : [],
 1322:   );
 1323: 
 1324:   if (hidden.has(key)) {
 1325:     hidden.delete(key);
 1326:   } else {
 1327:     hidden.add(key);
 1328:   }
 1329: 
 1330:   return Array.from(hidden);
 1331: }

 1373: function getStructuredTableBlock(
 1374:   table: SmartReportTable,
 1375:   sourceBlock?: StudioBlock,
 1376: ): StudioBlock {
 1377:   const settings = table.settings || {};
 1378:   const savedTitle = cleanText(sourceBlock?.title);
 1379:   const normalizedSavedTitle = savedTitle
 1380:     .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2")
 1381:     .toLowerCase()
 1382:     .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_")
 1383:     .replace(/^selected_/, "")
 1384:     .replace(/_(?:json|values?)$/, "")
 1385:     .replace(/^_|_$/g, "");
 1386:   const normalizedSourceKey = cleanText(table.sourceFieldKey)
 1387:     .toLowerCase()
 1388:     .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_")

 1390:     .replace(/_(?:json|values?)$/, "")
 1391:     .replace(/^_|_$/g, "");
 1392:   const title =
 1393:     !savedTitle || normalizedSavedTitle === normalizedSourceKey ? table.title : savedTitle;
 1394:   const studentDataTable = isStudentDataTable({
 1395:     sourceFieldKey: table.sourceFieldKey,
 1396:     sourceTableId: table.id,
 1397:     columns: table.columns,
 1398:   });
 1399:

 1403:     kind: "structured-table",

 1408:     source: sourceBlock?.source || "payload-table",

 1414:       table.columns.map((column) => cleanText(row.cells[column.key])),

 1432: function withReportTwoStructuredTables(
 1433:   template: StudioTemplate,
 1434:   payload: SmartReportPayload,
 1435: ): StudioTemplate {
 1436:   const tables = Array.isArray(payload.tables)
 1437:     ? payload.tables.map(normalizeSmartReportTablePresentation)
 1438:     : [];
 1439:   if (!tables.length) {
 1440:     return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder(template) as StudioTemplate;
 1441:   }
 1442: 
 1443:   const tableById = new Map(tables.map((table) => [table.id, table]));
 1444:   const boundTableIds = new Set<string>();
 1445:   let pages = template.pages.map((page) => ({
 1446:     ...page,
 1447:     blocks: page.blocks.flatMap((block) => {
 1448:       const canBindStructuredTable =
 1449:         block.kind === "structured-table" ||
 1450:         Boolean(cleanText(block.sourceTableId) || cleanText(block.sourceFieldKey));
 1451:       if (!canBindStructuredTable) return [block];
 1452:       const sourceTableId = cleanText(block.sourceTableId);
 1453:       const sourceFieldKey = cleanText(block.sourceFieldKey);
 1454:       const table =
 1455:         tableById.get(sourceTableId) ||
 1456:         tables.find((item) => item.sourceFieldKey === sourceFieldKey);
 1457:       if (!table) return [block];
 1458:       if (boundTableIds.has(table.id)) return [];
 1459:       boundTableIds.add(table.id);
 1460:       return [getStructuredTableBlock(table, block)];
 1461:     }),
 1462:   }));
 1463: 
 1464:   const missingTables = tables.filter((table) => !boundTableIds.has(table.id));
 1465:   if (!missingTables.length) {
 1466:     return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder({ ...template, pages }) as StudioTemplate;
 1467:   }
 1468: 
 1469:   let targetPageIndex = -1;
 1470:   for (let index = pages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
 1471:     if (pages[index].blocks.some((block) => block.kind === "dynamic-fields")) {
 1472:       targetPageIndex = index;
 1473:       break;
 1474:     }
 1475:   }
 1476:   if (targetPageIndex < 0) {
 1477:     targetPageIndex = pages.findIndex((page) => page.kind !== "evidence");
 1478:   }
 1479:   if (targetPageIndex < 0) targetPageIndex = 0;
 1480: 
 1481:   pages = pages.map((page, pageIndex) => {
 1482:     if (pageIndex !== targetPageIndex) return page;
 1483:     const insertionIndex = page.blocks.findIndex(
 1484:       (block) => block.kind === "evidence-gallery" || block.kind === "signature-grid",
 1485:     );
 1486:     const index = insertionIndex < 0 ? page.blocks.length : insertionIndex;
 1487:     return {
 1488:       ...page,
 1489:       blocks: [
 1490:         ...page.blocks.slice(0, index),
 1491:         ...missingTables.map((table) => getStructuredTableBlock(table)),
 1492:         ...page.blocks.slice(index),
 1493:       ],
 1494:     };
 1495:   });
 1496: 
 1497:   return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder({ ...template, pages }) as StudioTemplate;
 1498: }

 1613: function reorderReportTwoPages(
 1614:   pages: StudioPage[],
 1615:   sourcePageId: string,
 1616:   direction: "previous" | "next",
 1617: ) {
 1618:   const index = pages.findIndex((page) => page.id === sourcePageId);
 1619: 
 1620:   if (index < 0) return pages;
 1621: 
 1622:   const targetIndex = direction === "previous" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
 1623: 
 1624:   if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= pages.length) {
 1625:     return pages;
 1626:   }
 1627: 
 1628:   const nextPages = [...pages];
 1629:   const [page] = nextPages.splice(index, 1);
 1630:   nextPages.splice(targetIndex, 0, page);
 1631: 
 1632:   return nextPages;
 1633: }

 1636: function isReportTwoDynamicFieldsBlock(block: StudioBlock | null | undefined) {
 1637:   if (!block) return false;

 1641:   const title = cleanText(block.title);

 1645:     kind === "field-list" ||

 1647:     kind === "student-summary" ||
 1648:     kind === "service-summary" ||
 1649:     smartKind === "dynamic-fields" ||
 1650:     smartKind === "field-list" ||
 1651:     title.includes("حقول") ||
 1652:     title.includes("بيانات الحالة")
 1653:   );

 1659: function getReportTwoDisplayText(value: unknown): string {
 1660:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 1661:     return value
 1662:       .map((item) => getReportTwoDisplayText(item))
 1663:       .filter(Boolean)
 1664:       .join("، ");
 1665:   }
 1666: 
 1667:   if (value && typeof value === "object") {
 1668:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 1669: 
 1670:     const candidates = [
 1671:       record.displayValue,
 1672:       record.valueLabel,
 1673:       record.optionLabel,
 1674:       record.selectedOptionLabel,
 1675:       record.labelAr,
 1676:       record.nameAr,
 1677:       record.titleAr,
 1678:       record.label,
 1679:       record.name,
 1680:       record.title,
 1681:       record.text,
 1682:       record.value,
 1683:     ];
 1684: 
 1685:     for (const candidate of candidates) {
 1686:       const text = cleanText(candidate);
 1687: 
 1688:       if (text) return text;
 1689:     }
 1690: 
 1691:     return "";
 1692:   }

 1711: function getReportTwoOptionArabicLabel(field: any, rawValue: unknown) {

 1714:   if (!target) return "";

 1731:         displayValue: option.displayValue,

 1750: function getReportTwoReadableFieldLabel(field: any, index: number) {

 1827:   ];

 1833:   }

 1850: function getReportTwoDynamicFieldsFromPreviewCase(
 1851:   previewCase: ReturnType<typeof getPreviewCase>,
 1852: ): ReportTwoDynamicField[] {
 1853:   const fields = (previewCase.values || [])
 1854:     .map((item: any, index: number) => {
 1855:       const key = cleanText(item.fieldKey) || `workflow-field-${index + 1}`;
 1856:       const label = cleanText(item.fieldLabel) || key || `حقل ${index + 1}`;
 1857:       const value = cleanText(item.value);
 1858:       const valueItems = Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
 1859:         ? uniqueReportTwoValueItems(item.valueItems)
 1860:         : [];
 1861: 
 1862:       return {
 1863:         id: key || `workflow-field-${index + 1}`,
 1864:         key,
 1865:         label,
 1866:         value,
 1867:         ...(valueItems.length > 1 ? { valueItems } : {}),
 1868:         visible: Boolean(label && (value || valueItems.length)),
 1869:       };
 1870:     })
 1871:     .filter((item) => item.label && (item.value || item.valueItems?.length))
 1872:     .filter(
 1873:       (item) =>
 1874:         !previewCase.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(item),
 1875:     );
 1876: 
 1877:   return ensureUniqueReportTwoDynamicFieldIds(fields);
 1878: }
 1879: 
 1880: function getDynamicFieldsForBlock(
 1881:   block: StudioBlock | null,
 1882:   previewCase: ReturnType<typeof getPreviewCase>,
 1883: ) {
 1884:   const sourceFields = getReportTwoDynamicFieldsFromPreviewCase(previewCase);
 1885: 
 1886:   if (!block?.dynamicFields?.length) {
 1887:     return sourceFields;
 1888:   }
 1889: 
 1890:   const sourceByKey = new Map<string, ReportTwoDynamicField>();
 1891: 
 1892:   sourceFields.forEach((field) => {
 1893:     [field.id, field.key, field.label].forEach((value) => {
 1894:       const key = getReportTwoLookupKey(value);
 1895: 
 1896:       if (key) {
 1897:         sourceByKey.set(key, field);
 1898:       }
 1899:     });
 1900:   });
 1901: 
 1902:   const fields = block.dynamicFields
 1903:     .filter(
 1904:       (field) =>
 1905:         !previewCase.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(field),
 1906:     )
 1907:     .map((field, index) => {
 1908:     const source =
 1909:       sourceByKey.get(getReportTwoLookupKey(field.key)) ||
 1910:       sourceByKey.get(getReportTwoLookupKey(field.id)) ||
 1911:       sourceByKey.get(getReportTwoLookupKey(field.label)) ||
 1912:       sourceFields[index];
 1913: 
 1914:     const key = field.key || source?.key || `dynamic-field-${index + 1}`;
 1915:     const configuredValue = cleanText(field.value);
 1916:     const configuredValueItems = Array.isArray(field.valueItems)
 1917:       ? uniqueReportTwoValueItems(field.valueItems)
 1918:       : [];
 1919:     const sourceValue = cleanText(source?.value);
 1920:     const sourceValueItems = Array.isArray(source?.valueItems)
 1921:       ? uniqueReportTwoValueItems(source.valueItems)
 1922:       : [];
 1923:     const matchesSourceValue =
 1924:       Boolean(configuredValue && sourceValue) &&
 1925:       getReportTwoLookupKey(configuredValue) === getReportTwoLookupKey(sourceValue);
 1926:     const shouldUseSourceValueItems =
 1927:       sourceValueItems.length > 1 &&
 1928:       ((configuredValueItems.length > 0 &&
 1929:         configuredValueItems.every((item) => isReportTwoTechnicalValue(item))) ||
 1930:         (configuredValueItems.length === 0 &&
 1931:           (!configuredValue ||
 1932:             isReportTwoTechnicalValue(configuredValue) ||
 1933:             matchesSourceValue)));
 1934:     const valueItems = shouldUseSourceValueItems
 1935:       ? sourceValueItems
 1936:       : configuredValueItems;
 1937:     const value =
 1938:       configuredValue && !shouldUseSourceValueItems
 1939:         ? configuredValue
 1940:         : sourceValue || getReportTwoFieldValue(field.value) || configuredValue;
 1941: 
 1942:     return {
 1943:       id: field.id || source?.id || `dynamic-field-${index + 1}`,
 1944:       key,
 1945:       label: field.label ?? cleanText(source?.label) ?? getReportTwoFieldLabel(field.key, field.label) ?? key,
 1946:       value,
 1947:       ...(valueItems.length > 1 ? { valueItems } : {}),
 1948:       visible: field.visible !== false,
 1949:     };
 1950:   });
 1951: 
 1952:   return ensureUniqueReportTwoDynamicFieldIds(fields);
 1953: }

 2456: function getReportTwoPreparedExecutionSummary(payload: SmartReportPayload) {
 2457:   return cleanText(
 2458:     (payload as any)?.narrative?.body ||

 2465: function isReportTwoExecutionSummaryPlaceholderText(input: unknown) {
 2466:   const content = cleanText(input).toLowerCase();
 2467: 
 2468:   if (!content) return true;
 2469:   if (content.includes("workflow")) return true;
 2470:   if (content.includes("تم توثيق هذا الجزء")) return true;
 2471:   if (content.includes("اكتب النص هنا")) return true;
 2472:   if (content.includes("{{execution")) return true;
 2473:   if (content.includes("{{report.execution")) return true;
 2474:   if (content.includes("{{case.execution")) return true;
 2475: 
 2476:   return false;
 2477: }
 2478: 
 2479: function isReportTwoExecutionSummaryBlock(block: StudioBlock) {
 2480:   if (
 2481:     block.kind !== "section-text" &&
 2482:     block.kind !== "multi-paragraph" &&
 2483:     block.kind !== "plain-text"
 2484:   ) {
 2485:     return false;
 2486:   }
 2487: 
 2488:   const title = cleanText(block.title).toLowerCase();
 2489:   const content = cleanText(block.content).toLowerCase();
 2490: 
 2491:   if (title.includes("وصف") && title.includes("تنفيذ")) return true;
 2492:   if (content.includes("workflow")) return true;
 2493:   if (content.includes("تم توثيق هذا الجزء")) return true;
 2494: 
 2495:   return false;
 2496: }
 2497: 
 2498: function shouldAutoApplyReportTwoExecutionSummary(block: StudioBlock) {
 2499:   if (!isReportTwoExecutionSummaryBlock(block)) {
 2500:     return false;
 2501:   }
 2502: 
 2503:   const rawBlock = block as any;
 2504: 
 2505:   if (rawBlock.autoFilledFromExecutionSummary === true) {
 2506:     return true;
 2507:   }
 2508: 
 2509:   return isReportTwoExecutionSummaryPlaceholderText(block.content);
 2510: }
 2511: 
 2512: function applyReportTwoPreparedExecutionSummary(
 2513:   template: StudioTemplate,
 2514:   payload: SmartReportPayload,
 2515: ): StudioTemplate {
 2516:   const showExecutionDescriptionInReport =
 2517:     (payload as any)?.narrative?.visible !== false;
 2518: 
 2519:   if (!showExecutionDescriptionInReport) {
 2520:     return {
 2521:       ...template,
 2522:       pages: template.pages.map((page) => ({
 2523:         ...page,
 2524:         blocks: page.blocks.filter(
 2525:           (block) => !isReportTwoExecutionSummaryBlock(block),
 2526:         ),
 2527:       })),
 2528:     };
 2529:   }
 2530: 
 2531:   const summary = getReportTwoPreparedExecutionSummary(payload);
 2532: 
 2533:   if (!summary) return template;
 2534: 
 2535:   let replaced = false;
 2536: 
 2537:   return {
 2538:     ...template,
 2539:     pages: template.pages.map((page) => ({
 2540:       ...page,
 2541:       blocks: page.blocks.map((block) => {
 2542:         if (replaced || !shouldAutoApplyReportTwoExecutionSummary(block)) {
 2543:           return block;
 2544:         }
 2545: 
 2546:         replaced = true;
 2547: 
 2548:         return {
 2549:           ...block,
 2550:           content: summary,
 2551:           autoFilledFromExecutionSummary: true,
 2552:         };
 2553:       }),
 2554:     })),
 2555:   };
 2556: }
 2557: function getBlockKindName(kind: StudioBlockKind) {
 2558:   if (kind === "hero-title") return "عنوان رئيسي";
 2559:   if (kind === "meta-strip") return "شريط بيانات";
 2560:   if (kind === "plain-text") return "نص بسيط";
 2561:   if (kind === "section-text") return "فقرة";
 2562:   if (kind === "multi-paragraph") return "فقرات";
 2563:   if (kind === "highlight-note") return "ملاحظة بارزة";
 2564:   if (kind === "bullet-list") return "قائمة";
 2565:   if (kind === "dynamic-fields") return "حقول الحالة";
 2566:   if (kind === "evidence-gallery") return "الشواهد";
 2567:   if (kind === "closing-note") return "خاتمة";
 2568:   if (kind === "report-one-table") return "جدول";
 2569:   if (kind === "structured-table") return "جدول بيانات";
 2570:   if (kind === "signature-grid") return "تواقيع الاعتماد";
 2571: 
 2572:   return "بلوك";
 2573: }

 3151:   async function createReportTwoApprovedSnapshotInternal(options?: {
 3152:     showSuccessPopup?: boolean;
 3153:     allowReuseExisting?: boolean;
 3154:   }) {
 3155:     const showSuccessPopup = options?.showSuccessPopup !== false;
 3156:     const allowReuseExisting = options?.allowReuseExisting !== false;
 3157: 
 3158:     if (reportTwoApprovalSubmitting) return null;
 3159: 
 3160:     if (approvedSnapshot && allowReuseExisting) {
 3161:       return approvedSnapshot;
 3162:     }
 3163: 
 3164:     if (!signedVisiblePreviewTemplate.pages.length) {
 3165:       setReportTwoActionModal({
 3166:         title: "اعتماد التقرير",
 3167:         message: "لا توجد صفحات جاهزة للاعتماد.",
 3168:       });
 3169:       return null;
 3170:     }
 3171: 
 3172:     if (!signedVisiblePreviewTemplate.pages.length) {
 3173:       setPopup({
 3174:         type: "alert",
 3175:         title: "اعتماد التقرير",
 3176:         message: "لا توجد صفحات جاهزة للاعتماد.",
 3177:       });
 3178:       return null;
 3179:     }
 3180: 
 3181:     const snapshotHtml = buildReportTwoSnapshotHtml();
 3182: 
 3183:     if (!snapshotHtml.trim()) {
 3184:       setReportTwoActionModal({
 3185:         title: "اعتماد التقرير",
 3186:         message: "تعذر التقاط معاينة التقرير الحالية للاعتماد.",
 3187:       });
 3188:       return null;
 3189:     }
 3190: 
 3191:     if (!snapshotHtml.trim()) {
 3192:       setPopup({
 3193:         type: "alert",
 3194:         title: "اعتماد التقرير",
 3195:         message: "تعذر التقاط معاينة التقرير الحالية للاعتماد.",
 3196:       });
 3197:       return null;
 3198:     }
 3199: 
 3200:     setReportTwoApprovalSubmitting(true);
 3201: 
 3202:     try {
 3203:       const activeTemplate = templates.find(
 3204:         (item) => item.id === selectedTemplateOptionId,
 3205:       );
 3206:       const response = await fetch(
 3207:         `/api/dashboard/report-2/cases/${encodeURIComponent(caseId)}/approve`,
 3208:         {
 3209:           method: "POST",
 3210:           headers: {
 3211:             "Content-Type": "application/json",
 3212:           },
 3213:           body: JSON.stringify({
 3214:             reportTitle: getReportTwoSnapshotTitle(),
 3215:             templateId: selectedTemplateOptionId || null,
 3216:             templateName: activeTemplate?.name || template.name || null,
 3217:             variantId: selectedVariantId || null,

 3219:             snapshotTemplateJson: signedVisiblePreviewTemplate,
 3220:             snapshotPagesJson: signedVisiblePreviewTemplate.pages,
 3221:             snapshotHtml,

 3223:             approvedEditConfirmed: persistedReport?.status === "APPROVED",
 3224:           }),
 3225:         },
 3226:       );
 3227:       const text = await response.text();
 3228:       let result: any = {};
 3229: 
 3230:       try {
 3231:         result = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
 3232:       } catch {
 3233:         result = {
 3234:           error: text || `HTTP ${response.status}`,
 3235:         };
 3236:       }
 3237: 
 3238:       if (!response.ok) {
 3239:         throw new Error(
 3240:           result?.details ||
 3241:             result?.error ||
 3242:             `APPROVAL_FAILED_${response.status}`,
 3243:         );

 3260:         previewUrl: nextApprovedSnapshot.previewUrl,

 3262:

 3264:         setReportTwoActionModal({

 3268:           linkLabel: "استعراض التقرير المعتمد",

 3272:

 3276:           title: "تم اعتماد التقرير",
 3277:           message: "تم حفظ نسخة ثابتة من التقرير في أرشيف التقارير المعتمدة.",
 3278:         });
 3279:       }
 3280: 
 3281:       return nextApprovedSnapshot;

 3284:       setReportTwoActionModal({
 3285:         title: "اعتماد التقرير",
 3286:         message: "تعذر اعتماد التقرير. حاول مرة أخرى.",

 3289:       setPopup({
 3290:         type: "alert",

 3608:     if (reportTwoSaveSubmitting) return;

 3641:             snapshotPagesJson: signedVisiblePreviewTemplate.pages,

 3645:             approvedEditConfirmed,
 3646:           }),
 3647:         },

 3650:       if (!response.ok) throw new Error(result.error || "تعذر حفظ التقرير.");

 3652:         id: result.report.id,
 3653:         status: result.report.status,

 3996:       page.blocks.some((block) => block.id === selectedBlock.id),

 4000:     const index = sourcePage.blocks.findIndex(
 4001:       (block) => block.id === selectedBlock.id,
 4002:     );
 4003: 
 4004:     if (index < 0) return;

 4007:       selectedBlock.kind === "structured-table" && isStudentDataTable(selectedBlock);

 4011:     }

 4014:       return;
 4015:     }
 4016: 
 4017:     const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
 4018: 
 4019:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= sourcePage.blocks.length) return;
 4020:     const targetBlock = sourcePage.blocks[targetIndex];
 4021:     if (direction === "down" && isReportTwoSignatureBlock(targetBlock)) {
 4022:       setSemanticPlacementNotice("لا يمكن وضع محتوى بعد كتلة التوقيعات.");
 4023:       return;
 4024:     }
 4025:     if (
 4026:       direction === "up" &&
 4027:       targetBlock.kind === "structured-table" &&
 4028:       isStudentDataTable(targetBlock)
 4029:     ) {
 4030:       setSemanticPlacementNotice("جدول بيانات الطلاب يظهر دائمًا في بداية التقرير.");
 4031:       return;
 4032:     }
 4033: 
 4034:     const nextBlocks = [...sourcePage.blocks];
 4035:     const [block] = nextBlocks.splice(index, 1);
 4036:     nextBlocks.splice(targetIndex, 0, block);

 4039:       ...page,
 4040:       blocks: nextBlocks,
 4041:     }));

 4063:   function moveDynamicField(

 4065:     fieldId: string,
 4066:     direction: "up" | "down",
 4067:   ) {

 4070:       const index = fields.findIndex((field) => field.id === fieldId);
 4071: 
 4072:       if (index < 0) return block;
 4073: 
 4074:       const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
 4075: 
 4076:       if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= fields.length) return block;
 4077: 
 4078:       const nextFields = [...fields];
 4079:       const [field] = nextFields.splice(index, 1);
 4080:       nextFields.splice(targetIndex, 0, field);
 4081: 
 4082:       return {
 4083:         ...block,
 4084:         dynamicFields: nextFields,
 4085:       };
 4086:     });
 4087:   }

  373: function buildCertificateValues(data: RuntimePreviewCaseData) {
  374:   const studentGender = cleanValue(getValue(data, ["studentGender", "gender"])) || "";
  375:   const studentName =
  376:     cleanValue(getValue(data, ["studentName", "recipientName"])) ||
  377:     data.student?.name ||
  378:     "اسم الطالب";
  379: 
  380:   const studentClass =
  381:     cleanValue(getValue(data, ["studentClass", "student_class"])) ||
  382:     [data.student?.grade, data.student?.classroom].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") ||
  383:     "الصف / الفصل";
  384: 
  385:   const counselorTitleRaw = cleanValue(getValue(data, ["counselorTitle", "guideTitle", "advisorTitle"]));
  386:   const schoolLeaderTitleRaw = cleanValue(getValue(data, ["schoolLeaderTitle", "principalTitle", "leaderTitle"]));
  387: 
  388:   const counselorGender = cleanValue(
  389:     getValue(data, ["counselorGender", "guideGender", "advisorGender", "userGender", "gender"])
  390:   );
  391: 
  392:   const schoolLeaderGender = cleanValue(
  393:     getValue(data, ["schoolLeaderGender", "principalGender", "leaderGender"])
  394:   );
  395: 
  396:   return {
  397:     ministryName: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["ministryName"])) || "وزارة التعليم",
  398: 
  399:     ministryLogoUrl:
  400:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["ministryLogoUrl", "ministry_logo_url"])) ||
  401:       MOE_LOGO_SRC,
  402: 
  403:     schoolName: formatSchoolName(cleanValue(getValue(data, ["schoolName", "school_name"]))),
  404: 
  405:     educationDepartment: formatEducationDepartment(
  406:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["educationDepartment", "education_department"]))
  407:     ),
  408: 
  409:     educationOffice: formatEducationOffice(
  410:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["educationOffice", "education_office"]))
  411:     ),
  412: 
  413:     academicYear:
  414:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["academicYear", "academic_year"])) ||
  415:       "١٤٤٠ هـ / ١٤٣٩ هـ",
  416: 
  417:     studentName,
  418:     studentGender,
  419:     studentLabel: normalizeGender(studentGender) === "FEMALE" ? "الطالبة" : "الطالب",
  420:     studentClass,
  421:     stage: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["stage", "studentStage"])) || data.student?.stage || "",
  422: 
  423:     certificateTitle:
  424:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["certificateTitle"])) || "شهادة شكر وتقدير",
  425: 
  426:     appreciationReason:
  427:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["appreciationReason", "reason"])) ||
  428:       "تميزه في المتابعة الطلبة والمواقف اليومية الطارئةية",
  429: 
  430:     achievementCategory:
  431:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["achievementCategory", "category"])) ||
  432:       "التميز الطلابي",
  433: 
  434:     achievementTitle:
  435:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["achievementTitle"])) ||
  436:       "تميز ملحوظ",
  437: 
  438:     achievementSummary:
  439:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["achievementSummary"])) || "",
  440: 
  441:     termName:
  442:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["termName", "semesterName"])) ||
  443:       "الفصل الدراسي",
  444: 
  445:     weekName:
  446:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["weekName", "schoolWeek"])) ||
  447:       "الأسبوع",
  448: 
  449:     issueDate:
  450:       formatDisplayDate(cleanValue(getValue(data, ["issueDate", "date"])) || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)),
  451: 
  452:     certificateNumber:
  453:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["certificateNumber", "serialNumber"])) || "",
  454: 
  455:     score: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["score", "performanceScore"])) || "—",
  456:     rank: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["rank"])) || "",
  457:     attendanceRate: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["attendanceRate"])) || "—",
  458:     behaviorScore: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["behaviorScore"])) || "",
  459:     followUpResult: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["followUpResult", "result"])) || "متميز",
  460:     recommendation: cleanValue(getValue(data, ["recommendation", "notes"])) || "",
  461: 
  462:     counselorName:
  463:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["counselorName", "guideName", "advisorName", "studentGuideName"])) || "",
  464: 
  465:     counselorTitleDisplay: resolveCounselorTitle(counselorTitleRaw, counselorGender),
  466: 
  467:     schoolLeaderName:
  468:       cleanValue(getValue(data, ["schoolLeaderName", "principalName", "leaderName"])) || "",
  469: 
  470:     schoolLeaderTitleDisplay: resolveSchoolLeaderTitle(schoolLeaderTitleRaw, schoolLeaderGender),
  471:   };
  472: }
  473: 
  474: function getValue(data: RuntimePreviewCaseData, keys: string[]) {
  475:   const values = Array.isArray(data.values) ? (data.values as PreviewValue[]) : [];
  476: 
  477:   for (const key of keys) {
  478:     const item = values.find((value) => value.fieldKey === key);
  479: 
  480:     if (item?.value !== undefined && item.value !== null && String(item.value).trim()) {
  481:       return String(item.value).trim();
  482:     }
  483:   }
  484: 
  485:   return "";
  486: }
  487: 
  488: function cleanValue(value: unknown) {
  489:   if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
  490: 
  491:   const cleaned = String(value).trim();
  492: 
  493:   if (!cleaned || cleaned === "null" || cleaned === "undefined") return "";
  494: 
  495:   return cleaned;
  496: }
  497: 
  498: function formatSchoolName(value: string) {
  499:   if (!value) return "مدرسة ........................";
  500:   if (value.startsWith("مدرسة")) return value;
  501:   return `مدرسة ${value}`;
  502: }
  503: 
  504: function formatEducationDepartment(value: string) {
  505:   if (!value) return "الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة ................";
  506:   if (value.startsWith("الإدارة") || value.includes("الإدارة العامة")) return value;
  507:   return `الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة ${value}`;
  508: }
  509: 
  510: function formatEducationOffice(value: string) {
  511:   if (!value) return "مكتب التعليم بمحافظة ................";
  512:   if (value.startsWith("مكتب")) return value;
  513:   if (value.startsWith("ب")) return `مكتب التعليم ${value}`;
  514:   return `مكتب التعليم ب${value}`;
  515: }
  516: 
  517: function formatDisplayDate(value: string) {
  518:   const cleaned = cleanValue(value);
  519:   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cleaned)) return cleaned.replaceAll("-", "/");
  520:   return cleaned || "........................";
  521: }
  522: 
  523: function normalizeGender(value: string) {
  524:   const cleaned = cleanValue(value).toLowerCase();
  525: 
  526:   if (
  527:     cleaned.includes("female") ||
  528:     cleaned.includes("أنثى") ||
  529:     cleaned.includes("انثى") ||
  530:     cleaned.includes("طالبة") ||
  531:     cleaned.includes("موجهة") ||
  532:     cleaned.includes("مرشدة") ||
  533:     cleaned.includes("قائدة")
  534:   ) {
  535:     return "FEMALE";
  536:   }
  537: 
  538:   if (
  539:     cleaned.includes("male") ||
  540:     cleaned.includes("ذكر") ||
  541:     cleaned.includes("طالب") ||
  542:     cleaned.includes("موجه") ||
  543:     cleaned.includes("مرشد") ||
  544:     cleaned.includes("قائد")
  545:   ) {
  546:     return "MALE";
  547:   }
  548: 
  549:   return "UNKNOWN";
  550: }
  551: 
  552: function resolveCounselorTitle(title: string, gender: string) {
  553:   const cleanedTitle = cleanValue(title);
  554: 
  555:   if (
  556:     cleanedTitle &&
  557:     cleanedTitle !== "الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية" &&
  558:     cleanedTitle !== "الموجه / الموجهة الطلابية"
  559:   ) {
  560:     return cleanedTitle;
  561:   }
  562: 
  563:   const normalizedGender = normalizeGender(`${gender} ${cleanedTitle}`);
  564:   if (normalizedGender === "FEMALE") return "الموجهة الطلابية";
  565:   if (normalizedGender === "MALE") return "الموجه الطلابي";
  566:   return "الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية";
  567: }
  568: 
  569: function resolveSchoolLeaderTitle(title: string, gender: string) {
  570:   const cleanedTitle = cleanValue(title);
  571: 
  572:   if (
  573:     cleanedTitle &&
  574:     cleanedTitle !== "قائد/قائدة المدرسة" &&
  575:     cleanedTitle !== "قائد / قائدة المدرسة"
  576:   ) {
  577:     return cleanedTitle;
  578:   }
  579: 
  580:   const normalizedGender = normalizeGender(`${gender} ${cleanedTitle}`);
  581:   if (normalizedGender === "FEMALE") return "قائدة المدرسة";
  582:   if (normalizedGender === "MALE") return "قائد المدرسة";
  583:   return "قائد/قائدة المدرسة";
  584: }
  585: 
  586: function normalizeTemplateInfo(template: unknown) {
  587:   if (!template || typeof template !== "object") {
  588:     return {
  589:       name: appreciationCertificateTemplatePreset.name,
  590:       description: appreciationCertificateTemplatePreset.description,
  591:       sourceLabel: "قالب رسمي",
  592:     };
  593:   }
  594: 
  595:   const item = template as { name?: unknown; description?: unknown; status?: unknown };
  596: 
  597:   return {
  598:     name:
  599:       typeof item.name === "string" && item.name.trim()
  600:         ? item.name
  601:         : appreciationCertificateTemplatePreset.name,
  602: 
  603:     description:
  604:       typeof item.description === "string" && item.description.trim()
  605:         ? item.description
  606:         : appreciationCertificateTemplatePreset.description,
  607: 
  608:     sourceLabel: item.status === "PUBLISHED" ? "قالب منشور" : "قالب رسمي",
  609:   };
  610: }
