    7: 
    8: function getValueItems(item: ReportValueItem) {
    9:   const source = item.valueItems?.length
   10:     ? item.valueItems
   11:     : Array.isArray(item.value)
   12:       ? item.value
   13:       : [];
   14: 
   15:   return Array.from(
   16:     new Set(source.map((value) => String(value || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)),
   17:   );
   18: }
   19: 
   20: function getDisplayValue(item: ReportValueItem, valueItems: string[]) {
   21:   if (valueItems.length === 1) {
   22:     return valueItems[0];
   23:   }
   24: 
   25:   if (!Array.isArray(item.value)) {
   26:     const value = String(item.value || "").trim();
   27:     if (value) return value;
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   return "غير متوفر";
   31: }

    1: import type {

   10: 
   11: const SECTION_HEADER_COLORS = [
   12:   "#fee8a8",
   13:   "#ececec",
   14:   "#dce7f7",
   15:   "#e1efd9",
   16: ] as const;
   17: 
   18: function getDisplayValue(
   19:   item: ReportValueItem,
   20: ) {
   21:   if (
   22:     Array.isArray(item.valueItems) &&
   23:     item.valueItems.length
   24:   ) {
   25:     return item.valueItems.join(
   26:       " • ",
   27:     );
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (Array.isArray(item.value)) {
   31:     return item.value.join(" • ");
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   return String(
   35:     item.value || "—",
   36:   );
   37: }
   38: 
   39: export function MoeClassicFrameValueGrid({
   40:   items,
   41: }: ReportValueGridProps) {
   42:   const visibleItems =
   43:     items.filter(
   44:       (item) =>
   45:         String(
   46:           item.label || "",
   47:         ).trim() ||
   48:         String(
   49:           getDisplayValue(item),
   50:         ).trim(),
   51:     );
   52: 
   53:   if (!visibleItems.length) {
   54:     return null;
   55:   }
   56:

   58:     getReportSmartFieldProfile(
   59:       visibleItems,
   60:     );

   34: export type MoeOfficial2024ValueItem = {
   35:   key?: string;
   36:   label: string;
   37:   value?: string | string[] | null;
   38: };
   39: 
   40: type FieldVisual = {
   41:   icon: LucideIcon;
   42:   tone: "teal" | "green";
   43: };
   44: 
   45: function normalizeArabicLabel(value: string) {
   46:   return String(value || "")
   47:     .trim()
   48:     .replace(/[إأآ]/g, "ا")
   49:     .replace(/ة/g, "ه")
   50:     .replace(/ى/g, "ي");
   51: }
   52: 
   53: function getMoe24FieldVisual(
   54:   label: string,
   55:   index: number,
   56: ): FieldVisual {
   57:   const text = normalizeArabicLabel(label);
   58: 
   59:   const includesAny = (...words: string[]) =>
   60:     words.some((word) => text.includes(normalizeArabicLabel(word)));
   61: 
   62:   if (
   63:     includesAny(
   64:       "التقرير",
   65:       "السجل",
   66:       "الوثيقة",
   67:       "المرفق",
   68:       "النموذج",
   69:       "الملف",
   70:     )
   71:   ) {
   72:     return { icon: FileText, tone: "green" };
   73:   }
   74: 
   75:   if (
   76:     includesAny(
   77:       "المادة",
   78:       "التدريس",
   79:       "التعلم",
   80:       "المنهج",
   81:       "المقرر",
   82:       "المجال",
   83:     )
   84:   ) {
   85:     return { icon: BookOpen, tone: "teal" };
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (
   89:     includesAny(
   90:       "الطلاب",
   91:       "الطالبات",
   92:       "المستفيد",
   93:       "المستفيدين",
   94:       "الفئة",
   95:       "الحضور",
   96:     )
   97:   ) {
   98:     return { icon: UsersRound, tone: "teal" };
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   if (
  102:     includesAny(
  103:       "المعلم",
  104:       "المعلمة",
  105:       "المنفذ",
  106:       "المسؤول",
  107:       "المشرف",
  108:       "المرشد",
  109:       "الموجه",
  110:     )
  111:   ) {
  112:     return { icon: UserRound, tone: "green" };
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   if (
  116:     includesAny(
  117:       "التاريخ",
  118:       "اليوم",
  119:       "الفصل",
  120:       "الاسبوع",
  121:       "الأسبوع",
  122:       "موعد",
  123:     )
  124:   ) {
  125:     return { icon: CalendarDays, tone: "green" };
  126:   }
  127:

  389: 
  390: function normalizeValue(
  391:   value: string | string[] | null | undefined,
  392: ): string[] {
  393:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  394:     return value
  395:       .map((item) => String(item || "").trim())
  396:       .filter(Boolean);
  397:   }
  398: 
  399:   return String(value || "")
  400:     .split(/\n+/)
  401:     .map((item) => item.trim())
  402:     .filter(Boolean);
  403: }
  404: 
  405: function renderFieldValue(
  406:   value: string | string[] | null | undefined,
  407: ): ReactNode {
  408:   const items = normalizeValue(value);
  409: 
  410:   if (!items.length) {
  411:     return "غير متوفر";
  412:   }
  413: 
  414:   if (items.length === 1) {
  415:     return items[0];
  416:   }
  417: 
  418:   return (
  419:     <ul className="moe24-report-list">
  420:       {items.map((item, index) => (
  421:         <li key={`${item}-${index}`}>{item}</li>
  422:       ))}
  423:     </ul>
  424:   );
  425: }
  426: 
  427: export function MoeOfficial2024ValueGrid({
  428:   items,
  429: }: {
  430:   items: MoeOfficial2024ValueItem[];
  431: }) {
  432:   return (
  433:     <div
  434:       className="moe24-report-details-panel"
  435:       style={{
  436:         padding: "calc(4mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  437:         paddingTop: "calc(5mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  438:       }}
  439:     >
  440:       <div
  441:         className="moe24-report-detail-grid"
  442:         style={{
  443:           rowGap: "calc(2mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  444:           columnGap: "calc(4mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  445:         }}
  446:       >
  447:         {items.map((item, index) => {
  448:           const valueItems = normalizeValue(item.value);
  449:           const serializedValue = valueItems.join(" ");
  450: 
  451:           const isCompactArray =
  452:             valueItems.length > 1 &&
  453:             valueItems.length <= 4 &&
  454:             serializedValue.length <= 190 &&
  455:             valueItems.every((entry) => entry.length <= 85);
  456: 
  457:           /*
  458:            * لا نستخدم العرض الكامل إلا عند الحاجة الحقيقية.
  459:            *
  460:            * القوائم الصغيرة والمتوسطة تبقى نصف صف.
  461:            * النص المتوسط يسمح له بسطرين أو ثلاثة داخل العمود.
  462:            */
  463:           const wide =
  464:             valueItems.length >= 5 ||
  465:             serializedValue.length > 240 ||
  466:             valueItems.some((entry) => entry.length > 135) ||
  467:             serializedValue.includes("\n\n");
  468: 
  469:           const visual = getMoe24FieldVisual(
  470:             item.label,
  471:             index,
  472:           );
  473: 
  474:           const Icon = visual.icon;
  475: 
  476:           return (
  477:             <article
  478:               key={item.key || item.label || index}
  479:               className={[
  480:                 "moe24-report-field",
  481:                 `moe24-report-field-${visual.tone}`,
  482:                 wide ? "moe24-report-field-wide" : "",
  483:                 isCompactArray
  484:                   ? "moe24-report-field-compact-list"
  485:                   : "",
  486:               ]
  487:                 .filter(Boolean)
  488:                 .join(" ")}
  489:               style={{
  490:                 minHeight: "calc(12mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  491:                 gap: "calc(2.5mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  492:                 padding: "calc(1.5mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1)) calc(2.2mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  493:               }}
  494:             >
  495:               <span
  496:                 className="moe24-report-field-icon"
  497:                 aria-hidden="true"
  498:               >
  499:                 <Icon />
  500:               </span>
  501: 
  502:               <div className="moe24-report-field-content">
  503:                 <div className="moe24-report-field-label">
  504:                   <span
  505:                     className="moe24-report-field-dot"
  506:                     aria-hidden="true"
  507:                   />
  508: 
  509:                   <span
  510:                     style={{
  511:                       fontSize: "calc(7.8px * var(--report-field-label-scale, 1))",
  512:                     }}
  513:                   >
  514:                     {item.label}
  515:                   </span>
  516:                 </div>
  517: 
  518:                 <strong
  519:                   style={{
  520:                     marginTop: "calc(1mm * var(--report-field-spacing-scale, 1))",
  521:                     fontSize: `calc(${wide ? 9.8 : 10}px * var(--report-field-value-scale, 1))`,
  522:                     lineHeight: `calc(${wide ? 1.55 : 1.45}em * var(--report-narrative-density-scale, 1))`,
  523:                   }}
  524:                 >
  525:                   {renderFieldValue(item.value)}
  526:                 </strong>
  527:               </div>
  528:             </article>
  529:           );
  530:         })}
  531:       </div>
  532:     </div>
  533:   );
  534: }

  176:   value: unknown,

  178:   return (
  179:     typeof value === "string" &&
  180:     SELECTABLE_REPORT_DESIGN_IDS.includes(value as SelectableReportDesignId)
  181:   );
  182: }

  188:     reportDesignTemplates.find((design) => design.id === designId) ||
  189:     reportDesignTemplates[0]

    6: function findSavedEvidenceGalleryBlock(template: any) {
    7:   const pages = Array.isArray(template?.pages) ? template.pages : [];
    8: 
    9:   for (const page of pages) {
   10:     const blocks = Array.isArray(page?.blocks) ? page.blocks : [];
   11:     const block = blocks.find((item: any) => item?.kind === "evidence-gallery");
   12: 
   13:     if (block) {
   14:       return block;
   15:     }
   16:   }
   17: 
   18:   return null;
   19: }
   20: export function normalizeFinalReportTemplate(
   21:   template: any,
   22:   editorialBlocks: Record<string, string>,
   23:   previewCaseData: PreviewCaseData | null,
   24: ) {
   25:   const pages = Array.isArray(template?.pages) ? template.pages : [];
   26:   const savedEvidenceBlock = findSavedEvidenceGalleryBlock(template);
   27:   const hasEvidence = getValidPreviewEvidences(previewCaseData).length > 0;
   28: 
   29:   return {
   30:     ...template,
   31:     pages: pages.flatMap((page: any, pageIndex: number) => {
   32:       if (!hasEvidence && page?.kind === "evidence") {
   33:         return [];
   34:       }
   35: 
   36:       const pageBlocks = Array.isArray(page?.blocks) ? page.blocks : [];
   37: 
   38:       const normalizedBlocks = pageBlocks
   39:         .map((block: any, blockIndex: number) =>
   40:           normalizeFinalReportBlock(template, block, blockIndex, editorialBlocks),
   41:         )
   42:         .filter((block: any) => hasEvidence || block.kind !== "evidence-gallery");
   43: 
   44:       const shouldAddEvidenceBlock =
   45:         hasEvidence &&
   46:         page?.kind === "evidence" &&
   47:         !savedEvidenceBlock &&
   48:         !normalizedBlocks.some((block: any) => block.kind === "evidence-gallery");
   49: 
   50:       return [{
   51:         ...page,
   52:         id: page?.id || "final-page-" + (pageIndex + 1),
   53:         title: page?.title || "صفحة " + (pageIndex + 1),
   54:         kind: page?.kind || "content",
   55:         blocks: shouldAddEvidenceBlock
   56:           ? [
   57:               ...normalizedBlocks,
   58:               {
   59:                 id: "auto-evidence-gallery-" + (pageIndex + 1),
   60:                 kind: "evidence-gallery",
   61:                 title: "الشواهد والمرفقات",
   62:                 content: "",
   63:                 variant: "card",
   64:                 align: "right",
   65:                 showTitle: true,
   66:                 placement: "flow",
   67:                 evidenceLayout: "GRID_2X2",
   68:                 evidenceFit: "contain",
   69:                 evidenceAspectRatio: "LANDSCAPE_4_3",
   70:                 evidenceShowCaptions: true,
   71:                 evidenceAutoCreatePages: true,
   72:                 evidenceEmptyBehavior: "message",
   73:               },
   74:             ]
   75:           : normalizedBlocks,
   76:       }];
   77:     }),
   78:   };

  367: function getFinalEditedBlockContent(
  368:   block: any,
  369:   blockId: string,
  370:   editorialBlocks: Record<string, string>,
  371: ) {
  372:   const candidateKeys = [
  373:     blockId,
  374:     block?.id ? String(block.id) : "",
  375:   ].filter(Boolean);
  376: 
  377:   for (const key of candidateKeys) {
  378:     const value = editorialBlocks[key];
  379: 
  380:     if (!value || !String(value).trim()) {
  381:       continue;
  382:     }
  383: 
  384:     if (isFinalLegacyRenderedReportDump(value)) {
  385:       continue;
  386:     }
  387: 
  388:     return value;
  389:   }
  390: 
  391:   return "";
  392: }

  394: function isFinalLegacyRenderedReportDump(value: string) {
  395:   const text = String(value || "");
  396: 
  397:   if (!text.trim()) {
  398:     return false;
  399:   }
  400: 
  401:   const hasReplacementChars = /�/.test(text);
  402:   const hasMojibakeMarks = /[ØÙÃ]/.test(text);
  403:   const hasReportDumpLabels =
  404:     /program_name\s*:|semester\s*:|gregorian_date\s*:|beneficiaries\s*:|execution_action\s*:|execution_mechanism\s*:|performance_indicator\s*:|selectedStudent\s*:/.test(
  405:       text,
  406:     );
  407: 
  408:   const hasOldArabicDump =
  409:     text.includes("ملخص التقارير") ||
  410:     text.includes("بيانات الحالة") ||
  411:     text.includes("القيم المسجلة") ||
  412:     text.includes("الشواهد:") ||
  413:     text.includes("تقرير:");
  414: 
  415:   const tooLongForBlock = text.length > 1800;
  416: 
  417:   return (
  418:     hasReplacementChars ||
  419:     hasMojibakeMarks ||
  420:     hasReportDumpLabels ||
  421:     (hasOldArabicDump && tooLongForBlock)
  422:   );
  423: }

  426: function resolveFinalBlockContent({
  427:   template,
  428:   block,
  429:   settings,
  430:   textLibrary,
  431:   rawKind,
  432: }: {
  433:   template: any;
  434:   block: any;
  435:   settings: any;
  436:   textLibrary: any;
  437:   rawKind: string;
  438: }) {
  439:   if (rawKind === "cover-title") {
  440:     return block?.content || settings?.content || "{{case.title}}";
  441:   }
  442: 
  443:   if (rawKind === "custom-paragraph") {
  444:     return block?.customContent || block?.content || settings?.content || "";
  445:   }
  446:

  448:     return block?.content || settings?.content || "";
  449:   }
  450: 
  451:   if (rawKind === "text-library") {
  452:     return resolveFinalTextLibraryContent(template, block, settings, textLibrary);
  453:   }
  454: 
  455:   const candidateContent =
  456:     block?.content ||
  457:     settings?.content ||
  458:     block?.customContent ||
  459:     block?.defaultContent ||
  460:     "";
  461: 
  462:   return isFinalLegacyRenderedReportDump(candidateContent)
  463:     ? ""
  464:     : candidateContent;

  467: function resolveFinalTextLibraryContent(
  468:   template: any,
  469:   block: any,
  470:   settings: any,
  471:   textLibrary: any,
  472: ) {
  473:   const snippets = collectFinalTextSnippets(template);
  474:   const snippetId =
  475:     textLibrary?.snippetId ||
  476:     settings?.snippetId ||
  477:     block?.snippetId ||
  478:     "";
  479: 
  480:   if (snippetId) {
  481:     const selected = snippets.find((snippet: any) => snippet.id === snippetId);
  482: 
  483:     if (selected) {
  484:       return selected.content || selected.text || selected.body || "";
  485:     }
  486:   }
  487: 
  488:   const category =
  489:     textLibrary?.category ||
  490:     settings?.category ||
  491:     block?.category ||
  492:     "مقدمة";
  493: 
  494:   const serviceSlug =
  495:     textLibrary?.serviceSlug ||
  496:     settings?.serviceSlug ||
  497:     template?.serviceSlug ||
  498:     "";
  499: 
  500:   const matching = snippets.find((snippet: any) => {
  501:     const matchesCategory =
  502:       !category ||
  503:       category === "all" ||
  504:       snippet.category === category;
  505: 
  506:     const matchesService =
  507:       !serviceSlug ||
  508:       !snippet.serviceSlug ||
  509:       snippet.serviceSlug === serviceSlug;
  510: 
  511:     return matchesCategory && matchesService;
  512:   });
  513: 
  514:   if (matching) {
  515:     return matching.content || matching.text || matching.body || "";
  516:   }
  517: 
  518:   return getFinalTextLibraryFallback(category);
  519: }

  563: export function collectFinalValues(data: any): FinalReportValueItem[] {
  564:   if (Array.isArray(data?.values)) {
  565:     return data.values.map((item: any) => ({
  566:       fieldKey: item.fieldKey || item.key || "",
  567:       fieldLabel: item.fieldLabel || item.label || item.fieldKey || "",
  568:       value:
  569:         item.value === undefined || item.value === null
  570:           ? ""
  571:           : String(item.value),
  572:       valueItems: Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  573:         ? item.valueItems.map((valueItem: unknown) => String(valueItem || "").trim()).filter(Boolean)
  574:         : undefined,
  575:     }));
  576:   }
  577: 
  578:   if (data?.values && typeof data.values === "object") {
  579:     return Object.entries(data.values).map(([key, value]) => ({
  580:       fieldKey: key,
  581:       fieldLabel: key,
  582:       value:
  583:         value === undefined || value === null
  584:           ? ""
  585:           : String(value),
  586:     }));
  587:   }
  588: 
  589:   return [];
  590: }

  592: export function resolveContextVariable(key: string, context: Record<string, string>) {
  593:   const aliases: Record<string, string[]> = {
  594:     reportTitle: ["reportTitle", "case.title", "caseTitle"],
  595:     caseTitle: ["case.title", "caseTitle", "reportTitle"],
  596:     serviceName: ["service.name", "serviceName"],
  597:     studentName: ["student.name", "studentName"],
  598:     studentGrade: ["student.grade", "studentGrade"],
  599:     studentClassroom: ["student.classroom", "studentClassroom"],
  600:     guardianName: ["student.guardianName", "guardianName"],
  601:     guardianPhone: ["student.guardianPhone", "guardianPhone"],
  602:     schoolName: ["identity.schoolName", "schoolName"],
  603:     counselorName: ["identity.counselorName", "counselorName"],
  604:     principalName: ["identity.principalName", "principalName"],
  605:   };
  606: 
  607:   const lookupKeys = [
  608:     key,
  609:     ...(aliases[key] || []),
  610:     key.startsWith("field.") ? key : "field." + key,
  611:   ];
  612: 
  613:   for (const lookupKey of lookupKeys) {
  614:     const value = context[lookupKey];
  615: 
  616:     if (value !== undefined && value !== null && String(value).trim() !== "") {
  617:       return String(value);
  618:     }
  619:   }
  620: 
  621:   return "";
  622: }

  712: function formatFinalEvidenceCount(count: number) {
  713:   if (count <= 0) return "0 شاهد";
  714:   if (count === 1) return "شاهد واحد";
  715:   if (count === 2) return "شاهدان";
  716:   if (count >= 3 && count <= 10) return count + " شواهد";
  717: 
  718:   return count + " شاهد";
  719: }

  722: function formatFinalDate(value?: string | null) {

  726: 
  727:   try {
  728:     return new Date(value).toLocaleDateString("ar-SA");

  730:     return String(value);

    1: import type { ReportDesignId } from "../report-design-types";
    2: import type { ReportPhysicalPageModel } from "../smart-layout/report-smart-physical-types";
    3: import { A4DesignPage } from "./report-blocks";
    4: import {
    5:   getEvidencePerPage,
    6:   getEvidenceStartIndex,
    7:   getValidPreviewEvidences,
    8: } from "./report-evidence-data";
    9: import type { PreviewCaseData } from "./report-types";
   10: 
   11: export type AutoEvidencePhysicalPage = {
   12:   page: ReportPhysicalPageModel;
   13:   pageLabel: string;
   14: };
   15: 
   16: export function buildAutoEvidencePhysicalPages({
   17:   activePage,
   18:   previewCase,
   19:   primaryEvidenceCount,
   20: }: {
   21:   activePage?: ReportPhysicalPageModel | null;
   22:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
   23:   primaryEvidenceCount?: number;
   24: }): AutoEvidencePhysicalPage[] {
   25:   const evidenceBlock = activePage?.blocks?.find(
   26:     (block) => block?.kind === "evidence-gallery",
   27:   );
   28: 
   29:   if (
   30:     !activePage ||
   31:     !evidenceBlock ||
   32:     evidenceBlock.evidenceAutoCreatePages === false
   33:   ) {
   34:     return [];
   35:   }
   36: 
   37:   const evidences = getValidPreviewEvidences(previewCase);
   38: 
   39:   if (!evidences.length) {
   40:     return [];
   41:   }
   42: 
   43:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(evidenceBlock);
   44:   const initialStartIndex = getEvidenceStartIndex(evidenceBlock);
   45:   const availableEvidenceCount = Math.max(
   46:     0,
   47:     evidences.length - initialStartIndex,
   48:   );
   49:   const legacyPrimaryCount = Math.min(availableEvidenceCount, perPage);
   50:   const consumedByPrimary = Number.isFinite(Number(primaryEvidenceCount))
   51:     ? Math.min(
   52:         availableEvidenceCount,
   53:         Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(primaryEvidenceCount))),
   54:       )
   55:     : legacyPrimaryCount;
   56:   const remainingCount = Math.max(
   57:     0,
   58:     availableEvidenceCount - consumedByPrimary,
   59:   );
   60: 
   61:   if (remainingCount <= 0) {
   62:     return [];
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   const extraPagesCount = Math.ceil(remainingCount / perPage);
   66: 
   67:   return Array.from({ length: extraPagesCount }).map((_, index) => {
   68:     const pageNumber = index + 2;
   69:     const startIndex =
   70:       initialStartIndex + consumedByPrimary + index * perPage;
   71:     const pageEvidenceLimit = Math.min(
   72:       perPage,
   73:       evidences.length - startIndex,
   74:     );
   75:     const page: ReportPhysicalPageModel = {
   76:       ...activePage,
   77:       id: `${activePage.id}-evidence-${startIndex}`,
   78:       title: `${activePage.title} - صفحة ${pageNumber}`,
   79:       kind: "evidence",
   80:       corePhysicalPageId: activePage.corePhysicalPageId || activePage.id,
   81:       physicalPageRole: "evidence",
   82:       sourcePageIds: [...activePage.sourcePageIds],
   83:       blocks: [
   84:         {
   85:           ...evidenceBlock,
   86:           id: `${evidenceBlock.id}-auto-${startIndex}`,
   87:           title:
   88:             index === 0 && consumedByPrimary === 0
   89:               ? evidenceBlock.title
   90:               : `${evidenceBlock.title} - صفحة ${pageNumber}`,
   91:           evidenceStartIndex: startIndex,
   92:           evidenceLimit: pageEvidenceLimit,
   93:           evidenceAutoCreatePages: false,
   94:         },
   95:       ],
   96:     };
   97: 
   98:     return {
   99:       page,
  100:       pageLabel: `صفحة شواهد ${pageNumber}`,
  101:     };
  102:   });
  103: }
  104: 
  105: export function AutoEvidencePages({
  106:   designId,
  107:   activePage,
  108:   context,
  109:   previewCase,
  110:   primaryEvidenceCount,
  111:   preparedPages,
  112:   activePhysicalPageId,
  113:   renderMode = "stack",
  114: }: {
  115:   designId: ReportDesignId;
  116:   activePage?: ReportPhysicalPageModel;
  117:   context: Record<string, string>;
  118:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
  119:   primaryEvidenceCount?: number;
  120:   preparedPages?: AutoEvidencePhysicalPage[];
  121:   activePhysicalPageId?: string;
  122:   renderMode?: "single" | "stack";
  123: }) {
  124:   const pages = preparedPages || buildAutoEvidencePhysicalPages({
  125:     activePage,
  126:     previewCase,
  127:     primaryEvidenceCount,
  128:   });
  129:   const visiblePages = renderMode === "stack"
  130:     ? pages
  131:     : pages.filter(({ page }) => page.id === activePhysicalPageId);
  132: 
  133:   if (!visiblePages.length) {
  134:     return null;
  135:   }
  136: 
  137:   return (
  138:     <div
  139:       className={
  140:         renderMode === "stack"
  141:           ? "mt-6 space-y-6 print:mt-0 print:space-y-0"
  142:           : ""
  143:       }
  144:       data-report-auto-evidence-pages
  145:     >
  146:       {visiblePages.map(({ page, pageLabel }) => (
  147:         <A4DesignPage
  148:           key={page.id}
  149:           designId={designId}
  150:           page={page}
  151:           context={context}
  152:           previewCase={previewCase}
  153:           pageLabel={pageLabel}
  154:         />
  155:       ))}
  156:     </div>

    4: export function getBlockShellClass(
    5:   implementation: ReportDesignImplementation,

   17: 
   18:   const accent = implementation.palette;
   19:   if (variant === "hero") return `${base} ${accent.heroShellClass}`;
   20:   if (variant === "plain") return `${base} px-1 py-2`;
   21:   if (variant === "soft") return `${base} ${accent.softShellClass}`;
   22:   if (variant === "highlight") return `${base} ${accent.highlightShellClass}`;
   23:   if (variant === "outline") return `${base} ${accent.outlineShellClass}`;
   24:   if (variant === "quote") return `${base} ${accent.quoteShellClass}`;
   25:   return `${base} ${accent.cardShellClass}`;
   26: }
   27: 
   28: export function getPlacementClass(placement: string) {
   29:   const fullCenteredBase = "absolute left-0 right-0 w-full";
   30:   const centeredBase = "absolute left-1/2 w-full max-w-[78%] -translate-x-1/2";
   31:   const sideBase = "absolute w-full max-w-[58%]";
   32:   const classes: Record<string, string> = {
   33:     flow: "", top: `${fullCenteredBase} top-0`, middle: `${fullCenteredBase} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`, bottom: `${fullCenteredBase} bottom-0`,
   34:     "top-right": `${sideBase} right-0 top-0`, "top-center": `${centeredBase} top-0`, "top-left": `${sideBase} left-0 top-0`,
   35:     "middle-right": `${sideBase} right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`, "middle-center": `${centeredBase} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`, "middle-left": `${sideBase} left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`,
   36:     "bottom-right": `${sideBase} bottom-0 right-0`, "bottom-center": `${centeredBase} bottom-0`, "bottom-left": `${sideBase} bottom-0 left-0`,
   37:   };
   38:   return classes[placement] || "";
   39: }

  134: function isDynamicFieldsDesignBlock(block: any) {

  152: function getDynamicFieldCardsForBlock(block: any, previewCase: any) {
  153:   const configuredItems = Array.isArray(block?.dynamicFields)
  154:     ? block.dynamicFields
  155:     : [];
  156: 
  157:   if (configuredItems.length) {
  158:     return configuredItems
  159:       .map((item: any, index: number) => {
  160:         const id =
  161:           cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.id) ||
  162:           cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  163:           `dynamic-field-${index + 1}`;
  164:         const valueItems = Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  165:           ? translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.valueItems)
  166:           : translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.value);
  167: 
  168:         return {
  169:           id,
  170:           key:
  171:             cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  172:             id,
  173:           label:
  174:             item.label !== undefined
  175:               ? cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label)
  176:               : `حقل ${index + 1}`,
  177:           value:
  178:             item.value !== undefined
  179:               ? cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.value)
  180:               : "",
  181:           valueItems,
  182:           visible: item.visible !== false,
  183:         };
  184:       })
  185:       .filter((item: any) => item.visible && item.label)
  186:       .filter(
  187:         (item: any) =>
  188:           !previewCase?.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(item),
  189:       );
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   return getWorkflowDynamicFieldCards(previewCase)
  193:     .map((item: any, index: number) => {
  194:       const id =
  195:         cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.key) ||
  196:         cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label) ||
  197:         `workflow-field-${index + 1}`;
  198: 
  199:       return {
  200:         id,
  201:         key: id,
  202:         label: cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.label),
  203:         value: cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.value),
  204:         valueItems: Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  205:           ? item.valueItems.map((valueItem: unknown) => cleanWorkflowDynamicText(valueItem)).filter(Boolean)
  206:           : [],
  207:         visible: true,
  208:       };
  209:     })
  210:     .filter((item: any) => item.visible && item.label && item.value)
  211:     .filter(
  212:       (item: any) =>
  213:         !previewCase?.hasStudentDataTable || !isStudentIdentityField(item),
  214:     );

  247: function DesignBlock({

    1: import { filterValidReportEvidenceItems } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-evidence-utils";
    2: import type { PreviewCaseData } from "./report-types";
    3: 
    4: const REPORT_DESIGN_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_EXTENSION_PATTERN =
    5:   /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;
    6: 
    7: function hasReportDesignImageEvidenceExtension(value: unknown) {
    8:   const text = String(value || "").trim().replaceAll("\\", "/");
    9: 
   10:   if (!text) return false;
   11: 
   12:   return REPORT_DESIGN_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.test(text);
   13: }
   14: 
   15: function isReportDesignImageEvidence(
   16:   evidence: NonNullable<PreviewCaseData["evidences"]>[number] | undefined,
   17: ) {
   18:   if (!evidence) return false;
   19:   if (String(evidence.type || "").trim().toUpperCase() === "IMAGE") return true;
   20:   if (String(evidence.mimeType || "").toLowerCase().startsWith("image/")) return true;
   21: 
   22:   return [
   23:     evidence.imageUrl,
   24:     evidence.url,
   25:     evidence.fileUrl,
   26:     evidence.publicUrl,
   27:     evidence.storagePath,
   28:   ].some((value) => hasReportDesignImageEvidenceExtension(value));
   29: }
   30: 
   31: export function getReportDesignEvidenceImageUrl(
   32:   evidence: NonNullable<PreviewCaseData["evidences"]>[number] | undefined,
   33: ) {
   34:   if (!evidence || !isReportDesignImageEvidence(evidence)) return "";
   35: 
   36:   return String(
   37:     evidence.imageUrl ||
   38:       evidence.url ||
   39:       evidence.fileUrl ||
   40:       evidence.publicUrl ||
   41:       evidence.storagePath ||
   42:       "",
   43:   ).trim();
   44: }
   45: 
   46: export function getValidPreviewEvidences(previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null) {
   47:   const hasSelectedCase = Boolean(previewCase?.caseId);
   48: 
   49:   return filterValidReportEvidenceItems(previewCase?.evidences || [], {
   50:     allowSampleEvidence: !hasSelectedCase,
   51:   });
   52: }
   53: 
   54: export function getEvidenceStartIndex(block: any) {
   55:   const startIndex = Number(block.evidenceStartIndex || 0);
   56: 
   57:   if (!Number.isFinite(startIndex) || startIndex < 0) {
   58:     return 0;
   59:   }
   60: 
   61:   return Math.floor(startIndex);
   62: }
   63: 
   64: export function getEvidencePerPage(block: any) {
   65:   const explicitLimit = Number(block.evidenceLimit || 0);
   66: 
   67:   if (Number.isFinite(explicitLimit) && explicitLimit > 0) {
   68:     return Math.max(1, Math.floor(explicitLimit));
   69:   }
   70:   return getSmartEvidencePerPage(block);
   71: }
   72: 
   73: export function getSmartEvidencePerPage(block: any) {
   74:   const layout = String(block?.evidenceLayout || "TWO_PER_PAGE");
   75:   const ratio = String(block?.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3");
   76:   const fit = String(block?.evidenceFit || "contain");
   77: 
   78:   if (layout === "ATTACHMENT_LIST") return 10;
   79:   if (layout === "ONE_PER_PAGE") return 1;
   80:   if (layout === "TWO_PER_PAGE") return 2;
   81: 
   82:   /*
   83:     GRID_2X2 is a maximum capacity, not a forced capacity.
   84:     The system must keep every evidence card inside the A4 frame.
   85:     Portrait images are tall, so 4 cards can overflow the page.
   86:   */
   87:   if (layout === "GRID_2X2") {
   88:     if (ratio === "PORTRAIT_3_4") return 2;
   89:     if (ratio === "SQUARE_1_1" && fit === "cover") return 4;
   90:     if (ratio === "SQUARE_1_1") return 4;
   91:     if (ratio === "LANDSCAPE_16_9") return 4;
   92:     return 4;
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   return 2;
   96: }
   97: 
   98: export function createEvidencePlaceholders(count: number, startIndex: number) {
   99:   return Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, index) => ({
  100:     id: `placeholder-evidence-${startIndex + index + 1}`,
  101:     title: `شاهد تجريبي ${startIndex + index + 1}`,
  102:     caption: "مكان الشاهد داخل التقارير",
  103:     fileUrl: "",
  104:     imageUrl: "",
  105:   }));
  106: }
  107: 
  108: export function getEvidenceGridClass(block: any) {
  109:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
  110: 
  111:   if (block.evidenceLayout === "ATTACHMENT_LIST") {
  112:     return "grid gap-2";
  113:   }
  114: 
  115:   if (perPage <= 1) {
  116:     return "grid gap-3";
  117:   }
  118: 
  119:   return "grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2";
  120: }
  121: 
  122: export function getEvidenceImageHeightClass(block: any) {
  123:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
  124:   const ratio = block.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3";
  125: 
  126:   /*
  127:     Fixed heights are intentional:
  128:     they keep evidence inside the printable A4 area.
  129:     Extra evidence must go to a new Evidence Page instead of stretching A4.
  130:   */
  131:   if (perPage <= 1) {
  132:     switch (ratio) {
  133:       case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
  134:         return "h-[185mm]";
  135:       case "SQUARE_1_1":
  136:         return "h-[160mm]";
  137:       case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
  138:         return "h-[122mm]";
  139:       case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
  140:       default:
  141:         return "h-[138mm]";
  142:     }
  143:   }
  144: 
  145:   if (perPage === 2) {
  146:     switch (ratio) {
  147:       case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
  148:         return "h-[92mm]";
  149:       case "SQUARE_1_1":
  150:         return "h-[82mm]";
  151:       case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
  152:         return "h-[58mm]";
  153:       case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
  154:       default:
  155:         return "h-[66mm]";
  156:     }
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   switch (ratio) {
  160:     case "SQUARE_1_1":
  161:       return "h-[56mm]";
  162:     case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
  163:       return "h-[42mm]";
  164:     case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
  165:       return "h-[82mm]";
  166:     case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
  167:     default:
  168:       return "h-[48mm]";
  169:   }
  170: }
  171: 
  172: export function getEvidenceImageClass(block: any) {
  173:   const fit = block.evidenceFit === "cover" ? "object-cover" : "object-contain";
  174:   return `${getEvidenceImageHeightClass(block)} w-full ${fit}`;
  175: }

  177: export function getEvidenceGridStyle(block: any) {
  178:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
  179:   const gapMm = Number(block.evidenceGapMm || 0);
  180: 
  181:   const style: Record<string, string> = {};
  182: 
  183:   if (gapMm > 0) {
  184:     style.gap = `${Math.min(Math.max(gapMm, 2), 12)}mm`;
  185:   }
  186: 
  187:   if (block.evidenceLayout !== "ATTACHMENT_LIST") {
  188:     style.gridTemplateColumns =
  189:       perPage <= 1 ? "minmax(0, 1fr)" : "repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr))";
  190:   }
  191: 
  192:   return style;
  193: }
  194: 
  195: export function getEvidenceFigureStyle(block: any) {
  196:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
  197:   const widthMm = Number(block.evidenceImageWidthMm || 0);
  198: 
  199:   if (!widthMm || perPage > 1) {
  200:     return {};
  201:   }
  202: 
  203:   return {
  204:     maxWidth: `${Math.min(Math.max(widthMm, 40), 180)}mm`,
  205:     marginInline: "auto",
  206:   };
  207: }
  208: 
  209: export function getEvidenceImageStyle(block: any) {
  210:   const heightMm = Number(block.evidenceImageHeightMm || 0);
  211:   const widthMm = Number(block.evidenceImageWidthMm || 0);
  212:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
  213: 
  214:   const style: Record<string, string> = {
  215:     objectFit: block.evidenceFit === "cover" ? "cover" : "contain",
  216:   };
  217: 
  218:   if (heightMm > 0) {
  219:     style.height = `${Math.min(Math.max(heightMm, 35), 190)}mm`;
  220:   }
  221: 
  222:   if (widthMm > 0 && perPage <= 1) {
  223:     style.width = `${Math.min(Math.max(widthMm, 40), 180)}mm`;
  224:   }
  225: 
  226:   return style;
  227: }

   40: type ReportFieldIconItem = {
   41:   key?: string;
   42:   fieldKey?: string;
   43:   label?: string;
   44: };
   45: 
   46: type ReportFieldIconRule = {
   47:   icon: LucideIcon;
   48:   keyWords: readonly string[];
   49:   labelWords: readonly string[];
   50: };
   51: 
   52: function normalizeFieldText(value: unknown) {
   53:   return String(value || "")
   54:     .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
   55:     .toLocaleLowerCase("ar")
   56:     .replace(/[أإآ]/g, "ا")
   57:     .replace(/ة/g, "ه")
   58:     .replace(/ى/g, "ي")
   59:     .replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]/g, "")
   60:     .replace(/[^a-z0-9\u0621-\u064A]+/g, " ")
   61:     .trim();
   62: }
   63: 
   64: function getKeywordMatchScore(text: string, words: readonly string[]) {
   65:   return words.reduce((score, word) => {
   66:     const normalizedWord = normalizeFieldText(word);
   67:     return normalizedWord && text.includes(normalizedWord)
   68:       ? Math.max(score, normalizedWord.length)
   69:       : score;
   70:   }, 0);
   71: }
   72: 
   73: function findBestIcon(
   74:   text: string,
   75:   keywordSelector: (rule: ReportFieldIconRule) => readonly string[],
   76: ) {
   77:   let bestIcon: LucideIcon | null = null;
   78:   let bestScore = 0;
   79: 
   80:   for (const rule of REPORT_FIELD_ICON_RULES) {
   81:     const score = getKeywordMatchScore(text, keywordSelector(rule));
   82:     if (score > bestScore) {
   83:       bestIcon = rule.icon;
   84:       bestScore = score;
   85:     }
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   return bestIcon;
   89: }

  263: 
  264: export function resolveReportFieldIcon(item: ReportFieldIconItem): LucideIcon {
  265:   const fieldKey = normalizeFieldText(item.fieldKey || item.key);
  266: 
  267:   if (fieldKey) {
  268:     const keyMatch = findBestIcon(fieldKey, (rule) => rule.keyWords);
  269:     if (keyMatch) return keyMatch;
  270:   }
  271: 
  272:   const label = normalizeFieldText(item.label);
  273:   if (label) {
  274:     const labelMatch = findBestIcon(label, (rule) => rule.labelWords);
  275:     if (labelMatch) return labelMatch;
  276:   }
  277: 
  278:   return Tag;
  279: }

    1: export type ReportHeaderSettings = {
    2:   heightPx: number;
    3:   paddingTopPx: number;
    4:   paddingBottomPx: number;
    5:   paddingInlinePx: number;
    6:   itemGapPx: number;
    7:   logoSizePx: number;
    8:   headerFontSizePx: number;
    9:   titleFontSizePx: number;
   10:   subtitleFontSizePx: number;
   11:   fontWeight: "inherit" | "400" | "500" | "600" | "700" | "800" | "900";
   12:   lineHeight: number;
   13:   fontFamily: "inherit" | "Cairo" | "Arial";
   14: };
   15: 
   16: export const DEFAULT_REPORT_HEADER_SETTINGS: ReportHeaderSettings = {
   17:   heightPx: 0,
   18:   paddingTopPx: 0,
   19:   paddingBottomPx: 0,
   20:   paddingInlinePx: 0,
   21:   itemGapPx: 0,
   22:   logoSizePx: 0,
   23:   headerFontSizePx: 0,
   24:   titleFontSizePx: 0,
   25:   subtitleFontSizePx: 0,
   26:   fontWeight: "inherit",
   27:   lineHeight: 0,
   28:   fontFamily: "inherit",
   29: };
   30: 
   31: function clampHeaderNumber(
   32:   value: unknown,
   33:   fallback: number,
   34:   min: number,
   35:   max: number,
   36:   decimals = 0,
   37: ) {
   38:   const number = Number(value);
   39: 
   40:   if (!Number.isFinite(number)) {
   41:     return fallback;
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   const bounded = Math.min(max, Math.max(min, number));
   45:   const factor = 10 ** decimals;
   46: 
   47:   return Math.round(bounded * factor) / factor;
   48: }
   49: 
   50: export function normalizeReportHeaderSettings(
   51:   value: unknown,
   52: ): ReportHeaderSettings {
   53:   const settings =
   54:     value && typeof value === "object"
   55:       ? (value as Partial<ReportHeaderSettings>)
   56:       : {};
   57:   const fontWeight = String(settings.fontWeight || "inherit");
   58:   const fontFamily = String(settings.fontFamily || "inherit");
   59: 
   60:   return {
   61:     heightPx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.heightPx, 0, 0, 420),
   62:     paddingTopPx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.paddingTopPx, 0, 0, 160),
   63:     paddingBottomPx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.paddingBottomPx, 0, 0, 160),
   64:     paddingInlinePx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.paddingInlinePx, 0, 0, 180),
   65:     itemGapPx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.itemGapPx, 0, 0, 100),
   66:     logoSizePx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.logoSizePx, 0, 0, 240),
   67:     headerFontSizePx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.headerFontSizePx, 0, 0, 48),
   68:     titleFontSizePx: clampHeaderNumber(settings.titleFontSizePx, 0, 0, 72),
   69:     subtitleFontSizePx: clampHeaderNumber(
   70:       settings.subtitleFontSizePx,
   71:       0,
   72:       0,
   73:       48,
   74:     ),
   75:     fontWeight:
   76:       fontWeight === "400" ||
   77:       fontWeight === "500" ||
   78:       fontWeight === "600" ||
   79:       fontWeight === "700" ||
   80:       fontWeight === "800" ||
   81:       fontWeight === "900"
   82:         ? fontWeight
   83:         : "inherit",
   84:     lineHeight: clampHeaderNumber(settings.lineHeight, 0, 0, 3, 2),
   85:     fontFamily:
   86:       fontFamily === "Cairo" || fontFamily === "Arial"
   87:         ? fontFamily
   88:         : "inherit",
   89:   };
   90: }
   91: 
   92: export function getReportHeaderSettingsStyle(value: unknown) {
   93:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
   94:     return "";
   95:   }
   96: 
   97:   const settings = normalizeReportHeaderSettings(value);
   98:   const declarations = [
   99:     settings.heightPx > 0
  100:       ? `min-height: ${settings.heightPx}px !important;`
  101:       : "",
  102:     settings.paddingTopPx > 0
  103:       ? `padding-top: ${settings.paddingTopPx}px !important;`
  104:       : "",
  105:     settings.paddingBottomPx > 0
  106:       ? `padding-bottom: ${settings.paddingBottomPx}px !important;`
  107:       : "",
  108:     settings.paddingInlinePx > 0
  109:       ? `padding-left: ${settings.paddingInlinePx}px !important; padding-right: ${settings.paddingInlinePx}px !important;`
  110:       : "",
  111:     settings.itemGapPx > 0 ? `gap: ${settings.itemGapPx}px !important;` : "",
  112:     settings.headerFontSizePx > 0
  113:       ? `font-size: ${settings.headerFontSizePx}px !important;`
  114:       : "",
  115:     settings.fontWeight !== "inherit"
  116:       ? `font-weight: ${settings.fontWeight} !important;`
  117:       : "",
  118:     settings.lineHeight > 0
  119:       ? `line-height: ${settings.lineHeight} !important;`
  120:       : "",
  121:     settings.fontFamily === "Cairo"
  122:       ? `font-family: var(--font-cairo), Cairo, Arial, sans-serif !important;`
  123:       : settings.fontFamily === "Arial"
  124:         ? `font-family: Arial, Tahoma, sans-serif !important;`
  125:         : "",
  126:   ].filter(Boolean);
  127: 
  128:   const rules = [
  129:     declarations.length
  130:       ? `.report-design-header { ${declarations.join(" ")} }`
  131:       : "",
  132:     settings.heightPx > 0
  133:       ? `.pdf-report-page > div:has(> .report-design-header.absolute) { padding-top: ${settings.heightPx + 24}px !important; }`
  134:       : "",
  135:     settings.itemGapPx > 0
  136:       ? `.report-design-header > .grid, .report-design-header > .flex, .report-design-header > div > .grid, .report-design-header > div > .flex { gap: ${settings.itemGapPx}px !important; }`
  137:       : "",
  138:     settings.logoSizePx > 0
  139:       ? `.report-design-header img { width: auto !important; max-width: ${settings.logoSizePx}px !important; height: ${settings.logoSizePx}px !important; max-height: ${settings.logoSizePx}px !important; object-fit: contain !important; }`
  140:       : "",
  141:     settings.titleFontSizePx > 0
  142:       ? `.report-design-header h1, .report-design-header h2, .report-design-header-title { font-size: ${settings.titleFontSizePx}px !important; }`
  143:       : "",
  144:     settings.subtitleFontSizePx > 0
  145:       ? `.report-design-header p { font-size: ${settings.subtitleFontSizePx}px !important; }`
  146:       : "",
  147:     settings.headerFontSizePx > 0
  148:       ? `.report-design-header.grid > :first-child, .report-design-header.grid > :last-child, .report-design-header > .grid > :first-child, .report-design-header > .grid > :last-child, .report-design-header > div > .grid > :first-child, .report-design-header > div > .grid > :last-child { font-size: ${settings.headerFontSizePx}px !important; } .report-design-header.grid > :first-child p, .report-design-header.grid > :last-child p, .report-design-header > .grid > :first-child p, .report-design-header > .grid > :last-child p, .report-design-header > div > .grid > :first-child p, .report-design-header > div > .grid > :last-child p { font-size: inherit !important; }`
  149:       : "",
  150:     settings.fontWeight !== "inherit"
  151:       ? `.report-design-header, .report-design-header * { font-weight: ${settings.fontWeight} !important; }`
  152:       : "",
  153:     settings.lineHeight > 0
  154:       ? `.report-design-header, .report-design-header * { line-height: ${settings.lineHeight} !important; }`
  155:       : "",
  156:   ].filter(Boolean);
  157: 
  158:   return rules.join("\n");
  159: }

   70:   context: Record<string, string>,

   77:     return value;
   78:   }
   79: 
   80:   return fallback;
   81: }
   82: export function getDesignHeaderText(
   83:   context: Record<string, string>,
   84:   key: string,
   85:   fallback: string,
   86: ) {
   87:   const value = context?.[key];
   88:

    1: import { resolveContextVariable } from "./final-report";
    2: 
    3: export function renderText(text: string, context: Record<string, string>) {
    4:   const source = String(text || "");
    5: 
    6:   const replaceVariable = (_match: string, key: string) => {
    7:     const cleanKey = String(key || "").trim();
    8: 
    9:     if (!cleanKey) return "";
   10:     return resolveContextVariable(cleanKey, context);
   11:   };
   12: 
   13:   return source
   14:     .replace(/\{\{\s*([^}]+?)\s*\}\}/g, replaceVariable)
   15:     .replace(/\{([A-Za-z0-9_.\-\u0600-\u06FF ]+)\}/g, replaceVariable);
   16: }
   17: 
   18: export function splitLines(text: string) {
   19:   return String(text || "").split(/\n+/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
   20: }
   21: 
   22: export function splitParagraphs(text: string) {
   23:   return String(text || "").split(/\n\s*\n/).map((line) => line.trim()).filter(Boolean);
   24: }
   25: 
   26: export function getReportFontSizeClass(value: unknown, fallback = "text-base") {
   27:   switch (value) {
   28:     case "xs": return "text-xs";
   29:     case "sm": return "text-sm";
   30:     case "base": return "text-base";
   31:     case "lg": return "text-lg";
   32:     case "xl": return "text-xl";
   33:     case "2xl": return "text-2xl";
   34:     default: return fallback;
   35:   }
   36: }
   37: 
   38: export function getReportFontSizeMultiplier(value: unknown) {
   39:   switch (value) {
   40:     case "xs":
   41:       return 0.75;
   42:     case "sm":
   43:       return 0.875;
   44:     case "base":
   45:       return 1;
   46:     case "lg":
   47:       return 1.125;
   48:     case "xl":
   49:       return 1.25;
   50:     case "2xl":
   51:       return 1.5;
   52:     default:
   53:       return 1;
   54:   }
   55: }
   56: 
   57: export function getBlockSetting(block: any, key: string) {
   58:   return block?.[key] ?? block?.settings?.[key];
   59: }

   67: export function cleanWorkflowDynamicText(value: unknown) {
   68:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
   69: }
   70: 
   71: function isTechnicalWorkflowText(value: string) {
   72:   return /^[a-z0-9_/-]+$/i.test(value) && /[a-z_]/i.test(value);
   73: }
   74: 
   75: function translateWorkflowDynamicLabel(key: unknown, label: unknown) {
   76:   const cleanKey = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(key);
   77:   const cleanLabel = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(label);
   78: 
   79:   if (cleanLabel && cleanLabel !== cleanKey && !isTechnicalWorkflowText(cleanLabel)) {
   80:     return cleanLabel;
   81:   }
   82: 
   83:   return WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_FIELD_LABELS[cleanKey] || cleanLabel || cleanKey;
   84: }
   85: 
   86: function translateWorkflowDynamicValue(value: unknown): string {
   87:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
   88: 
   89:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   90:     return value
   91:       .map((item) => translateWorkflowDynamicValue(item))
   92:       .filter(Boolean)
   93:       .join("، ");
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   if (typeof value === "boolean") {
   97:     return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
   98:   }
   99: 
  100:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  101:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  102:     return (
  103:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.label) ||
  104:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.name) ||
  105:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.value) ||
  106:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.key) ||
  107:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.id) ||
  108:       ""
  109:     );
  110:   }
  111: 
  112:   const text = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(value);
  113:   const normalized = text.toLowerCase();
  114: 
  115:   if (WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_VALUE_LABELS[normalized]) {
  116:     return WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_VALUE_LABELS[normalized];
  117:   }
  118: 
  119:   const programMatch = /^program[_-](\d+)$/i.exec(text);
  120:   if (programMatch) {
  121:     return `برنامج النشاط رقم ${Number(programMatch[1])}`;
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   return text;
  125: }
  126: 
  127: export function translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(value: unknown): string[] {
  128:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
  129:     return [];
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   return Array.from(
  133:     new Set(
  134:       value
  135:         .map((item) => translateWorkflowDynamicValue(item))
  136:         .filter(Boolean)
  137:     )
  138:   );
  139: }
  140: 
  141: export function getWorkflowDynamicFieldCards(previewCase: any): WorkflowDynamicFieldCard[] {
  142:   return (previewCase?.values || [])
  143:     .map((item: any, index: number) => {
  144:       const key = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.fieldKey);
  145:       const label = translateWorkflowDynamicLabel(
  146:         item.fieldKey,
  147:         item.fieldLabel || `حقل ${index + 1}`,
  148:       );
  149:       const value = translateWorkflowDynamicValue(item.value);
  150:       const valueItems = Array.isArray(item.valueItems)
  151:         ? translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.valueItems)
  152:         : translateWorkflowDynamicValueItems(item.value);
  153: 
  154:       return {
  155:         key: key || label || `workflow-field-${index + 1}`,
  156:         label,
  157:         value,
  158:         valueItems,
  159:       };
  160:     })
  161:     .filter((item: any) => item.label && item.value);
  162: }

  764: `;
  765: 
  766: function applyProfile(
  767:   element: HTMLElement,
  768:   profile: ReportSmartA4Profile,
  769: ) {
  770:   const variables =
  771:     getReportSmartA4StyleVariables(
  772:       profile,
  773:     );
  774: 
  775:   Object.entries(
  776:     variables,
  777:   ).forEach(
  778:     ([property, value]) => {
  779:       element.style.setProperty(
  780:         property,
  781:         String(value),
  782:       );
  783:     },
  784:   );
  785: }
  786: 
  787: function applyCandidate(
  788:   viewport: HTMLElement,
  789:   profile: ReportSmartA4Profile,
  790:   fieldLayout:
  791:     ReportSmartA4FieldLayout,
  792: ) {
  793:   applyProfile(
  794:     viewport,
  795:     profile,
  796:   );
  797: 
  798:   viewport.dataset.reportDensity =
  799:     profile.mode;
  800: 
  801:   viewport.dataset.reportFieldLayout =
  802:     fieldLayout;
  803: }
  804: 
  805: function nextAnimationFrame() {
  806:   return new Promise<void>(
  807:     (resolve) => {
  808:       window.requestAnimationFrame(
  809:         () => resolve(),
  810:       );
  811:     },
  812:   );
  813: }
  814: 
  815: function sameResult(
  816:   current: ReportSmartA4LayoutResult,
  817:   next: ReportSmartA4LayoutResult,
  818: ) {
  819:   return (
  820:     current.mode === next.mode &&
  821:     current.fieldLayout ===
  822:       next.fieldLayout &&
  823:     current.fits === next.fits &&
  824:     current.needsOverflowPage ===
  825:       next.needsOverflowPage &&
  826:     current.overflowPx ===
  827:       next.overflowPx &&
  828:     current.signatureHeightPx ===
  829:       next.signatureHeightPx &&
  830:     current.signatureReservedPx ===
  831:       next.signatureReservedPx &&
  832:     current.boundaryBottomPx === next.boundaryBottomPx &&
  833:     current.footerBoundaryUsed === next.footerBoundaryUsed &&
  834:     current.dominantRole ===
  835:       next.dominantRole &&
  836:     current.severity ===
  837:       next.severity &&
  838:     current.candidateId ===
  839:       next.candidateId &&
  840:     current.score === next.score &&
  841:     current.preferEvidenceMove ===
  842:       next.preferEvidenceMove
  843:   );
  844: }

  847:   children,

  850:   className = "",
  851:   contentClassName = "",
  852:   layoutKey,
  853:   priorityMode = "signature",
  854:   onLayoutResult,

 1644:       >
 1645:         {children}
 1646:       </div>
 1647:     </div>
 1648:   );
 1649: }

    1: import {

   58: function getBlockRole(
   59:   element: HTMLElement,
   60: ): ReportSmartA4BlockRole {
   61:   if (
   62:     element.dataset.reportPriorityBlock === "signature" ||
   63:     element.hasAttribute("data-report-design-signature-block")
   64:   ) {
   65:     return "signature";
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   const kind = String(
   69:     element.dataset.reportSmartBlock || "",
   70:   ).trim();
   71: 
   72:   switch (kind) {
   73:     case "dynamic-fields":
   74:     case "field-list":
   75:     case "case-meta":
   76:     case "student-summary":
   77:     case "service-summary":
   78:       return "fields";
   79: 
   80:     case "evidence-gallery":
   81:       return "evidence";
   82: 
   83:     case "multi-paragraph":
   84:     case "closing-note":
   85:       return "narrative";
   86: 
   87:     case "report-one-table":
   88:     case "structured-table":
   89:       return "table";
   90: 
   91:     case "hero-title":
   92:     case "meta-strip":
   93:       return "title";
   94: 
   95:     default:
   96:       return "general";
   97:   }
   98: }

  100: function sumRoleHeight(
  101:   blocks: ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement[],
  102:   role: ReportSmartA4BlockRole,
  103: ) {
  104:   return blocks
  105:     .filter((block) => block.role === role)
  106:     .reduce((sum, block) => sum + block.heightPx, 0);
  107: }

  109: export function measureReportSmartA4Layout(
  110:   viewport: HTMLElement,
  111:   content: HTMLElement,
  112:   priorityMode: ReportSmartA4PriorityMode,
  113:   profile: ReportSmartA4Profile,
  114: ): ReportSmartA4Measurement {
  115:   const viewportRect = viewport.getBoundingClientRect();
  116:   const contentRect = content.getBoundingClientRect();
  117: 
  118:   const localScale =
  119:     viewport.clientHeight > 0
  120:       ? viewportRect.height / viewport.clientHeight
  121:       : 1;
  122: 
  123:   const safeScale =
  124:     Number.isFinite(localScale) && localScale > 0
  125:       ? localScale
  126:       : 1;
  127: 
  128:   const viewportHeightPx = viewport.clientHeight;
  129:   const footerSafeAreaMm = Math.max(
  130:     0,
  131:     Number(viewport.dataset.reportFooterSafeAreaMm || "0") || 0,
  132:   );
  133:   const footerSafeAreaPx = footerSafeAreaMm * (96 / 25.4);
  134:   const footerBoundaryGapPx =
  135:     REPORT_SMART_A4_FOOTER_BOUNDARY_GAP_MM * (96 / 25.4);
  136:   const physicalPage = viewport.closest<HTMLElement>(".pdf-report-page");
  137:   const pageFooter =
  138:     physicalPage?.querySelector<HTMLElement>("[data-report-page-footer]") ||
  139:     null;
  140:   const fallbackBoundaryBottom =
  141:     viewportRect.bottom - footerSafeAreaPx * safeScale;
  142:   const realFooterBoundaryBottom = pageFooter
  143:     ? pageFooter.getBoundingClientRect().top - footerBoundaryGapPx * safeScale
  144:     : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  145:   const boundaryBottom = Math.min(
  146:     fallbackBoundaryBottom,
  147:     realFooterBoundaryBottom,
  148:   );
  149:   const footerBoundaryUsed = Boolean(pageFooter);
  150:   const usableViewportHeightPx = Math.max(
  151:     0,
  152:     Math.min(
  153:       viewportHeightPx,
  154:       (boundaryBottom - viewportRect.top) / safeScale,
  155:     ),
  156:   );
  157: 
  158:   const elements = Array.from(
  159:     content.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
  160:       '[data-report-smart-block], [data-report-priority-block="signature"], [data-report-design-signature-block]',
  161:     ),
  162:   );
  163: 
  164:   const blocks = elements.map(
  165:     (element): ReportSmartA4BlockMeasurement => {
  166:       const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
  167: 
  168:       const topPx =
  169:         (rect.top - contentRect.top) / safeScale;
  170: 
  171:       const bottomPx =
  172:         (rect.bottom - contentRect.top) / safeScale;
  173: 
  174:       return {
  175:         role: getBlockRole(element),
  176:         kind: String(
  177:           element.dataset.reportSmartBlock || "",
  178:         ),
  179:         heightPx: round(rect.height / safeScale),
  180:         topPx: round(topPx),
  181:         bottomPx: round(bottomPx),
  182:         overflowPx: round(
  183:           Math.max(
  184:             0,
  185:             (rect.bottom - boundaryBottom) / safeScale,
  186:           ),
  187:         ),
  188:       };
  189:     },
  190:   );
  191:   const crossesHardBoundary = elements.some(
  192:     (element) => element.getBoundingClientRect().bottom > boundaryBottom,
  193:   );
  194: 
  195:   const signatureBlocks = blocks.filter(
  196:     (block) => block.role === "signature",
  197:   );
  198: 
  199:   const nonSignatureBlocks = blocks.filter(
  200:     (block) => block.role !== "signature",
  201:   );
  202: 
  203:   const signatureHeightPx = signatureBlocks.reduce(
  204:     (sum, block) => sum + block.heightPx,
  205:     0,
  206:   );
  207: 
  208:   const signatureReservedPx =
  209:     priorityMode === "signature" && signatureBlocks.length
  210:       ? signatureHeightPx + profile.signatureSafetyGapPx
  211:       : 0;
  212: 
  213:   const mainContentBudgetPx = Math.max(
  214:     0,
  215:     usableViewportHeightPx - signatureReservedPx,
  216:   );
  217: 
  218:   const mainContentBottomPx = nonSignatureBlocks.reduce(
  219:     (largest, block) =>
  220:       Math.max(largest, block.bottomPx),
  221:     0,
  222:   );
  223: 
  224:   const mainContentOverflowPx =
  225:     priorityMode === "signature"
  226:       ? Math.max(
  227:           0,
  228:           mainContentBottomPx - mainContentBudgetPx,
  229:         )
  230:       : 0;
  231: 
  232:   const blockOverflowPx = blocks.reduce(
  233:     (largest, block) =>
  234:       Math.max(largest, block.overflowPx),
  235:     0,
  236:   );
  237: 
  238:   const scrollOverflowPx = Math.max(
  239:     0,
  240:     content.scrollHeight - viewportHeightPx,
  241:   );
  242: 
  243:   const boundingOverflowPx = Math.max(
  244:     0,
  245:     (contentRect.bottom - viewportRect.bottom) / safeScale,
  246:   );
  247: 
  248:   const overflowPx = Math.max(
  249:     0,
  250:     blockOverflowPx,
  251:     scrollOverflowPx,
  252:     boundingOverflowPx,
  253:     mainContentOverflowPx,
  254:   );
  255: 
  256:   const roleHeights = {
  257:     fields: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "fields"),
  258:     evidence: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "evidence"),
  259:     narrative: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "narrative"),
  260:     table: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "table"),
  261:     signature: signatureHeightPx,
  262:     title: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "title"),
  263:     general: sumRoleHeight(blocks, "general"),
  264:   };
  265: 
  266:   const dominantRole = (
  267:     Object.entries(roleHeights) as Array<
  268:       [ReportSmartA4BlockRole, number]
  269:     >
  270:   ).reduce(
  271:     (best, current) =>
  272:       current[1] > best[1] ? current : best,
  273:     ["general", 0] as [
  274:       ReportSmartA4BlockRole,
  275:       number,
  276:     ],
  277:   )[0];
  278: 
  279:   return {
  280:     fits:
  281:       !crossesHardBoundary &&
  282:       blockOverflowPx <= 0 &&
  283:       overflowPx <= REPORT_SMART_A4_TOLERANCE_PX,
  284: 
  285:     viewportHeightPx: round(usableViewportHeightPx),
  286:     contentHeightPx: round(content.scrollHeight),
  287: 
  288:     overflowPx: round(overflowPx),
  289: 
  290:     signatureHeightPx: round(signatureHeightPx),
  291:     signatureReservedPx: round(signatureReservedPx),
  292: 
  293:     mainContentBottomPx: round(mainContentBottomPx),
  294:     mainContentBudgetPx: round(mainContentBudgetPx),
  295:     mainContentOverflowPx: round(mainContentOverflowPx),
  296: 
  297:     boundaryBottomPx: round(
  298:       (boundaryBottom - viewportRect.top) / safeScale,
  299:     ),
  300:     footerBoundaryUsed,
  301: 
  302:     fieldHeightPx: round(roleHeights.fields),
  303:     evidenceHeightPx: round(roleHeights.evidence),
  304:     narrativeHeightPx: round(roleHeights.narrative),
  305:     tableHeightPx: round(roleHeights.table),
  306: 
  307:     dominantRole,
  308: 
  309:     blocks,
  310:   };
  311: }

  112: export function getReportSmartA4OverflowSeverity(
  113:   overflowPx: number,
  114: ): ReportSmartA4OverflowSeverity {
  115:   if (overflowPx <= 2) return "none";
  116:   if (overflowPx <= 12) return "tiny";
  117:   if (overflowPx <= 48) return "small";
  118:   if (overflowPx <= 120) return "medium";
  119:   return "large";
  120: }
  121: 
  122: function getModeReadabilityScore(
  123:   mode: ReportSmartA4Mode,
  124: ) {
  125:   switch (mode) {
  126:     case "normal":
  127:       return 100;
  128: 
  129:     case "compact":
  130:       return 88;
  131: 
  132:     case "dense":
  133:       return 69;
  134: 
  135:     case "minimum-safe":
  136:       return 50;
  137: 
  138:     default:
  139:       return 50;
  140:   }
  141: }
  142: 
  143: function getFieldLayoutScore(
  144:   layout: ReportSmartA4FieldLayout,
  145: ) {
  146:   switch (layout) {
  147:     /*
  148:      * Preferred production layout:
  149:      * compact, formal and easy to scan.
  150:      */
  151:     case "packed":
  152:       return 8;
  153: 
  154:     /*
  155:      * Comfortable remains valid for very short reports.
  156:      */
  157:     case "comfortable":
  158:       return 10;
  159: 
  160:     /*
  161:      * Inline is a last-resort space saver.
  162:      * Do not select it merely because it saves a few pixels.
  163:      */
  164:     case "inline":
  165:       return -8;
  166: 
  167:     default:
  168:       return -20;
  169:   }
  170: }

  172: export function scoreReportSmartA4Candidate(
  173:   candidate: ReportSmartA4Candidate,
  174:   measurement: ReportSmartA4Measurement,
  175: ) {
  176:   const fitScore =
  177:     measurement.fits ? 1000 : 0;
  178: 
  179:   const readability =
  180:     getModeReadabilityScore(
  181:       candidate.mode,
  182:     );
  183: 
  184:   const fieldLayoutScore =
  185:     getFieldLayoutScore(
  186:       candidate.fieldLayout,
  187:     );
  188: 
  189:   /*
  190:    * إذا الخطة لا تدخل الصفحة نعاقب مقدار overflow.
  191:    * هذا يسمح باختيار أقرب خطة آمنة في حالة عدم نجاح أي خطة.
  192:    */
  193:   const overflowPenalty =
  194:     Math.min(
  195:       700,
  196:       measurement.overflowPx * 2.2,
  197:     );
  198: 
  199:   /*
  200:    * إذا الحقول تستهلك جزءًا كبيرًا من الصفحة،
  201:    * packed/inline يصبحان أكثر منطقية.
  202:    */
  203:   const fieldRatio =
  204:     measurement.fieldHeightPx /
  205:     Math.max(
  206:       1,
  207:       measurement.viewportHeightPx,
  208:     );
  209: 
  210:   const fieldEfficiencyBonus =
  211:     fieldRatio >= 0.28 &&
  212:     candidate.fieldLayout !==
  213:       "comfortable"
  214:       ? 5
  215:       : 0;
  216: 
  217:   return (
  218:     fitScore +
  219:     readability +
  220:     fieldLayoutScore +
  221:     fieldEfficiencyBonus -
  222:     overflowPenalty
  223:   );
  224: }
  225: 
  226: export function chooseReportSmartA4Plan(
  227:   evaluated:
  228:     ReportSmartA4EvaluatedCandidate[],
  229: ): ReportSmartA4Plan {
  230:   if (!evaluated.length) {
  231:     return {
  232:       candidateId:
  233:         "minimum-safe-inline",
  234: 
  235:       mode: "minimum-safe",
  236:       fieldLayout: "inline",
  237: 
  238:       fits: false,
  239:       score: 0,
  240: 
  241:       severity: "large",
  242:       dominantRole: "general",
  243: 
  244:       overflowPx: 0,
  245: 
  246:       preferEvidenceMove: false,
  247:     };
  248:   }
  249: 
  250:   const fitting =
  251:     evaluated.filter(
  252:       (item) =>
  253:         item.measurement.fits,
  254:     );
  255: 
  256:   const pool =
  257:     fitting.length
  258:       ? fitting
  259:       : evaluated;
  260: 
  261:   const selected = [...pool].sort(
  262:     (a, b) => b.score - a.score,
  263:   )[0];
  264: 
  265:   const measurement =
  266:     selected.measurement;
  267: 
  268:   const severity =
  269:     getReportSmartA4OverflowSeverity(
  270:       measurement.overflowPx,
  271:     );
  272: 
  273:   /*
  274:    * إذا التقرير لا يدخل إلا بعد dense/minimum-safe
  275:    * بينما يوجد شاهد في الصفحة، نفضل نقل الشاهد أولًا.
  276:    *
  277:    * هذا هو التغيير المهم:
  278:    * جودة النص والتوقيع أعلى أولوية من إبقاء كل الصور
  279:    * في الصفحة الرئيسية.
  280:    */
  281:   const aggressiveDensity =
  282:     selected.candidate.mode ===
  283:       "dense" ||
  284:     selected.candidate.mode ===
  285:       "minimum-safe";
  286: 
  287:   const hasEvidence =
  288:     measurement.evidenceHeightPx > 0;
  289: 
  290:   const preferEvidenceMove =
  291:     hasEvidence &&
  292:     (
  293:       !measurement.fits ||
  294:       aggressiveDensity
  295:     );
  296: 
  297:   return {
  298:     candidateId:
  299:       selected.candidate.id,
  300: 
  301:     mode:
  302:       selected.candidate.mode,
  303: 
  304:     fieldLayout:
  305:       selected.candidate
  306:         .fieldLayout,
  307: 
  308:     fits:
  309:       measurement.fits,
  310: 
  311:     score:
  312:       Math.round(
  313:         selected.score * 10,
  314:       ) / 10,
  315: 
  316:     severity,
  317: 
  318:     dominantRole:
  319:       measurement.dominantRole,
  320: 
  321:     overflowPx:
  322:       measurement.overflowPx,
  323: 
  324:     preferEvidenceMove,
  325:   };
  326: }

FILE: components/report-engine/design-renderers/smart-layout/report-smart-block-pagination.ts

    1: import type { LogicalReportBlock } from "./report-smart-table-pagination";
    2: 
    3: const FALLBACK_TEXT_CHUNK_LENGTH = 700;
    4: 
    5: function text(value: unknown) {
    6:   return String(value ?? "");
    7: }
    8: 
    9: function getSourceBlockId(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
   10:   return (
   11:     String(block.sourceBlockId || "").trim() ||
   12:     String(block.id || "").trim() ||
   13:     String(block.kind || "report-block").trim()
   14:   );
   15: }
   16: 
   17: function splitLongTextChunk(
   18:   value: string,
   19:   maxLength = FALLBACK_TEXT_CHUNK_LENGTH,
   20: ) {
   21:   const source = value.trim();
   22: 
   23:   if (!source) {
   24:     return [];
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   if (source.length <= maxLength) {
   28:     return [source];
   29:   }
   30: 
   31:   const result: string[] = [];
   32:   let remaining = source;
   33: 
   34:   while (remaining.length > maxLength) {
   35:     const candidate = remaining.slice(0, maxLength);
   36: 
   37:     const preferredBreak = Math.max(
   38:       candidate.lastIndexOf("."),
   39:       candidate.lastIndexOf("!"),
   40:       candidate.lastIndexOf("?"),
   41:       candidate.lastIndexOf(":"),
   42:       candidate.lastIndexOf(";"),
   43:       candidate.lastIndexOf(","),
   44:       candidate.lastIndexOf(" "),
   45:     );
   46: 
   47:     const splitAt =
   48:       preferredBreak >= Math.floor(maxLength * 0.55)
   49:         ? preferredBreak + 1
   50:         : maxLength;
   51: 
   52:     const part = remaining.slice(0, splitAt).trim();
   53: 
   54:     if (part) {
   55:       result.push(part);
   56:     }
   57: 
   58:     remaining = remaining.slice(splitAt).trim();
   59:   }
   60: 
   61:   if (remaining) {
   62:     result.push(remaining);
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   return result;
   66: }
   67: 
   68: function splitParagraphContent(value: string) {
   69:   const paragraphs = text(value)
   70:     .split(/\n\s*\n/)
   71:     .map((item) => item.trim())
   72:     .filter(Boolean);
   73: 
   74:   return paragraphs.flatMap((paragraph) =>
   75:     splitLongTextChunk(paragraph),
   76:   );
   77: }
   78: 
   79: function splitBulletContent(value: string) {
   80:   return text(value)
   81:     .split(/\n+/)
   82:     .map((item) => item.trim())
   83:     .filter(Boolean)
   84:     .flatMap((line) => splitLongTextChunk(line));
   85: }
   86: 
   87: function buildContinuationBlocks(
   88:   block: LogicalReportBlock,
   89:   parts: string[],
   90: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
   91:   if (parts.length <= 1) {
   92:     return [block];
   93:   }
   94: 
   95:   const sourceBlockId = getSourceBlockId(block);
   96: 
   97:   return parts.map((part, index) => ({
   98:     ...block,
   99:     id:
  100:       index === 0
  101:         ? block.id
  102:         : `${sourceBlockId}-part-${index + 1}`,
  103:     sourceBlockId,
  104:     content: part,
  105:     showTitle: index === 0 ? block.showTitle : false,
  106:     continuationIndex: index,
  107:     continuationCount: parts.length,
  108:   }));
  109: }
  110: 
  111: /**
  112:  * Split only a block that the real A4 measurement has already proven
  113:  * cannot fit by itself on one physical page.
  114:  *
  115:  * This function never creates physical pages.
  116:  * SmartPhysicalReportComposer remains responsible for measured A4 packing.
  117:  */
  118: export function splitOversizedReportBlock(
  119:   block: LogicalReportBlock,
  120: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
  121:   const kind = String(block.kind || "").trim();
  122: 
  123:   if (kind === "multi-paragraph") {
  124:     return buildContinuationBlocks(
  125:       block,
  126:       splitParagraphContent(text(block.content)),
  127:     );
  128:   }
  129: 
  130:   if (kind === "bullet-list") {
  131:     return buildContinuationBlocks(
  132:       block,
  133:       splitBulletContent(text(block.content)),
  134:     );
  135:   }
  136: 
  137:   return [block];
  138: }

FILE: components/report-engine/design-renderers/smart-layout/report-smart-field-layout.ts

    1: import type { ReportValueItem } from "../designs/report-design-component-types";
    2: 
    3: export type ReportSmartFieldKind =
    4:   | "short"
    5:   | "medium"
    6:   | "long"
    7:   | "list";
    8: 
    9: export type ReportSmartFieldProfile =
   10:   | "short-heavy"
   11:   | "balanced"
   12:   | "long-heavy";
   13: 
   14: function normalizeText(value: unknown) {
   15:   return String(value || "")
   16:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
   17:     .trim();
   18: }
   19: 
   20: function getValueItems(item: ReportValueItem) {
   21:   if (
   22:     Array.isArray(item.valueItems) &&
   23:     item.valueItems.length
   24:   ) {
   25:     return item.valueItems
   26:       .map(normalizeText)
   27:       .filter(Boolean);
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (Array.isArray(item.value)) {
   31:     return item.value
   32:       .map(normalizeText)
   33:       .filter(Boolean);
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   const value = normalizeText(item.value);
   37: 
   38:   return value ? [value] : [];
   39: }
   40: 
   41: export function getReportSmartFieldMetrics(
   42:   item: ReportValueItem,
   43: ) {
   44:   const label = normalizeText(item.label);
   45:   const values = getValueItems(item);
   46: 
   47:   const valueCharacters = values.reduce(
   48:     (sum, value) => sum + value.length,
   49:     0,
   50:   );
   51: 
   52:   const longestValue = values.reduce(
   53:     (longest, value) =>
   54:       Math.max(longest, value.length),
   55:     0,
   56:   );
   57: 
   58:   return {
   59:     labelCharacters: label.length,
   60:     valueCharacters,
   61:     longestValue,
   62:     totalCharacters:
   63:       label.length + valueCharacters,
   64:     valuesCount: values.length,
   65:   };
   66: }
   67: 
   68: export function classifyReportSmartField(
   69:   item: ReportValueItem,
   70: ): ReportSmartFieldKind {
   71:   const m =
   72:     getReportSmartFieldMetrics(item);
   73: 
   74:   /*
   75:    * SHORT
   76:    * مناسب لربع صف تقريبًا.
   77:    */
   78:   if (
   79:     m.valuesCount <= 1 &&
   80:     m.longestValue <= 36 &&
   81:     m.labelCharacters <= 36 &&
   82:     m.totalCharacters <= 68
   83:   ) {
   84:     return "short";
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   /*
   88:    * LIST
   89:    * القائمة الصغيرة ليست Full Width تلقائيًا.
   90:    * نسمح لها بنصف صف إذا كانت قصيرة.
   91:    */
   92:   if (
   93:     m.valuesCount > 1 &&
   94:     m.valuesCount <= 3 &&
   95:     m.longestValue <= 52 &&
   96:     m.valueCharacters <= 115
   97:   ) {
   98:     return "medium";
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   /*
  102:    * MEDIUM
  103:    * نصف صف، حتى لو احتاج سطرين أو ثلاثة.
  104:    */
  105:   if (
  106:     m.valuesCount <= 1 &&
  107:     m.longestValue <= 125 &&
  108:     m.totalCharacters <= 165
  109:   ) {
  110:     return "medium";
  111:   }
  112: 
  113:   /*
  114:    * القائمة الأكبر فقط تعتبر list كاملة.
  115:    */
  116:   if (m.valuesCount > 1) {
  117:     return "list";
  118:   }
  119: 
  120:   return "long";
  121: }
  122: 
  123: export function getReportSmartFieldProfile(
  124:   items: ReportValueItem[],
  125: ): ReportSmartFieldProfile {
  126:   if (!items.length) {
  127:     return "balanced";
  128:   }
  129: 
  130:   const counts = {
  131:     short: 0,
  132:     medium: 0,
  133:     long: 0,
  134:     list: 0,
  135:   };
  136: 
  137:   for (const item of items) {
  138:     counts[
  139:       classifyReportSmartField(item)
  140:     ] += 1;
  141:   }
  142: 
  143:   const wideCount =
  144:     counts.long + counts.list;
  145: 
  146:   if (
  147:     wideCount >=
  148:     Math.ceil(items.length * 0.55)
  149:   ) {
  150:     return "long-heavy";
  151:   }
  152: 
  153:   if (
  154:     counts.short + counts.medium >=
  155:     Math.ceil(items.length * 0.7)
  156:   ) {
  157:     return "short-heavy";
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   return "balanced";
  161: }
