    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import {
    4:   createContext,
    5:   type ReactNode,
    6:   useContext,
    7: } from "react";
    8: 
    9: const TRANSIENT_KEYS = new Set([
   10:   "candidateVersion",
   11:   "layoutResultFingerprint",
   12:   "measuredOverflow",
   13:   "measurementVersion",
   14:   "planningPhase",
   15:   "smartA4Candidate",
   16:   "smartA4Mode",
   17: ]);
   18: 
   19: function canonicalize(
   20:   value: unknown,
   21:   seen: WeakSet<object>,
   22: ): unknown {
   23:   if (
   24:     value === null ||
   25:     typeof value === "string" ||
   26:     typeof value === "number" ||
   27:     typeof value === "boolean"
   28:   ) {
   29:     return value;
   30:   }
   31: 
   32:   if (typeof value === "bigint") {
   33:     return String(value);
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   if (
   37:     typeof value === "undefined" ||
   38:     typeof value === "function" ||
   39:     typeof value === "symbol"
   40:   ) {
   41:     return null;
   42:   }
   43: 
   44:   if (value instanceof Date) {
   45:     return value.toISOString();
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   49:     return value.map((item) => canonicalize(item, seen));
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   if (typeof value === "object") {
   53:     if (seen.has(value)) {
   54:       return "[circular]";
   55:     }
   56: 
   57:     seen.add(value);
   58: 
   59:     const normalized = Object.fromEntries(
   60:       Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>)
   61:         .filter(
   62:           ([key]) =>
   63:             !TRANSIENT_KEYS.has(key) &&
   64:             !key.startsWith("data-smart-a4-") &&
   65:             !key.startsWith("data-report-density"),
   66:         )
   67:         .sort(([left], [right]) =>
   68:           left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0,
   69:         )
   70:         .map(([key, item]) => [key, canonicalize(item, seen)]),
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:     seen.delete(value);
   74:     return normalized;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   return String(value);
   78: }
   79: 
   80: export function createSemanticInputFingerprint(value: unknown) {
   81:   return JSON.stringify(canonicalize(value, new WeakSet()));
   82: }
   83: 
   84: export function getFingerprintPrefix(fingerprint: string) {
   85:   let hash = 2166136261;
   86: 
   87:   for (let index = 0; index < fingerprint.length; index += 1) {
   88:     hash ^= fingerprint.charCodeAt(index);
   89:     hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   return (hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, "0");
   93: }
   94: 
   95: export function roundLayoutMetric(value: number, precision = 1) {
   96:   if (!Number.isFinite(value)) {
   97:     return 0;
   98:   }
   99: 
  100:   const factor = 10 ** precision;
  101:   return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
  102: }
  103: 
  104: const ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintContext =
  105:   createContext("standalone-report-layout");
  106: 
  107: export function ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintProvider({
  108:   fingerprint,
  109:   children,
  110: }: {
  111:   fingerprint: string;
  112:   children: ReactNode;
  113: }) {
  114:   return (
  115:     <ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintContext.Provider value={fingerprint}>
  116:       {children}
  117:     </ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintContext.Provider>
  118:   );
  119: }
  120: 
  121: export function useReportSmartSemanticFingerprint() {
  122:   return useContext(ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintContext);
  123: }

  416:           keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  417:         ),
  418:       [
  419:         page,
  420:         evidenceBlock,
  421:         primaryEvidenceCount,
  422:         keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  423:       ],
  424:     );
  425: 
  426:   const signatureOverflowPage =
  427:     useMemo(
  428:       () =>
  429:         !keepSignatureOnPrimary &&
  430:         hasSignature &&
  431:         page
  432:           ? makeSignatureOverflowPage(
  433:               page,
  434:               signatureBlocks,
  435:             )
  436:           : null,
  437:       [
  438:         page,
  439:         signatureBlocks,
  440:         hasSignature,
  441:         keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  442:       ],
  443:     );
  444: 
  445:   const hasSignatureOverflowPage = Boolean(
  446:     signatureOverflowPage,
  447:   );
  448: 
  449:   const autoEvidencePhysicalPages = useMemo(
  450:     () =>
  451:       evidenceAutoEnabled
  452:         ? buildAutoEvidencePhysicalPages({
  453:             activePage: page,
  454:             previewCase,
  455:             primaryEvidenceCount,
  456:           })
  457:         : [],
  458:     [
  459:       evidenceAutoEnabled,
  460:       page,
  461:       previewCase,
  462:       primaryEvidenceCount,
  463:     ],
  464:   );
  465: 
  466:   const composedPhysicalPages = useMemo(
  467:     () => [
  468:       primaryPage,
  469:       ...autoEvidencePhysicalPages.map(({ page: evidencePage }) => evidencePage),
  470:       ...(signatureOverflowPage ? [signatureOverflowPage] : []),
  471:     ].filter((physicalPage): physicalPage is ReportPhysicalPageModel =>
  472:       Boolean(physicalPage),
  473:     ),
  474:     [autoEvidencePhysicalPages, primaryPage, signatureOverflowPage],
  475:   );
  476: 
  477:   useEffect(() => {
  478:     if (
  479:       planningPhase !== "FROZEN" ||
  480:       !page?.id ||
  481:       !onCompositionReady
  482:     ) {
  483:       return;
  484:     }
  485: 
  486:     onCompositionReady({
  487:       corePhysicalPageId: page.id,
  488:       pages: composedPhysicalPages,
  489:     });
  490:   }, [
  491:     composedPhysicalPages,
  492:     onCompositionReady,
  493:     page?.id,
  494:     planningPhase,
  495:   ]);
  496: 
  497:   useEffect(() => {
  498:     const host =
  499:       hostRef.current;
  500: 
  501:     if (!host) {
  502:       return;
  503:     }
  504: 
  505:     let frame:
  506:       | number
  507:       | null = null;
  508: 
  509:     let disposed = false;
  510:     let observer: MutationObserver | null = null;
  511: 
  512:     const resetStability = () => {
  513:       stabilityRef.current = {
  514:         signature: "",
  515:         count: 0,
  516:         attempts: stabilityRef.current.attempts,
  517:       };
  518:     };
  519: 
  520:     const recordStableResult = (signature: string) => {
  521:       const previous = stabilityRef.current;
  522: 
  523:       stabilityRef.current =
  524:         previous.signature === signature
  525:           ? {
  526:               signature,
  527:               count: previous.count + 1,
  528:               attempts: previous.attempts + 1,
  529:             }
  530:           : {
  531:               signature,
  532:               count: 1,
  533:               attempts: previous.attempts + 1,
  534:             };
  535: 
  536:       if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
  537:         host.dataset.reportComposerLayoutFingerprint =
  538:           getFingerprintPrefix(signature);
  539:         host.dataset.reportComposerStablePasses = String(
  540:           stabilityRef.current.count,
  541:         );
  542:         host.dataset.reportComposerAttempts = String(
  543:           stabilityRef.current.attempts,
  544:         );
  545:       }
  546: 
  547:       if (
  548:         stabilityRef.current.count >= 2 ||
  549:         stabilityRef.current.attempts >=
  550:           MAX_PAGE_COMPOSITION_ATTEMPTS
  551:       ) {
  552:         finalizedPlacementRef.current = {
  553:           semanticInputFingerprint: resetKey,
  554:           layoutResultFingerprint: signature,
  555:           primaryEvidenceCount,
  556:           keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  557:         };
  558:         observer?.disconnect();
  559:         setPhase("READY");
  560: 
  561:         queueMicrotask(() => {
  562:           if (
  563:             !disposed &&
  564:             planningPhaseRef.current === "READY" &&
  565:             finalizedPlacementRef.current
  566:               ?.semanticInputFingerprint === resetKey

  568:             setPhase("FROZEN");
  569:           }
  570:         });
  571:         return true;
  572:       }
  573: 
  574:       setPhase("STABILIZING");
  575:       return false;
  576:     };
  577: 
  578:     const inspect = () => {
  579:       if (isTerminalPhase()) {
  580:         return;
  581:       }
  582: 
  583:       if (frame !== null) {
  584:         window.cancelAnimationFrame(
  585:           frame,
  586:         );
  587:       }
  588: 
  589:       frame =
  590:         window.requestAnimationFrame(
  591:           () => {
  592:             frame = null;
  593: 
  594:             if (disposed) {
  595:               return;
  596:             }
  597: 
  598:             const smartViewports = Array.from(
  599:               host.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
  600:                 ".report-smart-a4-content",
  601:               ),
  602:             );
  603: 
  604:             /*
  605:              * Always bind composition decisions to the PRIMARY A4 page.
  606:              *
  607:              * The composer may also render evidence/signature overflow
  608:              * pages. Using smartViewports[0] blindly can make footer and
  609:              * signature decisions against the wrong A4 viewport.
  610:              */
  611:             const primaryPageElement =
  612:               host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
  613:                 ".pdf-report-page",
  614:               );
  615: 
  616:             const smartViewport =
  617:               primaryPageElement?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
  618:                 ".report-smart-a4-content",
  619:               ) ||
  620:               smartViewports[0];
  621: 
  622:             if (!smartViewport) {
  623:               const physicalPageCount =
  624:                 host.querySelectorAll(".pdf-report-page").length;
  625: 
  626:               if (physicalPageCount > 0) {
  627:                 const legacySignature = [
  628:                   resetKey,
  629:                   primaryEvidenceCount,
  630:                   keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  631:                   physicalPageCount,
  632:                   host.scrollHeight,
  633:                 ].join("::");
  634: 
  635:                 if (!recordStableResult(legacySignature)) {
  636:                   inspect();
  637:                 }
  638:               }
  639: 
  640:               return;
  641:             }
  642: 
  643:             if (
  644:               smartViewport.dataset.smartA4Phase !== "FROZEN"
  645:             ) {
  646:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  647:               return;
  648:             }
  649: 
  650:             /*
  651:              * Wait for a REAL Smart A4 planning pass.
  652:              */
  653:             const candidate =
  654:               smartViewport.dataset
  655:                 .smartA4Candidate;
  656: 
  657:             const severity =
  658:               smartViewport.dataset
  659:                 .smartA4Severity;
  660: 
  661:             if (
  662:               !candidate ||
  663:               !severity
  664:             ) {
  665:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  666:               resetStability();
  667:               return;
  668:             }
  669: 
  670:             const overflowState =
  671:               smartViewport.dataset
  672:                 .reportOverflow;
  673: 
  674:             /*
  675:              * Final physical footer verification.
  676:              *
  677:              * The primary page may have received evidence and
  678:              * signatures after regular physical packing.
  679:              * Therefore verify the COMPOSED page itself against
  680:              * its real footer before deciding to keep those
  681:              * special blocks on the primary page.
  682:              */
  683:             const primaryPhysicalPage =
  684:               primaryPageElement ||
  685:               smartViewport.closest<HTMLElement>(
  686:                 ".pdf-report-page",
  687:               );
  688: 
  689:             const primaryFooter =
  690:               primaryPhysicalPage?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
  691:                 "[data-report-page-footer]",
  692:               ) || null;
  693: 
  694:             const footerSafetyGapPx =
  695:               2 * (96 / 25.4);
  696: 
  697:             const footerBoundaryTop =
  698:               primaryFooter
  699:                 ? primaryFooter.getBoundingClientRect().top -
  700:                   footerSafetyGapPx
  701:                 : Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  702: 
  703:             const smartContentBoundaryBottom =
  704:               smartViewport.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
  705: 
  706:             const usablePrimaryBoundaryBottom =
  707:               Math.min(
  708:                 footerBoundaryTop,
  709:                 smartContentBoundaryBottom,
  710:               );
  711: 
  712:             const primarySmartBlocks =
  713:               primaryPhysicalPage
  714:                 ? Array.from(
  715:                     primaryPhysicalPage.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
  716:                       '[data-report-smart-block], [data-report-priority-block="signature"], [data-report-design-signature-block]',
  717:                     ),
  718:                   )
  719:                 : [];
  720: 
  721:             const crossesPhysicalFooter =
  722:               primaryFooter !== null &&
  723:               primarySmartBlocks.some((blockElement) => {
  724:                 const rect =
  725:                   blockElement.getBoundingClientRect();

  727:                 return (
  728:                   rect.height > 0 &&
  729:                   rect.bottom > footerBoundaryTop + 1
  730:                 );
  731:               });
  732: 
  733:             /*
  734:              * Signature collision is a separate physical condition.
  735:              *
  736:              * If everything else fits but the signature crosses the
  737:              * footer, move the signature itself. Do NOT unnecessarily
  738:              * remove evidence first.
  739:              */
  740:             const primarySignatureBlocks =
  741:               primaryPhysicalPage
  742:                 ? Array.from(
  743:                     primaryPhysicalPage.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
  744:                       '[data-report-priority-block="signature"], [data-report-design-signature-block]',
  745:                     ),
  746:                   )
  747:                 : [];
  748: 
  749:             const signatureDoesNotFit =
  750:               primarySignatureBlocks.some((signatureElement) => {
  751:                 const rect =
  752:                   signatureElement.getBoundingClientRect();
  753: 
  754:                 return (
  755:                   rect.height > 0 &&
  756:                   rect.bottom > usablePrimaryBoundaryBottom + 1
  757:                 );
  758:               });
  759: 
  760:             const doesNotFit =
  761:               overflowState !==
  762:                 "fit" ||
  763:               crossesPhysicalFooter;
  764: 
  765:             const preferEvidenceMove =
  766:               smartViewport.dataset
  767:                 .smartA4PreferEvidenceMove ===
  768:               "true";
  769: 
  770:             const density =
  771:               smartViewport.dataset
  772:                 .reportDensity ||
  773:               "normal";
  774: 
  775:             const fieldLayout =
  776:               smartViewport.dataset
  777:                 .reportFieldLayout ||
  778:               "comfortable";
  779: 
  780:             const minimumSafeSelected =
  781:               density === "minimum-safe";
  782: 
  783:             const overflowPx =
  784:               Number(
  785:                 smartViewport.getAttribute(
  786:                   "data-smart-a4-overflow-px",
  787:                 ) || "0",
  788:               );
  789: 
  790:             const decisionSignature = [
  791:               getFingerprintPrefix(resetKey),
  792:               primaryEvidenceCount,
  793:               keepSignatureOnPrimary,
  794:               doesNotFit,
  795:               signatureDoesNotFit,
  796:               preferEvidenceMove,
  797:               severity,
  798:               density,
  799:               fieldLayout,
  800:               candidate,
  801:               Number.isFinite(
  802:                 overflowPx,
  803:               )
  804:                 ? overflowPx
  805:                 : 0,
  806:             ].join("::");
  807: 
  808:             /*
  809:              * =================================================
  810:              * PHASE 1:
  811:              * MOVE EVIDENCE BEFORE SACRIFICING CORE CONTENT
  812:              * =================================================
  813:              *
  814:              * Reduce one evidence at a time.
  815:              *
  816:              * Every reduction triggers a fresh complete Smart A4
  817:              * multi-plan evaluation.
  818:              */
  819:             if (
  820:               evidenceAutoEnabled &&
  821:               primaryEvidenceCount > 0 &&
  822:               !signatureDoesNotFit &&
  823:               (
  824:                 doesNotFit ||
  825:                 preferEvidenceMove ||
  826:                 minimumSafeSelected
  827:               )
  828:             ) {
  829:               if (
  830:                 lastDecisionRef.current === decisionSignature
  831:               ) {
  832:                 return;
  833:               }
  834: 
  835:               lastDecisionRef.current = decisionSignature;
  836:               resetStability();
  837:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  838: 
  839:               setPrimaryEvidenceCount(
  840:                 (current) =>
  841:                   Math.max(
  842:                     0,
  843:                     current - 1,
  844:                   ),
  845:               );
  846: 
  847:               return;
  848:             }
  849: 
  850:             /*
  851:              * =================================================
  852:              * PHASE 2:
  853:              * SIGNATURE OVERFLOW FALLBACK
  854:              * =================================================
  855:              *
  856:              * Only after:
  857:              *
  858:              * - all movable evidence has left the primary page
  859:              * - Smart A4 still says the page does not fit
  860:              *
  861:              * do we move signature to a dedicated final page.
  862:              *
  863:              * We NEVER move regular narrative/fields just because
  864:              * the signature itself is the final obstruction.
  865:              */
  866:             if (
  867:               hasSignature &&
  868:               keepSignatureOnPrimary &&
  869:               (
  870:                 signatureDoesNotFit ||
  871:                 (
  872:                   doesNotFit &&
  873:                   primaryEvidenceCount <= 0
  874:                 )
  875:               )
  876:             ) {
  877:               if (
  878:                 lastDecisionRef.current === decisionSignature
  879:               ) {
  880:                 return;
  881:               }
  882: 
  883:               lastDecisionRef.current = decisionSignature;
  884:               resetStability();
  885:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  886: 
  887:               setKeepSignatureOnPrimary(
  888:                 false,
  889:               );
  890: 
  891:               return;
  892:             }
  893: 
  894:             if (
  895:               minimumSafeSelected &&
  896:               primaryEvidenceCount <= 0 &&
  897:               hasSignature &&
  898:               keepSignatureOnPrimary
  899:             ) {
  900:               if (lastDecisionRef.current === decisionSignature) {
  901:                 return;
  902:               }
  903: 
  904:               lastDecisionRef.current = decisionSignature;
  905:               resetStability();
  906:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  907:               setKeepSignatureOnPrimary(false);
  908:               return;
  909:             }
  910: 
  911:             /*
  912:              * If signature has moved and core content now fits,
  913:              * planning is stable.
  914:              *
  915:              * If core content itself still does not fit,
  916:              * Smart Physical Engine owns that pagination problem;
  917:              * do not hide/truncate anything here.
  918:              */
  919:             const allSmartLayoutsFrozen = smartViewports.every(
  920:               (viewport) =>
  921:                 viewport.dataset.smartA4Phase === "FROZEN",
  922:             );
  923:             const allSmartLayoutsFit = smartViewports.every(
  924:               (viewport) => viewport.dataset.reportOverflow === "fit",
  925:             );
  926: 
  927:             const unsettledImages = Array.from(
  928:               host.querySelectorAll<HTMLImageElement>("img"),
  929:             ).filter((image) => !image.complete);
  930: 
  931:             if (
  932:               !allSmartLayoutsFrozen ||
  933:               !allSmartLayoutsFit ||
  934:               unsettledImages.length > 0 ||
  935:               !fontsSettledRef.current
  936:             ) {
  937:               setPhase("MEASURING");
  938:               return;
  939:             }
  940: 
  941:             const finalSignature =
  942:               createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  943:                 decisionSignature,
  944:                 evidenceCount: validEvidences.length,
  945:                 pageCount:
  946:                   host.querySelectorAll(".pdf-report-page").length,
  947:                 hasSignatureOverflowPage:
  948:                   hasSignatureOverflowPage,
  949:                 smartLayouts: smartViewports.map((viewport) => ({
  950:                   candidate:
  951:                     viewport.dataset.smartA4Candidate || "",
  952:                   fieldLayout:
  953:                     viewport.dataset.reportFieldLayout || "comfortable",
  954:                   mode:
  955:                     viewport.dataset.reportDensity || "normal",
  956:                   overflowPx: roundLayoutMetric(
  957:                     Number(viewport.dataset.smartA4OverflowPx || "0"),
  958:                   ),
  959:                 })),
  960:               });
  961: 
  962:             if (!recordStableResult(finalSignature)) {
  963:               inspect();
  964:             }
  965:           },
  966:         );
  967:     };
  968: 
  969:     observer =
  970:       new MutationObserver(
  971:         inspect,
  972:       );
  973: 
  974:     observer.observe(
  975:       host,
  976:       {
  977:         subtree: true,
  978:         childList: true,
  979:         attributes: true,
  980: 
  981:         attributeFilter: [
  982:           "data-smart-a4-phase",
  983:         ],
  984:       },
  985:     );
  986: 
  987:     inspect();
  988: 
  989:     const handleAssetLoad = (event: Event) => {
  990:       if (isTerminalPhase()) {
  991:         return;
  992:       }
  993: 
  994:       const image =
  995:         event.target instanceof HTMLImageElement
  996:           ? event.target
  997:           : null;
  998:       const source = image?.currentSrc || image?.src || "";

 1010:

 1012:     };
 1013:

 1016: 
 1017:     const fonts = document.fonts;
 1018:     if (!fonts) {
 1019:       fontsSettledRef.current = true;

 1021:     } else if (fontsSettledRef.current) {

 1032:           if (!disposed) {

 1037:     }
 1038:

 1041:       observer?.disconnect();

 1047:           frame,
 1048:         );
 1049:       }

 1052:     primaryEvidenceCount,
 1053:     keepSignatureOnPrimary,
 1054:     evidenceAutoEnabled,
 1055:     hasSignature,
 1056:     hasSignatureOverflowPage,
 1057:     resetKey,
 1058:     validEvidences.length,

 1060:

 1075:         }
 1076:       : {};
 1077: 
 1078:   return (
 1079:     <div

 1099:       {/*

 1102:        * ======================================================

 1113:         />
 1114:       ) : null}

 1116:       {/*
 1117:        * ======================================================

 1132:           }
 1133:           preparedPages={autoEvidencePhysicalPages}
 1134:           activePhysicalPageId={activePhysicalPageId}
 1135:           renderMode={renderMode}
 1136:         />
 1137:       ) : null}
 1138: 
 1139:       {/*
 1140:        * ======================================================
 1141:        * SIGNATURE OVERFLOW
 1142:        * ======================================================

 1145:        * - evidence count already reached zero

 1147:        * - signature was the remaining protected block

 1151:         signatureOverflowPage.id === activePhysicalPageId) ? (

 1155:               ? "mt-6 print:mt-0 print:break-before-page"
 1156:               : ""
 1157:           }
 1158:           data-report-signature-overflow-page
 1159:         >
 1160:           <A4DesignPage
 1161:             designId={designId}
 1162:             page={

 1164:             }
 1165:             context={context}
 1166:             previewCase={previewCase}
 1167:             pageLabel="اعتماد التقرير"
 1168:           />
 1169:         </div>
 1170:       ) : null}
 1171:       </ReportSmartSemanticFingerprintProvider>
 1172:     </div>
 1173:   );
 1174: }

   33: type LogicalPage = {
   34:   id?: string;
   35:   title?: string;
   36:   kind?: string;
   37:   blocks?: LogicalReportBlock[];
   38:   [key: string]: any;
   39: };

   43: type SmartPhysicalReportComposerProps = {
   44:   designId: ReportDesignId;
   45:   pages: LogicalPage[];
   46:   activePageId?: string;
   47:   activePhysicalPageId?: string;
   48:   context: Record<string, string>;
   49:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
   50:   fallbackPageLabel?: string;
   51:   renderMode?: "single" | "stack";
   52:   suppressAutoEvidencePages?: boolean;
   53:   onPhysicalPagesChange?: (
   54:     pages: ReportTwoPhysicalNavigationItem[],
   55:   ) => void;
   56: };
   57: 
   58: type PhysicalPlanningPhase =
   59:   | "DIRTY"
   60:   | "PLANNING"
   61:   | "MEASURING"
   62:   | "STABILIZING"
   63:   | "READY"
   64:   | "FROZEN";
   65: 
   66: type PhysicalInvalidationReason =
   67:   | "initial"
   68:   | "design-change"
   69:   | "page-structure-change"
   70:   | "content-change"
   71:   | "evidence-change"
   72:   | "signature-change"
   73:   | "header-settings-change";
   74: 
   75: const MAX_PHYSICAL_STABILIZATION_ATTEMPTS = 80;
   76: 
   77: type FlowItem = {
   78:   block: LogicalReportBlock;
   79:   sourcePageId: string;
   80:   sourcePageTitle: string;
   81: };
   82: 
   83: type LogicalPageModel = {
   84:   sourcePageId: string;
   85:   sourcePageTitle: string;
   86:   kind: string;
   87:   regularItems: FlowItem[];
   88:   signatureItems: FlowItem[];
   89:   evidenceItems: FlowItem[];
   90:   fixedBlocks: LogicalReportBlock[];
   91: };
   92: 
   93: function normalizePlacement(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
   94:   return String(block?.placement || "flow").trim() || "flow";
   95: }
   96: 
   97: function isVisibleBlock(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
   98:   return Boolean(block) && block.visible !== false;
   99: }
  100: 
  101: function isEvidenceBlock(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
  102:   return String(block?.kind || "").trim() === "evidence-gallery";
  103: }
  104: 
  105: function isSignatureBlock(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
  106:   const kind = String(block?.kind || "").trim();
  107:   const smartKind = String(
  108:     block?.settings?.smartBlockKind || "",
  109:   ).trim();
  110:   const title = String(block?.title || "").trim();
  111: 
  112:   return (
  113:     kind === "signature-grid" ||
  114:     kind === "signatures" ||
  115:     kind === "approval-signatures" ||
  116:     smartKind === "signature-grid" ||
  117:     smartKind === "signatures" ||
  118:     title.includes("توقيع") ||
  119:     title.includes("اعتماد") ||
  120:     Array.isArray(block?.signatures)
  121:   );
  122: }
  123: 
  124: function uniqueStrings(values: string[]) {
  125:   return Array.from(
  126:     new Set(
  127:       values
  128:         .map((value) => String(value || "").trim())
  129:         .filter(Boolean),
  130:     ),
  131:   );
  132: }
  133: 
  134: /** Normalize deterministic physical identities without discarding content. */
  135: function canonicalizePhysicalPages(pages: readonly PhysicalPage[]) {
  136:   return pages.map((page, index) => {
  137:     const id = `smart-physical-${index + 1}`;
  138: 
  139:     return {
  140:       ...page,
  141:       id,
  142:       corePhysicalPageId: id,
  143:       physicalPageRole: "primary" as const,
  144:       blocks: [...page.blocks],
  145:       sourcePageIds: uniqueStrings(page.sourcePageIds),
  146:     };
  147:   });
  148: }
  149: 
  150: function buildLogicalPageModels(pages: LogicalPage[]): LogicalPageModel[] {
  151:   const sourcePages = pages.length > 0
  152:     ? pages
  153:     : [{
  154:         id: "logical-page-1",
  155:         title: "التقرير",
  156:         kind: "content",
  157:         blocks: [],
  158:       }];
  159: 
  160:   return sourcePages.map((page, pageIndex) => {
  161:     const regularItems: FlowItem[] = [];
  162:     const signatureItems: FlowItem[] = [];
  163:     const evidenceItems: FlowItem[] = [];
  164:     const sourcePageId =
  165:       String(page?.id || `logical-page-${pageIndex + 1}`);
  166: 
  167:     const sourcePageTitle =
  168:       String(page?.title || `صفحة ${pageIndex + 1}`);
  169: 
  170:     const blocks = Array.isArray(page?.blocks)
  171:       ? page.blocks.filter(isVisibleBlock)
  172:       : [];
  173: 
  174:     const fixedBlocks = blocks.filter(
  175:       (block) =>
  176:         normalizePlacement(block) !== "flow" &&
  177:         !isSignatureBlock(block),
  178:     );
  179: 
  180:     blocks
  181:       .filter(
  182:         (block) =>
  183:           normalizePlacement(block) === "flow" ||
  184:           isSignatureBlock(block),
  185:       )
  186:       .flatMap((block) => paginateStructuredTableBlock(block))
  187:       .forEach((block) => {
  188:         const item: FlowItem = {
  189:           block,
  190:           sourcePageId,
  191:           sourcePageTitle,
  192:         };
  193: 
  194:         if (isSignatureBlock(block)) {
  195:           signatureItems.push(item);
  196:           return;
  197:         }
  198: 
  199:         if (isEvidenceBlock(block)) {
  200:           evidenceItems.push(item);
  201:           return;
  202:         }
  203: 
  204:         regularItems.push(item);
  205:       });
  206:     return {
  207:       sourcePageId,
  208:       sourcePageTitle,
  209:       kind: String(page?.kind || "content"),
  210:       regularItems,
  211:       signatureItems,
  212:       evidenceItems,
  213:       fixedBlocks,
  214:     };
  215:   });
  216: }
  217: 
  218: function buildSemanticInputFingerprint(
  219:   designId: ReportDesignId,
  220:   pages: LogicalPage[],
  221:   context: Record<string, string>,
  222:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null,
  223:   fallbackPageLabel: string,
  224:   suppressAutoEvidencePages: boolean,
  225: ) {
  226:   return createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  227:     designId,
  228:     fallbackPageLabel,
  229:     suppressAutoEvidencePages,
  230:     context,
  231:     pages,
  232:     previewCase,
  233:   });
  234: }
  235: 
  236: function makePhysicalPage(
  237:   index: number,
  238:   logicalPage: LogicalPageModel,
  239:   blocks: LogicalReportBlock[],
  240: ): PhysicalPage {
  241:   return {
  242:     id: `smart-physical-${index + 1}`,
  243:     title: logicalPage.sourcePageTitle,
  244:     kind: logicalPage.kind,
  245:     blocks: mergeAdjacentCommitteeItemsTableBlocks(blocks),
  246:     sourcePageIds: [logicalPage.sourcePageId],
  247:     corePhysicalPageId: `smart-physical-${index + 1}`,
  248:     physicalPageRole: "primary",
  249:   };
  250: }
  251: 
  252: function addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
  253:   physicalPage: PhysicalPage,
  254:   logicalPage: LogicalPageModel,
  255:   includeFixedBlocks: boolean,
  256: ) {
  257:   if (!includeFixedBlocks || !logicalPage.fixedBlocks.length) {
  258:     return physicalPage;
  259:   }
  260: 
  261:   return {
  262:     ...physicalPage,
  263:     blocks: [
  264:       ...physicalPage.blocks,
  265:       ...logicalPage.fixedBlocks,
  266:     ],
  267:   };
  268: }
  269: 
  270: function appendLogicalPageSpecialBlocks(
  271:   pages: PhysicalPage[],
  272:   logicalPage: LogicalPageModel,
  273: ) {
  274:   const result =
  275:     pages.length > 0
  276:       ? pages.map((page) => ({
  277:           ...page,
  278:           blocks: [...page.blocks],
  279:           sourcePageIds: [...page.sourcePageIds],
  280:         }))
  281:       : [
  282:           {
  283:             id: "smart-physical-1",
  284:             title: logicalPage.sourcePageTitle,
  285:             kind: logicalPage.kind,
  286:             blocks: [...logicalPage.fixedBlocks],
  287:             sourcePageIds: [logicalPage.sourcePageId],
  288:             corePhysicalPageId: "smart-physical-1",
  289:             physicalPageRole: "primary",
  290:           } satisfies PhysicalPage,
  291:         ];
  292: 
  293:   const lastIndex = result.length - 1;
  294:   const last = result[lastIndex];
  295: 
  296:   /*
  297:    * Evidence is intentionally placed BEFORE signature.
  298:    *
  299:    * SmartReportPageComposer then decides:
  300:    * 2 evidence / 1 evidence / 0 evidence on this page,
  301:    * while the remaining evidence goes to AutoEvidencePages.
  302:    */
  303:   const primaryEvidenceItem = logicalPage.evidenceItems.find(
  304:     (item) => Number(item.block?.evidenceStartIndex || 0) <= 0,
  305:   ) || logicalPage.evidenceItems[0];
  306:   const evidenceBlocks = primaryEvidenceItem
  307:     ? [primaryEvidenceItem.block]
  308:     : [];
  309:   const evidenceContinuationItems = logicalPage.evidenceItems.filter(
  310:     (item) => item !== primaryEvidenceItem,
  311:   );
  312: 
  313:   const signatureBlocks =
  314:     logicalPage.signatureItems.map((item) => item.block);
  315: 
  316:   result[lastIndex] = {
  317:     ...last,
  318:     sourcePageIds: [logicalPage.sourcePageId],
  319:     blocks: [
  320:       ...last.blocks,
  321:       ...evidenceBlocks,
  322:       ...signatureBlocks,
  323:     ],
  324:   };
  325: 
  326:   evidenceContinuationItems.forEach((item) => {
  327:     result.push(
  328:       makePhysicalPage(
  329:         result.length,
  330:         logicalPage,
  331:         [item.block],
  332:       ),
  333:     );
  334:   });
  335: 
  336:   return result;
  337: }
  338: 
  339: function buildComposedPhysicalPages(
  340:   corePages: readonly PhysicalPage[],
  341:   compositions: Readonly<Record<string, ReportPhysicalPageComposition>>,
  342:   logicalPages: readonly LogicalPageModel[],
  343: ) {
  344:   const logicalTitles = new Map(
  345:     logicalPages.map((page) => [page.sourcePageId, page.sourcePageTitle]),
  346:   );
  347:   const logicalPageCounters = new Map<string, number>();
  348:   const seenPhysicalIds = new Set<string>();
  349: 
  350:   return corePages.flatMap((corePage) => {
  351:     const composedPages =
  352:       compositions[corePage.id]?.pages?.length
  353:         ? compositions[corePage.id].pages
  354:         : [corePage];
  355: 
  356:     return composedPages.flatMap((page) => {
  357:       const id = String(page.id || "").trim();
  358: 
  359:       if (!id || seenPhysicalIds.has(id)) {
  360:         return [];
  361:       }
  362: 
  363:       seenPhysicalIds.add(id);
  364:       const sourcePageIds = uniqueStrings(
  365:         page.sourcePageIds.length
  366:           ? page.sourcePageIds
  367:           : corePage.sourcePageIds,
  368:       );
  369:       const sourceLogicalPageId = sourcePageIds[0] || "logical-page-1";
  370:       const physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage =
  371:         (logicalPageCounters.get(sourceLogicalPageId) || 0) + 1;
  372:       logicalPageCounters.set(
  373:         sourceLogicalPageId,
  374:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage,
  375:       );
  376:       const sourceTitle =
  377:         logicalTitles.get(sourceLogicalPageId) || corePage.title || "التقرير";
  378:       const title =
  379:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage === 1
  380:           ? sourceTitle
  381:           : `${sourceTitle} - صفحة ${physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage}`;
  382: 
  383:       return [{
  384:         ...page,
  385:         title,
  386:         sourcePageIds,
  387:         corePhysicalPageId: corePage.id,
  388:         physicalPageIndex: seenPhysicalIds.size - 1,
  389:         physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage,
  390:       }];
  391:     });
  392:   });
  393: }
  394: 
  395: function buildPhysicalNavigationItems(
  396:   pages: readonly PhysicalPage[],
  397: ): ReportTwoPhysicalNavigationItem[] {
  398:   return pages.map((page, index) => ({
  399:     physicalPageId: page.id,
  400:     corePhysicalPageId: page.corePhysicalPageId,
  401:     sourceLogicalPageId: page.sourcePageIds[0] || "logical-page-1",
  402:     sourcePageIds: [...page.sourcePageIds],
  403:     label: page.title,
  404:     physicalPageIndex: index,
  405:     physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage:
  406:       page.physicalIndexWithinLogicalPage || 1,
  407:     role: page.physicalPageRole,
  408:   }));
  409: }
  410: 
  411: export function SmartPhysicalReportComposer({
  412:   designId,
  413:   pages,
  414:   activePageId,
  415:   activePhysicalPageId,
  416:   context,
  417:   previewCase,
  418:   fallbackPageLabel = "التقرير",
  419:   renderMode = "stack",
  420:   suppressAutoEvidencePages = false,
  421:   onPhysicalPagesChange,
  422: }: SmartPhysicalReportComposerProps) {
  423:   const logicalPageModels = useMemo(
  424:     () => buildLogicalPageModels(pages || []),
  425:     [pages],
  426:   );
  427: 
  428:   const semanticInputFingerprint = useMemo(
  429:     () =>
  430:       buildSemanticInputFingerprint(
  431:         designId,
  432:         pages || [],
  433:         context,
  434:         previewCase,
  435:         fallbackPageLabel,
  436:         suppressAutoEvidencePages,
  437:       ),
  438:     [
  439:       context,
  440:       designId,
  441:       fallbackPageLabel,
  442:       pages,
  443:       previewCase,
  444:       suppressAutoEvidencePages,
  445:     ],
  446:   );
  447: 
  448:   const semanticFingerprintParts = useMemo(
  449:     () => ({
  450:       content: semanticInputFingerprint,
  451:       design: createSemanticInputFingerprint(designId),
  452:       evidence: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  453:         blocks: pages.flatMap((page) =>
  454:           (page.blocks || []).filter(isEvidenceBlock),
  455:         ),
  456:         evidences: previewCase?.evidences || [],
  457:       }),
  458:       header: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  459:         fallbackPageLabel,
  460:         settings: Object.fromEntries(
  461:           Object.entries(context).filter(([key]) =>
  462:             key.startsWith("identity.") ||
  463:             key.startsWith("report."),
  464:           ),
  465:         ),
  466:       }),
  467:       pageStructure: createSemanticInputFingerprint(
  468:         pages.map((page) => ({
  469:           blocks: (page.blocks || []).map((block) => ({
  470:             id: block?.id,
  471:             kind: block?.kind,
  472:             placement: block?.placement,
  473:           })),
  474:           id: page.id,
  475:           kind: page.kind,
  476:         })),
  477:       ),
  478:       signatures: createSemanticInputFingerprint({
  479:         blocks: pages.flatMap((page) =>
  480:           (page.blocks || []).filter(isSignatureBlock),
  481:         ),
  482:         context: Object.fromEntries(
  483:           Object.entries(context).filter(([key]) =>
  484:             key.toLowerCase().includes("signature"),
  485:           ),
  486:         ),
  487:       }),
  488:     }),
  489:     [
  490:       context,
  491:       designId,
  492:       fallbackPageLabel,
  493:       pages,
  494:       previewCase?.evidences,
  495:       semanticInputFingerprint,
  496:     ],
  497:   );
  498: 
  499:   const semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint = useMemo(
  500:     () => createSemanticInputFingerprint(semanticFingerprintParts),
  501:     [semanticFingerprintParts],
  502:   );
  503: 
  504:   const measurementHostRef =
  505:     useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  506: 
  507:   const outputHostRef =
  508:     useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  509: 
  510:   const [physicalPages, setPhysicalPages] =
  511:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  512: 
  513:   const [finalPhysicalPages, setFinalPhysicalPages] =
  514:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  515: 
  516:   const [pageCompositions, setPageCompositions] =
  517:     useState<Record<string, ReportPhysicalPageComposition>>({});
  518: 
  519:   const [acceptedItems, setAcceptedItems] =
  520:     useState<FlowItem[]>([]);
  521: 
  522:   const [effectiveRegularItems, setEffectiveRegularItems] =
  523:     useState<FlowItem[]>(
  524:       () => logicalPageModels[0]?.regularItems ?? [],
  525:     );
  526: 
  527:   const [logicalPageIndex, setLogicalPageIndex] =
  528:     useState(0);
  529: 
  530:   const [currentLogicalPhysicalPages, setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages] =
  531:     useState<PhysicalPage[]>([]);
  532: 
  533:   const [cursor, setCursor] =
  534:     useState(0);
  535: 
  536:   const [candidateVersion, setCandidateVersion] =
  537:     useState(0);
  538: 
  539:   const [done, setDone] =
  540:     useState(false);
  541: 
  542:   const [planningPhase, setPlanningPhase] =
  543:     useState<PhysicalPlanningPhase>("DIRTY");
  544: 
  545:   const [plannedResetKey, setPlannedResetKey] =
  546:     useState(semanticInputFingerprint);
  547: 
  548:   const planningPhaseRef =
  549:     useRef<PhysicalPlanningPhase>("DIRTY");
  550: 
  551:   const outputStabilityRef = useRef({
  552:     signature: "",
  553:     count: 0,
  554:     attempts: 0,
  555:   });
  556: 
  557:   const finalizedPlanRef = useRef<{
  558:     semanticInputFingerprint: string;
  559:     layoutResultFingerprint: string;
  560:     pages: readonly PhysicalPage[];
  561:   } | null>(null);
  562: 
  563:   const previousSemanticPartsRef =
  564:     useRef<typeof semanticFingerprintParts | null>(null);
  565: 
  566:   const [invalidationReason, setInvalidationReason] =
  567:     useState<PhysicalInvalidationReason>("initial");
  568: 
  569:   const fontsSettledRef = useRef(false);
  570:   const settledAssetSourcesRef = useRef(new Set<string>());
  571:   const outputResizeFingerprintRef = useRef("");
  572: 
  573:   const decisionLockRef =
  574:     useRef(false);
  575: 
  576:   /*
  577:    * New report/template data => rebuild physical pagination.
  578:    */
  579:   useEffect(() => {
  580:     const currentParts = JSON.parse(
  581:       semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint,
  582:     ) as typeof semanticFingerprintParts;
  583:     const previousParts = previousSemanticPartsRef.current;
  584: 
  585:     const nextInvalidationReason: PhysicalInvalidationReason = !previousParts
  586:       ? "initial"
  587:       : previousParts.design !== currentParts.design
  588:         ? "design-change"
  589:         : previousParts.pageStructure !==
  590:             currentParts.pageStructure
  591:           ? "page-structure-change"
  592:           : previousParts.evidence !== currentParts.evidence
  593:             ? "evidence-change"
  594:             : previousParts.signatures !==
  595:                 currentParts.signatures
  596:               ? "signature-change"
  597:               : previousParts.header !== currentParts.header
  598:                 ? "header-settings-change"
  599:                 : "content-change";
  600: 
  601:     setInvalidationReason(nextInvalidationReason);
  602: 
  603:     previousSemanticPartsRef.current = currentParts;
  604:     finalizedPlanRef.current = null;
  605:     decisionLockRef.current = false;
  606: 
  607:     planningPhaseRef.current = "DIRTY";
  608:     setPlanningPhase("DIRTY");
  609:     setPhysicalPages([]);
  610:     setFinalPhysicalPages([]);
  611:     setPageCompositions({});
  612:     setAcceptedItems([]);
  613:     setEffectiveRegularItems(
  614:       logicalPageModels[0]?.regularItems ?? [],
  615:     );
  616:     setLogicalPageIndex(0);
  617:     setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages([]);
  618:     setCursor(0);
  619:     setCandidateVersion(
  620:       (current) => current + 1,
  621:     );
  622:     setDone(false);
  623:     planningPhaseRef.current = "PLANNING";
  624:     setPlanningPhase("PLANNING");
  625:     outputStabilityRef.current = {
  626:       signature: "",
  627:       count: 0,
  628:       attempts: 0,
  629:     };
  630:     settledAssetSourcesRef.current.clear();
  631:     outputResizeFingerprintRef.current = "";
  632:     setPlannedResetKey(semanticInputFingerprint);
  633:   }, [
  634:     semanticInputFingerprint,
  635:     semanticFingerprintPartsFingerprint,
  636:   ]);
  637: 
  638:   const activeLogicalPage =
  639:     logicalPageModels[logicalPageIndex] ?? logicalPageModels[0]!;
  640: 
  641:   const completeCurrentLogicalPage = useCallback(
  642:     (corePages: PhysicalPage[]) => {
  643:       if (!activeLogicalPage) {
  644:         setDone(true);
  645:         return;
  646:       }
  647: 
  648:       const logicalPhysicalPages = corePages.length > 0
  649:         ? corePages
  650:         : [
  651:             makePhysicalPage(
  652:               physicalPages.length,
  653:               activeLogicalPage,
  654:               [...activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks],
  655:             ),
  656:           ];
  657: 
  658:       const completedLogicalPages =
  659:         appendLogicalPageSpecialBlocks(
  660:           logicalPhysicalPages,
  661:           activeLogicalPage,
  662:         );
  663: 
  664:       setPhysicalPages(
  665:         canonicalizePhysicalPages([
  666:           ...physicalPages,
  667:           ...completedLogicalPages,
  668:         ]),
  669:       );
  670:       setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages([]);
  671:       setAcceptedItems([]);
  672:       setCursor(0);
  673: 
  674:       if (logicalPageIndex >= logicalPageModels.length - 1) {
  675:         setDone(true);
  676:       } else {
  677:         setEffectiveRegularItems(
  678:           logicalPageModels[logicalPageIndex + 1]?.regularItems ?? [],
  679:         );
  680:         setLogicalPageIndex((current) => current + 1);
  681:         setCandidateVersion((current) => current + 1);
  682:       }
  683:     },
  684:     [
  685:       activeLogicalPage,
  686:       logicalPageIndex,
  687:       logicalPageModels.length,
  688:       physicalPages,
  689:     ],
  690:   );
  691: 
  692:   const hasRegularItems =
  693:     effectiveRegularItems.length > 0;
  694: 
  695:   const nextItem =
  696:     effectiveRegularItems[cursor];
  697: 
  698:   const candidateItems = useMemo(() => {
  699:     if (done) {
  700:       return [];
  701:     }
  702: 
  703:     if (!hasRegularItems) {
  704:       return [];
  705:     }
  706: 
  707:     if (!nextItem) {
  708:       return acceptedItems;
  709:     }
  710: 
  711:     return [
  712:       ...acceptedItems,
  713:       nextItem,
  714:     ];
  715:   }, [
  716:     acceptedItems,
  717:     done,
  718:     hasRegularItems,
  719:     nextItem,
  720:   ]);
  721: 
  722:   const candidateBlocks = useMemo(() => {
  723:     if (!hasRegularItems) {
  724:       /*
  725:        * Signature-only report:
  726:        * signature is the core content because there are no
  727:        * regular blocks to pack.
  728:        */
  729:       const signatureBlocks = activeLogicalPage.signatureItems.map(
  730:         (item) => item.block,
  731:       );
  732: 
  733:       return [
  734:         ...signatureBlocks,
  735:         ...(currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0
  736:           ? activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks
  737:           : []),
  738:       ];
  739:     }
  740: 
  741:     /*
  742:      * IMPORTANT:
  743:      *
  744:      * Physical pagination packs REGULAR CONTENT ONLY.
  745:      *
  746:      * Do not inject signature into the final regular candidate.
  747:      * Doing that caused this failure:
  748:      *
  749:      * fields                         -> fits
  750:      * fields + narrative + signature -> fails
  751:      * engine closes page at fields   -> WRONG
  752:      *
  753:      * Now:
  754:      *
  755:      * fields + narrative + other regular blocks

  758:      * Evidence and signature are appended only after the core
  759:      * physical pages have been built, and SmartReportPageComposer
  760:      * negotiates their final placement.
  761:      */
  762:     return [
  763:       ...mergeAdjacentCommitteeItemsTableBlocks(
  764:         candidateItems.map((item) => item.block),
  765:       ),
  766:       ...(currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0
  767:         ? activeLogicalPage.fixedBlocks
  768:         : []),
  769:     ];
  770:   }, [
  771:     activeLogicalPage,
  772:     candidateItems,
  773:     currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length,
  774:     hasRegularItems,
  775:   ]);

  777:   const candidatePage = useMemo(

  779:       id:
  780:         `smart-measure-${candidateVersion}-${logicalPageIndex}-${cursor}-${acceptedItems.length}`,
  781: 
  782:       title: activeLogicalPage.sourcePageTitle || fallbackPageLabel,
  783: 
  784:       kind: "content",
  785: 
  786:       blocks: candidateBlocks,
  787:     }),
  788:     [
  789:       candidateVersion,
  790:       logicalPageIndex,
  791:       cursor,
  792:       acceptedItems.length,
  793:       fallbackPageLabel,
  794:       candidateBlocks,
  795:       activeLogicalPage.sourcePageTitle,
  796:     ],
  797:   );
  798: 
  799:   /*
  800:    * Special case:
  801:    * no regular blocks at all.
  802:    */

  805:       done ||
  806:       hasRegularItems
  807:     ) {
  808:       return;
  809:     }

  812:      * We still render the hidden measurement candidate first

  816:       return;
  817:     }

  819:     completeCurrentLogicalPage([]);

  821:     activeLogicalPage.signatureItems.length,
  822:     completeCurrentLogicalPage,
  823:     done,
  824:     hasRegularItems,
  825:   ]);

  827:   /*
  828:    * DOM-driven physical page packing.
  829:    *
  830:    * Greedy but measured:
  831:    *
  832:    * current accepted blocks + next block
  833:    *              ↓
  834:    *     real A4 Smart engine
  835:    *              ↓

  837:    * fits? no  => finalize previous physical page
  838:    */

  840:     const host =
  841:       measurementHostRef.current;

  843:     if (
  844:       !host ||
  845:       done

  861:           if (decisionLockRef.current) {

  866:             host.querySelector<HTMLElement>(

  881:               viewport.getAttribute(
  882:                 "data-smart-a4-score",

  887:             viewport.getAttribute(

  974:             setAcceptedItems(

  976:             );
  977:

  983:             setCandidateVersion(
  984:               (current) =>
  985:                 current + 1,

  989:             return;

  992:           /*
  993:            * Candidate does NOT fit.
  994:            *
  995:            * If we already had accepted content,

  997:            */
  998:           if (
  999:             acceptedItems.length > 0

 1001:             const basePage =
 1002:               makePhysicalPage(

 1004:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1005:                 acceptedItems.map(
 1006:                   (item) => item.block,
 1007:                 ),
 1008:               );

 1010:             const finalized =
 1011:               addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
 1012:                 basePage,
 1013:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1014:                 currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0,
 1015:               );

 1030:                 current + 1,
 1031:             );

 1034:             return;
 1035:           }

 1043:            */

 1046:               splitOversizedReportBlock(nextItem.block);
 1047: 
 1048:             if (splitBlocks.length > 1) {

 1050:                 block,

 1062:               decisionLockRef.current = false;

 1074:               addLogicalPageFixedBlocks(
 1075:                 oversizedPage,
 1076:                 activeLogicalPage,
 1077:                 currentLogicalPhysicalPages.length === 0,
 1078:               );
 1079:

 1081:               ...currentLogicalPhysicalPages,
 1082:               withFixed,
 1083:             ];
 1084: 
 1085:             if (isLastItem) {
 1086:               completeCurrentLogicalPage(newPages);
 1087:             } else {
 1088:               setCurrentLogicalPhysicalPages(newPages);
 1089: 
 1090:               setCursor(
 1091:                 (current) =>
 1092:                   current + 1,
 1093:               );
 1094: 
 1095:               setCandidateVersion(
 1096:                 (current) =>
 1097:                   current + 1,
 1098:               );
 1099:             }
 1100: 
 1101:             decisionLockRef.current = false;
 1102:             return;
 1103:           }
 1104: 
 1105:           decisionLockRef.current = false;
 1106:         });
 1107:     };
 1108: 
 1109:     const observer =
 1110:       new MutationObserver(inspect);
 1111: 
 1112:     observer.observe(host, {
 1113:       subtree: true,
 1114:       childList: true,
 1115:       attributes: true,
 1116:       attributeFilter: [
 1117:         "data-smart-a4-phase",
 1118:       ],
 1119:     });
 1120: 
 1121:     inspect();
 1122: 
 1123:     return () => {
 1124:       observer.disconnect();
 1125: 
 1126:       if (frame !== null) {
 1127:         window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
 1128:       }
 1129:     };
 1130:   }, [
 1131:     activeLogicalPage,
 1132:     acceptedItems,
 1133:     candidateVersion,
 1134:     completeCurrentLogicalPage,
 1135:     currentLogicalPhysicalPages,
 1136:     cursor,
 1137:     done,
 1138:     effectiveRegularItems.length,
 1139:     hasRegularItems,
 1140:     nextItem,
 1141:     physicalPages,
 1142:   ]);
 1143: 
 1144:   /*
 1145:    * During calculation keep old/new physical pages hidden
 1146:    * until a stable plan exists.
 1147:    */
 1148:   const isPlanCurrent =
 1149:     plannedResetKey === semanticInputFingerprint;
 1150: 
 1151:   const handlePageCompositionReady = useCallback(
 1152:     (composition: ReportPhysicalPageComposition) => {
 1153:       setPageCompositions((current) => {
 1154:         const previous = current[composition.corePhysicalPageId];

 1163:           return current;
 1164:         }
 1165:

 1167:           ...current,
 1168:           [composition.corePhysicalPageId]: composition,
 1169:         };
 1170:       });
 1171:     },
 1172:     [],
 1173:   );
 1174: 
 1175:   const composedPhysicalPages = useMemo(
 1176:     () =>
 1177:       buildComposedPhysicalPages(
 1178:         physicalPages,

 1180:         logicalPageModels,

 1182:     [logicalPageModels, pageCompositions, physicalPages],
 1183:   );
 1184: 
 1185:   const allCoreCompositionsReady =
 1186:     physicalPages.length > 0 &&

 1190:     () =>
 1191:       finalPhysicalPages.length > 0

 1198:     done && isPlanCurrent && renderablePhysicalPages.length
 1199:       ? renderablePhysicalPages

 1201:

 1206:           if (!visiblePages.length) {

 1208:           }

 1237:   useEffect(() => {

 1240:     }

FILE: components/report-engine/design-renderers/smart-layout/report-smart-table-pagination.ts
============================================================
    1: import { paginateSmartReportTable } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-structured-table-extractor";
    2: import type { SmartReportTable } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    3: 
    4: const COMMITTEE_ITEMS_SOURCE_FIELD_KEY = "committee_items";
    5: 
    6: export type LogicalReportBlock = {
    7:   id?: string;
    8:   kind?: string;
    9:   title?: string;
   10:   sourceBlockId?: string;
   11:   sourceTableId?: string;
   12:   sourceFieldKey?: string;
   13:   visible?: boolean;
   14:   placement?: string;
   15:   settings?: Record<string, unknown>;
   16:   signatures?: unknown[];
   17:   evidenceStartIndex?: number;
   18:   columns?: unknown[];
   19:   columnWidths?: unknown[];
   20:   rows?: unknown[];
   21:   rowMetadata?: Array<{ gender?: string | null }>;
   22:   tableSettings?: Record<string, unknown>;
   23:   [key: string]: unknown;
   24: };
   25: 
   26: function text(value: unknown) {
   27:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
   28: }
   29: 
   30: function isCommitteeItemsTable(block: LogicalReportBlock) {
   31:   return (
   32:     text(block.sourceFieldKey).toLowerCase() ===
   33:     COMMITTEE_ITEMS_SOURCE_FIELD_KEY
   34:   );
   35: }
   36: 
   37: /**
   38:  * The estimated paginator keeps large tables row-safe. When two estimated
   39:  * committee chunks are candidates for the same measured A4, combine them so
   40:  * the real DOM measurement decides whether they fit as one continuous table.
   41:  */
   42: export function mergeAdjacentCommitteeItemsTableBlocks(
   43:   blocks: LogicalReportBlock[],
   44: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
   45:   return blocks.reduce<LogicalReportBlock[]>((merged, block) => {
   46:     const previous = merged[merged.length - 1];
   47:     const sameCommitteeTable =
   48:       previous &&
   49:       isCommitteeItemsTable(previous) &&
   50:       isCommitteeItemsTable(block) &&
   51:       text(previous.sourceBlockId) !== "" &&
   52:       text(previous.sourceBlockId) === text(block.sourceBlockId);
   53: 
   54:     if (!sameCommitteeTable) {
   55:       merged.push(block);
   56:       return merged;
   57:     }
   58: 
   59:     merged[merged.length - 1] = {
   60:       ...previous,
   61:       rows: [
   62:         ...(Array.isArray(previous.rows) ? previous.rows : []),
   63:         ...(Array.isArray(block.rows) ? block.rows : []),
   64:       ],
   65:       rowMetadata: [
   66:         ...(Array.isArray(previous.rowMetadata) ? previous.rowMetadata : []),
   67:         ...(Array.isArray(block.rowMetadata) ? block.rowMetadata : []),
   68:       ],
   69:     };
   70: 
   71:     return merged;
   72:   }, []);
   73: }
   74: 
   75: /**
   76:  * Splits only table rows into generic continuation blocks. It never creates
   77:  * logical or physical pages; SmartPhysicalReportComposer still performs the
   78:  * real DOM-driven A4 packing for every resulting block.
   79:  */
   80: export function paginateStructuredTableBlock(
   81:   block: LogicalReportBlock,
   82: ): LogicalReportBlock[] {
   83:   if (block.kind !== "structured-table") {
   84:     return [block];
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   const columns = Array.isArray(block.columns)
   88:     ? block.columns.map((column) => text(column))
   89:     : [];
   90:   const rows = Array.isArray(block.rows) ? block.rows : [];
   91: 
   92:   if (!columns.length || !rows.length) {
   93:     return [block];
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   const sourceBlockId = text(block.sourceBlockId) || text(block.id) || "structured-table";
   97:   const settings = block.tableSettings || {};
   98:   const committeeItemsTable = isCommitteeItemsTable(block);
   99:   const table: SmartReportTable = {
  100:     id: text(block.sourceTableId) || sourceBlockId,
  101:     sourceFieldKey: text(block.sourceFieldKey),
  102:     title: text(block.title),
  103:     columns: columns.map((label, index) => ({
  104:       key: `column_${index}`,
  105:       label,
  106:       ...(Number(block.columnWidths?.[index]) > 0
  107:         ? { width: Number(block.columnWidths?.[index]) }
  108:         : {}),
  109:     })),
  110:     rows: rows.map((rawRow, rowIndex) => {
  111:       const row = Array.isArray(rawRow) ? rawRow : [];
  112: 
  113:       return {
  114:         id: `${sourceBlockId}-row-${rowIndex + 1}`,
  115:         cells: Object.fromEntries(
  116:           columns.map((_, columnIndex) => [
  117:             `column_${columnIndex}`,
  118:             text(row[columnIndex]),
  119:           ]),
  120:         ),
  121:         metadata: {
  122:           gender: block.rowMetadata?.[rowIndex]?.gender || null,
  123:         },
  124:       };
  125:     }),
  126:     settings: {
  127:       repeatHeader: settings.repeatHeader !== false,
  128:       compact: Boolean(settings.compact),
  129:       stripedRows: settings.stripedRows !== false,
  130:       highlightFirstColumn: Boolean(settings.highlightFirstColumn),
  131:     },
  132:   };
  133: 
  134:   const chunks = paginateSmartReportTable(table);
  135: 
  136:   return chunks.map((chunk, index) => ({
  137:     ...block,
  138:     id: index === 0 ? block.id : `${sourceBlockId}-table-part-${index + 1}`,
  139:     // A true committee continuation repeats the column header, not the
  140:     // report-section title or a visible "- تكملة" heading.
  141:     title: committeeItemsTable ? table.title : chunk.title,
  142:     showTitle:
  143:       committeeItemsTable && index > 0
  144:         ? false
  145:         : block.showTitle,
  146:     sourceBlockId,
  147:     rows: chunk.rows.map((row) =>
  148:       chunk.columns.map((column) => row.cells[column.key] || ""),
  149:     ),
  150:     rowMetadata: chunk.rows.map((row) => ({
  151:       gender: row.metadata?.gender || null,
  152:     })),
  153:   }));
  154: }

   19:   if (block.type === "NARRATIVE") return "وصف التنفيذ";

   37:   onEditTable,
   38: }: ReportBlockFrameProps) {
   39:   return (
   40:     <section
   41:       onClick={onSelect}
   42:       className={[
   43:         "group rounded-[1.25rem] border bg-white p-3 transition",
   44:         selected
   45:           ? "border-emerald-300 shadow-sm ring-2 ring-emerald-100"
   46:           : "border-slate-100 hover:border-emerald-200",
   47:       ].join(" ")}
   48:     >
   49:       <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 print:hidden">
   50:         <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
   51:           <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-800">
   52:             {getBlockLabel(block)}
   53:           </span>
   54: 
   55:           {block.locked ? (
   56:             <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500">
   57:               ثابت
   58:             </span>
   59:           ) : null}
   60:         </div>
   61: 
   62:         <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
   63:           {block.type === "TABLE" ? (
   64:             <button
   65:               type="button"
   66:               onClick={(event) => {
   67:                 event.stopPropagation();
   68:                 onEditTable?.();
   69:               }}
   70:               className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100"
   71:             >
   72:               تحرير الجدول
   73:             </button>
   74:           ) : null}
   75: 
   76:           <button
   77:             type="button"
   78:             onClick={(event) => {
   79:               event.stopPropagation();
   80:               onMovePrevious();
   81:             }}
   82:             className="rounded-full bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
   83:             title="تحريك للأعلى"
   84:           >
   85:             ↑
   86:           </button>
   87: 
   88:           <button
   89:             type="button"
   90:             onClick={(event) => {
   91:               event.stopPropagation();
   92:               onMoveNext();
   93:             }}
   94:             className="rounded-full bg-slate-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
   95:             title="تحريك للأسفل"
   96:           >
   97:             ↓
   98:           </button>
   99: 
  100:           {!block.locked ? (
  101:             <button
  102:               type="button"
  103:               onClick={(event) => {
  104:                 event.stopPropagation();
  105:                 onRemove();
  106:               }}
  107:               className="rounded-full bg-rose-50 px-2 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-100"
  108:               title="حذف"
  109:             >
  110:               حذف
  111:             </button>
  112:           ) : null}
  113:         </div>
  114:       </div>
  115: 
  116:       {children}
  117:     </section>
  118:   );
  119: }

   39: function renderFieldValue(value: unknown) {
   40:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "—";

   42:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   43:     return value.filter(Boolean).join("، ") || "—";
   44:   }
   45:

   69: function translateTechnicalValue(value: string) {
   70:   const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
   71: 
   72:   return ARABIC_VALUE_MAP[normalized] || ARABIC_VALUE_MAP[value] || value;
   73: }
   74: 
   75: function translateFieldLabel(key: string, label: string) {
   76:   if (label && label !== key && !/^[a-z0-9_]+$/i.test(label)) return label;
   77: 
   78:   return ARABIC_LABEL_MAP[key] || label || key;
   79: }
   80: 
   81: function renderValue(value: unknown) {
   82:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
   83: 
   84:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   85:     const items = Array.from(
   86:       new Set(
   87:         value
   88:           .map((item) => translateTechnicalValue(String(item)))
   89:           .map((item) => item.trim())
   90:           .filter(Boolean)
   91:       )
   92:     );
   93: 
   94:     if (!items.length) return "";
   95: 
   96:     return (
   97:       <ul className="mt-1 space-y-1.5 text-right text-sm font-black leading-7 text-slate-950" dir="rtl">
   98:         {items.map((item, index) => (
   99:           <li key={`${item}-${index}`} className="flex items-start justify-start gap-2">
  100:             <span className="mt-[0.75em] h-1.5 w-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-slate-500" />
  101:             <span>{item}</span>
  102:           </li>
  103:         ))}
  104:       </ul>
  105:     );
  106:   }
  107: 
  108:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
  109: 
  110:   return translateTechnicalValue(String(value));
  111: }

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
    4: import type { ReportTableBlock } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-types";

    6:   addReportTableColumn,

   13: 
   14: type ReportTableEditorModalProps = {
   15:   table: ReportTableBlock | null;
   16:   open: boolean;
   17:   onClose: () => void;
   18:   onSave: (table: ReportTableBlock) => void;
   19: };
   20: 
   21: export function ReportTableEditorModal({
   22:   table,
   23:   open,
   24:   onClose,
   25:   onSave,
   26: }: ReportTableEditorModalProps) {
   27:   const [draftTable, setDraftTable] = useState<ReportTableBlock | null>(table);
   28: 
   29:   useEffect(() => {
   30:     setDraftTable(table ? JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(table)) : null);
   31:   }, [table]);
   32: 
   33:   const filledCellsCount = useMemo(() => {
   34:     if (!draftTable) return 0;
   35: 
   36:     return draftTable.rows.reduce((total, row) => {
   37:       return (
   38:         total +
   39:         row.cells.filter((cell) => String(cell.value || "").trim().length > 0)
   40:           .length
   41:       );
   42:     }, 0);
   43:   }, [draftTable]);
   44: 
   45:   if (!open || !draftTable) return null;
   46: 
   47:   function updateTable(nextTable: ReportTableBlock) {
   48:     setDraftTable(nextTable);
   49:   }
   50: 
   51:   function updateSetting<K extends keyof ReportTableBlock["settings"]>(
   52:     key: K,
   53:     value: ReportTableBlock["settings"][K],
   54:   ) {
   55:     setDraftTable((currentTable) => {
   56:       if (!currentTable) return currentTable;
   57: 
   58:       return {
   59:         ...currentTable,
   60:         settings: {
   61:           ...currentTable.settings,
   62:           [key]: value,
   63:         },
   64:       };
   65:     });
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   return (
   69:     <div
   70:       className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/50 p-4 print:hidden"
   71:       role="dialog"
   72:       aria-modal="true"
   73:       dir="rtl"

  545: type LetterValues = ReturnType<typeof buildLetterValues>;
  546: 
  547: function buildLetterValues(data: RuntimePreviewCaseData) {
  548:   const studentClass =
  549:     cleanValue(getValue(data, ["studentClass", "student_class"])) ||
  550:     [data.student?.grade, data.student?.classroom].filter(Boolean).join(" / ") ||
  551:     "........................";
  552: 
  553:   const counselorTitleRaw = cleanValue(
  554:     getValue(data, ["counselorTitle", "guideTitle", "advisorTitle"])
  555:   );
  556: 
  557:   const schoolLeaderTitleRaw = cleanValue(
  558:     getValue(data, [
  559:       "schoolLeaderTitle",
  560:       "principalTitle",
  561:       "leaderTitle",
  562:       "schoolPrincipalTitle",
  563:     ])
  564:   );
  565: 
  566:   const counselorGender = cleanValue(
  567:     getValue(data, [
  568:       "counselorGender",
  569:       "guideGender",
  570:       "advisorGender",
  571:       "studentGuideGender",
  572:       "mentorGender",

  739: function getValue(data: RuntimePreviewCaseData, keys: string[]) {
  740:   const values = Array.isArray(data.values)
  741:     ? (data.values as PreviewValue[])
  742:     : [];
  743: 
  744:   for (const key of keys) {
  745:     const item = values.find((value) => value.fieldKey === key);
  746: 
  747:     if (
  748:       item?.value !== undefined &&
  749:       item.value !== null &&
  750:       String(item.value).trim()
  751:     ) {
  752:       return String(item.value).trim();
  753:     }
  754:   }
  755: 
  756:   return "";
  757: }

  759: function cleanValue(value: unknown) {
  760:   if (value === undefined || value === null) return "";
  761: 
  762:   const cleaned = String(value).trim();
  763: 
  764:   if (!cleaned || cleaned === "null" || cleaned === "undefined") return "";
  765: 
  766:   return cleaned;
  767: }

  769: function formatSchoolName(value: string) {

  773:

  777: function formatEducationDepartment(value: string) {

  781:     value.startsWith("الإدارة") ||

  784:   ) {

  786:   }
  787: 
  788:   return `الإدارة العامة للتعليم بمنطقة ${value}`;
  789: }
  790: 
  791: function formatEducationOffice(value: string) {

  793:

  795: 
  796:   if (value.startsWith("ب")) return `مكتب التعليم ${value}`;
  797: 
  798:   return `مكتب التعليم ب${value}`;
  799: }

  801: function formatDisplayDate(value: string) {
  802:   const cleaned = cleanValue(value);
  803: 
  804:   if (!cleaned) return "........................";
  805: 
  806:   if (/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(cleaned)) {
  807:     return cleaned.replaceAll("-", "/");
  808:   }
  809: 
  810:   return cleaned.replace(/\s+/g, " ");
  811: }

  813: function normalizePeriod(value: string) {
  814:   const cleaned = cleanValue(value);
  815: 
  816:   if (!cleaned) return "صباحًا";
  817:

  827:     .split(/،|,|\n|;/g)
  828:     .map((item) => item.trim())
  829:     .filter(Boolean);

  834: function resolveCounselorTitle(title: string, gender: string) {
  835:   const cleanedTitle = cleanValue(title);
  836: 
  837:   if (
  838:     cleanedTitle &&
  839:     cleanedTitle !== "الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية" &&
  840:     cleanedTitle !== "الموجه / الموجهة الطلابية"
  841:   ) {
  842:     return cleanedTitle;
  843:   }
  844: 
  845:   const normalizedGender = normalizeGender(`${gender} ${cleanedTitle}`);
  846: 
  847:   if (normalizedGender === "FEMALE") return "الموجهة الطلابية";
  848: 
  849:   if (normalizedGender === "MALE") return "الموجه الطلابي";
  850: 
  851:   return "الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية";
  852: }
  853: 
  854: function resolveSchoolLeaderTitle(title: string, gender: string) {
  855:   const cleanedTitle = cleanValue(title);
  856: 
  857:   if (
  858:     cleanedTitle &&
  859:     cleanedTitle !== "قائد/قائدة المدرسة" &&
  860:     cleanedTitle !== "قائد / قائدة المدرسة"
  861:   ) {
  862:     return cleanedTitle;
  863:   }
  864: 
  865:   const normalizedGender = normalizeGender(`${gender} ${cleanedTitle}`);
  866: 
  867:   if (normalizedGender === "FEMALE") return "قائدة المدرسة";
  868: 
  869:   if (normalizedGender === "MALE") return "قائد المدرسة";
  870: 
  871:   return "قائد/قائدة المدرسة";
  872: }
  873: 
  874: function normalizeGender(value: string) {
  875:   const cleaned = cleanValue(value).toLowerCase();
  876: 
  877:   if (
  878:     cleaned.includes("female") ||
  879:     cleaned.includes("woman") ||
  880:     cleaned.includes("أنثى") ||
  881:     cleaned.includes("انثى") ||
  882:     cleaned.includes("female") ||
  883:     cleaned.includes("موجهة") ||
  884:     cleaned.includes("مرشدة") ||
  885:     cleaned.includes("قائدة")
  886:   ) {
  887:     return "FEMALE";
  888:   }
  889: 
  890:   if (
  891:     cleaned.includes("male") ||
  892:     cleaned.includes("man") ||
  893:     cleaned.includes("ذكر") ||
  894:     cleaned.includes("موجه") ||
  895:     cleaned.includes("مرشد") ||
  896:     cleaned.includes("قائد")
  897:   ) {
  898:     return "MALE";
  899:   }
  900: 
  901:   return "UNKNOWN";
  902: }

  904: function normalizeTemplateInfo(template: unknown): TemplateInfo {
  905:   if (!template || typeof template !== "object") {
  906:     return {
  907:       name: guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.name,
  908:       description: guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.description,
  909:       sourceLabel: "قالب رسمي",
  910:     };
  911:   }
  912: 
  913:   const item = template as {
  914:     name?: unknown;
  915:     description?: unknown;
  916:     status?: unknown;
  917:   };
  918: 
  919:   return {
  920:     name:
  921:       typeof item.name === "string" && item.name.trim()
  922:         ? item.name
  923:         : guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.name,
  924: 
  925:     description:
  926:       typeof item.description === "string" && item.description.trim()
  927:         ? item.description
  928:         : guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.description,
  929: 
  930:     sourceLabel: item.status === "PUBLISHED" ? "قالب منشور" : "قالب رسمي",
  931:   };
  932: }

   53: export function ReportBuilderPdfRenderer({
   54:   template,
   55:   previewCaseData,
   56:   identity,
   57:   editorialBlocks = {},
   58:   evidenceLayoutMode = "two-per-page",
   59: }: ReportBuilderPdfRendererProps) {
   60:   const basePages: RenderReportPage[] = template.pages.length
   61:     ? (template.pages as RenderReportPage[])
   62:     : [
   63:         {
   64:           id: "fallback-cover",
   65:           title: "غلاف التقارير",
   66:           description: "",
   67:           kind: "cover",
   68:           blocks: [],
   69:         } as RenderReportPage,
   70:       ];
   71: 
   72:   const allEvidences = getRuntimeEvidences(previewCaseData);
   73: 
   74:   const pages: RenderReportPage[] = basePages.flatMap((page) => {
   75:     if (page.kind !== "evidence") {
   76:       return [page];
   77:     }
   78: 
   79:     const chunks = chunkEvidencesForLayout(allEvidences, evidenceLayoutMode);
   80: 
   81:     if (!chunks.length) {
   82:       return [];
   83:     }
   84: 
   85:     return chunks.map((chunk, index) => ({
   86:       ...page,
   87:       id: `${page.id}-evidence-${index + 1}`,
   88:       title:
   89:         chunks.length > 1
   90:           ? `${page.title || "الشواهد والمرفقات"} - صفحة ${index + 1}`
   91:           : page.title,
   92:       evidenceChunk: chunk,
   93:       evidencePageNumber: index + 1,
   94:       evidenceTotalPages: chunks.length,
   95:     }));
   96:   });
   97: 
   98:   return (
   99:     <section className="space-y-4 bg-transparent print:space-y-0" dir="rtl">
  100:       {pages.map((page, index) => {
  101:         const pageStyle: CSSProperties = {
  102:           width: "210mm",
  103:           height: "297mm",
  104:           minHeight: "297mm",
  105:           maxHeight: "297mm",
  106:           overflow: "hidden",
  107:           breakAfter: index < pages.length - 1 ? "page" : "auto",
  108:           pageBreakAfter: index < pages.length - 1 ? "always" : "auto",
  109:           breakInside: "avoid",
  110:           pageBreakInside: "avoid",
  111:         };
  112: 
  113:         return (
  114:           <article
  115:             key={page.id}
  116:             className="pdf-report-page mx-auto rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-950 shadow-sm print:rounded-none print:border-0 print:shadow-none"
  117:             style={pageStyle}
  118:           >
  119:             {page.kind === "cover" ? (
  120:               <OfficialCoverPage
  121:                 template={template}
  122:                 identity={identity}
  123:                 previewCaseData={previewCaseData}
  124:               />
  125:             ) : page.kind === "evidence" ? (
  126:               <OfficialEvidencePage
  127:                 pageTitle={page.title}
  128:                 evidences={page.evidenceChunk || []}
  129:                 evidenceLayoutMode={evidenceLayoutMode}
  130:                 pageNumber={page.evidencePageNumber || 1}
  131:                 totalPages={page.evidenceTotalPages || 1}
  132:               />
  133:             ) : page.kind === "approval" ? (
  134:               <OfficialApprovalPage identity={identity} />
  135:             ) : (
  136:               <OfficialContentPage
  137:                 pageTitle={page.title}
  138:                 blocks={page.blocks}
  139:                 template={template}
  140:                 previewCaseData={previewCaseData}
  141:                 editorialBlocks={editorialBlocks}
  142:               />
  143:             )}
  144:           </article>
  145:         );
  146:       })}
  147:     </section>
  148:   );

  234: function OfficialContentPage({
