  293: 
  294: function getEditorialSectionsForPage(
  295:   pageTitle: string,
  296:   editorialBlocks: Record<string, string>
  297: ) {
  298:   const normalizedTitle = pageTitle || "";
  299: 
  300:   const sections: Array<{
  301:     key: string;
  302:     title: string;
  303:     content: string;
  304:   }> = [];
  305: 
  306:   function add(key: string, title: string) {
  307:     const content = editorialBlocks[key]?.trim();
  308: 
  309:     if (content) {
  310:       sections.push({
  311:         key,
  312:         title,
  313:         content,
  314:       });
  315:     }
  316:   }
  317: 
  318:   if (
  319:     normalizedTitle.includes("ملخص") ||
  320:     normalizedTitle.includes("محتوى") ||
  321:     normalizedTitle.includes("تقرير")
  322:   ) {
  323:     add("intro", "مقدمة التقارير");
  324:     add("goals", "الأهداف");

  443: function OfficialEvidencePage({
  444:   pageTitle,

  588: function chunkEvidencesForLayout(
  589:   evidences: RuntimeEvidenceItem[],
  590:   evidenceLayoutMode: EvidenceLayoutMode
  591: ) {
  592:   const perPage = getEvidenceItemsPerPage(evidenceLayoutMode, evidences.length);
  593:   const chunks: RuntimeEvidenceItem[][] = [];
  594: 
  595:   for (let index = 0; index < evidences.length; index += perPage) {
  596:     chunks.push(evidences.slice(index, index + perPage));
  597:   }
  598: 
  599:   return chunks;
  600: }
  601: 
  602: function getEvidenceItemsPerPage(
  603:   evidenceLayoutMode: EvidenceLayoutMode,
  604:   total: number
  605: ) {
  606:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "one-per-page") return 1;
  607:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "two-per-page") return 2;
  608:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "grid-2x2") return 4;
  609:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "compact") return 6;
  610: 
  611:   if (total <= 1) return 1;
  612:   if (total <= 2) return 2;
  613:   if (total <= 4) return 4;
  614: 
  615:   return 4;
  616: }
  617: 
  618: function getEvidenceLayoutClasses(evidenceLayoutMode: EvidenceLayoutMode) {
  619:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "one-per-page") {
  620:     return {
  621:       gridClassName: "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4",
  622:       imageBoxClassName: "flex h-[170mm] items-center justify-center bg-slate-100",
  623:     };
  624:   }
  625: 
  626:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "two-per-page") {
  627:     return {
  628:       gridClassName: "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4",
  629:       imageBoxClassName: "flex h-[74mm] items-center justify-center bg-slate-100",
  630:     };
  631:   }
  632: 
  633:   if (evidenceLayoutMode === "compact") {
  634:     return {
  635:       gridClassName: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-3",
  636:       imageBoxClassName: "flex h-[42mm] items-center justify-center bg-slate-100",
  637:     };
  638:   }
  639: 
  640:   return {
  641:     gridClassName: "grid grid-cols-2 gap-4",
  642:     imageBoxClassName: "flex h-[58mm] items-center justify-center bg-slate-100",
  643:   };
  644: }
  645: 
  646: function getRuntimeValues(
  647:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null
  648: ): RuntimeValueItem[] {
  649:   const data = previewCaseData as { values?: RuntimeValueItem[] } | null;
  650:   return Array.isArray(data?.values) ? data.values : [];
  651: }
  652: 
  653: function getRuntimeEvidences(
  654:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null
  655: ): RuntimeEvidenceItem[] {
  656:   const data = previewCaseData as { evidences?: RuntimeEvidenceItem[] } | null;
  657:   return filterValidReportEvidenceItems(data?.evidences || [], {
  658:     allowSampleEvidence: !previewCaseData?.caseId,
  659:   });
  660: }
  661: 
  662: function getStudent(previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null) {
  663:   const data = previewCaseData as
  664:     | {
  665:         student?: {
  666:           fullName?: string | null;
  667:           nationalId?: string | null;
  668:           stage?: string | null;
  669:           grade?: string | null;
  670:           classroom?: string | null;
  671:           guardianName?: string | null;
  672:           guardianPhone?: string | null;
  673:         } | null;
  674:       }
  675:     | null;
  676: 
  677:   return {
  678:     fullName: data?.student?.fullName || "",
  679:     nationalId: data?.student?.nationalId || "",
  680:     stage: data?.student?.stage || "",
  681:     grade: data?.student?.grade || "",
  682:     classroom: data?.student?.classroom || "",
  683:     guardianName: data?.student?.guardianName || "",
  684:     guardianPhone: data?.student?.guardianPhone || "",
  685:   };
  686: }
  687: 
  688: function getCaseTitle(previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null) {
  689:   const data = previewCaseData as { title?: string | null } | null;
  690:   return data?.title || "تقرير إرشادي";
  691: }
  692: 
  693: function getServiceName(
  694:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel,
  695:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null
  696: ) {
  697:   const data = previewCaseData as { serviceName?: string | null } | null;
  698: 
  699:   if (data?.serviceName) {
  700:     return data.serviceName;
  701:   }
  702: 
  703:   if (template.scope === "SERVICE" && template.serviceSlug) {
  704:     return template.serviceSlug;
  705:   }
  706: 
  707:   return "الخدمة الإرشادية";
  708: }
  709: 
  710: function isImageEvidence(evidence: RuntimeEvidenceItem) {
  711:   if (evidence.mimeType?.startsWith("image/")) {
  712:     return true;
  713:   }
  714: 
  715:   const fileName = evidence.fileName || evidence.fileUrl || evidence.imageUrl || "";
  716:   return /\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif)$/i.test(fileName);
  717: }

  216:                   ? `الشواهد والمرفقات (${pageIndex + 1})`
  217:                   : "الشواهد والمرفقات"
  218:               }
  219:             />
  220: 
  221:             <EvidenceGrid
  222:               evidences={evidences}
  223:               layout={normalizedEvidenceLayout}
  224:               showCaption
  225:               mode="official"
  226:             />
  227:           </div>
  228: 
  229:           <ReportFooter identity={identity} />
  230:         </A4Page>
  231:       ))}
  232: 
  233:       <A4Page variant="approval">
  234:         <OfficialHeader identity={identity} compact />
  235: 
  236:         <div className="page-body approval-body">
  237:           <SectionTitle title="الاعتماد والتوقيع" />
  238: 
  239:           <div className="approval-intro">
  240:             <h2>اعتماد التقارير</h2>
  241:             <p>
  242:               تم إعداد هذا التقارير بناءً على البيانات والشواهد الموثقة في
  243:               المنصة، ويعد مرجعًا رسميًا لتنفيذ البرنامج/الخدمة.
  244:             </p>
  245:           </div>
  246: 
  247:           <ApprovalBlock report={report} />
  248:         </div>
  249: 
  250:         <ReportFooter identity={identity} />
  251:       </A4Page>
  252:     </main>
  253:   );
  254: }
  255: 
  256: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  257: /* Visual Activity Report                                                      */
  258: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  259: 
  260: function VisualActivityReport({
  261:   identity,
  262:   report,
  263:   evidenceLayout,
  264: }: {
  265:   identity: ReportIdentity;
  266:   report: OfficialReportData;
  267:   evidenceLayout: EvidenceLayout;
  268: }) {
  269:   const normalizedEvidenceLayout = getNormalizedEvidenceLayout(evidenceLayout);
  270:   const evidencePages = chunkArray(
  271:     report.evidences,
  272:     getEvidenceItemsPerPage(normalizedEvidenceLayout)
  273:   );
  274: 
  275:   const firstEvidencePage = evidencePages[0] || [];
  276:   const remainingEvidencePages = evidencePages.slice(1);
  277: 
  278:   return (
  279:     <main dir="rtl" className="report-root visual-root">
  280:       <ReportStyles />
  281: 
  282:       <A4Page variant="visual">
  283:         <div className="visual-topbar">
  284:           <span>{report.category || report.serviceName}</span>
  285:           <b>//</b>
  286:           <span>{report.reportDate}</span>
  287:         </div>
  288: 
  289:         <div className="visual-title-area">
  290:           <div className="visual-title-mark" />
  291: 
  292:           <div>
  293:             <h1>{report.category || report.serviceName}</h1>
  294:             <h2>{report.cover.programTitle}</h2>
  295:           </div>
  296:         </div>
  297: 
  298:         <p className="visual-description">
  299:           {report.cover.shortDescription ||
  300:             report.sections[0]?.content ||
  301:             report.subtitle}
  302:         </p>
  303: 
  304:         <EvidenceGrid
  305:           evidences={firstEvidencePage}
  306:           layout={normalizedEvidenceLayout}
  307:           showCaption={false}
  308:           mode="visual"
  309:         />
  310: 
  311:         <div className="visual-footer-shape" />
  312: 
  313:         <div className="visual-footer-info">
  314:           <span>{identity.schoolName}</span>
  315:           <span>{identity.counselorName}</span>
  316:         </div>
  317:       </A4Page>
  318: 
  319:       {remainingEvidencePages.map((evidences, pageIndex) => (
  320:         <A4Page key={`visual-evidence-${pageIndex}`} variant="visual">
  321:           <div className="visual-topbar">
  322:             <span>الشواهد والمرفقات</span>
  323:             <b>//</b>
  324:             <span>{pageIndex + 2}</span>
  325:           </div>
  326: 
  327:           <div className="visual-title-area smaller">
  328:             <div className="visual-title-mark" />
  329: 
  330:             <div>
  331:               <h1>الشواهد</h1>
  332:               <h2>{report.cover.programTitle}</h2>
  333:             </div>
  334:           </div>
  335: 
  336:           <EvidenceGrid
  337:             evidences={evidences}
  338:             layout={normalizedEvidenceLayout}
  339:             showCaption={false}
  340:             mode="visual"
  341:           />
  342: 
  343:           <div className="visual-footer-shape" />
  344: 
  345:           <div className="visual-footer-info">
  346:             <span>{identity.schoolName}</span>
  347:             <span>{identity.counselorName}</span>
  348:           </div>
  349:         </A4Page>
  350:       ))}
  351:     </main>
  352:   );
  353: }

  355: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  356: /* Executive Brief Report                                                      */

  358: 
  359: function ExecutiveBriefReport({
  360:   identity,
  361:   report,
  362:   showCover,
  363:   evidenceLayout,
  364: }: {
  365:   identity: ReportIdentity;
  366:   report: OfficialReportData;
  367:   showCover: boolean;
  368:   evidenceLayout: EvidenceLayout;
  369: }) {
  370:   const normalizedEvidenceLayout = getNormalizedEvidenceLayout(evidenceLayout);
  371:   const selectedEvidence = report.evidences.slice(0, 2);
  372: 
  373:   return (
  374:     <main dir="rtl" className="report-root executive-root">
  375:       <ReportStyles />
  376: 
  377:       {showCover ? (
  378:         <A4Page variant="executive-cover">
  379:           <OfficialHeader identity={identity} compact />
  380: 
  381:           <div className="page-body executive-cover-body">
  382:             <span>{report.serviceName}</span>
  383:             <h1>{report.title}</h1>
  384: 
  385:             {report.subtitle ? <p>{report.subtitle}</p> : null}
  386:           </div>
  387: 
  388:           <ReportFooter identity={identity} />
  389:         </A4Page>
  390:       ) : null}
  391: 
  392:       <A4Page>
  393:         <OfficialHeader identity={identity} compact />
  394: 
  395:         <div className="page-body">
  396:           <div className="executive-summary-card">
  397:             <h2>{report.cover.programTitle}</h2>
  398:             <p>
  399:               {report.cover.shortDescription ||
  400:                 report.sections[0]?.content ||
  401:                 "ملخص مختصر للتقرير."}
  402:             </p>
  403:           </div>
  404: 
  405:           <div className="report-executive-layout">
  406:             <InfoRow label="التاريخ" value={report.reportDate} />
  407:             <InfoRow
  408:               label="الفئة المستهدفة"
  409:               value={report.targetGroup || "غير محدد"}
  410:             />
  411:             <InfoRow label="الموجه/الموجهة" value={identity.counselorName} />
  412:             <InfoRow label="المدرسة" value={identity.schoolName} />
  413:           </div>
  414: 
  415:           {report.sections.slice(0, 2).map((section) => (
  416:             <ReportSectionBlock key={section.id} section={section} />
  417:           ))}
  418: 
  419:           <SectionTitle title="شواهد مختارة" />
  420: 
  421:           <EvidenceGrid
  422:             evidences={selectedEvidence}
  423:             layout={normalizedEvidenceLayout}
  424:             showCaption
  425:             mode="official"
  426:           />
  427:         </div>
  428: 
  429:         <ReportFooter identity={identity} />
  430:       </A4Page>
  431:     </main>
  432:   );
  433: }

  435: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  436: /* Shared Components                                                           */
  437: /* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
  438: 
  439: function A4Page({
  440:   children,
  441:   variant,
  442: }: {
  443:   children: React.ReactNode;
  444:   variant?: "cover" | "visual" | "approval" | "executive-cover";
  445: }) {
  446:   return (
  447:     <section
  448:       className={
  449:         variant ? `a4-page a4-page-${variant}` : "a4-page"
  450:       }
  451:     >
  452:       {children}
  453:     </section>
  454:   );
  455: }
  456: 
  457: function OfficialHeader({
  458:   identity,
  459:   compact = false,
  460: }: {
  461:   identity: ReportIdentity;
  462:   compact?: boolean;
  463: }) {
  464:   return (
  465:     <header className={compact ? "official-header compact" : "official-header"}>
  466:       <div className="header-accent" />
  467: 
  468:       <div className="header-main">
  469:         <LogoBox src={identity.schoolLogoUrl} label="شعار المدرسة" />
  470: 
  471:         <div className="header-text">
  472:           <strong>{identity.ministryName}</strong>
  473:           <span>{identity.educationDepartment}</span>
  474:           <span>{identity.educationOffice}</span>
  475:           <b>{identity.schoolName}</b>
  476:         </div>
  477: 
  478:         <LogoBox src={identity.ministryLogoUrl} label="شعار وزارة التعليم" />
  479:       </div>
  480:     </header>
  481:   );
  482: }
  483: 
  484: function LogoBox({
  485:   src,
  486:   label,
  487: }: {
  488:   src?: string;
  489:   label: string;
  490: }) {
  491:   return (
  492:     <div className="logo-box">
  493:       {src ? <img src={src} alt={label} /> : <span>{label}</span>}
  494:     </div>
  495:   );
  496: }
  497: 
  498: function ReportFooter({ identity }: { identity: ReportIdentity }) {
  499:   return (
  500:     <footer className="report-footer">
  501:       <div className="footer-line" />
  502: 
  503:       <div className="footer-content">
  504:         <span>{identity.schoolName}</span>
  505:         <span>
  506:           {identity.academicYear} - {identity.semester}
  507:         </span>
  508:         <span>صفحة</span>
  509:       </div>
  510:     </footer>
  511:   );
  512: }
  513: 
  514: function SectionTitle({ title }: { title: string }) {
  515:   return (
  516:     <div className="section-title">
  517:       <span />
  518:       <h3>{title}</h3>
  519:     </div>
  520:   );
  521: }
  522: 
  523: function InfoRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  524:   return (
  525:     <div className="info-row">
  526:       <span>{label}</span>
  527:       <strong>{value}</strong>
  528:     </div>
  529:   );
  530: }
  531: 
  532: function ReportSectionBlock({ section }: { section: ReportSection }) {
  533:   return (
  534:     <section className="report-section">
  535:       <SectionTitle title={section.title} />
  536: 
  537:       {section.content ? (
  538:         <p className="section-text">{section.content}</p>
  539:       ) : null}
  540: 
  541:       {section.items?.length ? (
  542:         <div className="section-items">
  543:           {section.items.map((item, index) => (
  544:             <InfoRow
  545:               key={`${item.label}-${index}`}
  546:               label={item.label}
  547:               value={item.value}
  548:             />
  549:           ))}
  550:         </div>
  551:       ) : null}
  552:     </section>
  553:   );
  554: }
  555: 
  556: function EvidenceGrid({
  557:   evidences,
  558:   layout,
  559:   showCaption,
  560:   mode,
  561: }: {
  562:   evidences: ReportEvidence[];
  563:   layout: EvidenceLayout;
  564:   showCaption: boolean;
  565:   mode: "official" | "visual";
  566: }) {
  567:   if (!evidences.length) {
  568:     return null;
  569:   }
  570: 
  571:   const normalizedLayout = getNormalizedEvidenceLayout(layout);
  572: 
  573:   return (
  574:     <div
  575:       className={`evidence-grid evidence-${normalizedLayout} evidence-mode-${mode}`}
  576:     >
  577:       {evidences.map((evidence) => (
  578:         <article key={evidence.id} className="evidence-card">
  579:           <div className="evidence-frame">
  580:             {evidence.imageUrl ? (
  581:               <img src={evidence.imageUrl} alt={evidence.title || "شاهد"} />
  582:             ) : (
  583:               <div className="evidence-placeholder">
  584:                 {evidence.fileName || "مرفق"}
  585:               </div>
  586:             )}
  587:           </div>
  588: 
  589:           {showCaption && (evidence.title || evidence.description) ? (
  590:             <div className="evidence-caption">
  591:               {evidence.title ? <strong>{evidence.title}</strong> : null}
  592:               {evidence.description ? <p>{evidence.description}</p> : null}
  593:             </div>
  594:           ) : null}
  595:         </article>
  596:       ))}
  597:     </div>
  598:   );
  599: }
  600: 
  601: function ApprovalBlock({ report }: { report: OfficialReportData }) {
  602:   return (
  603:     <section className="approval-block">
  604:       <div>
  605:         <span>الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية</span>
  606:         <strong>{report.approval.counselorName}</strong>
  607:         <em>التوقيع: ....................</em>
  608:       </div>
  609: 
  610:       <div>
  611:         <span>قائد/قائدة المدرسة</span>
  612:         <strong>{report.approval.principalName || "...................."}</strong>
  613:         <em>الختم: ....................</em>
  614:       </div>
  615: 
  616:       <div>
  617:         <span>التاريخ</span>
  618:         <strong>{report.approval.date}</strong>
  619:       </div>
  620:     </section>
  621:   );
  622: }

  131: function hasArabicText(value: string) {
  132:   return /[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(value);
  133: }
  134: 
  135: function isEnglishTechnicalText(value: string) {
  136:   return /^[a-z0-9_\-.@:/]+$/i.test(value.trim());

  139: function isTechnicalKey(key: string) {
  140:   const normalizedKey = String(key || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase();
  141: 
  142:   if (
  143:     normalizedKey === "studentsnapshot" ||
  144:     normalizedKey === "selectedstudent" ||
  145:     normalizedKey === "student" ||
  146:     normalizedKey === "student_name" ||
  147:     normalizedKey === "guardiansnapshot"

  149:     return false;
  150:   }
  151: 
  152:   return TECHNICAL_FIELD_PATTERNS.some((pattern) => pattern.test(normalizedKey));
  153: }

  155: function looksLikeJson(value: string) {
  156:   const text = value.trim();
  157: 
  158:   return (
  159:     (text.startsWith("{") && text.endsWith("}")) ||
  160:     (text.startsWith("[") && text.endsWith("]")) ||
  161:     text.includes('":') ||
  162:     text.includes('","')
  163:   );
  164: }

  166: function normalizePrimitive(value: unknown) {
  167:   return String(value ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  168: }
  169: 
  170: function getOptionLabel(options: FieldOptionLike[] | undefined, value: unknown) {
  171:   if (!options || options.length === 0) return "";
  172: 
  173:   const normalizedValue = normalizePrimitive(value);
  174: 
  175:   const matchedOption = options.find((option) => {
  176:     const possibleValues = [option.value, option.key, option.id, option.label];
  177: 
  178:     return possibleValues.some(
  179:       (item) => normalizePrimitive(item) === normalizedValue,
  180:     );
  181:   });
  182: 
  183:   if (!matchedOption) return "";
  184: 
  185:   const label =
  186:     matchedOption.label ||
  187:     matchedOption.name ||
  188:     matchedOption.text ||
  189:     matchedOption.title;
  190: 
  191:   const labelText = typeof label === "string" ? label.trim() : "";
  192: 
  193:   return hasArabicText(labelText) ? labelText : "";
  194: }

  196: function extractArabicNameFromSnapshot(value: unknown): string {
  197:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
  198: 
  199:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  200:     const text = value.trim();
  201: 
  202:     if (looksLikeJson(text)) {
  203:       try {
  204:         return extractArabicNameFromSnapshot(JSON.parse(text));
  205:       } catch {
  206:         return "";
  207:       }
  208:     }
  209: 
  210:     return hasArabicText(text) ? text : "";
  211:   }
  212: 
  213:   if (typeof value !== "object") return "";
  214: 
  215:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  216: 
  217:   const directName =
  218:     record.fullName ||
  219:     record.studentName ||
  220:     record.guardianName ||
  221:     record.guardianFullName ||
  222:     record.parentName ||
  223:     record.fatherName ||
  224:     record.name ||
  225:     record.arabicName ||
  226:     record.nameAr;
  227: 
  228:   if (typeof directName === "string" && directName.trim()) {
  229:     return hasArabicText(directName) ? directName.trim() : "";
  230:   }
  231:

  233: }

  235: function extractObjectArabicValue(value: Record<string, unknown>) {
  236:   const preferredValues = [
  237:     value.arabicName,
  238:     value.arabicLabel,
  239:     value.labelAr,
  240:     value.nameAr,
  241:     value.fullName,
  242:     value.name,
  243:     value.studentName,
  244:     value.grade,
  245:     value.stage,
  246:     value.className,
  247:   ]
  248:     .map((item) => extractDisplayValue(item))
  249:     .filter(Boolean);
  250: 
  251:   return Array.from(new Set(preferredValues)).join("، ");
  252: }
  253: 
  254: function extractDisplayValue(value: unknown): string {
  255:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
  256: 
  257:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
  258: 
  259:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  260:     return value.map(extractDisplayValue).filter(Boolean).join("، ");
  261:   }
  262: 
  263:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  264:     return extractObjectArabicValue(value as Record<string, unknown>);
  265:   }
  266: 
  267:   const text = String(value).trim();
  268:   const normalized = text.toLowerCase();
  269: 
  270:   if (VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[normalized]) return VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[normalized];
  271: 
  272:   if (looksLikeJson(text)) {
  273:     try {
  274:       return extractDisplayValue(JSON.parse(text));
  275:     } catch {
  276:       return "";
  277:     }
  278:   }
  279: 
  280:   if (isEnglishTechnicalText(text)) return "";
  281: 
  282:   return hasArabicText(text) ? text : "";
  283: }

  285: function getFieldLabel(field: SmartReportField) {

  289:   if (
  290:     normalizedKey === "studentsnapshot" ||

  292:     normalizedKey === "student" ||
  293:     normalizedKey === "student_name"

  295:     return "اسم الطالب";

  299:     return "اسم ولي الأمر";

  309: 
  310:   return "";

  320:     normalizedKey === "student" ||
  321:     normalizedKey === "student_name" ||
  322:     normalizedKey === "guardiansnapshot"
  323:   ) {
  324:     return extractArabicNameFromSnapshot(field.value);
  325:   }
  326: 
  327:   const directDisplay =
  328:     fieldWithMeta.valueLabel ||
  329:     fieldWithMeta.displayValue ||
  330:     fieldWithMeta.selectedLabel ||
  331:     fieldWithMeta.arabicValue;
  332: 
  333:   const directDisplayText = extractDisplayValue(directDisplay);
  334: 
  335:   if (directDisplayText) return directDisplayText;
  336: 
  337:   const options =
  338:     fieldWithMeta.options ||
  339:     fieldWithMeta.fieldOptions ||
  340:     fieldWithMeta.choices ||
  341:     [];
  342: 
  343:   if (Array.isArray(field.value)) {
  344:     const values = field.value
  345:       .map((item) => getOptionLabel(options, item) || extractDisplayValue(item))
  346:       .filter(Boolean);
  347: 
  348:     return Array.from(new Set(values)).join("، ");
  349:   }
  350: 
  351:   const optionLabel = getOptionLabel(options, field.value);
  352: 
  353:   if (optionLabel) return optionLabel;
  354: 
  355:   return extractDisplayValue(field.value);
  356: }
  357: 
  358: function createInitialFields(payload: SmartReportPayload): SelectedReportField[] {
  359:   const primary = payload.primaryFields.map((field, index) => ({
  360:     id: `primary:${field.key}:${index}`,
  361:     source: "primary" as const,
  362:     key: field.key,
  363:     label: getFieldLabel(field),
  364:     value: getFieldArabicValue(field),
  365:   }));
  366: 
  367:   const detail = payload.detailFields.map((field, index) => ({
  368:     id: `detail:${field.key}:${index}`,
  369:     source: "detail" as const,
  370:     key: field.key,
  371:     label: getFieldLabel(field),
  372:     value: getFieldArabicValue(field),
  373:   }));
  374: 
  375:   const uniqueFields = new Map<string, SelectedReportField>();
  376: 
  377:   for (const field of [...primary, ...detail]) {
  378:     const label = String(field.label || "").trim();
  379:     const value = String(field.value || "").trim();
  380: 
  381:     if (!label || !value) continue;
  382:     if (isTechnicalKey(field.key)) continue;
  383: 
  384:     const uniqueKey = `${label}::${value}`;
  385: 
  386:     if (!uniqueFields.has(uniqueKey)) {
  387:       uniqueFields.set(uniqueKey, field);
  388:     }
  389:   }
  390: 
  391:   return Array.from(uniqueFields.values());
  392: }
  393: 
  394: export function ReportFieldSelectionGate({
  395:   payload,
  396:   onContinue,
  397: }: ReportFieldSelectionGateProps) {
  398:   const initialFields = useMemo(() => createInitialFields(payload), [payload]);
  399: 
  400:   const [fields, setFields] = useState<SelectedReportField[]>(initialFields);
  401:   const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(
  402:     () => new Set(initialFields.map((field) => field.id)),
  403:   );
  404: 
  405:   const selectedCount = selectedIds.size;
  406: 
  407:   function toggleField(fieldId: string) {
  408:     setSelectedIds((current) => {
  409:       const next = new Set(current);
  410: 
  411:       if (next.has(fieldId)) {
  412:         next.delete(fieldId);
  413:       } else {
  414:         next.add(fieldId);
  415:       }
  416: 
  417:       return next;
  418:     });
  419:   }
  420: 
  421:   function updateField(
  422:     fieldId: string,
  423:     patch: Partial<Pick<SelectedReportField, "label" | "value">>,
  424:   ) {
  425:     setFields((current) =>
  426:       current.map((field) =>
  427:         field.id === fieldId
  428:           ? {
  429:               ...field,
  430:               ...patch,
  431:             }
  432:           : field,
  433:       ),
  434:     );
  435:   }
  436: 
  437:   function continueToReport() {
  438:     const selectedFields = fields
  439:       .filter((field) => selectedIds.has(field.id))
  440:       .filter((field) => String(field.value || "").trim().length > 0)
  441:       .filter((field) => String(field.label || "").trim().length > 0);
  442: 
  443:     onContinue(selectedFields);
  444:   }
  445: 
  446:   return (
  447:     <main className="min-h-screen bg-[#eef3ef] px-6 py-8" dir="rtl">
  448:       <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl">
  449:         <section className="rounded-[2rem] border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm">
  450:           <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
  451:             <div>
  452:               <p className="text-sm font-black text-emerald-700">
  453:                 اختيار بيانات التقرير
  454:               </p>
  455:               <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
  456:                 اختر الحقول التي تريد ظهورها داخل التقرير
  457:               </h1>
  458:               <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-bold leading-7 text-slate-500">
  459:                 لا يتم عرض أي قيمة تقنية أو إنجليزية من Workflow؛ تظهر فقط
  460:                 العناوين والقيم العربية.
  461:               </p>
  462:             </div>
  463: 
  464:             <button
  465:               type="button"
  466:               onClick={continueToReport}
  467:               disabled={selectedCount === 0}
  468:               className="rounded-2xl bg-emerald-700 px-6 py-3 text-sm font-black text-white transition hover:bg-emerald-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
  469:             >
  470:               متابعة إلى محرر التقرير
  471:             </button>
  472:           </div>
  473: 
  474:           <div className="mt-6 rounded-[1.5rem] border border-slate-100 bg-slate-50 p-4">
  475:             <div className="mb-4 text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  476:               الحقول المختارة: {selectedCount}
  477:             </div>
  478: 
  479:             <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
  480:               {fields.map((field) => {
  481:                 const selected = selectedIds.has(field.id);
  482: 
  483:                 return (
  484:                   <article
  485:                     key={field.id}
  486:                     className={[
  487:                       "rounded-2xl border p-4 transition",
  488:                       selected
  489:                         ? "border-emerald-200 bg-white shadow-sm"
  490:                         : "border-slate-100 bg-white/60 opacity-70",
  491:                     ].join(" ")}
  492:                   >
  493:                     <div className="mb-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
  494:                       <label className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-2">
  495:                         <input
  496:                           type="checkbox"
  497:                           checked={selected}
  498:                           onChange={() => toggleField(field.id)}
  499:                           className="h-4 w-4 accent-emerald-700"
  500:                         />
  501:                         <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-700">
  502:                           عرض في التقرير
  503:                         </span>
  504:                       </label>
  505:                     </div>
  506: 
  507:                     <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500">
  508:                       العنوان الظاهر
  509:                     </label>
  510:                     <input
  511:                       value={field.label}
  512:                       onChange={(event) =>
  513:                         updateField(field.id, { label: event.target.value })
  514:                       }
  515:                       className="mb-3 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-slate-800 outline-none transition focus:border-emerald-300 focus:bg-white"
  516:                     />
  517: 
  518:                     <label className="mb-1 block text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500">
  519:                       القيمة
  520:                     </label>
  521:                     <textarea
  522:                       value={String(field.value || "")}
  523:                       onChange={(event) =>
  524:                         updateField(field.id, { value: event.target.value })
  525:                       }
  526:                       rows={3}
  527:                       className="w-full resize-y rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black leading-6 text-slate-950 outline-none transition focus:border-emerald-300 focus:bg-white"
  528:                     />
  529:                   </article>
  530:                 );
  531:               })}
  532:             </div>
  533:           </div>
  534:         </section>
  535:       </div>
  536:     </main>
  537:   );
  538: }

  218: export function ReportTemplateAdminTools({
  219:   template,
  220:   identity,
  221:   snippets,
  222:   onIdentityChange,
  223:   onSnippetsChange,
  224: }: ReportTemplateAdminToolsProps) {
  225:   const [activePanel, setActivePanel] = useState<
  226:     "identity" | "library" | "test"
  227:   >("identity");
  228: 
  229:   const [libraryServiceFilter, setLibraryServiceFilter] =
  230:     useState<LibraryServiceFilter>("all");
  231: 
  232:   const [librarySearchQuery, setLibrarySearchQuery] = useState("");
  233: 
  234:   const [copiedVariableKey, setCopiedVariableKey] = useState("");
  235: 
  236:   const validation = useMemo(() => {
  237:     return validateReportTemplateForPublishing({
  238:       template,
  239:       identity,
  240:       snippets,
  241:     });
  242:   }, [template, identity, snippets]);
  243: 
  244:   const sampleVariables = useMemo(() => {
  245:     return buildSampleVariables(identity, template);
  246:   }, [identity, template]);
  247: 
  248:   const filteredSnippets = useMemo(() => {
  249:     const keyword = librarySearchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
  250: 
  251:     return snippets.filter((snippet) => {
  252:       const matchesService =
  253:         libraryServiceFilter === "all"
  254:           ? true
  255:           : libraryServiceFilter === "global"
  256:             ? !snippet.serviceSlug
  257:             : snippet.serviceSlug === libraryServiceFilter;
  258: 
  259:       if (!matchesService) {
  260:         return false;
  261:       }
  262: 
  263:       if (!keyword) {
  264:         return true;
  265:       }
  266: 
  267:       return [
  268:         snippet.title,
  269:         snippet.category,
  270:         snippet.serviceSlug || "عام",
  271:         snippet.content,
  272:       ]
  273:         .join(" ")
  274:         .toLowerCase()
  275:         .includes(keyword);
  276:     });
  277:   }, [snippets, librarySearchQuery, libraryServiceFilter]);
  278: 
  279:   const groupedSnippets = useMemo(() => {
  280:     return groupSnippetsByService(filteredSnippets);
  281:   }, [filteredSnippets]);
  282: 
  283:   const libraryStats = useMemo(() => {
  284:     const analyses = snippets.map((snippet) =>
  285:       analyzeSnippet(snippet, sampleVariables)
  286:     );
  287: 
  288:     const unknownVariablesCount = analyses.reduce(
  289:       (total, analysis) => total + analysis.unknownVariables.length,
  290:       0
  291:     );
  292: 
  293:     const emptyCount = analyses.filter((analysis) => analysis.isEmpty).length;
  294:     const longCount = analyses.filter((analysis) => analysis.isLong).length;
  295: 
  296:     return {
  297:       total: snippets.length,
  298:       unknownVariablesCount,
  299:       emptyCount,
  300:       longCount,
  301:     };
  302:   }, [snippets, sampleVariables]);
  303: 
  304:   function updateIdentity<K extends keyof ReportIdentitySettings>(
  305:     key: K,
  306:     value: ReportIdentitySettings[K]
  307:   ) {
  308:     onIdentityChange({
  309:       ...identity,
  310:       [key]: value,
  311:     });

  313:

  324:     };

  329:   function updateSnippet(

  332:   ) {
  333:     onSnippetsChange(
  334:       snippets.map((snippet) =>

  339: 
  340:   function deleteSnippet(snippetId: string) {
  341:     onSnippetsChange(snippets.filter((snippet) => snippet.id !== snippetId));
  342:   }
  343: 
  344:   async function copyVariable(key: string) {
  345:     const value = `{${key}}`;
  346: 
  347:     try {
  348:       await navigator.clipboard.writeText(value);
  349:       setCopiedVariableKey(key);
  350:       window.setTimeout(() => setCopiedVariableKey(""), 1200);
  351:     } catch {
  352:       setCopiedVariableKey("");
  353:     }
  354:   }
  355:

  754: function SmartVariablesPanel({
  755:   copiedVariableKey,
  756:   onCopyVariable,
  757: }: {
  758:   copiedVariableKey: string;
  759:   onCopyVariable: (key: string) => void;
  760: }) {
  761:   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  762:   const groupedVariables = groupVariablesByGroup(smartVariables);
  763: 
  764:   return (
  765:     <div className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
  766:       <button
  767:         type="button"
  768:         onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
  769:         className="flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-3 text-right"
  770:       >
  771:         <div>
  772:           <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  773:             المتغيرات الذكية المتاحة
  774:           </h3>
  775: 
  776:           <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500">
  777:             انسخ المتغير والصقه داخل أي نص. النظام يفحص المتغيرات الخاطئة
  778:             تلقائيًا.
  779:           </p>
  780:         </div>
  781: 
  782:         <span className="rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-black text-slate-600">
  783:           {open ? "إخفاء" : "عرض"}
  784:         </span>
  785:       </button>
  786:

  795:                 {group.group}

  799:                 {group.variables.map((variable) => (

  801:                     key={variable.key}

  813:                           {"}"}

  845: 
  846: function SnippetServiceGroup({
  847:   serviceKey,
  848:   serviceName,
  849:   snippets,
  850:   sampleVariables,
  851:   onAddSnippet,
  852:   onUpdateSnippet,
  853:   onDeleteSnippet,
  854: }: {
  855:   serviceKey: string;
  856:   serviceName: string;
  857:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
  858:   sampleVariables: Record<string, string>;
  859:   onAddSnippet: () => void;
  860:   onUpdateSnippet: (
  861:     snippetId: string,
  862:     updater: (snippet: ReportTextSnippet) => ReportTextSnippet
  863:   ) => void;
  864:   onDeleteSnippet: (snippetId: string) => void;
  865: }) {
  866:   const analyses = snippets.map((snippet) =>
  867:     analyzeSnippet(snippet, sampleVariables)
  868:   );
  869: 
  870:   const errorsCount = analyses.reduce(
  871:     (total, analysis) => total + analysis.unknownVariables.length,
  872:     0
  873:   );
  874: 
  875:   return (
  876:     <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
  877:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
  878:         <div>
  879:           <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  880:             <h3 className="text-base font-black text-slate-900">
  881:               {serviceName}
  882:             </h3>
  883: 
  884:             <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-600">
  885:               {snippets.length} نص
  886:             </span>
  887: 
  888:             {errorsCount > 0 ? (
  889:               <span className="rounded-full bg-red-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-red-700">
  890:                 {errorsCount} متغير خاطئ
  891:               </span>
  892:             ) : (
  893:               <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-700">
  894:                 جاهز
  895:               </span>
  896:             )}
  897:           </div>
  898: 
  899:           <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500">
  900:             {serviceKey === "global"
  901:               ? "نصوص عامة يمكن استخدامها مع جميع الخدمات."
  902:               : "نصوص مخصصة لهذه الخدمة وتساعد على توحيد صياغة تقاريرها."}
  903:           </p>
  904:         </div>
  905: 
  906:         <button
  907:           type="button"
  908:           onClick={onAddSnippet}
  909:           className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-3 text-xs font-black text-emerald-800 transition hover:bg-emerald-100"
  910:         >
  911:           إضافة نص لهذه الخدمة
  912:         </button>
  913:       </div>
  914: 
  915:       <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4">
  916:         {snippets.map((snippet) => (
  917:           <SnippetEditorCard
  918:             key={snippet.id}
  919:             snippet={snippet}
  920:             sampleVariables={sampleVariables}
  921:             onUpdate={(updater) => onUpdateSnippet(snippet.id, updater)}
  922:             onDelete={() => onDeleteSnippet(snippet.id)}
  923:           />
  924:         ))}
  925:       </div>
  926:     </section>
  927:   );
  928: }
  929: 
  930: function SnippetEditorCard({
  931:   snippet,
  932:   sampleVariables,
  933:   onUpdate,
  934:   onDelete,
  935: }: {
  936:   snippet: ReportTextSnippet;
  937:   sampleVariables: Record<string, string>;
  938:   onUpdate: (updater: (snippet: ReportTextSnippet) => ReportTextSnippet) => void;
  939:   onDelete: () => void;
  940: }) {
  941:   const analysis = analyzeSnippet(snippet, sampleVariables);
  942:

 1193: function groupSnippetsByService(snippets: ReportTextSnippet[]) {
 1194:   const groups = new Map<
 1195:     string,
 1196:     {
 1197:       serviceKey: string;
 1198:       serviceName: string;
 1199:       snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
 1200:     }
 1201:   >();
 1202: 
 1203:   for (const snippet of snippets) {
 1204:     const serviceKey = snippet.serviceSlug || "global";
 1205:     const serviceName = getServiceName(serviceKey);
 1206: 
 1207:     if (!groups.has(serviceKey)) {
 1208:       groups.set(serviceKey, {
 1209:         serviceKey,
 1210:         serviceName,
 1211:         snippets: [],
 1212:       });
 1213:     }
 1214: 
 1215:     groups.get(serviceKey)?.snippets.push(snippet);
 1216:   }
 1217: 
 1218:   return Array.from(groups.values()).sort((a, b) => {
 1219:     if (a.serviceKey === "global") return -1;
 1220:     if (b.serviceKey === "global") return 1;
 1221:     return a.serviceName.localeCompare(b.serviceName, "ar");
 1222:   });
 1223: }
 1224: 
 1225: function groupVariablesByGroup(variables: typeof smartVariables) {
 1226:   const groups = new Map<
 1227:     string,
 1228:     {
 1229:       group: string;
 1230:       variables: typeof smartVariables;
 1231:     }
 1232:   >();
 1233: 
 1234:   for (const variable of variables) {
 1235:     if (!groups.has(variable.group)) {
 1236:       groups.set(variable.group, {
 1237:         group: variable.group,
 1238:         variables: [],
 1239:       });
 1240:     }
 1241: 
 1242:     groups.get(variable.group)?.variables.push(variable);
 1243:   }
 1244: 
 1245:   return Array.from(groups.values());
 1246: }
 1247: 
 1248: function analyzeSnippet(
 1249:   snippet: ReportTextSnippet,
 1250:   sampleVariables: Record<string, string>
 1251: ): SnippetAnalysis {
 1252:   const usedVariables = extractVariablesFromText(snippet.content);
 1253:   const unknownVariables = usedVariables.filter(
 1254:     (variable) => !knownVariableKeys.has(variable)
 1255:   );
 1256: 
 1257:   return {
 1258:     usedVariables,
 1259:     unknownVariables,
 1260:     renderedText: renderTextWithVariables(snippet.content, sampleVariables),
 1261:     isEmpty: snippet.content.trim().length === 0,
 1262:     isLong: snippet.content.trim().length > 900,
 1263:   };
 1264: }
 1265: 
 1266: function extractVariablesFromText(text: string) {
 1267:   const matches = text.match(/\{([^}]+)\}/g) || [];
 1268: 
 1269:   return Array.from(
 1270:     new Set(matches.map((match) => match.replace(/[{}]/g, "").trim()))
 1271:   ).filter(Boolean);
 1272: }
 1273: 
 1274: function renderTextWithVariables(
 1275:   text: string,
 1276:   variables: Record<string, string>
 1277: ) {
 1278:   return text.replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (_, variableName: string) => {
 1279:     const cleanVariableName = String(variableName || "").trim();
 1280: 
 1281:     if (!knownVariableKeys.has(cleanVariableName)) {
 1282:       return `{${cleanVariableName}}`;
 1283:     }
 1284: 
 1285:     return variables[cleanVariableName] || "";
 1286:   });
 1287: }
 1288:

   39: function parseTemplateJson(item: any) {
   40:   const raw = item?.templateJson ?? item?.content ?? item?.template ?? null;
   41: 
   42:   if (!raw) return null;
   43: 
   44:   if (typeof raw === "string") {
   45:     try {
   46:       return JSON.parse(raw);
   47:     } catch {
   48:       return null;
   49:     }
   50:   }
   51: 
   52:   if (typeof raw === "object") {
   53:     return raw;
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   return null;

   59: function countBlocks(templateJson: any) {
   60:   const pages = Array.isArray(templateJson?.smartStudio?.pages)
   61:     ? templateJson.smartStudio.pages
   62:     : Array.isArray(templateJson?.pages)
   63:       ? templateJson.pages
   64:       : [];
   65: 
   66:   return pages.reduce((total: number, page: any) => {
   67:     const blocks = Array.isArray(page?.blocks) ? page.blocks : [];
   68:     return total + blocks.length;
   69:   }, 0);
   70: }

   72: function normalizeTemplate(item: any): TemplateRow | null {
   73:   const templateJson = parseTemplateJson(item) || {};
   74: 
   75:   const status =
   76:     templateJson.status === "PUBLISHED" ||
   77:     templateJson.status === "ARCHIVED" ||
   78:     templateJson.status === "DRAFT"
   79:       ? templateJson.status
   80:       : item?.isActive === false
   81:         ? "ARCHIVED"
   82:         : "DRAFT";
   83: 
   84:   const pages = Array.isArray(templateJson?.smartStudio?.pages)
   85:     ? templateJson.smartStudio.pages
   86:     : Array.isArray(templateJson?.pages)
   87:       ? templateJson.pages
   88:       : [];
   89: 
   90:   const workflowBinding = templateJson?.workflowBinding || {};
   91: 
   92:   const id = String(item?.id || templateJson?.id || "").trim();

   94:   if (!id) return null;
   95: 
   96:   return {

   98:     name: String(item?.name || templateJson?.name || "قالب بدون اسم"),
   99:     description: String(

  101:         templateJson?.description ||
  102:         "قالب تقرير رسمي ذكي محفوظ في النظام.",
  103:     ),

  110:       templateJson?.workflowSlug || workflowBinding?.workflowSlug || null,
  111:     locationKey:
  112:       templateJson?.locationKey || workflowBinding?.locationKey || null,
  113:     scope: templateJson?.scope || workflowBinding?.scope || "GLOBAL",
  114:     status,
  115:     updatedAt: String(

  339:             لا توجد قيم حقيقية من Case ID، سيتم عرض القيم عند ربط حالة حقيقية.
  340:           </div>
  341:         )}
  342:       </BlockShell>
  343:     );
  344:   }
  345: 
  346:   if (block.kind === "text-library") {
  347:     const runtimeData = buildRuntimeReportDataForTextLibrary(
  348:       template,
  349:       previewCaseData,
  350:     );
  351: 
  352:     const resolvedSnippets = resolveTextLibrarySnippets({
  353:       block,
  354:       template,
  355:       snippets,
  356:       data: runtimeData,
  357:     });
  358: 
  359:     if (!resolvedSnippets.length) {
  360:       const fallback = resolveTextLibraryFallback({ block });
  361: 
  362:       if (!fallback) {
  363:         return null;
  364:       }
  365: 
  366:       return (
  367:         <BlockShell block={block} tone="emerald">
  368:           <p className="whitespace-pre-line rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-4 text-sm leading-8 text-slate-800">
  369:             {fallback}
  370:           </p>
  371:         </BlockShell>
  372:       );
  373:     }
  374: 
  375:     return (
  376:       <BlockShell block={block} tone="emerald">
  377:         <div className="space-y-3">
  378:           {resolvedSnippets.map((snippet) => (
  379:             <article
  380:               key={snippet.id}
  381:               className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white p-4"
  382:             >
  383:               <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  384:                 <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-emerald-700">
  385:                   {snippet.category}
  386:                 </span>
  387: 
  388:                 <strong className="text-xs text-slate-500">
  389:                   {snippet.title}
  390:                 </strong>
  391:               </div>
  392: 
  393:               <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-8 text-slate-800">
  394:                 {snippet.renderedText}
  395:               </p>
  396:             </article>
  397:           ))}
  398:         </div>
  399:       </BlockShell>
  400:     );
  401:   }
  402: 
  403:   if (block.kind === "custom-paragraph") {
  404:     return (
  405:       <BlockShell block={block}>
  406:         {block.customTitle ? (
  407:           <h4 className="mb-3 text-base font-black text-slate-900">
  408:             {block.customTitle}
  409:           </h4>
  410:         ) : null}
  411: 
  412:         <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-8 text-slate-700">
  413:           {block.customContent || "لم يتم إدخال محتوى مخصص بعد."}
  414:         </p>
  415:       </BlockShell>
  416:     );
  417:   }
  418: 
  419:   if (block.kind === "evidence-gallery") {
  420:     const evidences = getRuntimeEvidences(previewCaseData);
  421:     const settings = block.settings || {};
  422:     const layout = settings.evidenceLayout || "grid-2x2";
  423: 
  424:     if (!evidences.length && previewCaseData?.caseId) {
  425:       return null;
  426:     }
  427: 
  428:     return (
  429:       <BlockShell block={block}>
  430:         {evidences.length ? (
  431:           <EvidencePreviewGrid
  432:             evidences={evidences}
  433:             layout={layout}
  434:             showCaptions={settings.showCaptions !== false}
  435:             imageFit={settings.imageFit || "cover"}
  436:           />
  437:         ) : (
  438:           <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-5 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
  439:             لا توجد شواهد في المعاينة الحالية.
  440:           </div>
  441:         )}
  442:       </BlockShell>
  443:     );
  444:   }
  445: 
  446:   if (block.kind === "approval-signature") {
  447:     return (
  448:       <BlockShell block={block}>
  449:         <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
  450:           <SignatureBox title="الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية" name="أ. الموجه الطلابي" />
  451:           <SignatureBox title="قائد/قائدة المدرسة" name="قائد/قائدة المدرسة" />
  452:         </div>
  453:       </BlockShell>
  454:     );
  455:   }
  456: 
  457:   return (
  458:     <BlockShell block={block}>
  459:       <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
  460:         نوع البلوك غير مدعوم في المعاينة الحالية.
  461:       </p>
  462:     </BlockShell>
  463:   );
  464: }
  465: 
  466: function BlockShell({
  467:   block,
  468:   tone = "slate",
  469:   children,
  470: }: {
  471:   block: ReportTemplateBlock;
  472:   tone?: "slate" | "emerald";
  473:   children: ReactNode;
  474: }) {
  475:   const settings = block.settings || {};
  476:   const showTitle = settings.showTitle !== false;
  477:   const style = settings.style || "card";
  478: 
  479:   if (style === "plain") {
  480:     return (
  481:       <section>
  482:         {showTitle ? (
  483:           <h4 className="mb-3 text-base font-black text-slate-900">
  484:             {block.title}
  485:           </h4>
  486:         ) : null}
  487: 
  488:         {children}
  489:       </section>
  490:     );
  491:   }
  492: 
  493:   if (style === "highlight") {
  494:     return (
  495:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-amber-100 bg-amber-50 p-5">
  496:         {showTitle ? (
  497:           <h4 className="mb-3 text-base font-black text-amber-950">
  498:             {block.title}
  499:           </h4>
  500:         ) : null}
  501: 
  502:         {children}
  503:       </section>
  504:     );
  505:   }
  506: 
  507:   return (
  508:     <section
  509:       className={[
  510:         "rounded-3xl border p-5",
  511:         tone === "emerald"
  512:           ? "border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50"
  513:           : "border-slate-200 bg-slate-50",
  514:       ].join(" ")}
  515:     >
  516:       {showTitle ? (
  517:         <h4
  518:           className={[
  519:             "mb-3 text-base font-black",
  520:             tone === "emerald" ? "text-emerald-950" : "text-slate-900",
  521:           ].join(" ")}
  522:         >
  523:           {block.title}
  524:         </h4>
  525:       ) : null}
  526: 
  527:       {children}
  528:     </section>
  529:   );
  530: }

  597: function EvidencePreviewGrid({
  598:   evidences,
  599:   layout,
  600:   showCaptions,
  601:   imageFit,
  602: }: {
  603:   evidences: RuntimeEvidenceItem[];
  604:   layout: string;
  605:   showCaptions: boolean;
  606:   imageFit: string;
  607: }) {
  608:   const gridClass =
  609:     layout === "one-per-page"
  610:       ? "grid-cols-1"
  611:       : layout === "stacked"
  612:         ? "grid-cols-1"
  613:         : layout === "two-columns"
  614:           ? "grid-cols-2"
  615:           : "grid-cols-2";
  616: 
  617:   return (
  618:     <div className={`grid gap-3 ${gridClass}`}>
  619:       {evidences
  620:         .slice(0, layout === "one-per-page" ? 1 : 4)
  621:         .map((evidence, index) => {
  622:           const imageUrl = evidence.imageUrl || evidence.fileUrl || "";
  623: 
  624:           return (
  625:             <article
  626:               key={evidence.id || `${evidence.fileName}-${index}`}
  627:               className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white"
  628:             >
  629:               <div className="flex h-40 items-center justify-center bg-slate-100">
  630:                 {isImageEvidence(evidence) && imageUrl ? (
  631:                   <img
  632:                     src={imageUrl}
  633:                     alt={evidence.title || evidence.fileName || "شاهد"}
  634:                     className={[
  635:                       "h-full w-full",
  636:                       imageFit === "contain" ? "object-contain" : "object-cover",
  637:                     ].join(" ")}
  638:                   />
  639:                 ) : (
  640:                   <span className="px-4 text-center text-xs font-black text-slate-500">
  641:                     {evidence.fileName || "مرفق"}
  642:                   </span>
  643:                 )}
  644:               </div>
  645: 
  646:               {showCaptions ? (
  647:                 <div className="p-3">
  648:                   <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-800">
  649:                     {evidence.title ||
  650:                       evidence.caption ||
  651:                       evidence.fileName ||
  652:                       "شاهد"}
  653:                   </p>
  654: 
  655:                   {evidence.description ? (
  656:                     <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">
  657:                       {evidence.description}
  658:                     </p>
  659:                   ) : null}
  660:                 </div>
  661:               ) : null}
  662:             </article>
  663:           );
  664:         })}
  665:     </div>
  666:   );

  669: function buildRuntimeReportDataForTextLibrary(
  670:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel,
  671:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null,
  672: ): RuntimeReportData {
  673:   const values = getRuntimeValues(previewCaseData);
  674:   const valueMap: Record<string, string> = {};
  675: 
  676:   values.forEach((item) => {
  677:     const value = item.value || "";
  678: 
  679:     if (item.fieldKey) {
  680:       valueMap[item.fieldKey] = value;
  681:     }
  682: 
  683:     if (item.fieldLabel) {
  684:       valueMap[item.fieldLabel] = value;
  685:     }
  686:   });
  687: 
  688:   const student = getStudent(previewCaseData);
  689:   const evidences = getRuntimeEvidences(previewCaseData);
  690: 
  691:   return {
  692:     reportTitle: template.name || "عنوان التقارير",
  693:     createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  694:     values: {
  695:       ...valueMap,
  696:       programTitle:
  697:         valueMap.program_name ||
  698:         valueMap["عنوان البرنامج"] ||
  699:         valueMap.programTitle ||
  700:         getCaseTitle(previewCaseData) ||
  701:         "برنامج إرشادي",
  702:       executionDate:
  703:         valueMap.gregorian_date ||
  704:         valueMap.executionDate ||
  705:         valueMap["تاريخ التنفيذ"] ||
  706:         "2026-05-26",
  707:       dayText: valueMap.day || valueMap["اليوم"] || "الأحد",
  708:       targetGroup:
  709:         valueMap.beneficiaries ||
  710:         valueMap.targetGroup ||
  711:         valueMap["الفئة المستهدفة"] ||
  712:         student.grade ||
  713:         "الفئة المستهدفة",
  714:       executionAction:
  715:         valueMap.execution_action ||
  716:         valueMap.executionAction ||
  717:         valueMap["الإجراء التنفيذي"] ||
  718:         "إجراء تنفيذي موثق",
  719:       executionMechanism:
  720:         valueMap.execution_mechanism ||
  721:         valueMap.executionMechanism ||
  722:         valueMap["آلية التنفيذ"] ||
  723:         "آلية تنفيذ موثقة",
  724:       performanceIndicator:
  725:         valueMap.performance_indicator ||
  726:         valueMap.performanceIndicator ||
  727:         valueMap["مؤشر الأداء"] ||
  728:         "مؤشر أداء",
  729:       evidenceSuggestion:
  730:         valueMap.evidence_suggestion ||
  731:         valueMap.evidenceSuggestion ||
  732:         valueMap["الشواهد"] ||
  733:         "الشواهد والمرفقات",
  734:       evidenceCountText: formatEvidenceCount(evidences.length),
  735:     },
  736:     evidences: evidences.map((evidence) => ({
  737:       id: evidence.id || undefined,
  738:       title: evidence.title || evidence.caption || evidence.fileName || undefined,
  739:       caption: evidence.caption || undefined,
  740:       description: evidence.description || undefined,
  741:       fileUrl: evidence.fileUrl || evidence.imageUrl || undefined,
  742:       url: evidence.imageUrl || evidence.fileUrl || undefined,
  743:       mimeType: evidence.mimeType || undefined,
  744:     })),
  745:     student: {
  746:       name: student.fullName || "اسم الطالب/الطالبة",
  747:       nationalId: student.nationalId || "",
  748:       grade: student.grade || "",
  749:       classroom: student.classroom || "",
  750:       gender: "",
  751:       guardianName: student.guardianName || "",
  752:       guardianPhone: student.guardianPhone || "",
  753:     },
  754:     service: {
  755:       name: getServiceName(template, previewCaseData),
  756:       slug: template.serviceSlug || "",
  757:     },
  758:     caseEntry: {
  759:       title: getCaseTitle(previewCaseData),
  760:       student: {
  761:         name: student.fullName || "اسم الطالب/الطالبة",
  762:         nationalId: student.nationalId || "",
  763:         grade: student.grade || "",
  764:         classroom: student.classroom || "",
  765:         gender: "",
  766:         guardianName: student.guardianName || "",
  767:         guardianPhone: student.guardianPhone || "",
  768:       },
  769:       service: {
  770:         name: getServiceName(template, previewCaseData),
  771:         slug: template.serviceSlug || "",
  772:       },
  773:     },
  774:     school: {
  775:       name: "اسم المدرسة",
  776:       schoolYear: "1447هـ",
  777:       semester: "الفصل الدراسي",
  778:       principalName: "قائد/قائدة المدرسة",
  779:     },
  780:     counselor: {
  781:       name: "الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية",
  782:     },
  783:   };
  784: }

  786: function getRuntimeValues(
  787:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null,
  788: ): RuntimeValueItem[] {
  789:   const data = previewCaseData as
  790:     | {
  791:         values?: RuntimeValueItem[];
  792:       }
  793:     | null;
  794: 
  795:   return Array.isArray(data?.values) ? data.values : [];
  796: }
  797: 
  798: function getRuntimeEvidences(
  799:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null,
  800: ): RuntimeEvidenceItem[] {
  801:   const data = previewCaseData as
  802:     | {
  803:         evidences?: RuntimeEvidenceItem[];
  804:       }
  805:     | null;
  806: 
  807:   return filterValidReportEvidenceItems(data?.evidences || [], {
  808:     allowSampleEvidence: !previewCaseData?.caseId,
  809:   });
  810: }
  811: 
  812: function getStudent(previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null) {
  813:   const data = previewCaseData as
  814:     | {
  815:         student?: {
  816:           fullName?: string | null;
  817:           nationalId?: string | null;
  818:           stage?: string | null;
  819:           grade?: string | null;
  820:           classroom?: string | null;
  821:           guardianName?: string | null;
  822:           guardianPhone?: string | null;
  823:         } | null;
  824:       }
  825:     | null;
  826: 
  827:   return {
  828:     fullName: data?.student?.fullName || "",
  829:     nationalId: data?.student?.nationalId || "",
  830:     stage: data?.student?.stage || "",
  831:     grade: data?.student?.grade || "",
  832:     classroom: data?.student?.classroom || "",
  833:     guardianName: data?.student?.guardianName || "",
  834:     guardianPhone: data?.student?.guardianPhone || "",
  835:   };
  836: }
  837: 
  838: function getCaseTitle(previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null) {
  839:   const data = previewCaseData as
  840:     | {
  841:         title?: string | null;
  842:       }
  843:     | null;
  844: 
  845:   return data?.title || "حالة تجريبية";
  846: }
  847: 
  848: function getServiceName(
  849:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel,
  850:   previewCaseData: RuntimePreviewCaseData | null,
  851: ) {
  852:   const data = previewCaseData as
  853:     | {
  854:         serviceName?: string | null;
  855:       }
  856:     | null;
  857: 
  858:   if (data?.serviceName) {
  859:     return data.serviceName;
  860:   }
  861: 
  862:   if (template.scope === "SERVICE" && template.serviceSlug) {
  863:     return template.serviceSlug;
  864:   }
  865: 
  866:   return "الخدمة الإرشادية";
  867: }
  868: 
  869: function shouldShowTitle(block: ReportTemplateBlock) {
  870:   return block.settings?.showTitle !== false;
  871: }
  872: 
  873: function isImageEvidence(evidence: RuntimeEvidenceItem) {
  874:   if (evidence.mimeType?.startsWith("image/")) {
  875:     return true;
  876:   }
  877: 
  878:   const fileName = evidence.fileName || evidence.fileUrl || evidence.imageUrl || "";
  879: 
  880:   return /\.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp|gif)$/i.test(fileName);
  881: }
  882: 
  883: function formatEvidenceCount(count: number) {
  884:   if (count <= 0) return "0 شاهد";
  885:   if (count === 1) return "شاهد واحد";
  886:   if (count === 2) return "شاهدان";
  887:   if (count >= 3 && count <= 10) return `${count} شواهد`;
  888:   return `${count} شاهد`;
  889: }
  890: 
  891: function getPageKindLabel(kind: string) {
  892:   if (kind === "cover") return "غلاف";
  893:   if (kind === "summary") return "ملخص";
  894:   if (kind === "narrative") return "محتوى";
  895:   if (kind === "results") return "نتائج";
  896:   if (kind === "evidence") return "شواهد";
  897:   if (kind === "approval") return "اعتماد";
  898:   return kind;
  899: }
