   64:     const pagesCount = template.pages.length;
   65:     const blocksCount = template.pages.reduce(
   66:       (total, page) => total + page.blocks.length,
   67:       0
   68:     );
   69: 
   70:     const textLibraryBlocksCount = template.pages.reduce(
   71:       (total, page) =>
   72:         total +
   73:         page.blocks.filter((block) => block.kind === "text-library").length,
   74:       0
   75:     );
   76: 
   77:     const evidenceBlocksCount = template.pages.reduce(
   78:       (total, page) =>
   79:         total +
   80:         page.blocks.filter((block) => block.kind === "evidence-gallery").length,
   81:       0
   82:     );
   83: 
   84:     const serviceSnippetsCount =
   85:       template.scope === "SERVICE" && template.serviceSlug
   86:         ? snippets.filter(
   87:             (snippet) =>
   88:               !snippet.serviceSlug || snippet.serviceSlug === template.serviceSlug
   89:           ).length
   90:         : snippets.length;
   91: 
   92:     return {
   93:       pagesCount,
   94:       blocksCount,
   95:       textLibraryBlocksCount,
   96:       evidenceBlocksCount,
   97:       serviceSnippetsCount,
   98:       snippetsCount: snippets.length,
   99:       snapshotsCount: snapshots.length,
  100:     };
  101:   }, [template, snippets, snapshots]);
  102: 
  103:   function openFeedback(
  104:     type: FeedbackState["type"],
  105:     title: string,
  106:     message: string
  107:   ) {
  108:     setFeedback({
  109:       open: true,
  110:       type,
  111:       title,
  112:       message,
  113:     });
  114:   }
  115: 
  116:   function closeFeedback() {
  117:     setFeedback((current) => ({
  118:       ...current,
  119:       open: false,
  120:     }));
  121:   }
  122: 
  123:   function publishTemplate() {
  124:     if (!validation.canPublish) {
  125:       openFeedback(
  126:         "warning",
  127:         "القالب غير جاهز للنشر",
  128:         "راجع اختبار القالب أولًا. يوجد أخطاء أو تنبيهات تمنع النشر الآمن للموجهين."
  129:       );
  130:       return;
  131:     }
  132: 
  133:     onTemplateStatusChange("PUBLISHED");
  134: 
  135:     openFeedback(
  136:       "success",
  137:       "تم نشر القالب",
  138:       "تم تغيير حالة القالب إلى منشور. لاحقًا سيتم ربط هذا الإجراء بقاعدة البيانات ونسخ الإصدارات."
  139:     );
  140:   }
  141: 
  142:   function moveToDraft() {
  143:     onTemplateStatusChange("DRAFT");
  144: 
  145:     openFeedback(
  146:       "info",
  147:       "تم تحويل القالب إلى مسودة",
  148:       "يمكنك الآن تعديل القالب ومراجعة مكتبة النصوص قبل نشره مرة أخرى."
  149:     );
  150:   }
  151: 
  152:   function archiveTemplate() {
  153:     onTemplateStatusChange("ARCHIVED");
  154: 
  155:     openFeedback(
  156:       "warning",
  157:       "تم أرشفة القالب",
  158:       "القالب أصبح مؤرشفًا. لاحقًا لن يظهر للموجهين إلا القوالب المنشورة فقط."
  159:     );
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   function createSnapshot() {
  163:     const snapshot = {
  164:       id: `report-template-snapshot-${Date.now()}`,
  165:       templateId: template.id,
  166:       templateName: template.name,
  167:       status: template.status,
  168:       createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  169:       pagesCount: template.pages.length,
  170:       blocksCount: templateStats.blocksCount,
  171:       snippetsCount: snippets.length,
  172:       template,
  173:       identity,
  174:       snippets,
  175:     } as unknown as GeneratedReportSnapshot;
  176: 
  177:     onSnapshotCreate(snapshot);
  178: 
  179:     openFeedback(
  180:       "success",
  181:       "تم إنشاء Snapshot",
  182:       "تم حفظ نسخة لحظية من القالب والهوية ومكتبة النصوص داخل حالة الصفحة الحالية. لاحقًا ستُحفظ هذه النسخة في قاعدة البيانات."
  183:     );
  184:   }
  185: 
  186:   function exportTemplatePackage() {
  187:     const packageData: PortableTemplatePackage = {
  188:       version: 1,
  189:       exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  190:       source: "student-guidance-platform-report-template-builder",
  191:       template,
  192:       identity,
  193:       snippets,
  194:     };
  195: 
  196:     const json = JSON.stringify(packageData, null, 2);
  197:     const blob = new Blob([json], {
  198:       type: "application/json;charset=utf-8",
  199:     });
  200: 
  201:     const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  202:     const anchor = document.createElement("a");
  203:     const fileName = buildSafeFileName(template.name);
  204: 
  205:     anchor.href = url;
  206:     anchor.download = `${fileName}-${Date.now()}.json`;
  207:     document.body.appendChild(anchor);
  208:     anchor.click();
  209:     anchor.remove();
  210: 
  211:     URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  212: 
  213:     openFeedback(
  214:       "success",
  215:       "تم تصدير القالب",
  216:       "تم تنزيل ملف JSON يحتوي القالب والهوية ومكتبة النصوص. هذا مفيد كنسخة احتياطية أو للنقل لاحقًا."
  217:     );
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   async function importTemplatePackage(file: File | null) {
  221:     if (!file) {
  222:       return;
  223:     }
  224: 
  225:     try {
  226:       const text = await file.text();
  227:       const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
  228:       const packageData = validatePortableTemplatePackage(parsed);
  229: 
  230:       openFeedback(
  231:         "success",
  232:         "تم قراءة ملف القالب",
  233:         `تم التحقق من الملف بنجاح: ${packageData.template.name}. الاستيراد الحقيقي سيُربط لاحقًا بإنشاء Draft جديد بدل استبدال القالب الحالي مباشرة.`
  234:       );
  235:     } catch (error) {
  236:       openFeedback(
  237:         "error",
  238:         "تعذر استيراد القالب",
  239:         error instanceof Error
  240:           ? error.message
  241:           : "حدث خطأ غير متوقع أثناء قراءة ملف JSON."
  242:       );
  243:     }
  244:   }
  245: 
  246:   return (
  247:     <section className="rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm">
  248:       <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
  249:         <div>
  250:           <p className="text-sm font-black text-emerald-700">
  251:             النشر والإصدارات
  252:           </p>
  253: 
  254:           <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black text-slate-900">
  255:             أدوات نشر القالب وحفظ نسخه
  256:           </h2>
  257: 
  258:           <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-sm leading-7 text-slate-500">
  259:             هنا يتم فحص جاهزية القالب، نشره، أرشفته، إنشاء Snapshot، وتصديره أو
  260:             استيراده كملف JSON. لاحقًا سيتم ربط هذه العمليات بقاعدة البيانات
  261:             ونظام Draft / Published / Archived.
  262:           </p>
  263:         </div>
  264: 
  265:         <TemplateStatusBadge status={template.status} />
  266:       </div>
  267: 
  268:       <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
  269:         <MetricCard label="الصفحات" value={templateStats.pagesCount} />
  270:         <MetricCard label="البلوكات" value={templateStats.blocksCount} />
  271:         <MetricCard
  272:           label="بلوكات مكتبة النصوص"
  273:           value={templateStats.textLibraryBlocksCount}
  274:         />
  275:         <MetricCard label="النصوص المتاحة" value={templateStats.snippetsCount} />
  276:       </div>
  277: 
  278:       <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">
  279:         <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
  280:           <div>
  281:             <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  282:               جاهزية القالب للنشر
  283:             </h3>
  284: 
  285:             <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500">
  286:               النشر يجب أن يتم فقط بعد نجاح الفحص حتى لا تظهر للموجهين قوالب
  287:               ناقصة أو غير مترابطة.
  288:             </p>
  289:           </div>
  290: 
  291:           <div
  292:             className={[
  293:               "rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-black",
  294:               validation.canPublish
  295:                 ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800"
  296:                 : "bg-red-100 text-red-800",
  297:             ].join(" ")}
  298:           >
  299:             {validation.score}/100
  300:           </div>
  301:         </div>
  302: 
  303:         <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
  304:           <ReadinessCard
  305:             title="حالة النشر"
  306:             value={validation.canPublish ? "جاهز للنشر" : "يحتاج مراجعة"}
  307:             tone={validation.canPublish ? "success" : "danger"}
  308:           />
  309: 
  310:           <ReadinessCard
  311:             title="نصوص الخدمة"
  312:             value={`${templateStats.serviceSnippetsCount} نص متاح`}
  313:             tone={templateStats.serviceSnippetsCount > 0 ? "success" : "warning"}
  314:           />
  315: 
  316:           <ReadinessCard
  317:             title="Snapshots"
  318:             value={`${templateStats.snapshotsCount} نسخة`}
  319:             tone={templateStats.snapshotsCount > 0 ? "success" : "neutral"}
  320:           />
  321:         </div>
  322: 
  323:         {!validation.canPublish ? (
  324:           <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl border border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 p-4">
  325:             <h4 className="text-xs font-black text-amber-900">
  326:               ملاحظات قبل النشر
  327:             </h4>
  328: 
  329:             <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2">
  330:               {validation.issues
  331:                 .filter((issue) => issue.severity !== "success")
  332:                 .slice(0, 4)
  333:                 .map((issue) => (
  334:                   <p
  335:                     key={issue.id}
  336:                     className="rounded-xl bg-white/70 px-3 py-2 text-xs leading-6 text-amber-800"
  337:                   >
  338:                     <span className="font-black">{issue.title}: </span>
  339:                     {issue.description}
  340:                   </p>
  341:                 ))}
  342:             </div>
  343:           </div>
  344:         ) : null}
  345:       </div>
  346: 
  347:       <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
  348:         <ActionButton
  349:           title="نشر القالب"
  350:           description="اعتماد القالب ليكون جاهزًا للموجهين."
  351:           tone="success"
  352:           onClick={publishTemplate}
  353:         />
  354: 
  355:         <ActionButton
  356:           title="إرجاع لمسودة"
  357:           description="إعادة القالب للتعديل قبل النشر."
  358:           tone="neutral"
  359:           onClick={moveToDraft}
  360:         />
  361: 
  362:         <ActionButton
  363:           title="أرشفة القالب"
  364:           description="إخفاء القالب من الاستخدام القادم."
  365:           tone="warning"
  366:           onClick={archiveTemplate}
  367:         />
  368:       </div>
  369: 
  370:       <div className="mt-5 grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-3">
  371:         <ActionButton
  372:           title="إنشاء Snapshot"
  373:           description="حفظ نسخة لحظية من القالب والنصوص."
  374:           tone="primary"
  375:           onClick={createSnapshot}
  376:         />
  377: 
  378:         <ActionButton
  379:           title="تصدير JSON"
  380:           description="تنزيل القالب والهوية والنصوص كنسخة احتياطية."
  381:           tone="neutral"
  382:           onClick={exportTemplatePackage}
  383:         />
  384: 
  385:         <ActionButton
  386:           title="استيراد JSON"
  387:           description="قراءة قالب محفوظ وتجهيزه كمسودة لاحقًا."
  388:           tone="neutral"
  389:           onClick={() => importInputRef.current?.click()}
  390:         />
  391: 
  392:         <input
  393:           ref={importInputRef}
  394:           type="file"
  395:           accept="application/json,.json"
  396:           className="hidden"
  397:           onChange={(event) => {
  398:             const file = event.currentTarget.files?.[0] || null;
  399:             importTemplatePackage(file);
  400:             event.currentTarget.value = "";
  401:           }}
  402:         />
  403:       </div>
  404: 
  405:       <SnapshotsList snapshots={snapshots} />
  406: 
  407:       {feedback.open ? (
  408:         <SmartFeedbackModal
  409:           type={feedback.type}
  410:           title={feedback.title}
  411:           message={feedback.message}
  412:           onClose={closeFeedback}
  413:         />
  414:       ) : null}
  415:     </section>
  416:   );
  417: }
  418: 
  419: function TemplateStatusBadge({ status }: { status: ReportTemplateStatus }) {
  420:   const config =
  421:     status === "PUBLISHED"
  422:       ? {
  423:           label: "منشور",
  424:           className: "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800",
  425:         }
  426:       : status === "ARCHIVED"
  427:         ? {
  428:             label: "مؤرشف",
  429:             className: "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800",
  430:           }
  431:         : {
  432:             label: "مسودة",
  433:             className: "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700",
  434:           };
  435: 
  436:   return (
  437:     <span
  438:       className={[
  439:         "rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-black",
  440:         config.className,
  441:       ].join(" ")}
  442:     >
  443:       {config.label}
  444:     </span>
  445:   );
  446: }
  447: 
  448: function MetricCard({ label, value }: { label: string; value: number }) {
  449:   return (
  450:     <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3">
  451:       <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-500">{label}</p>
  452:       <p className="mt-1 text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{value}</p>
  453:     </div>
  454:   );
  455: }
  456: 
  457: function ReadinessCard({
  458:   title,
  459:   value,
  460:   tone,
  461: }: {
  462:   title: string;
  463:   value: string;
  464:   tone: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";
  465: }) {
  466:   const toneClass = {
  467:     success: "border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800",
  468:     warning: "border-amber-200 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800",
  469:     danger: "border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-800",
  470:     neutral: "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700",
  471:   }[tone];
  472: 
  473:   return (
  474:     <div className={["rounded-2xl border p-4", toneClass].join(" ")}>
  475:       <p className="text-xs font-black opacity-80">{title}</p>
  476:       <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-black">{value}</p>
  477:     </div>
  478:   );
  479: }
  480: 
  481: function ActionButton({
  482:   title,
  483:   description,
  484:   tone,
  485:   onClick,
  486: }: {
  487:   title: string;
  488:   description: string;
  489:   tone: "primary" | "success" | "warning" | "neutral";
  490:   onClick: () => void;
  491: }) {
  492:   const toneClass = {
  493:     primary: "border-sky-100 bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 hover:bg-sky-100",
  494:     success:
  495:       "border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100",
  496:     warning: "border-amber-100 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 hover:bg-amber-100",
  497:     neutral: "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50",
  498:   }[tone];
  499: 
  500:   return (
  501:     <button
  502:       type="button"
  503:       onClick={onClick}
  504:       className={[
  505:         "rounded-3xl border p-4 text-right transition",
  506:         toneClass,
  507:       ].join(" ")}
  508:     >
  509:       <strong className="text-sm font-black">{title}</strong>
  510:       <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-6 opacity-80">{description}</p>
  511:     </button>
  512:   );
  513: }

  515: function SnapshotsList({
  516:   snapshots,
  517: }: {
  518:   snapshots: GeneratedReportSnapshot[];
  519: }) {
  520:   if (!snapshots.length) {
  521:     return (
  522:       <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 p-6 text-center">
  523:         <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  524:           لا توجد Snapshots بعد
  525:         </h3>
  526: 
  527:         <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-500">
  528:           أنشئ Snapshot قبل النشر أو قبل أي تعديل كبير حتى تحتفظ بنسخة مرجعية
  529:           من القالب.
  530:         </p>
  531:       </div>
  532:     );
  533:   }
  534: 
  535:   return (
  536:     <div className="mt-5 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">
  537:       <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
  538:         <div>
  539:           <h3 className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  540:             النسخ المحفوظة Snapshot
  541:           </h3>
  542: 
  543:           <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-6 text-slate-500">
  544:             هذه قائمة مؤقتة داخل واجهة البيلدر، وستنتقل لاحقًا إلى قاعدة
  545:             البيانات مع نظام الإصدارات.
  546:           </p>
  547:         </div>
  548: 
  549:         <span className="rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1 text-xs font-black text-slate-600">
  550:           {snapshots.length} نسخة
  551:         </span>
  552:       </div>
  553: 
  554:       <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3">
  555:         {snapshots.slice(0, 5).map((snapshot, index) => {
  556:           const normalized = normalizeSnapshot(snapshot, index);
  557: 
  558:           return (
  559:             <div
  560:               key={normalized.id}
  561:               className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4"
  562:             >
  563:               <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
  564:                 <div>
  565:                   <p className="text-sm font-black text-slate-900">
  566:                     {normalized.title}
  567:                   </p>
  568: 
  569:                   <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
  570:                     {normalized.createdAt}
  571:                   </p>
  572:                 </div>
  573: 
  574:                 <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-[11px] font-black">
  575:                   <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-slate-600">
  576:                     {normalized.status}
  577:                   </span>
  578: 
  579:                   <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-emerald-700">
  580:                     {normalized.pagesCount} صفحات
  581:                   </span>
  582: 
  583:                   <span className="rounded-full bg-sky-50 px-2.5 py-1 text-sky-700">
  584:                     {normalized.snippetsCount} نصوص
  585:                   </span>
  586:                 </div>
  587:               </div>
  588:             </div>
  589:           );
  590:         })}
  591:       </div>
  592:     </div>
  593:   );
  594: }
  595: 
  596: function SmartFeedbackModal({
  597:   type,
  598:   title,
  599:   message,
  600:   onClose,
  601: }: {
  602:   type: "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info";
  603:   title: string;
  604:   message: string;
  605:   onClose: () => void;
  606: }) {
  607:   const config = {
  608:     success: {
  609:       icon: "✓",
  610:       iconClass: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700",
  611:       buttonClass: "bg-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-900",
  612:     },
  613:     error: {
  614:       icon: "!",
  615:       iconClass: "bg-red-50 text-red-700",
  616:       buttonClass: "bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700",
  617:     },
  618:     warning: {
  619:       icon: "!",
  620:       iconClass: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700",
  621:       buttonClass: "bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700",
  622:     },
  623:     info: {
  624:       icon: "i",
  625:       iconClass: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700",
  626:       buttonClass: "bg-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-800",
  627:     },
  628:   }[type];
  629: 
  630:   return (
  631:     <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[120] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/40 px-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
  632:       <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl">
  633:         <div
  634:           className={[
  635:             "mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl text-2xl font-black",
  636:             config.iconClass,
  637:           ].join(" ")}
  638:         >
  639:           {config.icon}
  640:         </div>
  641: 
  642:         <div className="mt-4 text-center">
  643:           <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{title}</h2>
  644: 
  645:           <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-500">{message}</p>
  646:         </div>
  647: 
  648:         <button
  649:           type="button"
  650:           onClick={onClose}
  651:           className={[
  652:             "mt-6 w-full rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 text-sm font-black text-white transition",
  653:             config.buttonClass,
  654:           ].join(" ")}
  655:         >
  656:           إغلاق
  657:         </button>
  658:       </div>
  659:     </div>
  660:   );
  661: }
  662: 
  663: function buildSafeFileName(value: string) {
  664:   const cleaned = value
  665:     .replace(/[^\u0600-\u06FFa-zA-Z0-9-_ ]/g, "")
  666:     .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
  667:     .slice(0, 80);
  668: 
  669:   return cleaned || "report-template";
  670: }
  671: 
  672: function validatePortableTemplatePackage(
  673:   value: unknown
  674: ): PortableTemplatePackage {
  675:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
  676:     throw new Error("ملف القالب غير صالح.");
  677:   }
  678: 
  679:   const packageData = value as Partial<PortableTemplatePackage>;
  680: 
  681:   if (packageData.version !== 1) {
  682:     throw new Error("إصدار ملف القالب غير مدعوم.");
  683:   }
  684: 
  685:   if (
  686:     packageData.source !==
  687:     "student-guidance-platform-report-template-builder"
  688:   ) {
  689:     throw new Error("مصدر ملف القالب غير معروف.");
  690:   }
  691: 
  692:   if (!packageData.template || typeof packageData.template !== "object") {
  693:     throw new Error("الملف لا يحتوي على بيانات قالب صحيحة.");
  694:   }
  695: 
  696:   if (!packageData.identity || typeof packageData.identity !== "object") {
  697:     throw new Error("الملف لا يحتوي على إعدادات هوية صحيحة.");
  698:   }
  699: 
  700:   if (!Array.isArray(packageData.snippets)) {
  701:     throw new Error("الملف لا يحتوي على مكتبة نصوص صحيحة.");
  702:   }
  703: 
  704:   return packageData as PortableTemplatePackage;
  705: }
  706: 
  707: function normalizeSnapshot(snapshot: GeneratedReportSnapshot, index: number) {
  708:   const value = snapshot as unknown as {
  709:     id?: string;
  710:     templateName?: string;
  711:     name?: string;
  712:     title?: string;
  713:     createdAt?: string;
  714:     status?: string;
  715:     pagesCount?: number;
  716:     snippetsCount?: number;
  717:   };
  718: 
  719:   return {
  720:     id: value.id || `snapshot-${index}`,
  721:     title: value.templateName || value.name || value.title || `Snapshot ${index + 1}`,
  722:     createdAt: value.createdAt
  723:       ? formatDateTime(value.createdAt)
  724:       : "وقت غير محدد",
  725:     status: value.status || "محفوظ",
  726:     pagesCount: value.pagesCount || 0,
  727:     snippetsCount: value.snippetsCount || 0,
  728:   };
  729: }
  730: 
  731: function formatDateTime(value: string) {
  732:   try {
  733:     return new Date(value).toLocaleString("ar-SA");
  734:   } catch {
  735:     return value;
  736:   }
  737: }

  336: function createBlock(kind: BlockKind): StudioBlock {
  337:   const item = blockLibrary.find((block) => block.kind === kind) || blockLibrary[2];
  338: 
  339:   return {
  340:     id: makeId(kind),
  341:     kind: item.kind,
  342:     title: item.title,
  343:     content: item.defaultContent,

  345:     source: "manual",
  346:     boundFieldKey: undefined,
  347:     hideWhenMissing: false,
  348:     showTitle: item.kind !== "plain-text" && item.kind !== "hero-title",
  349:     showMeta: item.kind === "hero-title" || item.kind === "meta-strip",
  350:     align: item.defaultAlign || "right",
  351:     placement: item.kind === "hero-title" ? "middle-center" : "flow",
  352:     titleFontSize: "base",
  353:     contentFontSize: "base",
  354:     fieldLabelFontSize: "sm",
  355:     fieldValueFontSize: "base",
  356:     evidenceLayout: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? "TWO_PER_PAGE" : undefined,
  357:     evidenceFit: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? "contain" : undefined,
  358:     evidenceAspectRatio: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? "LANDSCAPE_4_3" : undefined,
  359:     evidenceShowCaptions: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? true : undefined,
  360:     evidenceAutoCreatePages: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? true : undefined,
  361:     evidenceEmptyBehavior: item.kind === "evidence-gallery" ? "message" : undefined,
  362:   };

  429: function buildRuntimeContext(template: StudioTemplate, previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null) {

  438:   return {

  440:     "identity.educationDepartment": "الإدارة العامة للتعليم",
  441:     "identity.educationOffice": "مكتب التعليم",
  442:     "identity.schoolName": "اسم المدرسة",
  443:     "identity.counselorName": "اسم الموجه/الموجهة",
  444:     "identity.principalName": "اسم مدير/مديرة المدرسة",
  445: 
  446:     "template.name": template.name,
  447:     "template.description": template.description,
  448: 
  449:     "case.id": previewCase?.caseId || "CASE-ID",
  450:     "case.title": previewCase?.title || "عنوان التقارير",
  451:     "case.status": previewCase?.status || "مسودة",
  452:     "case.createdAt": formatDate(previewCase?.createdAt) || "1447/01/01 هـ",
  453:     "case.updatedAt": formatDate(previewCase?.updatedAt) || "1447/01/01 هـ",
  454: 
  455:     "service.name": previewCase?.serviceName || getServiceName(template.serviceSlug) || "الخدمة الإرشادية",
  456:     "service.slug": previewCase?.serviceSlug || template.serviceSlug || "general",
  457: 
  458:     "student.name": previewCase?.student?.name || "اسم الطالب/الطالبة",
  459:     "student.grade": previewCase?.student?.grade || "الصف",
  460:     "student.classroom": previewCase?.student?.classroom || "الفصل",
  461:     "student.stage": previewCase?.student?.stage || "المرحلة",
  462:     "student.guardianName": previewCase?.student?.guardianName || "اسم ولي الأمر",
  463:     "student.guardianPhone": previewCase?.student?.guardianPhone || "رقم ولي الأمر",
  464: 
  465:     "evidence.count": String(
  466:       filterValidReportEvidenceItems(previewCase?.evidences || [], {
  467:         allowSampleEvidence: !previewCase?.caseId,
  468:       }).length,
  469:     ),
  470: 
  471:     ...values,
  472:   };
  473: }

  476: 
  477: function getServiceName(slug?: string) {
  478:   return SERVICE_OPTIONS.find((service) => service.slug === slug)?.name || "";
  479: }
  480: 
  481: function formatDate(value?: string) {
  482:   if (!value) return "";
  483: 
  484:   try {
  485:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA", {
  486:       dateStyle: "medium",
  487:     }).format(new Date(value));
  488:   } catch {
  489:     return value;
  490:   }
  491: }
  492: 
  493: function renderText(text: string, context: Record<string, string>) {
  494:   return text.replace(/{{\s*([^}]+)\s*}}/g, (_, key: string) => {
  495:     const cleanKey = key.trim();
  496:     return context[cleanKey] || `{{${cleanKey}}}`;
  497:   });
  498: }
  499: 
  500: function splitLines(text: string) {
  501:   return text
  502:     .split(/\n+/)
  503:     .map((line) => line.trim())
  504:     .filter(Boolean);
  505: }
  506: 
  507: function splitParagraphs(text: string) {
  508:   return text
  509:     .split(/\n\s*\n/)
  510:     .map((line) => line.trim())
  511:     .filter(Boolean);
  512: }
  513: 
  514: function extractUsedWorkflowFieldKeys(template: StudioTemplate) {
  515:   const keys = new Set<string>();
  516:   const regex = /{{\s*field\.([^}\s]+)\s*}}/g;
  517: 
  518:   for (const page of template.pages) {
  519:     for (const block of page.blocks) {
  520:       const content = `${block.title}\n${block.content}`;
  521:       let match = regex.exec(content);
  522: 
  523:       while (match) {
  524:         keys.add(match[1]);
  525:         match = regex.exec(content);
  526:       }
  527:     }
  528:   }
  529: 
  530:   return keys;
  531: }
  532: 
  533: function groupWorkflowFields(fields: WorkflowFieldOption[]) {
  534:   const groups = new Map<string, WorkflowFieldOption[]>();
  535: 
  536:   for (const field of fields) {
  537:     const groupName = field.stepTitle || "حقول عامة";
  538:     const current = groups.get(groupName) || [];
  539:     current.push(field);
  540:     groups.set(groupName, current);
  541:   }
  542: 
  543:   return Array.from(groups.entries()).map(([stepTitle, items]) => ({
  544:     stepTitle,
  545:     fields: items,
  546:   }));
  547: }
  548: 
  549: function parseSavedTemplateJson(item: any) {
  550:   const raw = item?.templateJson ?? item?.content ?? null;
  551: 
  552:   if (!raw) return null;
  553: 
  554:   if (typeof raw === "string") {
  555:     try {
  556:       return JSON.parse(raw);
  557:     } catch {
  558:       return null;
  559:     }
  560:   }
  561: 
  562:   if (typeof raw === "object") {
  563:     return raw;
  564:   }
  565: 
  566:   return null;
  567: }
  568: 
  569: function hydrateStudioTemplateFromSavedItem(item: any): StudioTemplate {
  570:   const templateJson = parseSavedTemplateJson(item) || {};
  571:   const smartStudio = templateJson?.smartStudio || {};
  572:   const fallback = createInitialTemplate();
  573: 
  574:   const pages =
  575:     Array.isArray(smartStudio?.pages) && smartStudio.pages.length
  576:       ? smartStudio.pages
  577:       : Array.isArray(templateJson?.pages) && templateJson.pages.length
  578:         ? templateJson.pages.map((page: any, pageIndex: number) => ({
  579:             id: page.id || makeId("page-loaded"),
  580:             kind:
  581:               page.kind === "approval"
  582:                 ? "approval"
  583:                 : page.kind === "evidence"
  584:                   ? "evidence"
  585:                   : pageIndex === 0
  586:                     ? "content"
  587:                     : "custom",
  588:             title: page.title || `صفحة ${pageIndex + 1}`,
  589:             description: page.description || "صفحة مستوردة من قالب محفوظ.",
  590:             blocks: Array.isArray(page.blocks)
  591:               ? page.blocks.map((block: any) => ({
  592:                   id: block.id || makeId("block-loaded"),
  593:                   kind:
  594:                     block.settings?.smartBlockKind ||
  595:                     block.source?.fieldKey ||
  596:                     "section-text",
  597:                   title: block.title || block.customTitle || "بلوك",
  598:                   content:
  599:                     block.customContent ||
  600:                     block.content ||
  601:                     block.source?.description ||
  602:                     "",
  603:                   variant: block.settings?.style || "card",
  604:                   source:
  605:                     block.source?.source === "library" ||
  606:                     block.source?.source === "workflow"
  607:                       ? block.source.source
  608:                       : "manual",
  609:                   snippetId: block.settings?.snippetId || undefined,
  610:                   boundFieldKey: block.settings?.boundFieldKey || undefined,
  611:                   hideWhenMissing: Boolean(block.settings?.hideWhenMissing),
  612:                   showTitle: block.settings?.showTitle !== false,
  613:                   showMeta: Boolean(block.settings?.showMeta),
  614:                   align: block.settings?.align || "right",
  615:                   placement: block.settings?.placement || "flow",
  616:                   titleFontSize: block.settings?.titleFontSize || block.titleFontSize || "base",
  617:                   contentFontSize: block.settings?.contentFontSize || block.contentFontSize || "base",
  618:                   fieldLabelFontSize: block.settings?.fieldLabelFontSize || block.fieldLabelFontSize || "sm",
  619:                   fieldValueFontSize: block.settings?.fieldValueFontSize || block.fieldValueFontSize || "base",
  620:                   evidenceLayout: block.settings?.evidenceLayout || undefined,
  621:                   evidenceFit: block.settings?.evidenceFit || undefined,
  622:                   evidenceAspectRatio: block.settings?.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3",
  623:                   evidenceShowCaptions: block.settings?.evidenceShowCaptions !== false,
  624:                   evidenceAutoCreatePages: block.settings?.evidenceAutoCreatePages !== false,
  625:                   evidenceEmptyBehavior: block.settings?.evidenceEmptyBehavior || "message",
  626:                 }))
  627:               : [createBlock("section-text")],
  628:           }))
  629:         : fallback.pages;
  630: 
  631:   return {
  632:     ...fallback,
  633:     id: templateJson.id || item?.id || fallback.id,
  634:     designTemplateId:
  635:       templateJson.designTemplateId ||
  636:       smartStudio.designTemplateId ||
  637:       "ministry-form",
  638:     name: item?.name || templateJson.name || fallback.name,
  639:     description:
  640:       item?.description || templateJson.description || fallback.description,
  641:     status:
  642:       templateJson.status === "PUBLISHED" ||
  643:       templateJson.status === "ARCHIVED" ||
  644:       templateJson.status === "DRAFT"
  645:         ? templateJson.status
  646:         : item?.isActive === false
  647:           ? "ARCHIVED"
  648:           : "DRAFT",
  649:     scope:
  650:       templateJson.scope ||
  651:       templateJson?.workflowBinding?.scope ||
  652:       (item?.serviceSlug ? "SERVICE" : "GLOBAL"),
  653:     serviceSlug:
  654:       item?.serviceSlug ||
  655:       templateJson.serviceSlug ||
  656:       templateJson?.workflowBinding?.serviceSlug ||
  657:       undefined,
  658:     workflowSlug:
  659:       templateJson.workflowSlug ||
  660:       templateJson?.workflowBinding?.workflowSlug ||
  661:       undefined,
  662:     locationKey:
  663:       templateJson.locationKey ||
  664:       templateJson?.workflowBinding?.locationKey ||
  665:       undefined,
  666:     previewCaseId: templateJson.previewCaseId || "",
  667:     updatedAt:
  668:       item?.updatedAt ||
  669:       templateJson.updatedAt ||
  670:       new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  671:     designConfig: {
  672:       header: normalizeReportHeaderSettings(
  673:         templateJson?.designConfig?.header ??
  674:           smartStudio?.designConfig?.header ??
  675:           DEFAULT_REPORT_HEADER_SETTINGS,
  676:       ),
  677:     },
  678:     pages,
  679:   } as StudioTemplate;
  680: }

  682: export function ReportTemplateStudio() {
  683:   const [template, setTemplate] = useState<StudioTemplate>(() => createInitialTemplate());
  684:   const [activePageId, setActivePageId] = useState(() => template.pages[0]?.id || "");
  685:   const [selectedBlockId, setSelectedBlockId] = useState(() => template.pages[0]?.blocks[0]?.id || "");
  686:   const [savedTemplateId, setSavedTemplateId] = useState("");
  687:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  688:   const [testingCase, setTestingCase] = useState(false);
  689:   const [previewCase, setPreviewCase] = useState<PreviewCaseData | null>(null);
  690:   const [workflowFields, setWorkflowFields] = useState<WorkflowFieldOption[]>([]);
  691:   const [workflowMessage, setWorkflowMessage] = useState("اختر خدمة أو Workflow لعرض الحقول المتاحة.");
  692:   const [loadingWorkflow, setLoadingWorkflow] = useState(false);
  693:   const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{
  694:     type: "success" | "error" | "info";
  695:     message: string;
  696:   } | null>(null);
  697: 
  698:   const activePage = useMemo(
  699:     () => template.pages.find((page) => page.id === activePageId) || template.pages[0],
  700:     [template.pages, activePageId],
  701:   );
  702: 
  703:   const selectedBlock = useMemo(
  704:     () =>
  705:       activePage?.blocks.find((block) => block.id === selectedBlockId) ||
  706:       template.pages.flatMap((page) => page.blocks).find((block) => block.id === selectedBlockId) ||
  707:       null,
  708:     [activePage?.blocks, selectedBlockId, template.pages],
  709:   );
  710: 
  711:   const runtimeContext = useMemo(
  712:     () => buildRuntimeContext(template, previewCase),
  713:     [template, previewCase],
  714:   );
  715: 
  716:   useEffect(() => {
  717:     let isMounted = true;
  718: 
  719:     async function loadTemplateFromQuery() {
  720:       const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  721:       const templateId = params.get("templateId");
  722:       const designTemplateId = params.get("designTemplateId");
  723: 
  724:       if (!templateId) {
  725:         if (
  726:           designTemplateId &&
  727:           isSelectableReportDesignId(designTemplateId)
  728:         ) {
  729:           setTemplate((current) => ({
  730:             ...current,
  731:             designTemplateId: designTemplateId as ReportDesignId,
  732:           }));
  733: 
  734:           setFeedback({
  735:             type: "success",
  736:             message: "تم تطبيق التصميم المختار داخل الاستديو.",
  737:           });
  738:         }
  739: 
  740:         return;
  741:       }
  742: 
  743:       try {
  744:         const cached = sessionStorage.getItem("template-studio-selected");
  745: 
  746:         if (cached) {
  747:           const cachedItem = JSON.parse(cached);
  748: 
  749:           if (String(cachedItem?.id || "") === templateId) {
  750:             const hydrated = hydrateStudioTemplateFromSavedItem(cachedItem);
  751: 
  752:             if (!isMounted) return;
  753: 
  754:             setTemplate(hydrated);
  755:             setSavedTemplateId(templateId);
  756:             setActivePageId(hydrated.pages[0]?.id || "");
  757:             setSelectedBlockId(hydrated.pages[0]?.blocks[0]?.id || "");
  758:             sessionStorage.removeItem("template-studio-selected");
  759: 
  760:             setFeedback({
  761:               type: "success",
  762:               message: "تم فتح القالب المحفوظ داخل الاستديو.",
  763:             });
  764: 
  765:             return;
  766:           }
  767:         }
  768: 
  769:         const response = await fetch(
  770:           `/api/dashboard/report-templates/${encodeURIComponent(templateId)}`,
  771:           { cache: "no-store" },
  772:         );
  773: 
  774:         const result = await response.json();
  775: 
  776:         if (!response.ok) {
  777:           throw new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "تعذر تحميل القالب.");
  778:         }
  779: 
  780:         const item = result?.template || result?.data || result;
  781:         const hydrated = hydrateStudioTemplateFromSavedItem(item);
  782: 
  783:         if (!isMounted) return;
  784: 
  785:         setTemplate(hydrated);
  786:         setSavedTemplateId(templateId);
  787:         setActivePageId(hydrated.pages[0]?.id || "");
  788:         setSelectedBlockId(hydrated.pages[0]?.blocks[0]?.id || "");
  789:         setFeedback({
  790:           type: "success",
  791:           message: "تم تحميل القالب المحفوظ داخل الاستديو.",
  792:         });
  793:       } catch (error) {
  794:         if (!isMounted) return;
  795: 
  796:         setFeedback({
  797:           type: "error",
  798:           message:
  799:             error instanceof Error
  800:               ? error.message
  801:               : "تعذر فتح القالب من المكتبة.",
  802:         });
  803:       }
  804:     }
  805: 
  806:     loadTemplateFromQuery();
  807: 
  808:     return () => {
  809:       isMounted = false;
  810:     };
  811:   }, []);
  812: 
  813:   const usedWorkflowFieldKeys = useMemo(
  814:     () => extractUsedWorkflowFieldKeys(template),
  815:     [template],
  816:   );
  817: 
  818:   useEffect(() => {
  819:     let isMounted = true;
  820: 
  821:     async function loadWorkflowFields() {
  822:       if (template.scope === "GLOBAL" || template.scope === "LOCATION") {
  823:         setWorkflowFields([]);
  824:         setWorkflowMessage("هذا القالب غير مربوط بخدمة أو Workflow حاليًا.");
  825:         return;
  826:       }
  827: 
  828:       if (!template.serviceSlug) {
  829:         setWorkflowFields([]);
  830:         setWorkflowMessage("اختر الخدمة أولًا حتى تظهر حقول الـ Workflow المرتبطة بها.");
  831:         return;
  832:       }
  833: 
  834:       try {
  835:         setLoadingWorkflow(true);
  836: 
  837:         const response = await fetch(
  838:           `/api/admin/report-templates/workflow-fields?serviceSlug=${encodeURIComponent(
  839:             template.serviceSlug,
  840:           )}`,
  841:           { cache: "no-store" },
  842:         );
  843: 
  844:         const result = await response.json();
  845: 
  846:         if (!isMounted) return;
  847: 
  848:         setWorkflowFields(Array.isArray(result?.fields) ? result.fields : []);
  849:         setWorkflowMessage(
  850:           result?.message ||
  851:             "تم جلب الحقول المتاحة. اختر المتغيرات المناسبة وأدرجها في البلوكات.",
  852:         );
  853:       } catch {
  854:         if (!isMounted) return;
  855: 
  856:         setWorkflowFields([]);
  857:         setWorkflowMessage("تعذر جلب حقول الـ Workflow. يمكن الاستمرار بالنصوص اليدوية مؤقتًا.");
  858:       } finally {
  859:         if (isMounted) {
  860:           setLoadingWorkflow(false);
  861:         }
  862:       }
  863:     }
  864: 
  865:     loadWorkflowFields();
  866: 
  867:     return () => {
  868:       isMounted = false;
  869:     };
  870:   }, [template.scope, template.serviceSlug, template.workflowSlug]);
  871: 
  872:   function updateTemplate(next: Partial<StudioTemplate>) {
  873:     setTemplate((current) => ({
  874:       ...current,
  875:       ...next,
  876:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  877:     }));

  880:   function updatePage(pageId: string, updater: (page: StudioPage) => StudioPage) {
  881:     setTemplate((current) => ({

  884:       pages: current.pages.map((page) => (page.id === pageId ? updater(page) : page)),
  885:     }));

  888:   function updateBlock(blockId: string, updater: (block: StudioBlock) => StudioBlock) {
  889:     setTemplate((current) => ({

  894:         blocks: page.blocks.map((block) =>
  895:           block.id === blockId ? updater(block) : block,
  896:         ),
  897:       })),
  898:     }));
  899:   }

  914:   function removeActivePage() {
  915:     if (!activePage || template.pages.length <= 1) {
  916:       return;
  917:     }
  918: 
  919:     const remainingPages = template.pages.filter((page) => page.id !== activePage.id);
  920:

  928:     setSelectedBlockId(remainingPages[0]?.blocks[0]?.id || "");

  931:   function addBlock(kind: BlockKind) {
  932:     if (!activePage) return;
  933: 
  934:     const block = createBlock(kind);
  935: 
  936:     updatePage(activePage.id, (page) => ({
  937:       ...page,
  938:       blocks: [...page.blocks, block],
  939:     }));
  940:

  944:   function removeSelectedBlock() {
  945:     if (!selectedBlock || !activePage || activePage.blocks.length <= 1) {
  946:       return;
  947:     }
  948: 
  949:     const remaining = activePage.blocks.filter((block) => block.id !== selectedBlock.id);
  950: 
  951:     updatePage(activePage.id, (page) => ({
  952:       ...page,
  953:       blocks: remaining,
  954:     }));
  955: 
  956:     setSelectedBlockId(remaining[0]?.id || "");
  957:   }
  958: 
  959:   function moveBlock(direction: "up" | "down") {
  960:     if (!selectedBlock || !activePage) return;
  961: 
  962:     const index = activePage.blocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === selectedBlock.id);
  963:     if (index === -1) return;
  964: 
  965:     const targetIndex = direction === "up" ? index - 1 : index + 1;
  966:     if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= activePage.blocks.length) return;
  967: 
  968:     const nextBlocks = [...activePage.blocks];
  969:     const [block] = nextBlocks.splice(index, 1);
  970:     nextBlocks.splice(targetIndex, 0, block);
  971: 
  972:     updatePage(activePage.id, (page) => ({
  973:       ...page,
  974:       blocks: nextBlocks,
  975:     }));
  976:   }
  977: 
  978:   function applySnippet(snippetId: string) {
  979:     if (!selectedBlock) return;
  980: 
  981:     const snippet = textSnippets.find((item) => item.id === snippetId);
  982:     if (!snippet) return;
  983: 
  984:     updateBlock(selectedBlock.id, (block) => ({
  985:       ...block,
  986:       source: "library",
  987:       snippetId,
  988:       title: block.title || snippet.title,
  989:       content: snippet.content,
  990:     }));
  991:   }

  993:   function insertVariable(variable: string) {
  994:     if (!selectedBlock) {
  995:       setFeedback({
  996:         type: "info",
  997:         message: "اختر بلوكًا أولًا حتى يتم إدراج المتغير داخله.",
  998:       });
  999:       return;
 1000:     }
 1001: 
 1002:     updateBlock(selectedBlock.id, (block) => ({
 1003:       ...block,
 1004:       content: `${block.content}${block.content.trim() ? " " : ""}${variable}`,
 1005:     }));
 1006:   }

 1008:   async function runCaseTest() {
 1009:     const caseId = template.previewCaseId.trim();
 1010:

 1014:         type: "info",
 1015:         message: "لم يتم إدخال Case ID. سيتم عرض بيانات تجريبية داخل المعاينة.",
 1016:       });
 1017:       return;
 1018:     }
 1019: 
 1020:     try {
 1021:       setTestingCase(true);
 1022: 
 1023:       const response = await fetch(
 1024:         `/api/admin/report-templates/preview-case?caseId=${encodeURIComponent(
 1025:           caseId,
 1026:         )}`,
 1027:         { cache: "no-store" },
 1028:       );
 1029: 
 1030:       const result = await response.json();
 1031: 
 1032:       setPreviewCase(result?.data || null);
 1033:       setFeedback({
 1034:         type: result?.data ? "success" : "info",
 1035:         message:
 1036:           result?.message ||

 1038:       });
 1039:     } catch {
 1040:       setPreviewCase(null);
 1041:       setFeedback({
 1042:         type: "error",
 1043:         message: "تعذر اختبار Case ID. راجع الرقم أو جرّب لاحقًا.",
 1044:       });
 1045:     } finally {
 1046:       setTestingCase(false);
 1047:     }

 1050:   function toReportTemplateJson(status: TemplateStatus) {
 1051:     return {
 1052:       id: template.id,
 1053:       name: template.name,
 1054:       description: template.description,
 1055:       scope: template.scope,
 1056:       serviceSlug: template.serviceSlug || undefined,
 1057:       workflowSlug: template.workflowSlug || undefined,
 1058:       locationKey: template.locationKey || undefined,
 1059:       status,
 1060:       documentType: template.documentType,
 1061:       designTemplateId: template.designTemplateId || "ministry-form",
 1062:       designPreset: "official-smart-multi-page",
 1063:       designConfig: template.designConfig,
 1064:       previewCaseId: template.previewCaseId,
 1065:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
 1066:       officialLayout: {
 1067:         pageSize: "A4",
 1068:         ministryLogoOnly: true,
 1069:         headerLocked: true,
 1070:         identityLocked: true,
 1071:         multiPage: true,
 1072:       },
 1073:       workflowBinding: {
 1074:         scope: template.scope,
 1075:         serviceSlug: template.serviceSlug || null,
 1076:         workflowSlug: template.workflowSlug || null,
 1077:         locationKey: template.locationKey || null,
 1078:         fields: workflowFields,
 1079:         usedFieldKeys: Array.from(usedWorkflowFieldKeys),
 1080:       },
 1081:       pages: template.pages.map((page) => ({
 1082:         id: page.id,
 1083:         kind: page.kind === "approval" ? "approval" : page.kind === "evidence" ? "evidence" : "narrative",
 1084:         title: page.title,
 1085:         description: page.description,
 1086:         blocks: page.blocks.map((block) => ({
 1087:           id: block.id,
 1088:           kind: "custom-paragraph",
 1089:           title: block.title,
 1090:           customTitle: block.showTitle ? block.title : "",
 1091:           customContent: block.content,
 1092:           required: false,
 1093:           source: {
 1094:             source: block.source,
 1095:             label: block.source === "library" ? "مكتبة النصوص" : "كتابة مباشرة",
 1096:             description: "بلوك من الاستديو الرسمي الذكي متعدد الصفحات",
 1097:             fieldKey: block.kind,
 1098:           },
 1099:           settings: {
 1100:             smartBlockKind: block.kind,
 1101:             style: block.variant,
 1102:             showTitle: block.showTitle,
 1103:             showMeta: block.showMeta,
 1104:             align: block.align,
 1105:             placement: block.placement || "flow",
 1106:             titleFontSize: block.titleFontSize || "base",
 1107:             contentFontSize: block.contentFontSize || "base",
 1108:             fieldLabelFontSize: block.fieldLabelFontSize || "sm",
 1109:             fieldValueFontSize: block.fieldValueFontSize || "base",
 1110:             evidenceLayout: block.evidenceLayout || null,
 1111:             evidenceFit: block.evidenceFit || null,
 1112:             evidenceAspectRatio: block.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3",
 1113:             evidenceShowCaptions: block.evidenceShowCaptions !== false,
 1114:             evidenceAutoCreatePages: block.evidenceAutoCreatePages !== false,
 1115:             evidenceEmptyBehavior: block.evidenceEmptyBehavior || "message",
 1116:             snippetId: block.snippetId || null,
 1117:           },
 1118:         })),
 1119:       })),
 1120:       smartStudio: {
 1121:         version: 2,
 1122:         mode: "multi-page-workflow-aware",
 1123:         designTemplateId: template.designTemplateId || "ministry-form",
 1124:         designConfig: template.designConfig,
 1125:         pages: template.pages,
 1126:       },
 1127:     };
 1128:   }

 1130:   async function saveTemplate(nextStatus: TemplateStatus = template.status) {
 1131:     try {
 1132:       setSaving(true);
 1133: 
 1134:       const templateJson = toReportTemplateJson(nextStatus);
 1135: 
 1136:       const payload = {
 1137:         name: template.name || "القالب الرسمي الذكي",
 1138:         description: template.description || "قالب رسمي ذكي متعدد الصفحات.",
 1139:         serviceSlug:
 1140:           template.scope === "SERVICE" || template.scope === "WORKFLOW"
 1141:             ? template.serviceSlug || null
 1142:             : null,
 1143:         type: "SCHOOL",
 1144:         content: JSON.stringify(templateJson),
 1145:         templateJson,
 1146:         genderAware: true,
 1147:         isActive: nextStatus !== "ARCHIVED",
 1148:       };
 1149: 
 1150:       const response = savedTemplateId
 1151:         ? await fetch(`/api/dashboard/report-templates/${savedTemplateId}`, {
 1152:             method: "PATCH",
 1153:             headers: {
 1154:               "Content-Type": "application/json",
 1155:             },
 1156:             body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 1157:           })
 1158:         : await fetch("/api/dashboard/report-templates", {
 1159:             method: "POST",
 1160:             headers: {
 1161:               "Content-Type": "application/json",
 1162:             },
 1163:             body: JSON.stringify(payload),
 1164:           });
 1165: 
 1166:       const result = await response.json();
 1167: 
 1168:       if (!response.ok) {
 1169:         throw new Error(result?.error || result?.message || "تعذر حفظ القالب.");
 1170:       }
 1171: 
 1172:       const nextSavedId =
 1173:         result?.template?.id || result?.data?.id || result?.id || savedTemplateId;
 1174: 
 1175:       if (nextSavedId) {
 1176:         setSavedTemplateId(nextSavedId);
 1177:       }
 1178: 
 1179:       setTemplate((current) => ({
 1180:         ...current,
 1181:         status: nextStatus,
 1182:         updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
 1183:       }));
 1184: 
 1185:       setFeedback({
 1186:         type: "success",
 1187:         message:
 1188:           nextStatus === "PUBLISHED"
 1189:             ? "تم حفظ القالب ونشره بنجاح."
 1190:             : "تم حفظ مسودة القالب بنجاح.",
 1191:       });
 1192:     } catch (error) {
 1193:       setFeedback({
 1194:         type: "error",
 1195:         message:
 1196:           error instanceof Error
 1197:             ? error.message
 1198:             : "حدث خطأ غير متوقع أثناء حفظ القالب.",
 1199:       });
 1200:     } finally {
 1201:       setSaving(false);
 1202:     }
 1203:   }
 1204: 
 1205:   return (
 1206:     <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f5f8f6]" dir="rtl">
 1207:       <header className="border-b border-emerald-100 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur">
 1208:         <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-[1640px] flex-col gap-4 px-6 py-5 xl:flex-row xl:items-center xl:justify-between">
 1209:           <div>
 1210:             <p className="text-sm font-black text-emerald-700">
 1211:               استديو القوالب الرسمي
 1212:             </p>
 1213: 
 1214:             <h1 className="mt-1 text-2xl font-black text-slate-950">
 1215:               قالب رسمي ذكي متعدد الصفحات
 1216:             </h1>
 1217: 
 1218:             <p className="mt-2 max-w-4xl text-sm leading-7 text-slate-500">
 1219:               الهوية ثابتة، والصفحات والبلوكات هي منطقة التحكم. عند ربط القالب
 1220:               بخدمة أو Workflow ستظهر خريطة الحقول المتاحة حتى تعرف ماذا تستخدم
 1221:               داخل التقارير.
 1222:             </p>
 1223:           </div>
 1224: 
 1225:           <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
 1226:             <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-4 py-2 text-xs font-black text-emerald-700">
 1227:               {statusLabels[template.status]}
 1228:             </span>
 1229: 
 1230:             <a
 1231:               href="/dashboard/admin/report-templates/designs"
 1232:               className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50 px-5 py-3 text-sm font-black text-emerald-800 shadow-sm transition hover:bg-emerald-100"
 1233:             >
 1234:               معرض التصاميم
 1235:             </a>
 1236: 
 1237:             <a
 1238:               href="/dashboard/admin/report-templates/library"

 2478: function HeaderSettingsPanel({
 2479:   settings,
 2480:   onChange,
 2481: }: {
 2482:   settings: ReportHeaderSettings;
 2483:   onChange: (settings: ReportHeaderSettings) => void;
 2484: }) {
 2485:   type NumericHeaderKey =
 2486:     | "heightPx"
 2487:     | "paddingTopPx"
 2488:     | "paddingBottomPx"
 2489:     | "paddingInlinePx"
 2490:     | "itemGapPx"
 2491:     | "logoSizePx"
 2492:     | "headerFontSizePx"
 2493:     | "titleFontSizePx"
 2494:     | "subtitleFontSizePx"
 2495:     | "lineHeight";
 2496: 
 2497:   function updateNumber(key: NumericHeaderKey, value: string) {
 2498:     onChange({
 2499:       ...settings,
 2500:       [key]: Number(value),
 2501:     });
 2502:   }
 2503: 
 2504:   const numberControls: Array<{
 2505:     key: Exclude<NumericHeaderKey, "lineHeight">;

 2518:       key: "subtitleFontSizePx",

 2634:     </details>

 2669: function PreviewBlock({
 2670:   block,
 2671:   context,
 2672:   previewCase,
 2673: }: {
 2674:   block: StudioBlock;
 2675:   context: Record<string, string>;
 2676:   previewCase: PreviewCaseData | null;
 2677: }) {
 2678:   const rendered = renderText(block.content, context);
 2679:   const textAlign = block.align === "center" ? "text-center" : "text-right";
 2680: 
 2681:   if (block.hideWhenMissing && block.boundFieldKey) {
 2682:     const fieldValue = String(context[`field.${block.boundFieldKey}`] || "").trim();
 2683: 
 2684:     if (!fieldValue) {
 2685:       return null;
 2686:     }
 2687:   }
 2688: 
 2689:   if (block.kind === "hero-title") {
 2690:     return (
 2691:       <section className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-5 text-center">
 2692:         <p className="text-xs font-black text-emerald-700">
 2693:           {context["service.name"]}
 2694:         </p>
 2695:         <h1 className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-[145mm] text-3xl font-black leading-[1.7] text-slate-950">
 2696:           {rendered}
 2697:         </h1>
 2698:         {block.showMeta ? (
 2699:           <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-500">
 2700:             <span className="rounded-full bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-1">
 2701:               {context["case.createdAt"]}
 2702:             </span>
 2703:             <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1">
 2704:               {context["identity.counselorName"]}
 2705:             </span>
 2706:           </div>
 2707:         ) : null}
 2708:       </section>
 2709:     );
 2710:   }
 2711: 
 2712:   if (block.kind === "meta-strip") {
 2713:     return (
 2714:       <section className="rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 p-4">
 2715:         <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
 2716:           {splitLines(rendered).map((line) => (
 2717:             <div
 2718:               key={line}
 2719:               className="rounded-2xl border border-emerald-100 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700"
 2720:             >
 2721:               {line}
 2722:             </div>
 2723:           ))}
 2724:         </div>
 2725:       </section>
 2726:     );
 2727:   }
 2728: 
 2729:   if (block.kind === "bullet-list") {
 2730:     return (
 2731:       <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2732:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2733:         <ul className="space-y-2">
 2734:           {splitLines(rendered).map((line) => (
 2735:             <li key={line} className="flex gap-2 text-sm leading-7 text-slate-700">
 2736:               <span className="mt-2 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-emerald-600" />
 2737:               <span>{line}</span>
 2738:             </li>
 2739:           ))}
 2740:         </ul>
 2741:       </section>
 2742:     );
 2743:   }
 2744: 
 2745:   if (block.kind === "multi-paragraph") {
 2746:     return (
 2747:       <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2748:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2749:         <div className="space-y-3">
 2750:           {splitParagraphs(rendered).map((paragraph) => (
 2751:             <p key={paragraph} className="text-sm leading-8 text-slate-700">
 2752:               {paragraph}
 2753:             </p>
 2754:           ))}
 2755:         </div>
 2756:       </section>
 2757:     );
 2758:   }
 2759: 
 2760:   if (block.kind === "dynamic-fields") {
 2761:     return (
 2762:       <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2763:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2764:         <div className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
 2765:           {getWorkflowDynamicFieldCards(previewCase).map(({ label, value }) => (
 2766:             <div
 2767:               key={label}
 2768:               className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-100 bg-white px-4 py-3"
 2769:             >
 2770:               <p className="text-[11px] font-black text-slate-400">{label}</p>
 2771:               <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-black text-slate-800">
 2772:                 {value || "غير متوفر"}
 2773:               </p>
 2774:             </div>
 2775:           ))}
 2776:         </div>
 2777:       </section>
 2778:     );
 2779:   }
 2780: 
 2781:   if (block.kind === "evidence-gallery") {
 2782:     const hasSelectedCase = Boolean(previewCase?.caseId);
 2783:     const realEvidences = filterValidReportEvidenceItems(
 2784:       previewCase?.evidences || [],
 2785:       { allowSampleEvidence: !hasSelectedCase },
 2786:     );
 2787:     const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
 2788:     const startIndex = block.evidenceStartIndex || 0;
 2789: 
 2790:     if (!realEvidences.length && hasSelectedCase) {
 2791:       return null;
 2792:     }
 2793: 
 2794:     if (!realEvidences.length && block.evidenceEmptyBehavior === "hide") {
 2795:       return null;
 2796:     }
 2797: 
 2798:     const placeholderEvidences = createEvidencePlaceholders(perPage, startIndex);
 2799:     const sourceEvidences = realEvidences.length ? realEvidences : placeholderEvidences;
 2800:     const visibleEvidences = sourceEvidences.slice(startIndex, startIndex + perPage);
 2801:     const hiddenCount = Math.max(realEvidences.length - (startIndex + perPage), 0);
 2802:     const isPlaceholderMode = !realEvidences.length;
 2803: 
 2804:     if (block.evidenceLayout === "ATTACHMENT_LIST") {
 2805:       return (
 2806:         <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2807:           {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2808: 
 2809:           <div className="space-y-2">
 2810:             {visibleEvidences.map((evidence, index) => (
 2811:               <div
 2812:                 key={evidence.id || evidence.fileUrl || String(index)}
 2813:                 className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700"
 2814:               >
 2815:                 <span>
 2816:                   {evidence.caption || evidence.title || "مرفق " + (startIndex + index + 1)}
 2817:                 </span>
 2818: 
 2819:                 <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-black text-slate-500">
 2820:                   {isPlaceholderMode ? "معاينة" : "شاهد"}
 2821:                 </span>
 2822:               </div>
 2823:             ))}
 2824:           </div>
 2825:         </section>
 2826:       );
 2827:     }
 2828: 
 2829:     return (
 2830:       <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2831:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2832: 
 2833:         <div className={getEvidenceGridClass(block)}>
 2834:           {visibleEvidences.map((evidence, index) => {
 2835:             const imageUrl = evidence.imageUrl || evidence.fileUrl || "";
 2836: 
 2837:             return (
 2838:               <figure
 2839:                 key={evidence.id || imageUrl || String(index)}
 2840:                 className="break-inside-avoid overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white"
 2841:               >
 2842:                 {imageUrl && !isPlaceholderMode ? (
 2843:                   <img
 2844:                     src={imageUrl}
 2845:                     alt={evidence.title || "شاهد " + (startIndex + index + 1)}
 2846:                     className={getEvidenceImageClass(block) + " bg-slate-50"}
 2847:                   />
 2848:                 ) : (
 2849:                   <div className={getEvidenceImageHeightClass(block) + " flex w-full flex-col items-center justify-center bg-slate-50 text-center"}>
 2850:                     <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-2xl">
 2851:                       📎
 2852:                     </div>
 2853:                     <p className="mt-3 text-xs font-black text-slate-500">
 2854:                       {isPlaceholderMode ? "مساحة شاهد للمعاينة" : "شاهد بدون صورة"}
 2855:                     </p>
 2856:                   </div>
 2857:                 )}
 2858: 
 2859:                 {block.evidenceShowCaptions !== false ? (
 2860:                   <figcaption className="max-h-12 overflow-hidden border-t border-slate-100 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold leading-6 text-slate-600">
 2861:                     {evidence.caption || evidence.title || "شاهد " + (startIndex + index + 1)}
 2862:                   </figcaption>
 2863:                 ) : null}
 2864:               </figure>
 2865:             );
 2866:           })}
 2867:         </div>
 2868: 
 2869:         {hiddenCount > 0 && block.evidenceAutoCreatePages === false ? (
 2870:           <p className="mt-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-amber-700">
 2871:             يوجد {hiddenCount} شاهد إضافي. سيتم نقله إلى صفحة شواهد إضافية حتى لا يتمدد إطار A4.
 2872:           </p>
 2873:         ) : null}
 2874: 
 2875:         {isPlaceholderMode ? (
 2876:           <p className="mt-3 rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
 2877:             هذه مربعات معاينة فقط. عند اختبار Case ID يحتوي شواهد، سيتم عرض الشواهد الفعلية هنا.
 2878:           </p>
 2879:         ) : null}
 2880:       </section>
 2881:     );
 2882:   }
 2883: 
 2884:   if (block.kind === "closing-note") {
 2885:     return (
 2886:       <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2887:         {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2888:         <p className="text-sm leading-8 text-slate-700">{rendered}</p>
 2889: 
 2890:         <div className="mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
 2891:           <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
 2892:             <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400">
 2893:               الموجه/الموجهة الطلابية
 2894:             </p>
 2895:             <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-black text-slate-800">
 2896:               {context["identity.counselorName"]}
 2897:             </p>
 2898:           </div>
 2899: 
 2900:           <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4">
 2901:             <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400">
 2902:               مدير/مديرة المدرسة
 2903:             </p>
 2904:             <p className="mt-4 text-sm font-black text-slate-800">
 2905:               {context["identity.principalName"]}
 2906:             </p>
 2907:           </div>
 2908:         </div>
 2909:       </section>
 2910:     );
 2911:   }
 2912: 
 2913:   return (
 2914:     <section className={getBlockClass(block.variant, textAlign)}>
 2915:       {block.showTitle ? <BlockTitle title={block.title} /> : null}
 2916:       <p className="whitespace-pre-line text-sm leading-8 text-slate-700">
 2917:         {rendered}
 2918:       </p>
 2919:     </section>
 2920:   );
 2921: }

 2923: 
 2924: function createEvidencePlaceholders(
 2925:   count: number,
 2926:   startIndex: number,
 2927: ): NonNullable<PreviewCaseData["evidences"]> {
 2928:   return Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, index) => {
 2929:     const evidenceNumber = startIndex + index + 1;
 2930: 
 2931:     return {
 2932:       id: "placeholder-evidence-" + evidenceNumber,
 2933:       title: "شاهد تجريبي " + evidenceNumber,
 2934:       caption: "مكان الشاهد داخل التقارير",
 2935:       fileUrl: "",
 2936:       imageUrl: "",
 2937:     };
 2938:   });
 2939: }
 2940: 
 2941: function getEvidencePerPage(block: any) {
 2942:   return getSmartEvidencePerPage(block);
 2943: }
 2944: 
 2945: function getSmartEvidencePerPage(block: any) {
 2946:   const layout = String(block?.evidenceLayout || "TWO_PER_PAGE");
 2947:   const ratio = String(block?.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3");
 2948:   const fit = String(block?.evidenceFit || "contain");
 2949: 
 2950:   if (layout === "ATTACHMENT_LIST") return 10;
 2951:   if (layout === "ONE_PER_PAGE") return 1;
 2952:   if (layout === "TWO_PER_PAGE") return 2;
 2953: 
 2954:   /*
 2955:     GRID_2X2 is a maximum capacity, not a forced capacity.
 2956:     The system must keep every evidence card inside the A4 frame.
 2957:     Portrait images are tall, so 4 cards can overflow the page.
 2958:   */
 2959:   if (layout === "GRID_2X2") {
 2960:     if (ratio === "PORTRAIT_3_4") return 2;
 2961:     if (ratio === "SQUARE_1_1" && fit === "cover") return 4;
 2962:     if (ratio === "SQUARE_1_1") return 4;
 2963:     if (ratio === "LANDSCAPE_16_9") return 4;
 2964:     return 4;
 2965:   }
 2966: 
 2967:   return 2;
 2968: }
 2969: 
 2970: function getEvidenceGridClass(block: any) {
 2971:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
 2972: 
 2973:   if (block.evidenceLayout === "ATTACHMENT_LIST") {
 2974:     return "grid gap-2";
 2975:   }
 2976: 
 2977:   if (perPage <= 1) {
 2978:     return "grid gap-3";
 2979:   }
 2980: 
 2981:   return "grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2";
 2982: }
 2983: 
 2984: 
 2985: function getEvidenceAspectRatioClass(block: StudioBlock) {
 2986:   switch (block.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3") {
 2987:     case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
 2988:       return "aspect-video";
 2989:     case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
 2990:       return "aspect-[3/4]";
 2991:     case "SQUARE_1_1":
 2992:       return "aspect-square";
 2993:     case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
 2994:     default:
 2995:       return "aspect-[4/3]";
 2996:   }
 2997: }
 2998: 
 2999: function getEvidenceImageHeightClass(block: any) {
 3000:   const perPage = getEvidencePerPage(block);
 3001:   const ratio = block.evidenceAspectRatio || "LANDSCAPE_4_3";
 3002: 
 3003:   /*
 3004:     Fixed heights are intentional:
 3005:     they keep evidence inside the printable A4 area.
 3006:     Extra evidence must go to a new Evidence Page instead of stretching A4.
 3007:   */
 3008:   if (perPage <= 1) {
 3009:     switch (ratio) {
 3010:       case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
 3011:         return "h-[185mm]";
 3012:       case "SQUARE_1_1":
 3013:         return "h-[160mm]";
 3014:       case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
 3015:         return "h-[122mm]";
 3016:       case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
 3017:       default:
 3018:         return "h-[138mm]";
 3019:     }
 3020:   }
 3021: 
 3022:   if (perPage === 2) {
 3023:     switch (ratio) {
 3024:       case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
 3025:         return "h-[92mm]";
 3026:       case "SQUARE_1_1":
 3027:         return "h-[82mm]";
 3028:       case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
 3029:         return "h-[58mm]";
 3030:       case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
 3031:       default:
 3032:         return "h-[66mm]";
 3033:     }
 3034:   }
 3035: 
 3036:   switch (ratio) {
 3037:     case "SQUARE_1_1":
 3038:       return "h-[56mm]";
 3039:     case "LANDSCAPE_16_9":
 3040:       return "h-[42mm]";
 3041:     case "PORTRAIT_3_4":
 3042:       return "h-[82mm]";
 3043:     case "LANDSCAPE_4_3":
 3044:     default:
 3045:       return "h-[48mm]";
 3046:   }
 3047: }
 3048: 
 3049: function getEvidenceImageClass(block: any) {
 3050:   const fit = block.evidenceFit === "cover" ? "object-cover" : "object-contain";
 3051:   return `${getEvidenceImageHeightClass(block)} w-full ${fit}`;
 3052: }

 3076: function getPlacementClass(placement: BlockPlacement) {
 3077:   const fullCenteredBase = "absolute left-0 right-0 w-full";
 3078:   const centeredBase = "absolute left-1/2 w-full max-w-[78%] -translate-x-1/2";
 3079:   const sideBase = "absolute w-full max-w-[58%]";
 3080: 
 3081:   const classes: Record<BlockPlacement, string> = {
 3082:     flow: "",
 3083: 
 3084:     // الخيارات العامة: تبقى بعرضها الطبيعي الكامل مثل وضع الترتيب الطبيعي
 3085:     top: `${fullCenteredBase} top-0`,
 3086:     middle: `${fullCenteredBase} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`,
 3087:     bottom: `${fullCenteredBase} bottom-0`,
 3088: 
 3089:     // الخيارات الدقيقة: يمين/وسط/يسار بعرض مخصص حتى لا تملأ الصفحة كاملة
 3090:     "top-right": `${sideBase} right-0 top-0`,
 3091:     "top-center": `${centeredBase} top-0`,
 3092:     "top-left": `${sideBase} left-0 top-0`,
 3093: 
 3094:     "middle-right": `${sideBase} right-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`,
 3095:     "middle-center": `${centeredBase} top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`,
 3096:     "middle-left": `${sideBase} left-0 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2`,
 3097: 
 3098:     "bottom-right": `${sideBase} bottom-0 right-0`,
 3099:     "bottom-center": `${centeredBase} bottom-0`,
 3100:     "bottom-left": `${sideBase} bottom-0 left-0`,
 3101:   };
 3102: 
 3103:   return classes[placement];
 3104: }

 3106: function getBlockClass(variant: BlockVariant, textAlign: string) {
 3107:   const base = `break-inside-avoid ${textAlign}`;
 3108: 
 3109:   const classes: Record<BlockVariant, string> = {
 3110:     hero: `${base} py-5`,
 3111:     plain: `${base} px-1 py-2`,
 3112:     card: `${base} rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5 shadow-sm`,
 3113:     soft: `${base} rounded-3xl border border-emerald-100 bg-emerald-50 p-5`,
 3114:     highlight: `${base} rounded-3xl border border-emerald-200 bg-gradient-to-l from-emerald-50 to-white p-5`,
 3115:     outline: `${base} rounded-3xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-white p-5`,
 3116:     quote: `${base} rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-5`,
 3117:   };
 3118: 
 3119:   return classes[variant];
 3120: }

 3193: function cleanWorkflowDynamicText(value: unknown) {
 3194:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
 3195: }
 3196: 
 3197: function isTechnicalWorkflowText(value: string) {
 3198:   return /^[a-z0-9_/-]+$/i.test(value) && /[a-z_]/i.test(value);
 3199: }
 3200: 
 3201: function translateWorkflowDynamicLabel(key: unknown, label: unknown) {
 3202:   const cleanKey = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(key);
 3203:   const cleanLabel = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(label);
 3204: 
 3205:   if (cleanLabel && cleanLabel !== cleanKey && !isTechnicalWorkflowText(cleanLabel)) {
 3206:     return cleanLabel;
 3207:   }
 3208: 
 3209:   return WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_FIELD_LABELS[cleanKey] || cleanLabel || cleanKey;
 3210: }
 3211: 
 3212: function translateWorkflowDynamicValue(value: unknown): string {
 3213:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
 3214: 
 3215:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
 3216:     return value
 3217:       .map((item) => translateWorkflowDynamicValue(item))
 3218:       .filter(Boolean)
 3219:       .join("، ");
 3220:   }
 3221: 
 3222:   if (typeof value === "boolean") {
 3223:     return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
 3224:   }
 3225: 
 3226:   if (typeof value === "object") {
 3227:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
 3228:     return (
 3229:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.label) ||
 3230:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.name) ||
 3231:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.value) ||
 3232:       translateWorkflowDynamicValue(record.key) ||
 3233:       ""
 3234:     );
 3235:   }
 3236: 
 3237:   const text = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(value);
 3238:   const normalized = text.toLowerCase();
 3239: 
 3240:   if (WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_VALUE_LABELS[normalized]) {
 3241:     return WORKFLOW_DYNAMIC_VALUE_LABELS[normalized];
 3242:   }
 3243: 
 3244:   const programMatch = /^program[_-](\d+)$/i.exec(text);
 3245:   if (programMatch) {
 3246:     return `برنامج النشاط رقم ${Number(programMatch[1])}`;
 3247:   }
 3248: 
 3249:   return text;
 3250: }
 3251: 
 3252: function getWorkflowDynamicFieldCards(previewCase: any): WorkflowDynamicFieldCard[] {
 3253:   return (previewCase?.values || [])
 3254:     .map((item: any, index: number) => {
 3255:       const key = cleanWorkflowDynamicText(item.fieldKey);
 3256:       const label = translateWorkflowDynamicLabel(
 3257:         item.fieldKey,
 3258:         item.fieldLabel || `حقل ${index + 1}`,
 3259:       );
 3260:       const value = translateWorkflowDynamicValue(item.value);
 3261: 
 3262:       return {
 3263:         key: key || label || `workflow-field-${index + 1}`,
 3264:         label,
 3265:         value,
 3266:       };
 3267:     })
 3268:     .filter((item: any) => item.label && item.value);
 3269: }

FILE: components/report-engine/save-smart-report-button.tsx
============================================================
    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: import { useState } from "react";
    4: import { Save } from "lucide-react";
    5: 
    6: import type { ReportVariantId } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-variant-registry";
    7: import type { ReportDraftAdjustments } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    8: 
    9: type SaveSmartReportButtonProps = {
   10:   caseId: string;
   11:   variantId: ReportVariantId;
   12:   adjustments?: ReportDraftAdjustments | null;
   13: };
   14: 
   15: export function SaveSmartReportButton({
   16:   caseId,
   17:   variantId,
   18:   adjustments,
   19: }: SaveSmartReportButtonProps) {
   20:   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
   21:   const [error, setError] = useState("");
   22: 
   23:   async function handleSave() {
   24:     try {
   25:       setSaving(true);
   26:       setError("");
   27: 
   28:       const response = await fetch(
   29:         `/api/dashboard/reports/case/${caseId}/generate`,
   30:         {
   31:           method: "POST",
   32:           headers: {
   33:             "Content-Type": "application/json",
   34:           },
   35:           body: JSON.stringify({
   36:             variantId,
   37:             reportDraftAdjustments: adjustments,
   38:           }),
   39:         },
   40:       );
   41: 
   42:       const result = await response.json();
   43: 
   44:       if (!response.ok || !result?.success || !result?.reportId) {
   45:         throw new Error(result?.error || "تعذر حفظ التقرير.");
   46:       }
   47: 
   48:       window.location.href = `/dashboard/report/${result.reportId}/preview`;
   49:     } catch (error) {
   50:       setError(
   51:         error instanceof Error
   52:           ? error.message
   53:           : "حدث خطأ غير متوقع أثناء حفظ التقرير.",
   54:       );
   55:     } finally {
   56:       setSaving(false);
   57:     }
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   return (
   61:     <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
   62:       <button
   63:         type="button"
   64:         onClick={handleSave}
   65:         disabled={saving}
   66:         className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-950 px-5 py-3 text-xs font-black text-white transition hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
   67:       >
   68:         <Save className="h-4 w-4" />
   69:         {saving ? "جار الحفظ..." : "حفظ التقرير"}
   70:       </button>
   71: 
   72:       {error ? (
   73:         <p className="max-w-xs rounded-xl bg-red-50 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold leading-6 text-red-700">
   74:           {error}
   75:         </p>
   76:       ) : null}
   77:     </div>
   78:   );
   79: }

   73:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "غير محدد";
   74:   if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length ? value.join("، ") : "غير محدد";
   75:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
   76:   return String(value);
   77: }
   78: 
   79: function renderArabicValue(
   80:   value: SmartReportField["value"],
   81:   fieldKey: string,
   82: ): string {
   83:   const base = renderValue(value);
   84:   if (base === "غير محدد") return base;
   85:   const lower = base.toLowerCase();
   86:   const translated = ARABIC_LABEL_MAP[lower] || ARABIC_LABEL_MAP[base];
   87:   if (translated && translated !== base && translated !== lower) return translated;
   88:   return base;
   89: }

   91: function imageContainerStyle(
   92:   imageSize: ReportEvidenceConfig["imageSize"],

   98:   if (imageSize === "portrait") return { height: "75mm" };
   99:   if (imageSize === "landscape") return { height: "55mm" };
  100:   return { height: "45mm" };

   72:   const normalized = normalizeTechnicalText(value);
