   37:                   : "bg-white text-slate-700 ring-1 ring-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100",
   38:               ].join(" ")}
   39:               title={variant.description}
   40:             >
   41:               {variant.shortName}
   42:             </Link>
   43:           );
   44:         })}
   45:       </div>
   46:     </div>
   47:   );
   48: }

  280: 
  281: function getMatchingSnippets({
  282:   template,
  283:   snippets,
  284:   settings,
  285: }: {
  286:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
  287:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
  288:   settings: TextLibraryBlockSettings;
  289: }) {
  290:   return snippets.filter((snippet) => {
  291:     const matchesCategory =
  292:       !settings.category ||
  293:       settings.category === "all" ||
  294:       snippet.category === settings.category;
  295: 
  296:     const matchesService = matchesServiceMode({
  297:       snippet,
  298:       template,
  299:       settings,
  300:     });
  301: 
  302:     return matchesCategory && matchesService;
  303:   });
  304: }
  305: 
  306: function matchesServiceMode({
  307:   snippet,
  308:   template,
  309:   settings,
  310: }: {
  311:   snippet: ReportTextSnippet;
  312:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
  313:   settings: TextLibraryBlockSettings;
  314: }) {
  315:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "all") {
  316:     return true;
  317:   }
  318: 
  319:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "global") {
  320:     return !snippet.serviceSlug;
  321:   }
  322: 
  323:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "specific-service") {
  324:     return snippet.serviceSlug === settings.serviceSlug;
  325:   }
  326: 
  327:   if (template.scope === "SERVICE" && template.serviceSlug) {
  328:     return snippet.serviceSlug === template.serviceSlug || !snippet.serviceSlug;
  329:   }
  330: 
  331:   return !snippet.serviceSlug;
  332: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-a4-paginator.ts
============================================================
    1: import type {
    2:   ReportDocumentBlock,
    3:   ReportDocumentDraft,
    4:   ReportDocumentPage,
    5:   ReportEvidenceBlock,
    6:   ReportTableBlock,
    7: } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-types";
    8: import { sortByOrder } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-utils";
    9: 
   10: export type ReportDocumentRenderablePage = ReportDocumentPage & {
   11:   sourcePageId: string;
   12:   physicalPageIndex: number;
   13:   isContinuation: boolean;
   14: };
   15: 
   16: const A4_CONTENT_CAPACITY = 665;
   17: 
   18: function estimateTextHeight(text: string, charsPerLine: number, lineHeight: number) {
   19:   const length = String(text || "").trim().length;
   20:   const lines = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(length / charsPerLine));
   21: 
   22:   return lines * lineHeight;
   23: }
   24: 
   25: function estimateBlockHeight(block: ReportDocumentBlock) {
   26:   if (block.type === "META_FIELDS") {
   27:     return Math.ceil(block.fields.length / 3) * 48 + 58;
   28:   }
   29: 
   30:   if (block.type === "NARRATIVE") {
   31:     return 76 + estimateTextHeight(block.body, 58, 24);
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   if (block.type === "PARAGRAPH") {
   35:     return 76 + estimateTextHeight(block.body, 58, 24);
   36:   }
   37: 
   38:   if (block.type === "BULLET_LIST") {
   39:     const lines = String(block.body || "")
   40:       .split(/\r?\n/)
   41:       .filter((line) => line.trim().length > 0).length;
   42: 
   43:     return 76 + Math.max(1, lines) * 28;
   44:   }
   45: 
   46:   if (block.type === "TABLE") {
   47:     return 58 + 42 + block.rows.length * (block.settings.compact ? 36 : 48);
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   if (block.type === "EVIDENCE") {
   51:     if (block.evidenceConfig?.visible === false) return 0;
   52: 
   53:     const itemsPerPage = block.evidenceConfig?.itemsPerPage ?? 2;
   54: 
   55:     if (itemsPerPage === 1) return 600;
   56:     if (itemsPerPage === 2) return 390;
   57: 
   58:     return 360;
   59:   }
   60: 
   61:   if (block.type === "SIGNATURES") {
   62:     return 132;
   63:   }
   64: 
   65:   return 80;
   66: }
   67: 
   68: function splitEvidenceBlock(block: ReportEvidenceBlock): ReportEvidenceBlock[] {
   69:   if (block.evidenceConfig?.visible === false) return [];
   70: 
   71:   const itemsPerPage = Math.max(1, block.evidenceConfig?.itemsPerPage ?? 2);
   72:   const chunks: ReportEvidenceBlock[] = [];
   73: 
   74:   for (let index = 0; index < block.evidenceItems.length; index += itemsPerPage) {
   75:     chunks.push({
   76:       ...block,
   77:       id: `${block.id}-part-${chunks.length + 1}`,
   78:       title: chunks.length === 0 ? block.title : `${block.title || "الشواهد"} - تابع`,
   79:       evidenceItems: block.evidenceItems.slice(index, index + itemsPerPage),
   80:       order: block.order + chunks.length / 100,
   81:     });
   82:   }
   83: 
   84:   return chunks;
   85: }
   86: 
   87: function splitTableBlock(block: ReportTableBlock): ReportTableBlock[] {
   88:   const maxRowsPerPage = block.settings.compact ? 8 : 6;
   89: 
   90:   if (block.rows.length <= maxRowsPerPage) return [block];
   91: 
   92:   const chunks: ReportTableBlock[] = [];
   93: 
   94:   for (let index = 0; index < block.rows.length; index += maxRowsPerPage) {
   95:     chunks.push({
   96:       ...block,
   97:       id: `${block.id}-part-${chunks.length + 1}`,
   98:       title: chunks.length === 0 ? block.title : `${block.title || "جدول"} - تابع`,
   99:       rows: block.rows.slice(index, index + maxRowsPerPage),
  100:       order: block.order + chunks.length / 100,
  101:     });
  102:   }
  103: 
  104:   return chunks;
  105: }
  106: 
  107: function splitLargeBlock(block: ReportDocumentBlock): ReportDocumentBlock[] {
  108:   if (block.type === "EVIDENCE") return splitEvidenceBlock(block);
  109:   if (block.type === "TABLE") return splitTableBlock(block);
  110: 
  111:   return [block];
  112: }
  113: 
  114: function createRenderablePage(
  115:   sourcePage: ReportDocumentPage,
  116:   blocks: ReportDocumentBlock[],
  117:   physicalPageIndex: number,
  118: ): ReportDocumentRenderablePage {
  119:   return {
  120:     ...sourcePage,
  121:     id:
  122:       physicalPageIndex === 0
  123:         ? sourcePage.id
  124:         : `${sourcePage.id}-a4-${physicalPageIndex + 1}`,
  125:     sourcePageId: sourcePage.id,
  126:     physicalPageIndex,
  127:     isContinuation: physicalPageIndex > 0,
  128:     title:
  129:       physicalPageIndex === 0
  130:         ? sourcePage.title
  131:         : `${sourcePage.title || "صفحة"} ${physicalPageIndex + 1}`,
  132:     blocks,
  133:   };
  134: }
  135: 
  136: function paginateLogicalPage(sourcePage: ReportDocumentPage) {
  137:   const blocks = sortByOrder(sourcePage.blocks).flatMap(splitLargeBlock);
  138:   const pages: ReportDocumentRenderablePage[] = [];
  139: 
  140:   let currentBlocks: ReportDocumentBlock[] = [];
  141:   let currentHeight = 0;
  142: 
  143:   function flushPage() {
  144:     pages.push(createRenderablePage(sourcePage, currentBlocks, pages.length));
  145:     currentBlocks = [];
  146:     currentHeight = 0;
  147:   }
  148: 
  149:   for (const block of blocks) {
  150:     const height = estimateBlockHeight(block);
  151: 
  152:     if (currentBlocks.length > 0 && currentHeight + height > A4_CONTENT_CAPACITY) {
  153:       flushPage();
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     currentBlocks.push(block);
  157:     currentHeight += Math.min(height, A4_CONTENT_CAPACITY);
  158:   }
  159: 
  160:   if (currentBlocks.length > 0 || pages.length === 0) {
  161:     flushPage();
  162:   }
  163: 
  164:   return pages;
  165: }
  166: 
  167: export function paginateReportDocumentDraftForA4(
  168:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  169: ): ReportDocumentRenderablePage[] {
  170:   return sortByOrder(draft.pages).flatMap(paginateLogicalPage);
  171: }

  109: 
  110:   return null;
  111: }
  112: 
  113: function buildPagePayload(
  114:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  115:   page: ReportDocumentPage,
  116: ): SmartReportPayload {
  117:   const payload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft.payload)) as SmartReportPayload;
  118:   const narrativeBlock = page.blocks.find((block) => block.type === "NARRATIVE");
  119:   const evidenceBlock = page.blocks.find((block) => block.type === "EVIDENCE");
  120:   const signaturesBlock = page.blocks.find((block) => block.type === "SIGNATURES");
  121: 
  122:   payload.title = page.title || draft.title;
  123:   payload.caseInfo = {
  124:     ...payload.caseInfo,
  125:     title: page.title || draft.title,
  126:   };
  127: 
  128:   payload.primaryFields = page.blocks.some((block) => block.type === "META_FIELDS")
  129:     ? payload.primaryFields
  130:     : [];
  131:   payload.detailFields = page.blocks.some((block) => block.type === "META_FIELDS")
  132:     ? payload.detailFields
  133:     : [];
  134: 
  135:   payload.narrative =
  136:     narrativeBlock && narrativeBlock.type === "NARRATIVE"
  137:       ? {
  138:           title: narrativeBlock.title || "وصف التنفيذ",
  139:           body: narrativeBlock.body,
  140:         }
  141:       : {
  142:           title: "",
  143:           body: "",
  144:         };
  145: 
  146:   payload.evidence =
  147:     evidenceBlock && evidenceBlock.type === "EVIDENCE"
  148:       ? {
  149:           layout: payload.evidence.layout,
  150:           items: evidenceBlock.evidenceItems,
  151:         }
  152:       : {
  153:           layout: payload.evidence.layout,
  154:           items: [],
  155:         };
  156: 
  157:   payload.signatures =
  158:     signaturesBlock && signaturesBlock.type === "SIGNATURES"
  159:       ? signaturesBlock.signatures
  160:       : [];
  161: 
  162:   payload.evidenceConfig = draft.evidenceConfig;
  163: 
  164:   return payload;
  165: }
  166: 
  167: export function mapReportDocumentDraftToRenderablePages(draft: ReportDocumentDraft) {
  168:   return draft.pages.map((page, index) => ({
  169:     key: page.id,
  170:     title: page.title || `صفحة ${index + 1}`,
  171:     index,
  172:     blocks: page.blocks
  173:       .map(mapDocumentBlockToLegacyBlock)
  174:       .filter((block): block is ReportBlock => Boolean(block)),
  175:     payload: buildPagePayload(draft, page),
  176:   }));
  177: }

   60: function isTechnicalMetaFieldKey(key: string) {
   61:   const normalizedKey = String(key || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase();
   62: 
   63:   if (
   64:     normalizedKey === "studentsnapshot" ||
   65:     normalizedKey === "selectedstudent" ||

   67:     normalizedKey === "student_name" ||

   78: function looksLikeJsonText(value: string) {
   79:   const text = value.trim();
   80: 
   81:   return (
   82:     (text.startsWith("{") && text.endsWith("}")) ||
   83:     (text.startsWith("[") && text.endsWith("]")) ||
   84:     text.includes('","') ||
   85:     text.includes('":')
   86:   );
   87: }

   89: function extractArabicText(value: unknown): string {
   90:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
   91: 
   92:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
   93: 
   94:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   95:     return value
   96:       .map((item) => extractArabicText(item))
   97:       .filter(Boolean)
   98:       .join("، ");
   99:   }
  100: 
  101:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  102:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  103:     const preferredValues = [
  104:       record.fullName,
  105:       record.name,
  106:       record.studentName,
  107:       record.grade,
  108:       record.stage,
  109:       record.className,
  110:     ]
  111:       .map((item) => extractArabicText(item))
  112:       .filter(Boolean);
  113: 
  114:     return Array.from(new Set(preferredValues)).join("، ");
  115:   }
  116: 
  117:   const text = String(value).trim();
  118:   const normalized = text.toLowerCase();
  119: 
  120:   if (REPORT_VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[normalized]) {
  121:     return REPORT_VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[normalized];
  122:   }
  123: 
  124:   if (looksLikeJsonText(text)) {
  125:     try {
  126:       return extractArabicText(JSON.parse(text));
  127:     } catch {
  128:       return "";
  129:     }
  130:   }
  131: 
  132:   if (/^[a-z0-9_\-.@:/]+$/i.test(text)) {
  133:     return REPORT_VALUE_TRANSLATIONS[normalized] || "";
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   return text;
  137: }

  139: function normalizeReportMetaField<T extends { key: string; label: string; value: unknown }>(
  140:   field: T,
  141: ): T | null {
  142:   if (isTechnicalMetaFieldKey(field.key)) return null;
  143: 
  144:   const normalizedKey = String(field.key || "").replace(/\s+/g, "").toLowerCase();
  145:   const value = extractArabicText(field.value);
  146: 
  147:   if (!value) return null;
  148: 
  149:   const label =
  150:     normalizedKey === "studentsnapshot" ||
  151:     normalizedKey === "selectedstudent" ||
  152:     normalizedKey === "student" ||
  153:     normalizedKey === "student_name" ||
  154:     normalizedKey === "guardiansnapshot"
  155:       ? "اسم الطالب"
  156:       : field.label;
  157: 
  158:   return {
  159:     ...field,
  160:     label,
  161:     value,
  162:   };
  163: }
  164: 
  165: function hasValue(value: unknown) {
  166:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return false;
  167: 
  168:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  169:     return value.some((item) => String(item ?? "").trim().length > 0);
  170:   }
  171: 
  172:   return String(value).trim().length > 0;
  173: }

  221: function buildCustomTextBlock(

  225:   if (
  226:     customBlock.type !== "PARAGRAPH" &&
  227:     customBlock.type !== "BULLET_LIST" &&
  228:     customBlock.type !== "TABLE"

  232:

  234:     const table = customBlock.table;

  243:       source: "USER",

  246:       columns: table.columns,
  247:       rows: table.rows,
  248:     };
  249:   }
  250: 
  251:   if (!hasValue(customBlock.title) && !hasValue(customBlock.body)) {
  252:     return null;
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   if (customBlock.type === "BULLET_LIST") {
  256:     return {
  257:       id: customBlock.id || createReportDocumentId("bullet"),
  258:       type: "BULLET_LIST",
  259:       title: customBlock.title || "قائمة نقاط",
  260:       body: customBlock.body || "",
  261:       order: customBlock.order ?? 300 + index * 100,
  262:       source: "USER",
  263:       locked: false,
  264:     };
  265:   }
  266: 
  267:   return {
  268:     id: customBlock.id || createReportDocumentId("paragraph"),
  269:     type: "PARAGRAPH",
  270:     title: customBlock.title || "عنوان الفقرة",
  271:     body: customBlock.body || "",
  272:     order: customBlock.order ?? 300 + index * 100,

  275:   };

  296: function buildInitialPage(
  297:   payload: SmartReportPayload,
  298:   evidenceConfig: ReportEvidenceConfig,
  299: ): ReportDocumentPage {
  300:   const blocks: ReportDocumentBlock[] = [];
  301: 
  302:   const metaBlock = buildMetaFieldsBlock(payload);
  303:   const narrativeBlock = buildNarrativeBlock(payload);
  304:   const evidenceBlock = buildEvidenceBlock(payload, evidenceConfig);
  305: 
  306:   if (metaBlock) blocks.push(metaBlock);
  307:   if (narrativeBlock) blocks.push(narrativeBlock);
  308: 
  309:   for (const [index, customBlock] of (payload.customBlocks || []).entries()) {
  310:     const block = buildCustomTextBlock(customBlock, index);
  311: 
  312:     if (block) blocks.push(block);
  313:   }
  314: 
  315:   if (evidenceBlock) blocks.push(evidenceBlock);
  316: 
  317:   return {
  318:     id: "page-auto-1",
  319:     title: payload.title || payload.caseInfo.title || "التقرير",
  320:     order: 1000,
  321:     kind: "AUTO",
  322:     blocks: sortByOrder(blocks),
  323:   };
  324: }

   52:   type: ReportDocumentBlockInsertType,
   53:   order: number,

   55:   if (type === "TABLE") return createDefaultReportTableBlock(order);
   56:   if (type === "BULLET_LIST") return createBulletListBlock(order);

   61: function getInsertOrderAfter(
   62:   blocks: ReportDocumentBlock[],
   63:   afterBlockId?: string | null,
   64: ) {
   65:   const sortedBlocks = sortByOrder(blocks);
   66: 
   67:   if (!afterBlockId) {
   68:     const lastOrder = sortedBlocks.at(-1)?.order ?? null;
   69: 
   70:     return getOrderBetween(lastOrder, null);
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   const currentIndex = sortedBlocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === afterBlockId);
   74:   const previousOrder =
   75:     currentIndex >= 0 ? sortedBlocks[currentIndex].order : sortedBlocks.at(-1)?.order ?? null;
   76:   const nextOrder =
   77:     currentIndex >= 0 && currentIndex < sortedBlocks.length - 1
   78:       ? sortedBlocks[currentIndex + 1].order
   79:       : null;
   80: 
   81:   return getOrderBetween(previousOrder, nextOrder);
   82: }
   83: 
   84: export function addReportDocumentPageAfter(
   85:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
   86:   pageId: string,
   87: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
   88:   const sortedPages = sortByOrder(draft.pages);
   89:   const currentIndex = sortedPages.findIndex((page) => page.id === pageId);
   90:   const insertIndex = currentIndex >= 0 ? currentIndex + 1 : sortedPages.length;
   91:   const previousOrder =
   92:     insertIndex > 0 ? sortedPages[insertIndex - 1]?.order ?? null : null;
   93:   const nextOrder =
   94:     insertIndex < sortedPages.length ? sortedPages[insertIndex]?.order ?? null : null;
   95: 
   96:   const page: ReportDocumentPage = {
   97:     id: createReportDocumentId("page"),
   98:     title: `صفحة ${sortedPages.length + 1}`,
   99:     order: getOrderBetween(previousOrder, nextOrder),
  100:     kind: "MANUAL",
  101:     blocks: [],
  102:   };
  103: 
  104:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  105:     ...draft,
  106:     pages: sortByOrder([...draft.pages, page]),
  107:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  108:   });
  109: }

  111: export function removeReportDocumentPage(
  112:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  113:   pageId: string,
  114: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  115:   const page = draft.pages.find((item) => item.id === pageId);
  116: 
  117:   if (!page || page.kind !== "MANUAL") return draft;
  118: 
  119:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  120:     ...draft,
  121:     pages: draft.pages.filter((item) => item.id !== pageId),
  122:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  123:   });
  124: }

  126: export function moveReportDocumentPage(
  127:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  128:   pageId: string,
  129:   direction: "previous" | "next",
  130: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  131:   const sortedPages = sortByOrder(draft.pages);
  132:   const currentIndex = sortedPages.findIndex((page) => page.id === pageId);
  133: 
  134:   if (currentIndex < 0) return draft;
  135: 
  136:   const targetIndex = direction === "previous" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  137: 
  138:   if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= sortedPages.length) return draft;
  139: 
  140:   const reordered = [...sortedPages];
  141:   const [page] = reordered.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  142:   reordered.splice(targetIndex, 0, page);
  143: 
  144:   const nextPages = reordered.map((item, index) => ({
  145:     ...item,
  146:     order: (index + 1) * 1000,
  147:   }));
  148: 
  149:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  150:     ...draft,
  151:     pages: nextPages,
  152:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  153:   });
  154: }
  155: 
  156: export function addReportDocumentBlock(
  157:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  158:   pageId: string,
  159:   type: ReportDocumentBlockInsertType,
  160:   afterBlockId?: string | null,
  161: ): {
  162:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft;
  163:   blockId: string;
  164: } {
  165:   const page = getPageOrFirst(draft, pageId);
  166: 
  167:   if (!page) {
  168:     return { draft, blockId: "" };
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   const order = getInsertOrderAfter(page.blocks, afterBlockId);
  172:   const block = createBlockByType(type, order);
  173: 
  174:   const nextDraft = applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  175:     ...draft,
  176:     pages: draft.pages.map((item) =>
  177:       item.id === page.id
  178:         ? {
  179:             ...item,
  180:             blocks: sortByOrder([...item.blocks, block]),
  181:           }
  182:         : item,
  183:     ),
  184:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  185:   });
  186: 
  187:   return {
  188:     draft: nextDraft,
  189:     blockId: block.id,
  190:   };
  191: }

  193: export function updateReportDocumentBlock(
  194:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  195:   blockId: string,
  196:   patch: Partial<ReportDocumentBlock>,
  197: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  198:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  199:     ...draft,
  200:     pages: draft.pages.map((page) => ({
  201:       ...page,
  202:       blocks: page.blocks.map((block) =>
  203:         block.id === blockId ? ({ ...block, ...patch } as ReportDocumentBlock) : block,
  204:       ),
  205:     })),
  206:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  207:   });
  208: }

  221:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  222:     ...draft,
  223:     pages: draft.pages.map((page) => ({
  224:       ...page,
  225:       blocks: page.blocks.filter((block) => block.id !== blockId || block.locked),
  226:     })),
  227:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  228:   });
  229: }
  230: 
  231: export function moveReportDocumentBlock(
  232:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  233:   pageId: string,
  234:   blockId: string,
  235:   direction: "previous" | "next",
  236: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  237:   const page = getPageOrFirst(draft, pageId);
  238: 
  239:   if (!page) return draft;
  240: 
  241:   const movableBlocks = sortByOrder(page.blocks);
  242:   const currentIndex = movableBlocks.findIndex((block) => block.id === blockId);
  243: 
  244:   if (currentIndex < 0) return draft;
  245: 
  246:   const targetIndex = direction === "previous" ? currentIndex - 1 : currentIndex + 1;
  247: 
  248:   if (targetIndex < 0 || targetIndex >= movableBlocks.length) return draft;
  249: 
  250:   const reordered = [...movableBlocks];
  251:   const [block] = reordered.splice(currentIndex, 1);
  252:   reordered.splice(targetIndex, 0, block);
  253: 
  254:   const nextBlocks = reordered.map((item, index) => ({
  255:     ...item,
  256:     order: (index + 1) * 100,
  257:   })) as ReportDocumentBlock[];
  258: 
  259:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  260:     ...draft,
  261:     pages: draft.pages.map((item) =>
  262:       item.id === page.id ? { ...item, blocks: nextBlocks } : item,
  263:     ),
  264:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  265:   });
  266: }
  267: 
  268: export function ensureReportDocumentSystemBlocks(
  269:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  270: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  271:   const evidenceItems = draft.payload.evidence?.items || [];
  272:   const hasEvidenceBlock = draft.pages.some((page) =>
  273:     page.blocks.some((block) => block.type === "EVIDENCE"),
  274:   );
  275: 
  276:   if (evidenceItems.length === 0) {
  277:     return applyReportSignaturePolicy(draft);
  278:   }
  279: 
  280:   const evidenceConfig =
  281:     draft.evidenceConfig ||
  282:     draft.payload.evidenceConfig || {
  283:       visible: true,
  284:       itemsPerPage: 2,
  285:       showCaptions: false,
  286:       imageSize: "small-squares" as const,
  287:     };
  288: 
  289:   if (hasEvidenceBlock) {
  290:     return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  291:       ...draft,
  292:       evidenceConfig,
  293:       payload: {
  294:         ...draft.payload,
  295:         evidenceConfig,
  296:       },
  297:       pages: draft.pages.map((page) => ({
  298:         ...page,
  299:         blocks: page.blocks.map((block) =>
  300:           block.type === "EVIDENCE"
  301:             ? {
  302:                 ...block,
  303:                 title: block.title || "الشواهد",
  304:                 evidenceItems,
  305:                 evidenceConfig,
  306:               }
  307:             : block,
  308:         ),
  309:       })),
  310:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  311:     });
  312:   }
  313: 
  314:   const nextPages = draft.pages.length > 0 ? draft.pages : [
  315:     {
  316:       id: "page-auto-1",
  317:       title: draft.title || "التقرير",
  318:       order: 1000,
  319:       kind: "AUTO" as const,
  320:       blocks: [],
  321:     },
  322:   ];
  323: 
  324:   const firstPage = nextPages[0];
  325: 
  326:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  327:     ...draft,
  328:     evidenceConfig,
  329:     payload: {
  330:       ...draft.payload,
  331:       evidenceConfig,
  332:     },
  333:     pages: nextPages.map((page) =>
  334:       page.id === firstPage.id
  335:         ? {
  336:             ...page,
  337:             blocks: [
  338:               ...page.blocks.filter((block) => block.type !== "SIGNATURES"),
  339:               {
  340:                 id: "system-evidence",
  341:                 type: "EVIDENCE" as const,
  342:                 title: "الشواهد",
  343:                 evidenceItems,
  344:                 evidenceConfig,
  345:                 order: 800,
  346:                 source: "SYSTEM" as const,
  347:                 locked: false,
  348:               },
  349:             ],
  350:           }
  351:         : page,
  352:     ),
  353:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  354:   });
  355: }
  356:

  412: export function removeReportDocumentMetaField(
  413:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  414:   fieldKey: string,
  415: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  416:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  417:     ...draft,
  418:     payload: {
  419:       ...draft.payload,
  420:       primaryFields: draft.payload.primaryFields.filter(
  421:         (field) => field.key !== fieldKey,
  422:       ),
  423:       detailFields: draft.payload.detailFields.filter(
  424:         (field) => field.key !== fieldKey,
  425:       ),
  426:     },
  427:     pages: draft.pages.map((page) => ({
  428:       ...page,
  429:       blocks: page.blocks
  430:         .map((block) =>
  431:           block.type === "META_FIELDS"
  432:             ? {
  433:                 ...block,
  434:                 fields: block.fields.filter((field) => field.key !== fieldKey),
  435:               }
  436:             : block,
  437:         )
  438:         .filter(
  439:           (block) => block.type !== "META_FIELDS" || block.fields.length > 0,
  440:         ),
  441:     })),
  442:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  443:   });
  444: }
  445: 
  446: export function updateReportDocumentMetaField(
  447:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  448:   fieldKey: string,
  449:   patch: {
  450:     label?: string;
  451:     value?: string;
  452:   },
  453: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
  454:   function updateField<T extends { key: string; label: string; value: unknown }>(
  455:     field: T,
  456:   ): T {
  457:     if (field.key !== fieldKey) return field;
  458: 
  459:     return {
  460:       ...field,
  461:       label: patch.label ?? field.label,
  462:       value: patch.value ?? field.value,
  463:     };
  464:   }
  465: 
  466:   return applyReportSignaturePolicy({
  467:     ...draft,
  468:     payload: {
  469:       ...draft.payload,
  470:       primaryFields: draft.payload.primaryFields.map(updateField),
  471:       detailFields: draft.payload.detailFields.map(updateField),
  472:     },
  473:     pages: draft.pages.map((page) => ({
  474:       ...page,
  475:       blocks: page.blocks.map((block) =>
  476:         block.type === "META_FIELDS"
  477:           ? {
  478:               ...block,
  479:               fields: block.fields.map(updateField),
  480:             }
  481:           : block,
  482:       ),
  483:     })),
  484:     updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  485:   });
  486: }

    1: import type {
    2:   ReportDocumentBlock,
    3:   ReportDocumentDraft,
    4:   ReportTableBlock,
    5: } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-types";
    6: import { sortByOrder } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-utils";

    9:   ReportDraftAdjustments,
   10:   SmartReportCustomBlock,
   11:   SmartReportPayload,
   12: } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";

   14: function isUserContentBlock(block: ReportDocumentBlock) {
   15:   return (
   16:     block.type === "PARAGRAPH" ||
   17:     block.type === "BULLET_LIST" ||
   18:     block.type === "TABLE"
   19:   );
   20: }
   21: 
   22: function tableBlockToCustomBlock(block: ReportTableBlock): SmartReportCustomBlock {
   23:   return {
   24:     id: block.id,
   25:     type: "TABLE",
   26:     title: block.title || "جدول",
   27:     body: "",
   28:     order: block.order,
   29:     table: {
   30:       settings: block.settings,
   31:       columns: block.columns,
   32:       rows: block.rows,
   33:     },
   34:   };
   35: }
   36: 
   37: function blockToCustomBlock(block: ReportDocumentBlock): SmartReportCustomBlock | null {
   38:   if (block.type === "PARAGRAPH") {
   39:     return {
   40:       id: block.id,
   41:       type: "PARAGRAPH",
   42:       title: block.title || "",
   43:       body: block.body || "",
   44:       order: block.order,
   45:     };
   46:   }
   47: 
   48:   if (block.type === "BULLET_LIST") {
   49:     return {
   50:       id: block.id,
   51:       type: "BULLET_LIST",
   52:       title: block.title || "",
   53:       body: block.body || "",
   54:       order: block.order,
   55:     };
   56:   }
   57: 
   58:   if (block.type === "TABLE") {
   59:     return tableBlockToCustomBlock(block);
   60:   }
   61: 
   62:   return null;
   63: }
   64: 
   65: export function serializeReportDocumentDraftToPayload(
   66:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
   67: ): SmartReportPayload {
   68:   const payload: SmartReportPayload = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(draft.payload));
   69: 
   70:   const allBlocks = sortByOrder(
   71:     draft.pages.flatMap((page) => page.blocks),
   72:   );
   73: 
   74:   const narrativeBlock = allBlocks.find((block) => block.type === "NARRATIVE");
   75:   const evidenceBlock = allBlocks.find((block) => block.type === "EVIDENCE");
   76: 
   77:   const customBlocks = allBlocks
   78:     .filter(isUserContentBlock)
   79:     .map(blockToCustomBlock)
   80:     .filter((block): block is SmartReportCustomBlock => Boolean(block))
   81:     .filter((block) => {
   82:       if (block.type === "TABLE") return Boolean(block.table);
   83:       return Boolean(block.title.trim() || block.body.trim());
   84:     });
   85: 
   86:   payload.title = draft.title || payload.title;
   87:   payload.caseInfo = {
   88:     ...payload.caseInfo,
   89:     title: draft.title || payload.caseInfo.title,
   90:   };
   91: 
   92:   if (narrativeBlock?.type === "NARRATIVE") {
   93:     payload.narrative = {
   94:       title: narrativeBlock.title || "وصف التنفيذ",
   95:       body: narrativeBlock.body || "",
   96:     };
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (evidenceBlock?.type === "EVIDENCE") {
  100:     payload.evidence = {
  101:       layout: payload.evidence.layout,
  102:       items: evidenceBlock.evidenceItems,
  103:     };
  104:   }
  105: 
  106:   payload.evidenceConfig = draft.evidenceConfig;
  107:   payload.customBlocks = customBlocks;
  108: 
  109:   return payload;
  110: }
  111: 
  112: export function computeReportDocumentDraftAdjustments(
  113:   originalPayload: SmartReportPayload,
  114:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
  115: ): ReportDraftAdjustments {
  116:   const editedPayload = serializeReportDocumentDraftToPayload(draft);
  117: 
  118:   return {
  119:     ...computeReportDraftAdjustments(originalPayload, editedPayload),
  120:     evidenceConfig: draft.evidenceConfig,
  121:     customBlocks: editedPayload.customBlocks || [],
  122:   };
  123: }

    1: export function createReportDocumentId(prefix = "item") {
    2:   if (typeof crypto !== "undefined" && "randomUUID" in crypto) {
    3:     return `${prefix}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
    4:   }
    5: 
    6:   return `${prefix}-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`;
    7: }
    8: 
    9: export function getOrderBetween(
   10:   previousOrder: number | null,
   11:   nextOrder: number | null,
   12: ) {
   13:   if (previousOrder === null && nextOrder === null) return 1000;
   14:   if (previousOrder === null) return nextOrder! - 100;
   15:   if (nextOrder === null) return previousOrder + 100;
   16: 
   17:   return (previousOrder + nextOrder) / 2;
   18: }
   19: 
   20: export function sortByOrder<T extends { order: number }>(items: T[]) {
   21:   return [...items].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
   22: }
   23: 
   24: export function clampIndex(index: number, length: number) {
   25:   if (length <= 0) return 0;
   26: 
   27:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(index, length - 1));
   28: }

   10: export function saveReportDocumentDraft(draft: ReportDocumentDraft) {
   11:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
   12: 
   13:   window.localStorage.setItem(
   14:     getReportDocumentDraftKey(draft.caseId, draft.variantId),
   15:     JSON.stringify({
   16:       ...draft,
   17:       updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   18:     }),
   19:   );
   20: }
   21: 
   22: export function loadReportDocumentDraft(
   23:   caseId: string,
   24:   variantId: string,
   25: ): ReportDocumentDraft | null {
   26:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
   27: 
   28:   const raw = window.localStorage.getItem(
   29:     getReportDocumentDraftKey(caseId, variantId),
   30:   );
   31: 
   32:   if (!raw) return null;
   33: 
   34:   try {
   35:     const draft = JSON.parse(raw) as ReportDocumentDraft;
   36: 
   37:     if (draft.caseId !== caseId || draft.variantId !== variantId) return null;
   38: 
   39:     return draft;
   40:   } catch {
   41:     return null;
   42:   }
   43: }
   44: 
   45: export function clearReportDocumentDraft(caseId: string, variantId: string) {
   46:   if (typeof window === "undefined") return;
   47: 
   48:   window.localStorage.removeItem(getReportDocumentDraftKey(caseId, variantId));
   49: }
   50: 
   51: export function saveReportDocumentEditorState(state: ReportDocumentEditorState) {

FILE: lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-signature-policy.ts
============================================================
    1: import type {
    2:   ReportDocumentBlock,
    3:   ReportDocumentDraft,
    4:   ReportDocumentPage,
    5:   ReportSignatureBlock,
    6: } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-types";
    7: 
    8: function isSignatureBlock(block: ReportDocumentBlock): block is ReportSignatureBlock {
    9:   return block.type === "SIGNATURES";
   10: }
   11: 
   12: function removeSignatureBlocksFromPage(page: ReportDocumentPage): ReportDocumentPage {
   13:   return {
   14:     ...page,
   15:     blocks: page.blocks.filter((block) => !isSignatureBlock(block)),
   16:   };
   17: }
   18: 
   19: export function getReportSignatureBlock(
   20:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
   21: ): ReportSignatureBlock | null {
   22:   for (const page of draft.pages) {
   23:     const signatureBlock = page.blocks.find(isSignatureBlock);
   24: 
   25:     if (signatureBlock) return signatureBlock;
   26:   }
   27: 
   28:   const signatures = draft.payload.signatures || [];
   29: 
   30:   if (signatures.length === 0) return null;
   31: 
   32:   return {
   33:     id: "system-signatures",
   34:     type: "SIGNATURES",
   35:     title: "الاعتمادات",
   36:     signatures,
   37:     order: 999999,
   38:     source: "SYSTEM",
   39:     locked: true,
   40:   };
   41: }
   42: 
   43: export function applyReportSignaturePolicy(
   44:   draft: ReportDocumentDraft,
   45: ): ReportDocumentDraft {
   46:   const signatureBlock = getReportSignatureBlock(draft);
   47: 
   48:   const pagesWithoutSignatures = draft.pages.map(removeSignatureBlocksFromPage);
   49: 
   50:   if (!signatureBlock) {
   51:     return {
   52:       ...draft,
   53:       pages: pagesWithoutSignatures,
   54:     };
   55:   }
   56: 
   57:   const pages =
   58:     pagesWithoutSignatures.length > 0
   59:       ? pagesWithoutSignatures
   60:       : [
   61:           {
   62:             id: "page-auto-1",
   63:             title: draft.title || "التقرير",
   64:             order: 1000,
   65:             kind: "AUTO" as const,
   66:             blocks: [],
   67:           },
   68:         ];
   69: 
   70:   const lastPage = pages[pages.length - 1];
   71: 
   72:   return {
   73:     ...draft,
   74:     pages: pages.map((page) =>
   75:       page.id === lastPage.id
   76:         ? {
   77:             ...page,
   78:             blocks: [
   79:               ...page.blocks.filter((block) => !isSignatureBlock(block)),
   80:               {
   81:                 ...signatureBlock,
   82:                 order: 999999,
   83:                 locked: true,
   84:                 source: "SYSTEM",
   85:               },
   86:             ],
   87:           }
   88:         : page,
   89:     ),
   90:   };
   91: }

    6: } from "@/lib/report-engine/document-draft/report-document-types";

    8: 
    9: export function createReportTableCell(value = ""): ReportTableCell {
   10:   return {
   11:     id: createReportDocumentId("cell"),
   12:     value,
   13:   };
   14: }
   15: 
   16: export function createReportTableColumn(title: string): ReportTableColumn {
   17:   return {
   18:     id: createReportDocumentId("column"),
   19:     title,
   20:   };
   21: }
   22: 
   23: export function createReportTableRow(columns: ReportTableColumn[]): ReportTableRow {
   24:   return {
   25:     id: createReportDocumentId("row"),
   26:     cells: columns.map(() => createReportTableCell()),
   27:   };
   28: }
   29: 
   30: export function createDefaultReportTableBlock(order: number): ReportTableBlock {
   31:   const columns = [
   32:     createReportTableColumn("المجال"),
   33:     createReportTableColumn("الإجراء"),
   34:     createReportTableColumn("ملاحظات"),
   35:   ];
   36: 
   37:   return {
   38:     id: createReportDocumentId("table"),
   39:     type: "TABLE",
   40:     title: "جدول",
   41:     order,
   42:     source: "USER",
   43:     locked: false,
   44:     settings: {
   45:       highlightHeaderRow: true,
   46:       highlightFirstColumn: true,
   47:       repeatHeaderOnPageBreak: true,
   48:       rounded: true,
   49:       compact: false,
   50:     },
   51:     columns,
   52:     rows: [
   53:       createReportTableRow(columns),
   54:       createReportTableRow(columns),
   55:       createReportTableRow(columns),
   56:     ],
   57:   };
   58: }
   59: 
   60: export function normalizeTableRows(table: ReportTableBlock): ReportTableBlock {
   61:   return {
   62:     ...table,
   63:     rows: table.rows.map((row) => ({
   64:       ...row,
   65:       cells: table.columns.map((_, index) => {
   66:         return row.cells[index] || createReportTableCell();
   67:       }),
   68:     })),
   69:   };
   70: }
   71: 
   72: export function addReportTableRow(table: ReportTableBlock): ReportTableBlock {
   73:   return normalizeTableRows({
   74:     ...table,
   75:     rows: [...table.rows, createReportTableRow(table.columns)],
   76:   });
   77: }
   78: 
   79: export function removeReportTableRow(
   80:   table: ReportTableBlock,
   81:   rowId: string,
   82: ): ReportTableBlock {
   83:   if (table.rows.length <= 1) return table;
   84: 
   85:   return normalizeTableRows({
   86:     ...table,
   87:     rows: table.rows.filter((row) => row.id !== rowId),
   88:   });
   89: }
   90: 
   91: export function addReportTableColumn(table: ReportTableBlock): ReportTableBlock {
   92:   const nextColumn = createReportTableColumn(`عمود ${table.columns.length + 1}`);
   93: 
   94:   return normalizeTableRows({
   95:     ...table,
   96:     columns: [...table.columns, nextColumn],
   97:     rows: table.rows.map((row) => ({
   98:       ...row,
   99:       cells: [...row.cells, createReportTableCell()],
  100:     })),
  101:   });
  102: }
  103: 
  104: export function removeReportTableColumn(
  105:   table: ReportTableBlock,
  106:   columnId: string,
  107: ): ReportTableBlock {
  108:   if (table.columns.length <= 1) return table;
  109: 
  110:   const columnIndex = table.columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === columnId);
  111: 
  112:   if (columnIndex < 0) return table;
  113: 
  114:   return normalizeTableRows({
  115:     ...table,
  116:     columns: table.columns.filter((column) => column.id !== columnId),
  117:     rows: table.rows.map((row) => ({
  118:       ...row,
  119:       cells: row.cells.filter((_, index) => index !== columnIndex),
  120:     })),
  121:   });
  122: }
  123: 
  124: export function updateReportTableColumn(
  125:   table: ReportTableBlock,
  126:   columnId: string,
  127:   title: string,
  128: ): ReportTableBlock {
  129:   return {
  130:     ...table,
  131:     columns: table.columns.map((column) =>
  132:       column.id === columnId ? { ...column, title } : column,
  133:     ),
  134:   };
  135: }
  136: 
  137: export function updateReportTableCell(
  138:   table: ReportTableBlock,
  139:   rowId: string,
  140:   columnId: string,
  141:   value: string,
  142: ): ReportTableBlock {
  143:   const columnIndex = table.columns.findIndex((column) => column.id === columnId);
  144: 
  145:   if (columnIndex < 0) return table;
  146: 
  147:   return normalizeTableRows({
  148:     ...table,
  149:     rows: table.rows.map((row) => {
  150:       if (row.id !== rowId) return row;
  151: 
  152:       return {
  153:         ...row,
  154:         cells: row.cells.map((cell, index) =>
  155:           index === columnIndex ? { ...cell, value } : cell,
  156:         ),
  157:       };
  158:     }),
  159:   });
  160: }
  161: 
  162: export function countFilledTableCells(table: ReportTableBlock) {
  163:   return table.rows.reduce((total, row) => {
  164:     return (
  165:       total +
  166:       row.cells.filter((cell) => String(cell.value || "").trim().length > 0)
  167:         .length
  168:     );
  169:   }, 0);
  170: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/guardian-summons-template-runtime.ts
============================================================
    1: import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma";
    2: import { guardianSummonsTemplatePreset } from "@/components/report-engine/guardian-summons-letter-preview";
    3: 
    4: const DESIGN_PRESET = "guardian-summons-letter-v1";
    5: const PRESET_ID = "tpl-guardian-summons-letter";
    6: 
    7: type DbReportTemplateLike = {
    8:   id?: string;
    9:   name?: string | null;
   10:   description?: string | null;
   11:   serviceSlug?: string | null;
   12:   isActive?: boolean | null;
   13:   templateJson?: unknown;
   14:   content?: unknown;
   15:   updatedAt?: Date | string | null;
   16:   createdAt?: Date | string | null;
   17: };
   18: 
   19: export async function resolveGuardianSummonsTemplate() {
   20:   const savedTemplate = await findSavedGuardianSummonsTemplate();
   21: 
   22:   if (savedTemplate) {
   23:     return savedTemplate;
   24:   }
   25: 
   26:   return guardianSummonsTemplatePreset;
   27: }
   28: 
   29: async function findSavedGuardianSummonsTemplate() {
   30:   try {
   31:     const prismaAny = prisma as unknown as {
   32:       reportTemplate?: {
   33:         findMany: (args: unknown) => Promise<DbReportTemplateLike[]>;
   34:       };
   35:     };
   36: 
   37:     if (!prismaAny.reportTemplate?.findMany) {
   38:       return null;
   39:     }
   40: 
   41:     const rows = await prismaAny.reportTemplate.findMany({
   42:       where: {
   43:         isActive: true,
   44:       },
   45:       orderBy: {
   46:         updatedAt: "desc",
   47:       },
   48:       take: 100,
   49:     });
   50: 
   51:     const normalized = rows
   52:       .map(normalizeSavedTemplate)
   53:       .filter(Boolean) as Array<typeof guardianSummonsTemplatePreset>;
   54: 
   55:     const published = normalized.find(
   56:       (template: any) =>
   57:         template.designPreset === DESIGN_PRESET &&
   58:         template.status === "PUBLISHED"
   59:     );
   60: 
   61:     if (published) return published;
   62: 
   63:     const latest = normalized.find(
   64:       (template: any) => template.designPreset === DESIGN_PRESET
   65:     );
   66: 
   67:     return latest || null;
   68:   } catch (error) {
   69:     console.error("resolveGuardianSummonsTemplate failed:", error);
   70:     return null;
   71:   }
   72: }
   73: 
   74: function normalizeSavedTemplate(row: DbReportTemplateLike) {
   75:   const raw = row.templateJson ?? row.content;
   76: 
   77:   let parsed = raw;
   78: 
   79:   if (typeof raw === "string") {
   80:     try {
   81:       parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
   82:     } catch {
   83:       parsed = null;
   84:     }
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== "object") {
   88:     return null;
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   const template = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
   92: 
   93:   const designPreset = String(template.designPreset || "");
   94: 
   95:   if (designPreset !== DESIGN_PRESET && row.id !== PRESET_ID) {
   96:     return null;
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   return {
  100:     ...guardianSummonsTemplatePreset,
  101:     ...template,
  102:     id: String(template.id || row.id || PRESET_ID),
  103:     name: String(template.name || row.name || guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.name),
  104:     description: String(
  105:       template.description ||
  106:         row.description ||
  107:         guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.description
  108:     ),
  109:     serviceSlug:
  110:       typeof template.serviceSlug === "string"
  111:         ? template.serviceSlug
  112:         : row.serviceSlug || undefined,
  113:     designPreset: DESIGN_PRESET,
  114:     updatedAt: String(
  115:       template.updatedAt ||
  116:         row.updatedAt ||
  117:         row.createdAt ||
  118:         guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.updatedAt
  119:     ),
  120:     pages:
  121:       Array.isArray(template.pages) && template.pages.length
  122:         ? template.pages
  123:         : guardianSummonsTemplatePreset.pages,
  124:   } as any;
  125: }

   42:     return {};
   43:   }

   45:     caseEntry: {
   46:       is: buildCaseEntryReportWhereForUser(user),
   47:     },

   49: }

   56:   if (role === "STAFF") return "الحالات المرتبطة بك";
   57:

   59: }

    1: import type { ReportBlock } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-block-types";
    2: import type { SmartReportPayload } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    3: 
    4: function cleanText(value: unknown) {
    5:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
    6: }
    7: 
    8: function hasValue(value: unknown) {
    9:   return cleanText(value).length > 0;
   10: }
   11: 
   12: function estimatedTextHeight(title: string | undefined, body: string | undefined) {
   13:   const titleLength = cleanText(title).length;
   14:   const bodyLength = cleanText(body).length;
   15: 
   16:   if (titleLength + bodyLength <= 0) return 0;
   17: 
   18:   const titleHeight = titleLength > 0 ? 14 : 0;
   19:   const lineCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(bodyLength / 34));
   20: 
   21:   return 22 + titleHeight + lineCount * 10;
   22: }
   23: 
   24: function estimatedFieldsHeight(count: number) {
   25:   if (count <= 0) return 0;
   26: 
   27:   return 14 + Math.ceil(count / 4) * 14;
   28: }
   29: 
   30: export function buildReportBlocks(payload: SmartReportPayload): ReportBlock[] {
   31:   const primaryFields = payload.primaryFields.filter((field) =>
   32:     hasValue(field.value),
   33:   );
   34: 
   35:   const detailFields = payload.detailFields.filter((field) =>
   36:     hasValue(field.value),
   37:   );
   38: 
   39:   const allFields = [...primaryFields, ...detailFields];
   40: 
   41:   const blocks: ReportBlock[] = [
   42:     {
   43:       id: "header",
   44:       type: "HEADER",
   45:       placement: "LOCKED",
   46:       estimatedHeight: 0,
   47:       movable: false,
   48:       editable: false,
   49:       order: 0,
   50:     },
   51:   ];
   52: 
   53:   if (allFields.length > 0) {
   54:     blocks.push({
   55:       id: "meta-fields",
   56:       type: "META_FIELDS",
   57:       fields: allFields,
   58:       placement: "CONTENT",
   59:       estimatedHeight: estimatedFieldsHeight(allFields.length),
   60:       movable: false,
   61:       editable: true,
   62:       order: 100,
   63:     });
   64:   }
   65: 
   66:   if (hasValue(payload.narrative?.body)) {
   67:     blocks.push({
   68:       id: "narrative",
   69:       type: "NARRATIVE",
   70:       title: payload.narrative.title || "وصف التنفيذ",
   71:       body: payload.narrative.body,
   72:       placement: "CONTENT",
   73:       estimatedHeight: estimatedTextHeight(
   74:         payload.narrative.title,
   75:         payload.narrative.body,
   76:       ),
   77:       movable: false,
   78:       editable: true,
   79:       order: 200,
   80:     });
   81:   }
   82: 
   83:   for (const [index, customBlock] of (payload.customBlocks || []).entries()) {
   84:     if (!hasValue(customBlock.title) && !hasValue(customBlock.body)) continue;
   85: 
   86:     blocks.push({
   87:       id: `custom-${customBlock.id}`,
   88:       type:
   89:         customBlock.type === "BULLET_LIST"
   90:           ? "CUSTOM_BULLET_LIST"
   91:           : "CUSTOM_PARAGRAPH",
   92:       title: customBlock.title,
   93:       body: customBlock.body,
   94:       placement: "CONTENT",
   95:       estimatedHeight: estimatedTextHeight(
   96:         customBlock.title,
   97:         customBlock.body,
   98:       ),
   99:       movable: true,
  100:       editable: true,
  101:       sourceCustomBlockId: customBlock.id,
  102:       targetPageIndex: customBlock.targetPageIndex,
  103:       targetZone: customBlock.targetZone,
  104:       order: customBlock.order ?? 300 + index * 10,
  105:     });
  106:   }
  107: 
  108:   if (payload.evidence.items.length > 0) {
  109:     blocks.push({
  110:       id: "evidence",
  111:       type: "EVIDENCE_GRID",
  112:       evidenceItems: payload.evidence.items,
  113:       placement: "CONTENT",
  114:       estimatedHeight: 90,
  115:       movable: false,
  116:       editable: true,
  117:       order: 800,
  118:     });
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   if (payload.signatures.length > 0) {
  122:     blocks.push({
  123:       id: "signatures",
  124:       type: "SIGNATURES",
  125:       signatures: payload.signatures,
  126:       placement: "END",
  127:       estimatedHeight: 34,
  128:       movable: false,
  129:       editable: false,
  130:       order: 900,
  131:     });
  132:   }
  133: 
  134:   blocks.push({
  135:     id: "footer",
  136:     type: "FOOTER",
  137:     placement: "LOCKED",
  138:     estimatedHeight: 0,
  139:     movable: false,
  140:     editable: false,
  141:     order: 1000,
  142:   });
  143: 
  144:   return blocks;
  145: }

    1: import type {
    2:   ReportBlock,

   12: const DEFAULT_PAGE_CAPACITY = 260;
   13: const MAX_TEXT_BLOCK_HEIGHT = 82;
   14: const APPROX_CHARS_PER_TEXT_PAGE = 280;
   15: const BULLET_LINES_PER_PAGE = 7;
   16: 
   17: function clonePayload(payload: SmartReportPayload): SmartReportPayload {
   18:   return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
   19: }
   20: 
   21: function chunkArray<T>(items: T[], size: number) {
   22:   const result: T[][] = [];
   23: 
   24:   for (let index = 0; index < items.length; index += size) {
   25:     result.push(items.slice(index, index + size));
   26:   }
   27: 
   28:   return result;
   29: }
   30: 
   31: function splitText(value: string, maxLength: number) {
   32:   const text = String(value || "").trim();
   33: 
   34:   if (text.length <= maxLength) return text ? [text] : [];
   35: 
   36:   const chunks: string[] = [];
   37:   let remaining = text;
   38: 
   39:   while (remaining.length > maxLength) {
   40:     let cutIndex = remaining.lastIndexOf(" ", maxLength);
   41: 
   42:     if (cutIndex < Math.floor(maxLength * 0.6)) {
   43:       cutIndex = maxLength;
   44:     }
   45: 
   46:     chunks.push(remaining.slice(0, cutIndex).trim());
   47:     remaining = remaining.slice(cutIndex).trim();
   48:   }
   49: 
   50:   if (remaining) chunks.push(remaining);
   51: 
   52:   return chunks;
   53: }
   54: 
   55: function estimateTextHeight(title: string | undefined, body: string | undefined) {
   56:   const titleLength = String(title || "").trim().length;
   57:   const bodyLength = String(body || "").trim().length;
   58:   const titleHeight = titleLength > 0 ? 12 : 0;
   59:   const lineCount = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(bodyLength / 38));
   60: 
   61:   return 20 + titleHeight + lineCount * 9;
   62: }
   63: 
   64: function getEvidenceBlockHeight(config?: ReportEvidenceConfig) {
   65:   const itemsPerPage = config?.itemsPerPage ?? 2;
   66: 
   67:   if (itemsPerPage === 1) return 165;
   68:   if (itemsPerPage === 2) return 108;
   69: 
   70:   return 84;
   71: }
   72: 
   73: function getPageTitle(baseTitle: string, index: number) {
   74:   return index === 0 ? baseTitle : `${baseTitle} ${index + 1}`;
   75: }
   76: 
   77: function isCustomTextBlock(block: ReportBlock) {
   78:   return (
   79:     block.type === "CUSTOM_PARAGRAPH" ||
   80:     block.type === "CUSTOM_BULLET_LIST"
   81:   );
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function isCustomBlock(block: ReportBlock) {
   85:   return (
   86:     block.type === "CUSTOM_PARAGRAPH" ||
   87:     block.type === "CUSTOM_BULLET_LIST"
   88:   );
   89: }
   90: 
   91: function getPageHeight(blocks: ReportBlock[]) {
   92:   return blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.estimatedHeight, 0);
   93: }
   94: 
   95: function expandEvidenceBlocks(
   96:   block: ReportBlock,
   97:   evidenceConfig?: ReportEvidenceConfig,
   98: ): ReportBlock[] {
   99:   const items = filterValidReportEvidenceItems(block.evidenceItems || []);
  100:   const visible = evidenceConfig?.visible ?? true;
  101: 
  102:   if (!visible || items.length === 0) return [];
  103: 
  104:   const itemsPerPage = evidenceConfig?.itemsPerPage ?? 2;
  105:   const chunks = chunkArray(items, itemsPerPage);
  106: 
  107:   return chunks.map((chunk, index) => ({
  108:     ...block,
  109:     id: `${block.id}-${index + 1}`,
  110:     evidenceItems: chunk,
  111:     estimatedHeight: getEvidenceBlockHeight(evidenceConfig),
  112:   }));
  113: }
  114: 
  115: function splitOversizedTextBlock(block: ReportBlock): ReportBlock[] {
  116:   if (!isCustomTextBlock(block)) return [block];
  117: 
  118:   const body = String(block.body || "").trim();
  119:   const title = String(block.title || "").trim();
  120: 
  121:   const chunks =
  122:     block.type === "CUSTOM_BULLET_LIST"
  123:       ? chunkArray(
  124:           body
  125:             .split(/\r?\n/)
  126:             .map((line) => line.trim())
  127:             .filter(Boolean),
  128:           BULLET_LINES_PER_PAGE,
  129:         ).map((chunk) => chunk.join("\n"))
  130:       : splitText(body, APPROX_CHARS_PER_TEXT_PAGE);
  131: 
  132:   if (chunks.length <= 1 && block.estimatedHeight <= MAX_TEXT_BLOCK_HEIGHT) {
  133:     return [block];
  134:   }
  135: 
  136:   if (chunks.length === 0) return [block];
  137: 
  138:   return chunks.map((chunk, index) => {
  139:     const partTitle = index === 0 ? title : `${title || "فقرة"} - تابع`;
  140: 
  141:     return {
  142:       ...block,
  143:       id: `${block.id}-part-${index + 1}`,
  144:       title: partTitle,
  145:       body: chunk,
  146:       estimatedHeight: Math.min(
  147:         MAX_TEXT_BLOCK_HEIGHT,
  148:         estimateTextHeight(partTitle, chunk),
  149:       ),
  150:     };
  151:   });
  152: }
  153: 
  154: function normalizeContentBlock(
  155:   block: ReportBlock,
  156:   evidenceConfig?: ReportEvidenceConfig,
  157: ): ReportBlock[] {
  158:   if (block.type === "EVIDENCE_GRID") {
  159:     return expandEvidenceBlocks(block, evidenceConfig);
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   return splitOversizedTextBlock(block);
  163: }
  164: 
  165: function pushBlockWithCapacity(
  166:   pages: ReportBlock[][],
  167:   block: ReportBlock,
  168:   pageCapacity: number,
  169: ) {
  170:   let currentPage = pages[pages.length - 1];
  171: 
  172:   if (!currentPage) {
  173:     currentPage = [];
  174:     pages.push(currentPage);
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   const currentHeight = getPageHeight(currentPage);
  178: 
  179:   if (currentPage.length > 0 && currentHeight + block.estimatedHeight > pageCapacity) {
  180:     pages.push([block]);
  181:     return;
  182:   }
  183: 
  184:   currentPage.push(block);
  185: }
  186: 
  187: function insertAnchoredBlock(
  188:   pages: ReportBlock[][],
  189:   block: ReportBlock,
  190:   pageCapacity: number,
  191: ) {
  192:   const targetPageIndex =
  193:     typeof block.targetPageIndex === "number" && block.targetPageIndex >= 0
  194:       ? block.targetPageIndex
  195:       : 0;
  196: 
  197:   while (pages.length <= targetPageIndex) {
  198:     pages.push([]);
  199:   }
  200: 
  201:   let pageIndex = targetPageIndex;
  202: 
  203:   while (true) {
  204:     const page = pages[pageIndex] || [];
  205:     pages[pageIndex] = page;
  206: 
  207:     const pageHeight = getPageHeight(page);
  208:     const relaxedCapacity =
  209:       pageIndex === targetPageIndex ? pageCapacity + 45 : pageCapacity;
  210: 
  211:     if (page.length === 0 || pageHeight + block.estimatedHeight <= relaxedCapacity) {
  212:       page.push(block);
  213:       return;
  214:     }
  215: 
  216:     pageIndex++;
  217: 
  218:     if (!pages[pageIndex]) {
  219:       pages[pageIndex] = [];
  220:     }
  221:   }
  222: }
  223: 
  224: function buildPayloadForPage(
  225:   basePayload: SmartReportPayload,
  226:   pageTitle: string,
  227:   blocks: ReportBlock[],
  228:   evidenceConfig?: ReportEvidenceConfig,
  229: ): SmartReportPayload {
  230:   const payload = clonePayload(basePayload);
  231: 
  232:   const metaBlock = blocks.find((block) => block.type === "META_FIELDS");
  233:   const narrativeBlock = blocks.find((block) => block.type === "NARRATIVE");
  234:   const evidenceItems = blocks.flatMap((block) => block.evidenceItems || []);
  235:   const signatures = blocks.flatMap((block) => block.signatures || []);
  236: 
  237:   const customBlocks = blocks
  238:     .filter(isCustomBlock)
  239:     .map((block) => ({
  240:       id: block.sourceCustomBlockId || block.id,
  241:       type:
  242:         block.type === "CUSTOM_BULLET_LIST"
  243:           ? ("BULLET_LIST" as const)
  244:           : ("PARAGRAPH" as const),
  245:       title: block.title || "",
  246:       body: block.body || "",
  247:       targetPageIndex: block.targetPageIndex,
  248:       targetZone: block.targetZone,
  249:       order: block.order,
  250:     }));
  251: 
  252:   payload.title = pageTitle;
  253:   payload.caseInfo = {
  254:     ...payload.caseInfo,
  255:     title: pageTitle,
  256:   };
  257: 
  258:   payload.primaryFields = metaBlock ? payload.primaryFields : [];
  259:   payload.detailFields = metaBlock ? payload.detailFields : [];
  260: 
  261:   payload.narrative = narrativeBlock
  262:     ? {
  263:         title: narrativeBlock.title || payload.narrative.title || "وصف التنفيذ",
  264:         body: narrativeBlock.body || "",
  265:       }
  266:     : {
  267:         title: "",
  268:         body: "",
  269:       };
  270: 
  271:   payload.customBlocks = customBlocks;
  272:   payload.evidence = {
  273:     layout: payload.evidence.layout,
  274:     items: evidenceItems,
  275:   };
  276:   payload.signatures = signatures;
  277:   payload.evidenceConfig = evidenceConfig;
  278: 
  279:   return payload;
  280: }
  281: 
  282: export function paginateReportBlocks(
  283:   payload: SmartReportPayload,
  284:   blocks: ReportBlock[],
  285:   options: ReportPaginationOptions = {},
  286: ): ReportPage[] {
  287:   const pageCapacity = options.pageCapacity ?? DEFAULT_PAGE_CAPACITY;
  288:   const evidenceConfig = options.evidenceConfig;
  289:   const baseTitle = payload.title || payload.caseInfo.title || "التقرير";
  290: 
  291:   const anchoredCustomBlocks = blocks.filter(
  292:     (block) => isCustomBlock(block) && typeof block.targetPageIndex === "number",
  293:   );
  294: 
  295:   const contentBlocks = blocks
  296:     .filter((block) => block.placement === "CONTENT")
  297:     .filter((block) => !(isCustomBlock(block) && typeof block.targetPageIndex === "number"))
  298:     .sort((a, b) => (a.order ?? 500) - (b.order ?? 500))
  299:     .flatMap((block) => normalizeContentBlock(block, evidenceConfig));
  300: 
  301:   const signatureBlock =
  302:     blocks.find((block) => block.placement === "END" && block.type === "SIGNATURES") ||
  303:     null;
  304: 
  305:   const pages: ReportBlock[][] = [[]];
  306: 
  307:   for (const block of contentBlocks) {
  308:     if (block.type === "MANUAL_PAGE_BREAK") {
  309:       pages.push([block]);
  310:       continue;
  311:     }
  312: 
  313:     pushBlockWithCapacity(pages, block, pageCapacity);
  314:   }
  315: 
  316:   for (const anchoredBlock of anchoredCustomBlocks) {
  317:     const parts = splitOversizedTextBlock(anchoredBlock);
  318: 
  319:     for (const part of parts) {
  320:       insertAnchoredBlock(pages, part, pageCapacity);
  321:     }
  322:   }
  323: 
  324:   const safePages = pages.length > 0 ? pages : [[]];
  325: 
  326:   if (signatureBlock) {
  327:     const lastPage = safePages[safePages.length - 1];
  328:     const lastPageHeight = getPageHeight(lastPage);
  329: 
  330:     if (lastPage.length > 0 && lastPageHeight + signatureBlock.estimatedHeight <= pageCapacity) {
  331:       lastPage.push(signatureBlock);
  332:     } else {
  333:       safePages.push([signatureBlock]);
  334:     }
  335:   }
  336: 
  337:   return safePages.map((pageBlocks, index) => {
  338:     const title = getPageTitle(baseTitle, index);
  339: 
  340:     return {
  341:       key: index === 0 ? "main" : `page-${index + 1}`,
  342:       title,
  343:       index,
  344:       blocks: pageBlocks,
  345:       payload: buildPayloadForPage(payload, title, pageBlocks, evidenceConfig),
  346:     };
  347:   });
  348: }

   15: export function isLegacyReportTemplateId(value?: string | null) {
   16:   return Boolean(

   18:       LEGACY_REPORT_TEMPLATE_IDS.includes(value as LegacyReportTemplateId)
   19:   );

   22: export function parseBuilderTemplateJson(value: unknown) {
   23:   if (!value) {
   24:     return null;
   25:   }
   26: 
   27:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   28:     try {
   29:       return JSON.parse(value) as Record<string, any>;
   30:     } catch {
   31:       return null;
   32:     }
   33:   }
   34: 
   35:   if (typeof value === "object") {
   36:     return value as Record<string, any>;
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return null;
   40: }

   42: export function getBuilderTemplateFromSnapshot(snapshot: unknown) {
   43:   const data = snapshot as
   44:     | {
   45:         source?: string;
   46:         builderTemplate?: any;
   47:       }
   48:     | null
   49:     | undefined;
   50: 
   51:   if (data?.source !== "TEMPLATE_BUILDER") {
   52:     return null;
   53:   }
   54: 
   55:   if (!data.builderTemplate || !Array.isArray(data.builderTemplate.pages)) {
   56:     return null;
   57:   }
   58: 
   59:   return data.builderTemplate;
   60: }

   62: export async function getBuilderTemplateFromDatabase(templateId?: string | null) {
   63:   if (!templateId || isLegacyReportTemplateId(templateId)) {
   64:     return null;
   65:   }
   66: 
   67:   const templateRecord = await prisma.reportTemplate.findUnique({
   68:     where: {
   69:       id: templateId,
   70:     },
   71:   });
   72: 
   73:   if (!templateRecord) {
   74:     return null;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   const templateJson =
   78:     parseBuilderTemplateJson(templateRecord.templateJson) ||
   79:     parseBuilderTemplateJson(templateRecord.content);
   80: 
   81:   if (!templateJson || !Array.isArray(templateJson.pages)) {
   82:     return null;
   83:   }
   84: 
   85:   return {
   86:     ...templateJson,
   87:     id: templateRecord.id,
   88:     name: templateRecord.name || templateJson.name,
   89:     description:
   90:       templateRecord.description ||
   91:       templateJson.description ||
   92:       "قالب تقرير محفوظ من صانع القوالب.",
   93:     serviceSlug: templateRecord.serviceSlug || templateJson.serviceSlug || null,
   94:     status: templateJson.status || "PUBLISHED",
   95:   };

  118: export function buildBuilderPreviewCaseData(

  141:         .filter((item: any) => item.visible !== false)
  142:         .map((item: any) => ({

  150:               : undefined,

  152:           note: item.caption || "",
  153:         }))
  154:     : caseEvidenceItems.map((item: any) => ({

  164:           note: item.note || "",

  166:   );

  120: function stringifyReportValue(value: unknown): string {
  121:   if (value === null || value === undefined) {
  122:     return "";
  123:   }
  124: 
  125:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  126:     return value;
  127:   }
  128: 
  129:   if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
  130:     return String(value);
  131:   }
  132: 
  133:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  134:     return value
  135:       .map((item) => stringifyReportValue(item))
  136:       .filter(Boolean)
  137:       .join("، ");
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   try {
  141:     return JSON.stringify(value);
  142:   } catch {
  143:     return String(value);
  144:   }
  145: }

  147:   /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;

  149: function hasReportImageEvidenceExtension(value: unknown) {
  150:   const text = String(value || "").trim().replaceAll("\\", "/");

  153:     return false;
  154:   }
  155: 
  156:   return REPORT_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.test(text);
  157: }

  159: function isImageEvidence(item: {
  160:   type?: string | null;
  161:   mimeType?: string | null;
  162:   fileUrl?: string | null;
  163:   url?: string | null;
  164:   imageUrl?: string | null;
  165:   publicUrl?: string | null;
  166:   storagePath?: string | null;
  167:   fileName?: string | null;
  168:   title?: string | null;

  173:

  179:     item.fileUrl,

  181:     item.imageUrl,
  182:     item.publicUrl,
  183:     item.storagePath,
  184:     item.fileName,
  185:     item.title,

  297:   });
  298: 
  299:   return normalizeValue(found?.value);
  300: }
  301: 
  302: function getItemsByKeywords(
  303:   values: CaseValueLike[] | undefined,
  304:   keywords: string[]
  305: ) {
  306:   const safeValues = values || [];
  307: 
  308:   return safeValues
  309:     .filter((item) => {
  310:       const label = normalizeArabic(item.field?.label || "");
  311:       const name = normalizeArabic(item.field?.name || "");
  312: 
  313:       return keywords.some((keyword) => {
  314:         const normalizedKeyword = normalizeArabic(keyword);
  315: 
  316:         return (
  317:           label.includes(normalizedKeyword) ||
  318:           name.includes(normalizedKeyword)
  319:         );
  320:       });
  321:     })
  322:     .map((item) => normalizeValue(item.value))
  323:     .filter((value): value is string => Boolean(value));
  324: }
  325: 
  326: function normalizeArabic(value: string) {
  327:   return value
  328:     .replace(/[أإآ]/g, "ا")
  329:     .replace(/ى/g, "ي")
  330:     .replace(/ة/g, "ه")
  331:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  332:     .trim()
  333:     .toLowerCase();
  334: }
  335: 
  336: function normalizeValue(value?: string | null) {
  337:   if (!value) return undefined;
  338: 
  339:   const cleanValue = String(value).trim();
  340: 
  341:   if (!cleanValue || cleanValue === "null" || cleanValue === "undefined") {
  342:     return undefined;
  343:   }
  344: 
  345:   return cleanValue;
  346: }
  347: 
  348: function buildStudentTarget(student?: StudentLike | null) {
  349:   if (!student) return "غير محدد";
  350: 
  351:   const name = student.fullName || student.name;
  352:   const grade = student.grade;
  353:   const classroom = student.classroom;
  354: 
  355:   return [name, grade, classroom].filter(Boolean).join(" - ") || "غير محدد";
  356: }
  357: 
  358: function formatArabicDate(date?: Date | string | null) {
  359:   if (!date) {
  360:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA", {
  361:       year: "numeric",
  362:       month: "2-digit",
  363:       day: "2-digit",
  364:     }).format(new Date());
  365:   }
  366: 
  367:   const dateObject = typeof date === "string" ? new Date(date) : date;
  368: 
  369:   if (Number.isNaN(dateObject.getTime())) {
  370:     return String(date);
  371:   }
  372: 
  373:   return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA", {
  374:     year: "numeric",
  375:     month: "2-digit",
  376:     day: "2-digit",
  377:   }).format(dateObject);
  378: }
  379: 
  380: function toArabicOrdinal(index: number) {
  381:   const values: Record<number, string> = {
  382:     1: "الأول",
  383:     2: "الثاني",
  384:     3: "الثالث",
  385:     4: "الرابع",
  386:     5: "الخامس",
  387:     6: "السادس",
  388:     7: "السابع",
  389:     8: "الثامن",
  390:     9: "التاسع",
  391:     10: "العاشر",
  392:   };
  393: 
  394:   return values[index] || String(index);
  395: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/report-draft-merger.ts

    1: import type {
    2:   ReportDraftAdjustments,
    3:   SmartReportCustomBlock,
    4:   SmartReportPayload,
    5: } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    6: 
    7: function normalizeValue(value: unknown) {
    8:   if (typeof value === "string") return value;
    9:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
   10: 
   11:   return String(value);
   12: }
   13: 
   14: function applyFieldAdjustments(
   15:   fields: SmartReportPayload["primaryFields"],
   16:   adjustments: Array<{ key: string; value: string }> | undefined,
   17: ) {
   18:   if (!adjustments?.length) return fields;
   19: 
   20:   return fields.map((field) => {
   21:     const override = adjustments.find((item) => item.key === field.key);
   22: 
   23:     return override ? { ...field, value: override.value } : field;
   24:   });
   25: }
   26: 
   27: function normalizeCustomBlocks(
   28:   blocks: SmartReportCustomBlock[] | undefined,
   29: ): SmartReportCustomBlock[] {
   30:   return (blocks || [])
   31:     .map((block) => ({
   32:       id: block.id,
   33:       type: block.type,
   34:       title: String(block.title || "").trim(),
   35:       body: String(block.body || "").trim(),
   36:       table: block.type === "TABLE" ? block.table : undefined,
   37:       targetPageIndex:
   38:         typeof block.targetPageIndex === "number"
   39:           ? block.targetPageIndex
   40:           : undefined,
   41:       targetZone: block.targetZone,
   42:       order: typeof block.order === "number" ? block.order : undefined,
   43:     }))
   44:     .filter((block) => {
   45:       if (block.type === "TABLE") return Boolean(block.table);
   46: 
   47:       return block.type === "PAGE_BREAK" || block.title || block.body;
   48:     });
   49: }
   50: 
   51: function getChangedFields(
   52:   originalFields: SmartReportPayload["primaryFields"],
   53:   editedFields: SmartReportPayload["primaryFields"],
   54: ) {
   55:   return editedFields
   56:     .filter((field) => {
   57:       const original = originalFields.find((item) => item.key === field.key);
   58: 
   59:       return (
   60:         original &&
   61:         normalizeValue(original.value) !== normalizeValue(field.value)
   62:       );
   63:     })
   64:     .map((field) => ({
   65:       key: field.key,
   66:       value: normalizeValue(field.value),
   67:     }));
   68: }
   69: 
   70: export function applyReportDraftAdjustments(
   71:   basePayload: SmartReportPayload,
   72:   adjustments: ReportDraftAdjustments | null | undefined,
   73: ): SmartReportPayload {
   74:   if (!adjustments) return basePayload;
   75: 
   76:   const nextPayload: SmartReportPayload = {
   77:     ...basePayload,
   78:     ...(adjustments.title !== undefined ? { title: adjustments.title } : {}),
   79:     ...(adjustments.evidenceConfig !== undefined
   80:       ? { evidenceConfig: adjustments.evidenceConfig }
   81:       : {}),
   82:     ...(adjustments.customBlocks !== undefined
   83:       ? { customBlocks: normalizeCustomBlocks(adjustments.customBlocks) }
   84:       : {}),
   85:     caseInfo: {
   86:       ...basePayload.caseInfo,
   87:       ...(adjustments.title !== undefined ? { title: adjustments.title } : {}),
   88:       ...(adjustments.caseInfo?.issuedAt !== undefined
   89:         ? { issuedAt: adjustments.caseInfo.issuedAt }
   90:         : {}),
   91:       ...(adjustments.caseInfo?.issuedBy !== undefined
   92:         ? { issuedBy: adjustments.caseInfo.issuedBy }
   93:         : {}),
   94:     },
   95:     narrative: {
   96:       ...basePayload.narrative,
   97:       ...(adjustments.narrative?.title !== undefined
   98:         ? { title: adjustments.narrative.title }
   99:         : {}),
  100:       ...(adjustments.narrative?.body !== undefined
  101:         ? { body: adjustments.narrative.body }
  102:         : {}),
  103:     },
  104:     primaryFields: applyFieldAdjustments(
  105:       basePayload.primaryFields,
  106:       adjustments.primaryFields,
  107:     ),
  108:     detailFields: applyFieldAdjustments(
  109:       basePayload.detailFields,
  110:       adjustments.detailFields,
  111:     ),
  112:   };
  113: 
  114:   return nextPayload;
  115: }
  116: 
  117: export function computeReportDraftAdjustments(
  118:   original: SmartReportPayload,
  119:   edited: SmartReportPayload,
  120: ): ReportDraftAdjustments {
  121:   const adjustments: ReportDraftAdjustments = {};
  122: 
  123:   if (edited.title !== original.title) {
  124:     adjustments.title = edited.title;
  125:   }
  126: 
  127:   if (edited.narrative.title !== original.narrative.title) {
  128:     adjustments.narrative = {
  129:       ...adjustments.narrative,
  130:       title: edited.narrative.title,
  131:     };
  132:   }
  133: 
  134:   if (edited.narrative.body !== original.narrative.body) {
  135:     adjustments.narrative = {
  136:       ...adjustments.narrative,
  137:       body: edited.narrative.body,
  138:     };
  139:   }
  140: 
  141:   const primaryFields = getChangedFields(
  142:     original.primaryFields,
  143:     edited.primaryFields,
  144:   );
  145: 
  146:   if (primaryFields.length > 0) {
  147:     adjustments.primaryFields = primaryFields;
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   const detailFields = getChangedFields(
  151:     original.detailFields,
  152:     edited.detailFields,
  153:   );
  154: 
  155:   if (detailFields.length > 0) {
  156:     adjustments.detailFields = detailFields;
  157:   }
  158: 
  159:   if (edited.caseInfo.issuedAt !== original.caseInfo.issuedAt) {
  160:     adjustments.caseInfo = {
  161:       ...adjustments.caseInfo,
  162:       issuedAt: edited.caseInfo.issuedAt,
  163:     };
  164:   }
  165: 
  166:   if (edited.caseInfo.issuedBy !== original.caseInfo.issuedBy) {
  167:     adjustments.caseInfo = {
  168:       ...adjustments.caseInfo,
  169:       issuedBy: edited.caseInfo.issuedBy,
  170:     };
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   if (
  174:     JSON.stringify(original.customBlocks || []) !==
  175:     JSON.stringify(edited.customBlocks || [])
  176:   ) {
  177:     adjustments.customBlocks = normalizeCustomBlocks(edited.customBlocks);
  178:   }
  179: 
  180:   return adjustments;
  181: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/report-evidence-utils.ts
