    1: export type ReportEvidenceLike = Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined;
    2: 
    3: type EvidenceValidationOptions = {
    4:   allowSampleEvidence?: boolean;
    5: };
    6: 
    7: const EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_KEYS = [
    8:   "url",
    9:   "fileUrl",
   10:   "imageUrl",
   11:   "publicUrl",
   12:   "storagePath",
   13:   "attachmentId",
   14:   "fileId",
   15:   "evidenceId",
   16:   "path",
   17:   "filePath",
   18:   "thumbnailUrl",
   19:   "previewUrl",
   20:   "downloadUrl",
   21:   "secureUrl",
   22:   "src",
   23: ];
   24: 
   25: const INVALID_REFERENCE_VALUES = new Set([
   26:   "#",
   27:   "-",
   28:   "null",
   29:   "undefined",
   30:   "about:blank",
   31: ]);
   32: 
   33: function cleanEvidenceText(value: unknown) {
   34:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
   35: }
   36: 
   37: function normalizeEvidenceReference(value: unknown) {
   38:   return cleanEvidenceText(value).replaceAll("\\", "/");
   39: }
   40: 
   41: function isPlaceholderEvidenceItem(item: Record<string, unknown>) {
   42:   const id = cleanEvidenceText(item.id);
   43:   const title = cleanEvidenceText(item.title);
   44:   const caption = cleanEvidenceText(item.caption);
   45:   const description = cleanEvidenceText(item.description);
   46:   const text = `${id} ${title} ${caption} ${description}`.toLowerCase();
   47: 
   48:   return (
   49:     /^placeholder-evidence(?:-|$)/i.test(id) ||
   50:     /^preview-evidence(?:-|$)/i.test(id) ||
   51:     text.includes("مساحة شاهد") ||
   52:     text.includes("مكان الشاهد") ||
   53:     text.includes("للمعاينة") ||
   54:     text.includes("placeholder evidence") ||
   55:     text.includes("preview evidence")
   56:   );
   57: }
   58: 
   59: function isUsableEvidenceReference(value: unknown) {
   60:   const reference = normalizeEvidenceReference(value);
   61:   const normalized = reference.toLowerCase();
   62: 
   63:   if (!reference || INVALID_REFERENCE_VALUES.has(normalized)) {
   64:     return false;
   65:   }
   66: 
   67:   if (normalized.startsWith("javascript:")) {
   68:     return false;
   69:   }
   70: 
   71:   if (
   72:     normalized === "preview" ||
   73:     normalized === "placeholder" ||
   74:     normalized.includes("placeholder-evidence")
   75:   ) {
   76:     return false;
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   return true;
   80: }
   81: 
   82: function isSampleEvidenceReference(value: unknown) {
   83:   const normalized = normalizeEvidenceReference(value).toLowerCase();
   84: 
   85:   return (
   86:     normalized.includes("/sample/report-evidence/") ||
   87:     normalized.startsWith("sample/report-evidence/")
   88:   );
   89: }
   90: 
   91: export function isValidReportEvidenceItem(
   92:   item: ReportEvidenceLike,
   93:   options: EvidenceValidationOptions = {},
   94: ) {
   95:   if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
   96:     return false;
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   if (isPlaceholderEvidenceItem(item)) {
  100:     return false;
  101:   }
  102: 
  103:   const references = EVIDENCE_REFERENCE_KEYS.map((key) => item[key]);
  104:   const usableReferences = references.filter(isUsableEvidenceReference);
  105: 
  106:   if (!usableReferences.length) {
  107:     return false;
  108:   }
  109: 
  110:   if (options.allowSampleEvidence) {
  111:     return true;
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return usableReferences.some((reference) => !isSampleEvidenceReference(reference));
  115: }
  116: 
  117: export function filterValidReportEvidenceItems<T extends ReportEvidenceLike>(
  118:   items: T[] | null | undefined,
  119:   options: EvidenceValidationOptions = {},
  120: ): T[] {
  121:   return (items || []).filter((item): item is T =>
  122:     isValidReportEvidenceItem(item, options),
  123:   );
  124: }

   33: function stripEducationOfficePrefix(value: string) {
   34:   return value
   35:     .replace(/^مكتب\s+(?:ال)?تعليم\s*/u, "")
   36:     .replace(/^مكتب\s+التعليم\s*/u, "")
   37:     .replace(/^إدارة\s+(?:ال)?تعليم\s*/u, "")
   38:     .replace(/^الإدارة\s+العامة\s+للتعليم\s*(?:ب)?/u, "")
   39:     .replace(/^ب(?=منطقة\s|محافظة\s)/u, "")
   40:     .replace(/^(منطقة|محافظة)\s+\1\s+/u, "$1 ")
   41:     .trim();
   42: }

   51:   const department = stripEducationOfficePrefix(
   52:     cleanOrganizationValue(params.educationDepartment),
   53:   );

   72:   { from: "منفذة", to: "منفذ" },
   73: ];
   74: 
   75: const PROTECTED_FIELD_HINTS = [
   76:   "student",
   77:   "studentname",
   78:   "guardian",
   79:   "executor",
   80:   "teachername",
   81:   "principalname",
   82:   "signedname",
   83:   "phone",
   84:   "nationalid",
   85:   "email",
   86:   "signature",
   87:   "توقيع",
   88:   "جوال",
   89:   "هاتف",
   90:   "هوية",
   91:   "اسم الطالب",
   92:   "اسم الطالبة",
   93:   "اسم ولي الأمر",
   94:   "اسم المعلم",
   95:   "اسم المعلمة",
   96:   "اسم المدير",
   97:   "اسم المديرة",
   98: ];
   99: 
  100: const PROTECTED_PHRASES = [
  101:   "النشاط الطلابي",
  102:   "النشاط الطلابية",
  103:   "الطلابي",
  104:   "الطلابية",
  105:   "الطالبية",
  106: ];
  107: 
  108: function cleanText(value: unknown) {
  109:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
  110: }
  111: 
  112: function normalizeLookupText(value: string) {
  113:   return value.toLowerCase().replace(/[\s_-]+/g, "");
  114: }
  115: 
  116: function escapeRegExp(value: string) {
  117:   return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
  118: }
  119: 
  120: function sortLongestFirst(replacements: PhraseReplacement[]) {
  121:   return [...replacements].sort((a, b) => b.from.length - a.from.length);
  122: }
  123: 
  124: function replaceAllExact(text: string, from: string, to: string) {
  125:   if (!from || !text.includes(from)) {
  126:     return text;
  127:   }
  128: 
  129:   return text.split(from).join(to);
  130: }
  131: 
  132: function replaceArabicWholeWord(text: string, from: string, to: string) {
  133:   if (!from) {
  134:     return text;
  135:   }
  136: 
  137:   const pattern = new RegExp(`(^|[^ء-ي])(${escapeRegExp(from)})(?=$|[^ء-ي])`, "g");
  138: 
  139:   return text.replace(pattern, (_, prefix: string) => `${prefix}${to}`);
  140: }
  141: 
  142: function protectPhrases(text: string) {
  143:   const protectedMap = new Map<string, string>();
  144:   let nextText = text;
  145: 
  146:   PROTECTED_PHRASES.forEach((phrase, index) => {
  147:     const token = `__REPORT_LANG_PROTECTED_${index}__`;
  148: 
  149:     if (nextText.includes(phrase)) {
  150:       protectedMap.set(token, phrase);
  151:       nextText = replaceAllExact(nextText, phrase, token);
  152:     }
  153:   });
  154: 
  155:   return {
  156:     text: nextText,
  157:     protectedMap,
  158:   };
  159: }
  160: 
  161: function restoreProtectedPhrases(text: string, protectedMap: Map<string, string>) {
  162:   let nextText = text;
  163: 
  164:   protectedMap.forEach((phrase, token) => {
  165:     nextText = replaceAllExact(nextText, token, phrase);
  166:   });
  167: 
  168:   return nextText;
  169: }
  170: 
  171: function getExactReplacements(mode: ReportLanguageMode) {
  172:   return mode === "FEMALE"
  173:     ? sortLongestFirst(FEMALE_EXACT_REPLACEMENTS)
  174:     : sortLongestFirst(MALE_EXACT_REPLACEMENTS);
  175: }
  176: 
  177: function getWholeWordReplacements(mode: ReportLanguageMode) {
  178:   return mode === "FEMALE"
  179:     ? sortLongestFirst(FEMALE_WHOLE_WORD_REPLACEMENTS)
  180:     : sortLongestFirst(MALE_WHOLE_WORD_REPLACEMENTS);
  181: }
  182: 
  183: export function normalizeReportLanguageMode(value: unknown): ReportLanguageMode {
  184:   return String(value || "").toUpperCase() === "FEMALE" ? "FEMALE" : "MALE";
  185: }
  186: 
  187: export function getReportLanguageModeFromUserGender(value: unknown): ReportLanguageMode {
  188:   return String(value || "").toUpperCase() === "FEMALE" ? "FEMALE" : "MALE";
  189: }
  190: 
  191: export function getReportLanguageModeLabel(mode: ReportLanguageMode): string {
  192:   return normalizeReportLanguageMode(mode) === "FEMALE" ? "مؤنث" : "مذكر";
  193: }
  194: 
  195: export function getReportLanguageModeInstruction(mode: ReportLanguageMode): string {
  196:   return normalizeReportLanguageMode(mode) === "FEMALE"
  197:     ? "استخدم صياغة التأنيث بشكل متسق. استخدم الطالبات بدل الطلاب، والمعلمة بدل المعلم، ورائدة النشاط بدل رائد النشاط، والموجهة الطلابية بدل الموجه الطلابي، ومديرة المدرسة بدل مدير المدرسة عند الحاجة. لا تستخدم الصياغة المذكرة العامة إذا كانت صيغة التقرير مؤنثة."
  198:     : "استخدم صياغة التذكير بشكل متسق في التقرير، وتجنب التحول إلى الصياغة المؤنثة إلا إذا كانت جزءًا ثابتًا من اسم شخص أو قيمة أصلية لا يجب تغييرها.";
  199: }
  200: 
  201: export function applyReportLanguageModeToText(
  202:   text: unknown,
  203:   mode: ReportLanguageMode,
  204: ): string {
  205:   const normalizedText = cleanText(text);
  206: 
  207:   if (!normalizedText) {
  208:     return "";
  209:   }
  210: 
  211:   const normalizedMode = normalizeReportLanguageMode(mode);
  212:   const { text: protectedText, protectedMap } = protectPhrases(normalizedText);
  213: 
  214:   let nextText = protectedText;
  215: 
  216:   for (const replacement of getExactReplacements(normalizedMode)) {
  217:     nextText = replaceAllExact(nextText, replacement.from, replacement.to);
  218:   }
  219: 
  220:   for (const replacement of getWholeWordReplacements(normalizedMode)) {
  221:     nextText = replaceArabicWholeWord(nextText, replacement.from, replacement.to);
  222:   }
  223: 
  224:   return restoreProtectedPhrases(nextText, protectedMap);
  225: }
  226: 
  227: export function shouldApplyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(
  228:   key: string,
  229:   label: string,
  230: ): boolean {
  231:   const lookup = normalizeLookupText(`${key} ${label}`);
  232: 
  233:   return !PROTECTED_FIELD_HINTS.some((hint) => {
  234:     const normalizedHint = normalizeLookupText(hint);
  235:     return normalizedHint ? lookup.includes(normalizedHint) : false;
  236:   });
  237: }
  238: 
  239: export function applyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(
  240:   value: unknown,
  241:   mode: ReportLanguageMode,
  242:   key: string,
  243:   label: string,
  244: ): string {
  245:   const text = cleanText(value);
  246: 
  247:   if (!text) {
  248:     return "";
  249:   }
  250: 
  251:   if (!shouldApplyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(key, label)) {
  252:     return text;
  253:   }
  254: 
  255:   return applyReportLanguageModeToText(text, mode);
  256: }

    1: export const REPORT_ATTACHED_CERTIFICATES_FIELD_KEY =
    2:   "report_attached_certificate_ids";

    4: const PRIVATE_REPORT_FIELD_KEYS = new Set([
    5:   REPORT_ATTACHED_CERTIFICATES_FIELD_KEY,
    6: ]);
    7: 
    8: export function isPrivateReportFieldKey(fieldKey: unknown) {
    9:   return PRIVATE_REPORT_FIELD_KEYS.has(String(fieldKey || "").trim());
   10: }
   11: 
   12: function getPossibleFieldKey(item: unknown) {
   13:   if (!item || typeof item !== "object") {
   14:     return "";
   15:   }
   16: 
   17:   const record = item as Record<string, any>;
   18: 
   19:   return String(
   20:     record.fieldKey ||
   21:       record.key ||
   22:       record.name ||
   23:       record.id ||
   24:       record.code ||
   25:       record.slug ||
   26:       record.field?.key ||
   27:       record.field?.fieldKey ||
   28:       record.dynamicField?.key ||
   29:       record.dynamicField?.fieldKey ||
   30:       "",
   31:   ).trim();
   32: }
   33: 
   34: export function filterPrivateReportValues<T>(values: T[] | null | undefined): T[] {
   35:   if (!Array.isArray(values)) {
   36:     return [];
   37:   }
   38: 
   39:   return values.filter((item) => {
   40:     const key = getPossibleFieldKey(item);
   41: 
   42:     return !isPrivateReportFieldKey(key);
   43:   });
   44: }

   24: export function buildSmartReportTextSections(
   25:   input: SmartReportTextInput
   26: ): ReportSection[] {
   27:   const variables = buildSmartTextVariables(input);
   28:   const templateSet = resolveSmartTextTemplateSet(input.serviceName);
   29: 
   30:   return templateSet.sections
   31:     .filter((template) => {
   32:       if (!template.when) return true;
   33:       return template.when(variables);
   34:     })
   35:     .map((template) => ({
   36:       id: template.id,
   37:       title: template.title,
   38:       content: renderSmartTemplate(template.body, variables),
   39:     }))
   40:     .filter((section) => {
   41:       return typeof section.content === "string" && section.content.trim().length > 0;
   42:     });
   43: }

   45: export function buildSmartTextVariables(
   46:   input: SmartReportTextInput
   47: ): SmartTextVariableMap {
   48:   const day = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, ["day", "اليوم"]);
   49: 
   50:   const week = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   51:     "week",
   52:     "الأسبوع",
   53:     "الاسبوع",
   54:   ]);
   55: 
   56:   const semester = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   57:     "semester",
   58:     "الفصل",
   59:     "الفصل الدراسي",
   60:   ]);
   61: 
   62:   const executionAction = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   63:     "execution_action",
   64:     "action",
   65:     "الإجراء",
   66:     "الاجراء",
   67:   ]);
   68: 
   69:   const executionMechanism = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   70:     "execution_mechanism",
   71:     "mechanism",
   72:     "آلية",
   73:     "الية",
   74:   ]);
   75: 
   76:   const performanceIndicator = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   77:     "performance_indicator",
   78:     "indicator",
   79:     "مؤشر",
   80:     "قياس",
   81:   ]);
   82: 
   83:   const evidenceSuggestion = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   84:     "evidence_suggestion",
   85:     "evidence",
   86:     "الشاهد",
   87:     "الشواهد",
   88:   ]);
   89: 
   90:   const operation = findValueByKeys(input.reportValues, [
   91:     "operation",
   92:     "العمليات",
   93:     "العملية",
   94:   ]);
   95: 
   96:   const semesterWeekText =
   97:     semester && week
   98:       ? `${semester}، ${week}`
   99:       : semester || week || "الخطة الزمنية المعتمدة";
  100: 
  101:   const dayText = day ? `، الموافق يوم ${day}` : "";
  102: 
  103:   return {
  104:     serviceName: cleanText(input.serviceName) || "الخدمة الإرشادية",
  105:     reportTitle: cleanText(input.reportTitle) || "تقرير إرشادي",
  106:     programTitle:
  107:       cleanText(input.programTitle) ||
  108:       cleanText(input.reportTitle) ||

  110: 
  111:     executionDate: cleanText(input.executionDate) || "تاريخ غير محدد",
  112:     targetGroup: cleanText(input.targetGroup) || "الفئة المستهدفة",
  113: 
  114:     day,
  115:     week,
  116:     semester,
  117:     dayText,
  118:     semesterWeekText,
  119: 
  120:     executionAction: executionAction || "إجراء تنفيذي موثق",
  121:     executionMechanism: executionMechanism || "آلية تنفيذ موثقة",
  122:     performanceIndicator,
  123:     evidenceSuggestion: evidenceSuggestion || "الشواهد والمرفقات المرتبطة",
  124:     operation: operation || "حفظ وتوثيق",
  125: 
  126:     evidenceCountText: formatEvidenceCount(input.evidenceCount),
  127:   };
  128: }
  129: 
  130: function findValueByKeys(items: SmartReportValue[], keys: string[]) {
  131:   const normalizedKeys = keys.map(normalizeSearchText);
  132: 
  133:   const found = items.find((item) => {
  134:     const key = normalizeSearchText(item.fieldKey);
  135:     const label = normalizeSearchText(item.fieldLabel);
  136: 
  137:     return normalizedKeys.some(
  138:       (target) => key.includes(target) || label.includes(target)
  139:     );
  140:   });
  141: 
  142:   return cleanText(found?.displayValue || "");
  143: }
  144: 
  145: function formatEvidenceCount(count?: number) {
  146:   if (typeof count !== "number") {
  147:     return "الشواهد المتاحة";
  148:   }
  149: 
  150:   if (count <= 0) {
  151:     return "0 شاهد";
  152:   }
  153: 
  154:   if (count === 1) {
  155:     return "شاهد واحد";
  156:   }
  157: 
  158:   if (count === 2) {
  159:     return "شاهدان";
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   if (count >= 3 && count <= 10) {
  163:     return `${count} شواهد`;
  164:   }
  165: 
  166:   return `${count} شاهد`;
  167: }
  168: 
  169: function cleanText(value?: string | null) {
  170:   return String(value || "")
  171:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  172:     .trim();
  173: }
  174: 
  175: function normalizeSearchText(value: string) {
  176:   return value
  177:     .toLowerCase()
  178:     .replace(/[أإآ]/g, "ا")
  179:     .replace(/ى/g, "ي")
  180:     .replace(/ة/g, "ه")
  181:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  182:     .trim();
  183: }

  191: export function resolveSmartTextTemplateSet(serviceName: string) {
  192:   const normalizedServiceName = normalizeSearchText(serviceName);
  193: 
  194:   const matched = SMART_TEXT_LIBRARIES.find((library) => {
  195:     if (!library.serviceNameIncludes?.length) {
  196:       return false;
  197:     }
  198: 
  199:     return library.serviceNameIncludes.some((keyword) => {
  200:       return normalizedServiceName.includes(normalizeSearchText(keyword));
  201:     });
  202:   });
  203: 
  204:   return matched || GENERAL_REPORT_TEXT_LIBRARY;
  205: }

  212:     return variables[variableName] ?? "";
  213:   });
  214: }

    1: import type { SmartReportTable } from "@/lib/report-engine/smart-report-types";
    2: import {
    3:   getStructuredValueTableMetadata,
    4:   isStudentIdentityField,
    5:   isStudentDataTable,
    6: } from "@/lib/workflow-values/structured-value-metadata";
    7: 
    8: function clean(value: unknown) {
    9:   return String(value ?? "").trim();
   10: }
   11: 
   12: function normalizeKey(value: unknown) {
   13:   return clean(value)
   14:     .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2")
   15:     .toLowerCase()
   16:     .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_")
   17:     .replace(/_+/g, "_")
   18:     .replace(/^_|_$/g, "");
   19: }
   20: 
   21: function normalizedTechnicalTitle(value: unknown) {
   22:   return normalizeKey(value)
   23:     .replace(/^selected_/, "")
   24:     .replace(/_(?:json|values?)$/, "");
   25: }
   26: 
   27: function isUnresolvedLabel(label: unknown, key: unknown) {
   28:   const normalizedLabel = normalizeKey(label);
   29:   const normalizedKey = normalizeKey(key);
   30:   return !normalizedLabel || normalizedLabel === normalizedKey;
   31: }
   32: 
   33: export function hasMeaningfulStructuredTableValue(value: unknown): boolean {
   34:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return false;
   35:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   36:     const normalized = value.trim();
   37:     return Boolean(normalized && normalized !== "-" && normalized !== "—");
   38:   }
   39:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   40:     return value.some(hasMeaningfulStructuredTableValue);
   41:   }
   42:   if (typeof value === "object") {
   43:     return Object.values(value as Record<string, unknown>).some(
   44:       hasMeaningfulStructuredTableValue,
   45:     );
   46:   }
   47:   return true;
   48: }
   49: 
   50: export function getStudentDataTableTitle(
   51:   rowCount: number,
   52:   genders: Array<unknown>,
   53: ) {
   54:   const normalizedGenders = genders.map((gender) =>
   55:     clean(gender).toUpperCase(),
   56:   );
   57:   const allFemale =
   58:     rowCount > 0 &&
   59:     normalizedGenders.length === rowCount &&
   60:     normalizedGenders.every((gender) => gender === "FEMALE");
   61: 
   62:   if (rowCount === 1) return allFemale ? "بيانات الطالبة" : "بيانات الطالب";
   63:   return allFemale ? "بيانات الطالبات" : "بيانات الطلاب";
   64: }
   65: 
   66: export function normalizeSmartReportTablePresentation(table: SmartReportTable) {
   67:   const columns = table.columns.filter((column) =>
   68:     table.rows.some((row) =>
   69:       hasMeaningfulStructuredTableValue(row.cells[column.key]),
   70:     ),
   71:   );
   72:   const studentTable = isStudentDataTable(table);
   73: 
   74:   return {
   75:     ...table,
   76:     ...(studentTable
   77:       ? {
   78:           title: getStudentDataTableTitle(
   79:             table.rows.length,
   80:             table.rows.map((row) => row.metadata?.gender),
   81:           ),
   82:         }
   83:       : {}),
   84:     columns,
   85:   } satisfies SmartReportTable;
   86: }
   87: 
   88: export function normalizeStructuredTableBlockPresentation<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(
   89:   block: T,
   90: ) {
   91:   if (block.kind !== "structured-table") return block;
   92:   const columns = Array.isArray(block.columns) ? block.columns : [];
   93:   const rows = Array.isArray(block.rows) ? block.rows : [];
   94:   const columnWidths = Array.isArray(block.columnWidths) ? block.columnWidths : [];
   95:   const retainedIndexes = columns
   96:     .map((_, index) => index)
   97:     .filter((index) =>
   98:       rows.some((row) =>
   99:         hasMeaningfulStructuredTableValue(
  100:           Array.isArray(row) ? row[index] : undefined,
  101:         ),
  102:       ),
  103:     );
  104:   const studentTable = isStudentDataTable(block);
  105:   const rowMetadata = Array.isArray(block.rowMetadata) ? block.rowMetadata : [];
  106:   const calculatedStudentTitle = getStudentDataTableTitle(
  107:     rows.length,
  108:     rowMetadata.map((metadata) =>
  109:       metadata && typeof metadata === "object"
  110:         ? (metadata as { gender?: unknown }).gender
  111:         : null,
  112:     ),
  113:   );
  114:   const studentTitle =
  115:     block.reportTwoVirtualBlock === true
  116:       ? `${clean(block.studentTableTitle) || calculatedStudentTitle} - تكملة`
  117:       : calculatedStudentTitle;
  118: 
  119:   return {
  120:     ...block,
  121:     ...(studentTable
  122:       ? {
  123:           title: studentTitle,
  124:           studentTableTitle:
  125:             clean(block.studentTableTitle) || calculatedStudentTitle,
  126:           showTitle: true,
  127:         }
  128:       : {}),
  129:     columns: retainedIndexes.map((index) => columns[index]),
  130:     rows: rows.map((row) =>
  131:       retainedIndexes.map((index) => (Array.isArray(row) ? row[index] : "")),
  132:     ),
  133:     columnWidths: retainedIndexes.map((index) => columnWidths[index] ?? 0),
  134:   };
  135: }
  136: 
  137: export function resolveStructuredTableDisplayMetadata(table: SmartReportTable) {
  138:   const metadata = getStructuredValueTableMetadata(table.sourceFieldKey);
  139:   if (!metadata) return normalizeSmartReportTablePresentation(table);
  140: 
  141:   const configuredColumns = new Map(
  142:     metadata.tableColumns.map((column) => [normalizeKey(column.key), column]),
  143:   );
  144:   const title =
  145:     !clean(table.title) ||
  146:     normalizedTechnicalTitle(table.title) === normalizedTechnicalTitle(table.sourceFieldKey)
  147:       ? metadata.tableTitle
  148:       : table.title;
  149: 
  150:   return normalizeSmartReportTablePresentation({
  151:     ...table,
  152:     title,
  153:     columns: table.columns.map((column) => {
  154:       const configured = configuredColumns.get(normalizeKey(column.key));
  155:       if (!configured) return column;
  156:       return {
  157:         ...column,
  158:         label: isUnresolvedLabel(column.label, column.key)
  159:           ? configured.label
  160:           : column.label,
  161:         ...(column.width ? {} : configured.width ? { width: configured.width } : {}),
  162:         optionLabels: column.optionLabels || configured.optionLabels,
  163:       };
  164:     }),
  165:   } satisfies SmartReportTable);
  166: }
  167: 
  168: export function applyStructuredTableDisplayMetadataToTemplate(
  169:   template: unknown,
  170:   sourcePayload: unknown,
  171: ) {
  172:   if (!template || typeof template !== "object") return template;
  173:   if (!sourcePayload || typeof sourcePayload !== "object") {
  174:     return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder(template);
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   const payloadTables = (sourcePayload as { tables?: unknown }).tables;
  178:   if (!Array.isArray(payloadTables) || !payloadTables.length) {
  179:     return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder(template);
  180:   }
  181: 
  182:   const tables = payloadTables
  183:     .filter((table): table is SmartReportTable => Boolean(table && typeof table === "object"))
  184:     .map(resolveStructuredTableDisplayMetadata);
  185:   const byId = new Map(tables.map((table) => [clean(table.id), table]));
  186:   const source = template as { pages?: unknown };
  187:   if (!Array.isArray(source.pages)) return template;
  188: 
  189:   return normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder({
  190:     ...source,
  191:     pages: source.pages.map((page) => {
  192:       if (!page || typeof page !== "object") return page;
  193:       const pageRecord = page as { blocks?: unknown };
  194:       if (!Array.isArray(pageRecord.blocks)) return page;
  195: 
  196:       return {
  197:         ...pageRecord,
  198:         blocks: pageRecord.blocks.map((block) => {
  199:           if (!block || typeof block !== "object") return block;
  200:           const blockRecord = block as Record<string, unknown>;
  201:           if (blockRecord.kind !== "structured-table") return block;
  202: 
  203:           const table =
  204:             byId.get(clean(blockRecord.sourceTableId)) ||
  205:             tables.find(
  206:               (candidate) =>
  207:                 normalizeKey(candidate.sourceFieldKey) === normalizeKey(blockRecord.sourceFieldKey),
  208:             );
  209:           if (!table) return normalizeStructuredTableBlockPresentation(blockRecord);
  210: 
  211:           const savedTitle = clean(blockRecord.title);
  212:           const title =
  213:             !savedTitle ||
  214:             normalizedTechnicalTitle(savedTitle) ===
  215:               normalizedTechnicalTitle(table.sourceFieldKey)
  216:               ? table.title
  217:               : savedTitle;
  218: 
  219:           return {
  220:             ...blockRecord,
  221:             title,
  222:             ...(isStudentDataTable({
  223:               sourceFieldKey: table.sourceFieldKey,
  224:               sourceTableId: table.id,
  225:               columns: table.columns,
  226:             })
  227:               ? { showTitle: true }
  228:               : {}),
  229:             columns: table.columns.map((column) => column.label),
  230:             rows: table.rows.map((row) =>
  231:               table.columns.map((column) => row.cells[column.key] || ""),
  232:             ),
  233:             columnWidths: table.columns.map((column) => column.width || 0),
  234:             rowMetadata: table.rows.map((row) => ({
  235:               gender: row.metadata?.gender || null,
  236:             })),
  237:           };
  238:         }),
  239:       };
  240:     }),
  241:   });
  242: }
  243: 
  244: export function normalizeStudentDataTableBlockOrder(template: unknown) {
  245:   if (!template || typeof template !== "object") return template;
  246:   const source = template as { pages?: unknown };
  247:   if (!Array.isArray(source.pages)) return template;
  248: 
  249:   const studentBlocks: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  250:   const signatureBlocks: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
  251:   const hasStudentTable = source.pages.some((page) =>
  252:     Boolean(
  253:       page &&
  254:         typeof page === "object" &&
  255:         Array.isArray((page as { blocks?: unknown }).blocks) &&
  256:         ((page as { blocks: unknown[] }).blocks.some(
  257:           (block) =>
  258:             Boolean(block && typeof block === "object") &&
  259:             (block as Record<string, unknown>).kind === "structured-table" &&
  260:             isStudentDataTable(block as Record<string, unknown>),
  261:         )),
  262:     ),
  263:   );
  264:   const pages = source.pages.map((page) => {
  265:     if (!page || typeof page !== "object") return page;
  266:     const pageRecord = page as Record<string, unknown>;
  267:     if (!Array.isArray(pageRecord.blocks)) return page;
  268: 
  269:     const blocks = pageRecord.blocks.flatMap((block) => {
  270:       if (!block || typeof block !== "object") return [block];
  271:       const candidate = normalizeStructuredTableBlockPresentation(
  272:         block as Record<string, unknown>,
  273:       );
  274:       const studentTable =
  275:         candidate.kind === "structured-table" && isStudentDataTable(candidate);
  276:       const signatureBlock =
  277:         candidate.kind === "signature-grid" ||
  278:         candidate.kind === "signatures" ||
  279:         candidate.kind === "approval-signatures" ||
  280:         Array.isArray(candidate.signatures);
  281:       if (signatureBlock) {
  282:         signatureBlocks.push({ ...candidate, placement: "flow" });
  283:         return [];
  284:       }
  285: 
  286:       if (!studentTable) {
  287:         if (
  288:           hasStudentTable &&
  289:           candidate.kind === "dynamic-fields" &&
  290:           Array.isArray(candidate.dynamicFields)
  291:         ) {
  292:           const dynamicFields = candidate.dynamicFields.filter(
  293:             (field) =>
  294:               !field ||
  295:               typeof field !== "object" ||
  296:               !isStudentIdentityField(field as Record<string, unknown>),
  297:           );
  298:           return [
  299:             {
  300:               ...candidate,
  301:               dynamicFields,
  302:               ...(dynamicFields.length ? {} : { visible: false }),
  303:             },
  304:           ];
  305:         }
  306:         return [candidate];
  307:       }
  308: 
  309:       const normalizedStudentBlock = normalizeStructuredTableBlockPresentation({
  310:         ...candidate,
  311:         showTitle: true,
  312:       });
  313:       const id = clean(candidate.id);
  314:       const sourceBlockId = clean(candidate.sourceBlockId);
  315:       const continuation =
  316:         candidate.reportTwoVirtualBlock === true ||
  317:         /-auto-table-\d+$/i.test(id) ||
  318:         Boolean(sourceBlockId && sourceBlockId !== id);
  319:       if (continuation) return [normalizedStudentBlock];
  320: 
  321:       studentBlocks.push(normalizedStudentBlock);
  322:       return [];
  323:     });
  324:     return { ...pageRecord, blocks };
  325:   });
  326: 
  327:   if (!studentBlocks.length && !signatureBlocks.length) return template;
  328:   const targetPageIndex = pages.findIndex((page) => {
  329:     if (!page || typeof page !== "object") return false;
  330:     const candidate = page as Record<string, unknown>;
  331:     return candidate.kind !== "evidence" && Array.isArray(candidate.blocks);
  332:   });
  333:   if (targetPageIndex < 0) return template;
  334: 
  335:   const lastPageIndex = pages.length - 1;
  336: 
  337:   return {
  338:     ...(source as Record<string, unknown>),
  339:     pages: pages.map((page, index) => {
  340:       if (!page || typeof page !== "object") return page;
  341:       const pageRecord = page as Record<string, unknown>;
  342:       const existingBlocks = (pageRecord.blocks as unknown[]) || [];
  343:       return {
  344:         ...pageRecord,
  345:         blocks: [
  346:           ...(index === targetPageIndex ? studentBlocks : []),
  347:           ...existingBlocks,
  348:           ...(index === lastPageIndex ? signatureBlocks : []),
  349:         ],
  350:       };
  351:     }),
  352:   };
  353: }

   35: type StructuredTableConfig = {
   36:   tableTitle?: string;
   37:   tableColumns?: unknown;
   38:   columns?: unknown;
   39:   hiddenColumns?: unknown;
   40:   repeatHeader?: boolean;
   41:   compact?: boolean;
   42:   stripedRows?: boolean;
   43:   highlightFirstColumn?: boolean;
   44: };
   45: 
   46: const ARABIC_COLUMN_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
   47:   agenda: "جدول الأعمال",
   48:   discussion: "محور النقاش",
   49:   recommendation: "التوصية",
   50:   name: "الاسم",
   51:   role: "الصفة",
   52:   signature: "التوقيع",
   53:   title: "العنوان",
   54:   description: "الوصف",
   55:   result: "النتيجة",
   56:   notes: "الملاحظات",
   57:   note: "ملاحظة",
   58:   count: "العدد",
   59:   category: "التصنيف",
   60:   type: "النوع",
   61: };
   62: 
   63: const TABLE_TITLE_FALLBACKS: Record<string, string> = {
   64:   committee_items: "جدول الاجتماع",
   65:   committee_members: "أعضاء اللجنة",
   66: };
   67: 
   68: const TECHNICAL_KEYS = new Set([
   69:   "id",
   70:   "_id",
   71:   "rowid",
   72:   "row_id",
   73:   "uuid",
   74:   "key",
   75:   "order",
   76:   "sortorder",
   77:   "createdat",
   78:   "updatedat",
   79:   "created_at",
   80:   "updated_at",
   81:   "metadata",
   82:   "settings",
   83:   "linkedtovalue",
   84:   "sourcefieldkey",
   85: ]);
   86: 
   87: function text(value: unknown) {
   88:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
   89:   if (typeof value === "string") return value.trim();
   90:   if (typeof value === "number") return String(value);
   91:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
   92:   return "";
   93: }
   94: 
   95: function record(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   96:   return value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
   97:     ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   98:     : null;
   99: }
  100: 
  101: function normalizeKey(value: unknown) {
  102:   return text(value)
  103:     .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1_$2")
  104:     .toLowerCase()
  105:     .replace(/[\s-]+/g, "_")
  106:     .replace(/_+/g, "_")
  107:     .replace(/^_|_$/g, "");
  108: }
  109: 
  110: function parseJson(value: unknown): unknown {
  111:   if (typeof value !== "string") return value;
  112:   const clean = value.trim();
  113:   if (!clean || (!clean.startsWith("[") && !clean.startsWith("{"))) return value;
  114: 
  115:   try {
  116:     return JSON.parse(clean);
  117:   } catch {
  118:     return value;
  119:   }
  120: }
  121: 
  122: function getRowRecords(value: unknown): Array<Record<string, unknown>> {
  123:   const parsed = parseJson(value);
  124:   const direct = Array.isArray(parsed)
  125:     ? parsed
  126:     : (() => {
  127:         const source = record(parsed);
  128:         if (!source) return [];
  129:         for (const key of ["rows", "items", "entries", "data"]) {
  130:           if (Array.isArray(source[key])) return source[key] as unknown[];
  131:         }
  132:         return [];
  133:       })();
  134: 
  135:   if (!direct.length) return [];
  136:   if (!direct.some((item) => record(item))) return [];
  137: 
  138:   return direct.map(record).filter((item): item is Record<string, unknown> => Boolean(item));
  139: }
  140: 
  141: function readConfig(source: unknown): StructuredTableConfig {
  142:   const root = record(source);
  143:   if (!root) return {};
  144:   const nested =
  145:     record(root.reportTable) ||
  146:     record(root.table) ||
  147:     record(root.tableConfig) ||
  148:     record(root.defaultJson)?.reportTable ||
  149:     record(root.defaultJson)?.table ||
  150:     record(root.defaultJson)?.tableConfig ||
  151:     record(root.settings)?.reportTable ||
  152:     record(root.settings)?.table;
  153:   const config = record(nested) || root;
  154: 
  155:   const schema = record(config.schema) || record(config.jsonSchema) || config;
  156:   const itemSchema = record(schema.items) || schema;
  157:   const properties = record(itemSchema.properties);
  158:   const schemaColumns = properties
  159:     ? Object.entries(properties).map(([key, definition]) => {
  160:         const property = record(definition);
  161:         return {
  162:           key,
  163:           label: text(property?.label || property?.title),
  164:           hidden: property?.hidden === true,
  165:           width: property?.width,
  166:           optionLabels: property?.optionLabels,
  167:         };
  168:       })
  169:     : undefined;
  170: 
  171:   const result: StructuredTableConfig = {};
  172:   const tableTitle = text(config.tableTitle || config.title);
  173:   if (tableTitle) result.tableTitle = tableTitle;
  174:   if (config.tableColumns !== undefined) result.tableColumns = config.tableColumns;
  175:   else if (config.columns !== undefined) result.columns = config.columns;
  176:   else if (schemaColumns?.length) result.columns = schemaColumns;
  177:   if (config.hiddenColumns !== undefined) result.hiddenColumns = config.hiddenColumns;
  178:   if (typeof config.repeatHeader === "boolean") result.repeatHeader = config.repeatHeader;
  179:   if (typeof config.compact === "boolean") result.compact = config.compact;
  180:   if (typeof config.stripedRows === "boolean") result.stripedRows = config.stripedRows;
  181:   if (typeof config.highlightFirstColumn === "boolean") {
  182:     result.highlightFirstColumn = config.highlightFirstColumn;
  183:   }
  184:   return result;
  185: }
  186: 
  187: function mergeConfigs(...sources: unknown[]): StructuredTableConfig {
  188:   return sources.reduce<StructuredTableConfig>(
  189:     (result, source) => ({ ...result, ...readConfig(source) }),
  190:     {},
  191:   );
  192: }
  193: 
  194: function humanizeColumnKey(key: string) {
  195:   const normalized = normalizeKey(key);
  196:   if (ARABIC_COLUMN_LABELS[normalized]) return ARABIC_COLUMN_LABELS[normalized];
  197: 
  198:   return key
  199:     .replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2")
  200:     .replace(/[_-]+/g, " ")
  201:     .replace(/\s+/g, " ")
  202:     .trim();
  203: }
  204: 
  205: function humanizeTableTitle(key: string) {
  206:   const withoutTechnicalAffixes = normalizeKey(key)
  207:     .replace(/^selected_/, "")
  208:     .replace(/_(?:json|values?)$/, "");
  209:   return humanizeColumnKey(withoutTechnicalAffixes || key) || "جدول بيانات";
  210: }
  211: 
  212: function isHelperKey(key: string, availableKeys: Set<string>) {
  213:   const normalized = normalizeKey(key);
  214:   if (TECHNICAL_KEYS.has(normalized)) return true;
  215: 
  216:   const helperMatch = key.match(/^(.*?)(Label|Other)$/i);
  217:   if (!helperMatch) return false;
  218: 
  219:   const base = helperMatch[1];
  220:   return availableKeys.has(base) || availableKeys.has(normalizeKey(base));
  221: }
  222: 
  223: function getConfiguredColumns(config: StructuredTableConfig): SmartReportTableColumn[] {
  224:   const source = Array.isArray(config.tableColumns)
  225:     ? config.tableColumns
  226:     : Array.isArray(config.columns)
  227:       ? config.columns
  228:       : [];
  229:   const hidden = new Set(
  230:     Array.isArray(config.hiddenColumns)
  231:       ? config.hiddenColumns.map(normalizeKey).filter(Boolean)
  232:       : [],
  233:   );
  234: 
  235:   return source
  236:     .map((item): SmartReportTableColumn | null => {
  237:       if (typeof item === "string") {
  238:         const key = normalizeKey(item);
  239:         return key && !hidden.has(key) ? { key, label: humanizeColumnKey(item) } : null;
  240:       }
  241: 
  242:       const sourceColumn = record(item);
  243:       const key = normalizeKey(sourceColumn?.key || sourceColumn?.id || sourceColumn?.value);
  244:       if (!key || hidden.has(key) || sourceColumn?.hidden === true) return null;
  245:       const width = Number(sourceColumn?.width);
  246: 
  247:       return {
  248:         key,
  249:         label: text(sourceColumn?.label || sourceColumn?.title) || humanizeColumnKey(key),
  250:         ...(Number.isFinite(width) && width > 0 ? { width } : {}),
  251:         ...(record(sourceColumn?.optionLabels)
  252:           ? {
  253:               optionLabels: Object.fromEntries(
  254:                 Object.entries(record(sourceColumn?.optionLabels)!)
  255:                   .map(([value, label]) => [text(value), text(label)])
  256:                   .filter(([value, label]) => Boolean(value && label)),
  257:               ),
  258:             }
  259:           : {}),
  260:       };
  261:     })
  262:     .filter((item): item is SmartReportTableColumn => Boolean(item));
  263: }
  264: 
  265: function inferColumns(
  266:   rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>>,
  267:   config: StructuredTableConfig,
  268:   fields: StructuredTableFieldLike[],
  269: ): SmartReportTableColumn[] {
  270:   const configured = getConfiguredColumns(config);
  271:   if (configured.length) return configured;
  272: 
  273:   const firstSeen: string[] = [];
  274:   const availableKeys = new Set<string>();
  275:   rows.forEach((row) => {
  276:     Object.keys(row).forEach((key) => {
  277:       availableKeys.add(key);
  278:       availableKeys.add(normalizeKey(key));
  279:     });
  280:   });
  281: 
  282:   rows.forEach((row) => {
  283:     Object.keys(row).forEach((key) => {
  284:       const normalized = normalizeKey(key);
  285:       if (!normalized || firstSeen.includes(normalized) || isHelperKey(key, availableKeys)) return;
  286:       firstSeen.push(normalized);
  287:     });
  288:   });
  289: 
  290:   const configuredLabels = new Map(
  291:     fields
  292:       .map((field) => [normalizeKey(field.key), text(field.label)] as const)
  293:       .filter(([key, label]) => Boolean(key && label)),
  294:   );
  295: 
  296:   return firstSeen.map((key) => ({
  297:     key,
  298:     label: configuredLabels.get(key) || humanizeColumnKey(key),
  299:   }));
  300: }
  301: 
  302: function optionLabel(option: StructuredTableOptionLike) {
  303:   return text(option.label || option.name || option.value || option.key || option.id);
  304: }
  305: 
  306: function buildOptionResolvers(fields: StructuredTableFieldLike[]) {
  307:   const byField = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  308:   const globalCandidates = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  309: 
  310:   fields.forEach((field) => {
  311:     const fieldKeys = [normalizeKey(field.key), normalizeKey(field.label)].filter(Boolean);
  312:     const labels = new Map<string, string>();
  313:     (field.options || []).forEach((option) => {
  314:       const label = optionLabel(option);
  315:       if (!label) return;
  316:       [option.value, option.key, option.id, option.label, option.name].forEach((candidate) => {
  317:         const key = text(candidate);
  318:         if (!key) return;
  319:         labels.set(key, label);
  320:         const global = globalCandidates.get(key) || new Set<string>();
  321:         global.add(label);
  322:         globalCandidates.set(key, global);
  323:       });
  324:     });
  325:     fieldKeys.forEach((key) => byField.set(key, labels));
  326:   });
  327: 
  328:   return { byField, globalCandidates };
  329: }
  330: 
  331: function findRawValue(row: Record<string, unknown>, key: string) {
  332:   if (key in row) return row[key];
  333:   const sourceKey = Object.keys(row).find((candidate) => normalizeKey(candidate) === key);
  334:   return sourceKey ? row[sourceKey] : undefined;
  335: }
  336: 
  337: function getCompanionValue(row: Record<string, unknown>, key: string, suffix: string) {
  338:   const target = `${normalizeKey(key)}_${suffix.toLowerCase()}`;
  339:   const sourceKey = Object.keys(row).find((candidate) => {
  340:     const normalized = normalizeKey(candidate);
  341:     return normalized === target || normalized === `${normalizeKey(key)}${suffix.toLowerCase()}`;
  342:   });
  343:   return sourceKey ? text(row[sourceKey]) : "";
  344: }
  345: 
  346: function resolveCell(
  347:   row: Record<string, unknown>,
  348:   column: SmartReportTableColumn,
  349:   resolvers: ReturnType<typeof buildOptionResolvers>,
  350: ) {
  351:   const columnKey = column.key;
  352:   const other = getCompanionValue(row, columnKey, "Other");
  353:   if (other) return other;
  354: 
  355:   const explicitLabel = getCompanionValue(row, columnKey, "Label");
  356:   if (explicitLabel && explicitLabel !== "أخرى") return explicitLabel;
  357: 
  358:   const raw = findRawValue(row, columnKey);
  359:   if (Array.isArray(raw)) {
  360:     return raw.map((item) => text(item)).filter(Boolean).join("، ");
  361:   }
  362:   if (record(raw)) {
  363:     const rawRecord = record(raw)!;
  364:     return text(rawRecord.label || rawRecord.name || rawRecord.title || rawRecord.value);
  365:   }
  366: 
  367:   const value = text(raw);
  368:   if (!value || value === "OTHER" || value === "other" || value === "أخرى") return "";
  369: 
  370:   const configuredOptionLabel = column.optionLabels?.[value];
  371:   if (configuredOptionLabel) return configuredOptionLabel;
  372: 
  373:   const matchingField = Array.from(resolvers.byField.entries()).find(([fieldKey]) =>
  374:     fieldKey === columnKey || fieldKey.includes(columnKey) || columnKey.includes(fieldKey),
  375:   );
  376:   const scopedLabel = matchingField?.[1].get(value);
  377:   if (scopedLabel) return scopedLabel;
  378: 
  379:   const globalLabels = resolvers.globalCandidates.get(value);
  380:   if (globalLabels?.size === 1) return Array.from(globalLabels)[0];
  381:   return value;
  382: }
  383: 
  384: export function extractSmartReportTable({
  385:   value,
  386:   fields = [],
  387:   snapshotField,
  388: }: {
  389:   value: StructuredTableValueLike;
  390:   fields?: StructuredTableFieldLike[];
  391:   snapshotField?: unknown;
  392: }): SmartReportTable | null {
  393:   const sourceFieldKey = normalizeKey(value.field?.key || value.fieldKey);
  394:   if (!sourceFieldKey) return null;
  395: 
  396:   const rows = getRowRecords(value.jsonValue ?? value.value);
  397:   if (!rows.length) return null;
  398: 
  399:   const domainConfig = getStructuredValueTableMetadata(sourceFieldKey);
  400:   const sourceConfig = mergeConfigs(
  401:     snapshotField,
  402:     value.field?.defaultJson,
  403:     value.field?.settings,
  404:     value.field?.metadata,
  405:   );
  406:   const config = mergeConfigs(
  407:     domainConfig,
  408:     sourceConfig,
  409:   );
  410:   const columns = inferColumns(rows, config, fields);
  411:   if (!columns.length) return null;
  412: 
  413:   const resolvers = buildOptionResolvers(fields);
  414:   const normalizedRows: SmartReportTableRow[] = rows
  415:     .map((row, index) => {
  416:       const cells = Object.fromEntries(
  417:         columns.map((column) => [column.key, resolveCell(row, column, resolvers)]),
  418:       );
  419:       return {
  420:         id: text(row.id) || `${sourceFieldKey}-row-${index + 1}`,
  421:         cells,
  422:       };
  423:     })
  424:     .filter((row) => Object.values(row.cells).some((cell) => text(cell)));
  425: 
  426:   if (!normalizedRows.length) return null;
  427: 
  428:   return resolveStructuredTableDisplayMetadata({
  429:     id: `table:${sourceFieldKey}`,
  430:     sourceFieldKey,
  431:     title:
  432:       sourceConfig.tableTitle ||
  433:       text(value.field?.label) ||
  434:       text(record(snapshotField)?.label) ||
  435:       domainConfig?.tableTitle ||
  436:       TABLE_TITLE_FALLBACKS[sourceFieldKey] ||
  437:       humanizeTableTitle(sourceFieldKey),
  438:     columns,
  439:     rows: normalizedRows,
  440:     settings: {
  441:       repeatHeader: config.repeatHeader ?? true,
  442:       compact: config.compact ?? false,
  443:       stripedRows: config.stripedRows ?? true,
  444:       highlightFirstColumn: config.highlightFirstColumn ?? false,
  445:     },
  446:   });
  447: }
  448: 
  449: export function extractSmartReportTables({
  450:   values,
  451:   fields = [],
  452:   snapshotFields = new Map<string, unknown>(),
  453: }: {
  454:   values: StructuredTableValueLike[];
  455:   fields?: StructuredTableFieldLike[];
  456:   snapshotFields?: Map<string, unknown>;
  457: }) {
  458:   return values
  459:     .map((value) =>
  460:       extractSmartReportTable({
  461:         value,
  462:         fields,
  463:         snapshotField: snapshotFields.get(normalizeKey(value.field?.key || value.fieldKey)),
  464:       }),
  465:     )
  466:     .filter((table): table is SmartReportTable => Boolean(table));
  467: }
  468: 
  469: function estimateRowUnits(row: SmartReportTableRow, columns: SmartReportTableColumn[]) {
  470:   const longestLines = columns.reduce((max, column) => {
  471:     const cell = text(row.cells[column.key]);
  472:     const widthShare = column.width && column.width > 0 ? column.width / 100 : 1 / columns.length;
  473:     const charsPerLine = Math.max(9, Math.floor(62 * widthShare));
  474:     const lines = cell
  475:       .split(/\n+/)
  476:       .reduce((count, line) => count + Math.max(1, Math.ceil(line.length / charsPerLine)), 0);
  477:     return Math.max(max, lines);
  478:   }, 1);
  479:   return Math.max(8, 5 + longestLines * 4.5);
  480: }
  481: 
  482: export function paginateSmartReportTable(
  483:   table: SmartReportTable,
  484:   options: { maxPageUnits?: number } = {},
  485: ) {
  486:   const maxPageUnits = Math.max(36, options.maxPageUnits || 130);
  487:   const chunks: SmartReportTable[] = [];
  488:   let rows: SmartReportTableRow[] = [];
  489:   let units = 14;
  490: 
  491:   const push = () => {
  492:     if (!rows.length) return;
  493:     const index = chunks.length;
  494:     chunks.push({
  495:       ...table,
  496:       id: index === 0 ? table.id : `${table.id}:continuation:${index + 1}`,
  497:       title: index === 0 ? table.title : `${table.title} - تكملة`,
  498:       rows,
  499:     });
  500:     rows = [];
  501:     units = 14;
  502:   };
  503: 
  504:   table.rows.forEach((row) => {
  505:     const rowUnits = estimateRowUnits(row, table.columns);
  506:     if (rows.length && units + rowUnits > maxPageUnits) push();
  507:     rows.push(row);
  508:     units += Math.min(rowUnits, maxPageUnits - 14);
  509:   });
  510:   push();
  511: 
  512:   return chunks;
  513: }
  514: 
  515: export function getSmartReportTableCell(
  516:   table: SmartReportTable | null | undefined,
  517:   rowIndex: number,
  518:   columnKey: string,
  519: ) {
  520:   return text(table?.rows[rowIndex]?.cells[normalizeKey(columnKey)]);
  521: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/report-template-portability.ts
============================================================
    1: import type {
    2:   ReportIdentitySettings,
    3:   ReportTemplateBuilderModel,
    4:   ReportTextSnippet,
    5: } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-template-builder-types";
    6: 
    7: export type ReportTemplatePortablePackage = {
    8:   version: 1;
    9:   exportedAt: string;
   10:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
   11:   identity: ReportIdentitySettings;
   12:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
   13: };
   14: 
   15: export function createReportTemplatePortablePackage(params: {
   16:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
   17:   identity: ReportIdentitySettings;
   18:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
   19: }): ReportTemplatePortablePackage {
   20:   return {
   21:     version: 1,
   22:     exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   23:     template: params.template,
   24:     identity: params.identity,
   25:     snippets: params.snippets,
   26:   };
   27: }
   28: 
   29: export function downloadReportTemplatePackage(params: {
   30:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
   31:   identity: ReportIdentitySettings;
   32:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
   33: }) {
   34:   const packageData = createReportTemplatePortablePackage(params);
   35:   const json = JSON.stringify(packageData, null, 2);
   36:   const blob = new Blob([json], {
   37:     type: "application/json;charset=utf-8",
   38:   });
   39: 
   40:   const safeName = params.template.name
   41:     .replace(/[^\u0600-\u06FFa-zA-Z0-9-_ ]/g, "")
   42:     .replace(/\s+/g, "-")
   43:     .slice(0, 80);
   44: 
   45:   const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
   46:   const anchor = document.createElement("a");
   47: 
   48:   anchor.href = url;
   49:   anchor.download = `${safeName || "report-template"}-${Date.now()}.json`;
   50:   document.body.appendChild(anchor);
   51:   anchor.click();
   52:   anchor.remove();
   53: 
   54:   URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
   55: }
   56: 
   57: export async function readReportTemplatePackageFromFile(
   58:   file: File
   59: ): Promise<ReportTemplatePortablePackage> {
   60:   const text = await file.text();
   61:   const parsed = JSON.parse(text) as unknown;
   62: 
   63:   return validatePortablePackage(parsed);
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function validatePortablePackage(
   67:   value: unknown
   68: ): ReportTemplatePortablePackage {
   69:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
   70:     throw new Error("ملف القالب غير صالح.");
   71:   }
   72: 
   73:   const packageData = value as Partial<ReportTemplatePortablePackage>;
   74: 
   75:   if (packageData.version !== 1) {
   76:     throw new Error("إصدار ملف القالب غير مدعوم.");
   77:   }
   78: 
   79:   if (!packageData.template || typeof packageData.template !== "object") {
   80:     throw new Error("ملف القالب لا يحتوي على template صالح.");
   81:   }
   82: 
   83:   if (!packageData.identity || typeof packageData.identity !== "object") {
   84:     throw new Error("ملف القالب لا يحتوي على identity صالح.");
   85:   }
   86: 
   87:   if (!Array.isArray(packageData.snippets)) {
   88:     throw new Error("ملف القالب لا يحتوي على snippets صالحة.");
   89:   }
   90: 
   91:   return packageData as ReportTemplatePortablePackage;
   92: }

   92: export function getReportTemplate(templateId: ReportTemplateId) {
   93:   return (
   94:     reportTemplates.find((template) => template.id === templateId) ||
   95:     reportTemplates[0]
   96:   );
   97: }
   98: 
   99: export function getReportValue(
  100:   report: OfficialReportData,
  101:   key: ReportTemplateFieldKey
  102: ) {
  103:   switch (key) {
  104:     case "title":
  105:       return report.title;
  106:     case "subtitle":
  107:       return report.subtitle;
  108:     case "serviceName":
  109:       return report.serviceName;
  110:     case "category":
  111:       return report.category;
  112:     case "reportDate":
  113:       return report.reportDate;
  114:     case "targetGroup":
  115:       return report.targetGroup;
  116:     case "cover.programTitle":
  117:       return report.cover.programTitle;
  118:     case "cover.executionDate":
  119:       return report.cover.executionDate;
  120:     case "cover.shortDescription":
  121:       return report.cover.shortDescription;
  122:     case "sections":
  123:       return report.sections?.length ? report.sections : null;
  124:     case "evidences":
  125:       return report.evidences?.length ? report.evidences : null;
  126:     case "approval":
  127:       return report.approval;
  128:     default:
  129:       return null;
  130:   }
  131: }
  132: 
  133: export function getMissingReportFields(
  134:   report: OfficialReportData,
  135:   templateId: ReportTemplateId
  136: ) {
  137:   const template = getReportTemplate(templateId);
  138: 
  139:   return template.requiredFields.filter((field) => {
  140:     const value = getReportValue(report, field);
  141: 
  142:     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  143:       return value.length === 0;
  144:     }
  145: 
  146:     return !value;
  147:   });
  148: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/report-template-validation.ts
============================================================
    1: import type {
    2:   ReportIdentitySettings,
    3:   ReportTemplateBuilderModel,
    4:   ReportTemplateValidationIssue,
    5:   ReportTemplateValidationResult,
    6:   ReportTextSnippet,
    7: } from "@/lib/report-engine/report-template-builder-types";
    8: 
    9: export function validateReportTemplateForPublishing({
   10:   template,
   11:   identity,
   12:   snippets,
   13: }: {
   14:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
   15:   identity: ReportIdentitySettings;
   16:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
   17: }): ReportTemplateValidationResult {
   18:   const issues: ReportTemplateValidationIssue[] = [];
   19: 
   20:   if (!template.name.trim()) {
   21:     issues.push({
   22:       id: "missing-template-name",
   23:       severity: "error",
   24:       title: "اسم القالب مفقود",
   25:       description: "يجب كتابة اسم واضح للقالب قبل نشره.",
   26:     });
   27:   }
   28: 
   29:   if (!template.description.trim()) {
   30:     issues.push({
   31:       id: "missing-template-description",
   32:       severity: "warning",
   33:       title: "وصف القالب غير مكتمل",
   34:       description: "يفضل إضافة وصف يساعد الأدمن لاحقًا على معرفة استخدام القالب.",
   35:     });
   36:   }
   37: 
   38:   if (template.scope === "SERVICE" && !template.serviceSlug) {
   39:     issues.push({
   40:       id: "missing-service",
   41:       severity: "error",
   42:       title: "القالب خاص بخدمة بدون تحديد الخدمة",
   43:       description: "اختر الخدمة المرتبطة بالقالب أو اجعل القالب عامًا.",
   44:     });
   45:   }
   46: 
   47:   if (!template.pages.length) {
   48:     issues.push({
   49:       id: "no-pages",
   50:       severity: "error",
   51:       title: "القالب لا يحتوي على صفحات",
   52:       description: "أضف صفحة واحدة على الأقل قبل النشر.",
   53:     });
   54:   }
   55: 
   56:   const hasCover = template.pages.some((page) => page.kind === "cover");
   57:   const hasEvidence = template.pages.some((page) =>
   58:     page.blocks.some((block) => block.kind === "evidence-gallery")
   59:   );
   60:   const hasApproval = template.pages.some((page) =>
   61:     page.blocks.some((block) => block.kind === "approval-signature")
   62:   );
   63:   const hasCaseData = template.pages.some((page) =>
   64:     page.blocks.some((block) =>
   65:       ["case-meta", "paragraph", "field-list", "cover-title"].includes(block.kind)
   66:     )
   67:   );
   68: 
   69:   if (!hasCover) {
   70:     issues.push({
   71:       id: "no-cover",
   72:       severity: "warning",
   73:       title: "لا توجد صفحة غلاف",
   74:       description: "الغلاف اختياري، لكنه مهم للتقارير الرسمية والطباعة.",
   75:     });
   76:   }
   77: 
   78:   if (!hasCaseData) {
   79:     issues.push({
   80:       id: "no-case-data",
   81:       severity: "error",
   82:       title: "القالب لا يسحب بيانات من الحالة",
   83:       description:
   84:         "أضف بلوكًا مرتبطًا بالحالة مثل بيانات التقارير أو فقرة من بيانات الحالة.",
   85:     });
   86:   }
   87: 
   88:   if (!hasEvidence) {
   89:     issues.push({
   90:       id: "no-evidence",
   91:       severity: "warning",
   92:       title: "لا يوجد بلوك شواهد",
   93:       description: "قد لا يناسب القالب التقارير التي تتطلب صورًا أو مرفقات.",
   94:     });
   95:   }
   96: 
   97:   if (!hasApproval) {
   98:     issues.push({
   99:       id: "no-approval",
  100:       severity: "warning",
  101:       title: "لا توجد صفحة اعتماد",
  102:       description: "يفضل إضافة توقيع واعتماد للتقارير الرسمية.",
  103:     });
  104:   }
  105: 
  106:   template.pages.forEach((page, pageIndex) => {
  107:     if (!page.title.trim()) {
  108:       issues.push({
  109:         id: `page-${page.id}-missing-title`,
  110:         severity: "error",
  111:         title: `صفحة رقم ${pageIndex + 1} بدون عنوان`,
  112:         description: "اكتب عنوانًا واضحًا للصفحة.",
  113:       });
  114:     }
  115: 
  116:     if (!page.blocks.length) {
  117:       issues.push({
  118:         id: `page-${page.id}-empty`,
  119:         severity: "warning",
  120:         title: `صفحة ${page.title || pageIndex + 1} فارغة`,
  121:         description: "الصفحات الفارغة ستظهر بلا محتوى في التقارير.",
  122:       });
  123:     }
  124: 
  125:     page.blocks.forEach((block) => {
  126:       if (
  127:         block.source?.source === "caseValues" &&
  128:         !block.source?.fieldKey &&
  129:         ["paragraph", "field-list"].includes(block.kind)
  130:       ) {
  131:         issues.push({
  132:           id: `block-${block.id}-missing-field`,
  133:           severity: "warning",
  134:           title: `مصدر غير محدد: ${block.title}`,
  135:           description:
  136:             "حدد الحقل الذي سيقرأ منه هذا البلوك من Workflow/CaseValue.",
  137:         });
  138:       }
  139: 
  140:       if (block.kind === "custom-paragraph") {
  141:         if (!block.customTitle?.trim()) {
  142:           issues.push({
  143:             id: `block-${block.id}-missing-custom-title`,
  144:             severity: "warning",
  145:             title: "فقرة مخصصة بدون عنوان",
  146:             description: "يفضل كتابة عنوان للفقرة المخصصة.",
  147:           });
  148:         }
  149: 
  150:         if (!block.customContent?.trim()) {
  151:           issues.push({
  152:             id: `block-${block.id}-missing-custom-content`,
  153:             severity: "warning",
  154:             title: "فقرة مخصصة بدون محتوى",
  155:             description: "اكتب محتوى الفقرة أو احذفها من القالب.",
  156:           });
  157:         }
  158:       }
  159:     });
  160:   });
  161: 
  162:   if (!identity.schoolName.trim()) {
  163:     issues.push({
  164:       id: "identity-school-name",
  165:       severity: "error",
  166:       title: "اسم المدرسة مفقود",
  167:       description: "أدخل اسم المدرسة في إعدادات هوية التقارير.",
  168:     });
  169:   }
  170: 
  171:   if (!identity.counselorName.trim()) {
  172:     issues.push({
  173:       id: "identity-counselor-name",
  174:       severity: "warning",
  175:       title: "اسم الموجه/الموجهة غير محدد",
  176:       description: "يفضل إدخال اسم الموجه/الموجهة في إعدادات الهوية.",
  177:     });
  178:   }
  179: 
  180:   if (!identity.schoolLeaderName.trim()) {
  181:     issues.push({
  182:       id: "identity-leader-name",
  183:       severity: "warning",
  184:       title: "اسم قائد/قائدة المدرسة غير محدد",
  185:       description: "يفضل إدخال اسم القائد/القائدة للتقارير الرسمية.",
  186:     });
  187:   }
  188: 
  189:   if (!snippets.length) {
  190:     issues.push({
  191:       id: "no-text-snippets",
  192:       severity: "warning",
  193:       title: "مكتبة النصوص فارغة",
  194:       description:
  195:         "إضافة نصوص جاهزة تساعد الموجه/الموجهة عند إصدار التقارير.",
  196:     });
  197:   }
  198: 
  199:   const errors = issues.filter((issue) => issue.severity === "error").length;
  200:   const warnings = issues.filter((issue) => issue.severity === "warning").length;
  201: 
  202:   const score = Math.max(0, 100 - errors * 30 - warnings * 8);
  203: 
  204:   if (!issues.length) {
  205:     issues.push({
  206:       id: "template-ready",
  207:       severity: "success",
  208:       title: "القالب جاهز للنشر",
  209:       description: "لم يتم العثور على مشاكل أساسية في بنية القالب.",
  210:     });
  211:   }
  212: 
  213:   return {
  214:     canPublish: errors === 0,
  215:     score,
  216:     issues,
  217:   };
  218: }

  187: function normalizeTemplateValue(value: SmartReportField["value"]) {
  188:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
  189: 
  190:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  191:     return value.filter(Boolean).join("، ");
  192:   }
  193: 
  194:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
  195: 
  196:   return String(value);
  197: }
  198: 
  199: export function getPayloadFieldText(payload: SmartReportPayload, keys: string[]) {
  200:   for (const key of keys) {
  201:     const field =
  202:       payload.primaryFields.find((item) => item.key === key) ||
  203:       payload.detailFields.find((item) => item.key === key);
  204: 
  205:     const value = field ? normalizeTemplateValue(field.value) : "";
  206: 
  207:     if (value) return value;
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   return "";
  211: }
  212: 
  213: export function renderReportTextTemplate(
  214:   template: ReportTextTemplate,
  215:   payload: SmartReportPayload,
  216: ) {
  217:   const values: Record<string, string> = {
  218:     activityTitle: payload.title || payload.caseInfo.title || "اسم النشاط",
  219:     activityDomain:
  220:       getPayloadFieldText(payload, ["activity_domain"]) ||
  221:       payload.service.name ||
  222:       "المجال",
  223:     targetGroup:
  224:       getPayloadFieldText(payload, ["target_group"]) ||
  225:       payload.student?.grade ||
  226:       payload.student?.stage ||
  227:       "الفئة المستهدفة",
  228:     executionMethod:
  229:       getPayloadFieldText(payload, ["execution_method", "execution_mode"]) ||
  230:       "طريقة التنفيذ",
  231:     beneficiaryCount:
  232:       getPayloadFieldText(payload, [
  233:         "beneficiary_count",
  234:         "beneficiaries_count",
  235:         "students_count",
  236:         "student_count",
  237:         "participant_students_count",
  238:       ]) || "عدد",
  239:     executor:
  240:       getPayloadFieldText(payload, ["executor"]) ||
  241:       payload.caseInfo.issuedBy ||
  242:       "المعلم المنفذ",
  243:   };
  244: 
  245:   return template.body.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, key: string) => {
  246:     return values[key] || "";
  247:   });
  248: }

  124: export function getTextLibrarySettings(
  125:   block: ReportTemplateBlock,

  137: export function setTextLibrarySettingsOnBlock(
  138:   block: ReportTemplateBlock,
  139:   settings: TextLibrarySettings,
  140: ): ReportTemplateBlock {
  141:   const currentSettings = getTextLibrarySettings(block);
  142: 
  143:   const nextSettings = {
  144:     ...(block.settings ?? {}),

  147:       ...settings,

  157: export function matchesTextLibraryService(params: {
  158:   snippet: ReportTextSnippet;
  159:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
  160:   settings: TextLibrarySettings;
  161: }): boolean {
  162:   const { snippet, template } = params;
  163: 
  164:   const settings: NormalizedTextLibrarySettings = {
  165:     ...DEFAULT_TEXT_LIBRARY_SETTINGS,
  166:     ...params.settings,
  167:   };
  168: 
  169:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "all") {
  170:     return true;
  171:   }
  172: 
  173:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "global") {
  174:     return isGlobalTextSnippet(snippet);
  175:   }
  176: 
  177:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "specific-service") {
  178:     if (!settings.serviceSlug) {
  179:       return false;
  180:     }
  181: 
  182:     return snippet.serviceSlug === settings.serviceSlug;
  183:   }
  184: 
  185:   if (settings.textSourceMode === "same-template-service") {
  186:     if (isGlobalTextSnippet(snippet)) {
  187:       return true;
  188:     }
  189: 
  190:     if (template.scope === "SERVICE" && template.serviceSlug) {
  191:       return snippet.serviceSlug === template.serviceSlug;
  192:     }
  193: 
  194:     return false;
  195:   }
  196: 
  197:   return false;
  198: }
  199: 
  200: export function getMatchingTextSnippets(params: {
  201:   block: ReportTemplateBlock;
  202:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
  203:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
  204: }): ReportTextSnippet[] {
  205:   const { block, template, snippets } = params;
  206:   const settings = getTextLibrarySettings(block);
  207: 
  208:   const candidates = snippets.filter((snippet) => {
  209:     const serviceMatch = matchesTextLibraryService({
  210:       snippet,
  211:       template,
  212:       settings,
  213:     });
  214: 
  215:     if (!serviceMatch) {
  216:       return false;
  217:     }
  218: 
  219:     if (settings.category && settings.category !== "all") {
  220:       return snippet.category === settings.category;
  221:     }
  222: 
  223:     return true;
  224:   });
  225: 
  226:   if (settings.renderMode === "selected" && settings.snippetId) {
  227:     return candidates.filter((snippet) => snippet.id === settings.snippetId);
  228:   }
  229: 
  230:   return candidates;
  231: }
  232: 
  233: export function resolveTextLibrarySnippets(params: {
  234:   block: ReportTemplateBlock;
  235:   template: ReportTemplateBuilderModel;
  236:   snippets: ReportTextSnippet[];
  237:   data: RuntimeReportData;
  238: }): ResolvedTextSnippet[] {
  239:   const { block, template, snippets, data } = params;
  240:   const settings = getTextLibrarySettings(block);
  241: 
  242:   const matchingSnippets = getMatchingTextSnippets({
  243:     block,
  244:     template,
  245:     snippets,
  246:   });
  247: 
  248:   let selectedSnippets: ReportTextSnippet[] = [];
  249: 
  250:   if (settings.renderMode === "selected") {
  251:     selectedSnippets = matchingSnippets.filter(
  252:       (snippet) => snippet.id === settings.snippetId,
  253:     );
  254:   } else if (settings.renderMode === "all") {
  255:     selectedSnippets = matchingSnippets;
  256:   } else {
  257:     selectedSnippets = matchingSnippets.slice(0, 1);
  258:   }
  259: 
  260:   const variables = buildRuntimeVariables(data);
  261: 
  262:   return selectedSnippets.map((snippet) => {
  263:     const text = getSnippetText(snippet);
  264: 
  265:     return {
  266:       id: snippet.id,
  267:       title: snippet.title,
  268:       category: snippet.category,
  269:       serviceSlug: snippet.serviceSlug ?? "",
  270:       isGlobal: isGlobalTextSnippet(snippet),
  271:       originalText: text,
  272:       renderedText: renderTextWithVariables(text, variables),
  273:     };
  274:   });
  275: }
  276: 
  277: export function resolveTextLibraryFallback(params: {
  278:   block: ReportTemplateBlock;
  279: }): string | null {
  280:   const { block } = params;
  281:   const settings = getTextLibrarySettings(block);
  282: 
  283:   if (settings.fallbackBehavior === "hide") {
  284:     return null;
  285:   }
  286: 
  287:   return (
  288:     settings.fallbackText ||
  289:     DEFAULT_TEXT_LIBRARY_SETTINGS.fallbackText ||
  290:     "لم يتم اختيار نص من مكتبة النصوص بعد."
  291:   );
  292: }

  325:       safeText(data.createdAt),
  326: 
  327:     dayText: safeText(values.dayText) || safeText(values.day),
  328: 
  329:     targetGroup:
  330:       safeText(values.targetGroup) ||
  331:       safeText(values.audience) ||
  332:       safeText(values.beneficiaries),
  333: 
  334:     objective:
  335:       safeText(values.objective) ||
  336:       safeText(values.objectives) ||
  337:       safeText(values.goal),
  338: 
  339:     procedures:
  340:       safeText(values.procedures) ||
  341:       safeText(values.actions) ||
  342:       safeText(values.implementation),
  343: 
  344:     results:
  345:       safeText(values.results) ||
  346:       safeText(values.outcomes) ||
  347:       safeText(values.result),
  348: 
  349:     recommendations:
  350:       safeText(values.recommendations) ||
  351:       safeText(values.recommendation),
  352: 
  353:     notes: safeText(values.notes),
  354:   };
  355: }
  356: 
  357: export function renderTextWithVariables(
  358:   text: string,
  359:   variables: Record<string, string>,
  360: ): string {
  361:   return text.replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (_, key: string) => {
  362:     const normalizedKey = String(key).trim();
  363:     return variables[normalizedKey] ?? `{${normalizedKey}}`;
  364:   });
  365: }
  366: 
  367: export function getRuntimeValues(
  368:   data: RuntimeReportData,
  369: ): Record<string, unknown> {
  370:   if (!data.values || typeof data.values !== "object") {
  371:     return {};
  372:   }
  373: 
  374:   return data.values;
  375: }
  376: 
  377: export function getRuntimeEvidences(
  378:   data: RuntimeReportData,
  379: ): ReportEvidenceItem[] {
  380:   if (!Array.isArray(data.evidences)) {
  381:     return [];
  382:   }
  383: 
  384:   return data.evidences;
  385: }
  386: 
  387: export function getStudent(data: RuntimeReportData): RuntimeStudentData | null {
  388:   return data.student ?? data.caseEntry?.student ?? null;
  389: }
  390: 
  391: export function getCaseTitle(data: RuntimeReportData): string {
  392:   return (
  393:     safeText(data.caseEntry?.title) ||
  394:     safeText(data.reportTitle) ||
  395:     "تقرير إرشادي"
  396:   );
  397: }
  398: 
  399: export function getServiceName(data: RuntimeReportData): string {
  400:   return (
  401:     safeText(data.service?.name) ||
  402:     safeText(data.caseEntry?.service?.name) ||
  403:     "خدمة إرشادية"
  404:   );
  405: }
  406: 
  407: function isGlobalTextSnippet(snippet: ReportTextSnippet): boolean {
  408:   return !snippet.serviceSlug;
  409: }
  410: 
  411: function getSnippetText(snippet: ReportTextSnippet): string {
  412:   const candidate = snippet as ReportTextSnippet & {
  413:     text?: unknown;
  414:     content?: unknown;
  415:     body?: unknown;
  416:   };
  417: 
  418:   return (
  419:     safeText(candidate.text) ||
  420:     safeText(candidate.content) ||
  421:     safeText(candidate.body)
  422:   );
  423: }
  424: 
  425: function safeText(value: unknown): string {
  426:   if (value === null || value === undefined) {
  427:     return "";
  428:   }
  429: 
  430:   if (value instanceof Date) {
  431:     return value.toLocaleDateString("ar-SA");
  432:   }
  433: 
  434:   if (typeof value === "string") {
  435:     return value.trim();
  436:   }
  437: 
  438:   if (typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") {
  439:     return String(value);
  440:   }
  441: 
  442:   return "";
  443: }

  374: export function renderReportTextTemplate(
  375:   template: string,
  376:   variables: Record<string, string>
  377: ) {
  378:   return template.replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (_, variableName: string) => {
  379:     return variables[variableName] ?? "";
  380:   });
  381: }
  382: 
  383: export function extractVariablesFromText(text: string) {
  384:   const matches = text.match(/\{([^}]+)\}/g) || [];
  385: 
  386:   return Array.from(
  387:     new Set(matches.map((match) => match.replace(/[{}]/g, "").trim()))
  388:   ).filter(Boolean);
  389: }
  390: 
  391: export function validateReportTextTemplate(
  392:   template: ReportTextTemplatePreset
  393: ): ReportTextStudioValidationIssue[] {
  394:   const knownVariables = new Set(REPORT_TEXT_VARIABLES.map((item) => item.key));
  395:   const issues: ReportTextStudioValidationIssue[] = [];
  396: 
  397:   for (const block of template.blocks) {
  398:     const cleanBody = block.body.trim();
  399: 
  400:     if (block.isRequired && !cleanBody) {
  401:       issues.push({
  402:         id: `${block.id}-empty-required`,
  403:         level: "error",
  404:         title: "قسم مطلوب فارغ",
  405:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" مطلوب ولا يحتوي على نص.`,
  406:         blockId: block.id,
  407:       });
  408:     }
  409: 
  410:     if (cleanBody.length > 900) {
  411:       issues.push({
  412:         id: `${block.id}-too-long`,
  413:         level: "warning",
  414:         title: "النص طويل",
  415:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" طويل وقد يؤثر على تنسيق صفحة A4.`,
  416:         blockId: block.id,
  417:       });
  418:     }
  419: 
  420:     const usedVariables = extractVariablesFromText(cleanBody);
  421:     const unknownVariables = usedVariables.filter(
  422:       (variable) => !knownVariables.has(variable)
  423:     );
  424: 
  425:     for (const variable of unknownVariables) {
  426:       issues.push({
  427:         id: `${block.id}-unknown-${variable}`,
  428:         level: "error",
  429:         title: "متغير غير معروف",
  430:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" يستخدم المتغير {${variable}} وهو غير موجود في قائمة المتغيرات.`,
  431:         blockId: block.id,
  432:       });
  433:     }
  434: 
  435:     if (block.showWhenVariableExists) {
  436:       const exists = knownVariables.has(block.showWhenVariableExists);
  437: 
  438:       if (!exists) {
  439:         issues.push({
  440:           id: `${block.id}-bad-condition`,
  441:           level: "error",
  442:           title: "شرط ظهور غير صحيح",
  443:           description: `شرط ظهور القسم "${block.title}" يعتمد على متغير غير معروف.`,
  444:           blockId: block.id,
  445:         });
  446:       }
  447:     }
  448:   }
  449: 
  450:   if (!issues.length) {
  451:     issues.push({
  452:       id: "template-ready",
  453:       level: "info",
  454:       title: "القالب جاهز للمعاينة",
  455:       description:
  456:         "لا توجد أخطاء واضحة في النصوص أو المتغيرات. يمكن اعتماد القالب بعد ربط الحفظ والنشر.",
  457:     });
  458:   }
  459: 
  460:   return issues;
  461: }
