  375: export function renderReportTextTemplate(
  376:   template: string,
  377:   variables: Record<string, string>
  378: ) {
  379:   return template.replace(/\{([^}]+)\}/g, (_, variableName: string) => {
  380:     return variables[variableName] ?? "";
  381:   });
  382: }
  383: 
  384: export function extractVariablesFromText(text: string) {
  385:   const matches = text.match(/\{([^}]+)\}/g) || [];
  386: 
  387:   return Array.from(
  388:     new Set(matches.map((match) => match.replace(/[{}]/g, "").trim()))
  389:   ).filter(Boolean);
  390: }
  391: 
  392: export function validateReportTextTemplate(
  393:   template: ReportTextTemplatePreset
  394: ): ReportTextStudioValidationIssue[] {
  395:   const knownVariables = new Set(REPORT_TEXT_VARIABLES.map((item) => item.key));
  396:   const issues: ReportTextStudioValidationIssue[] = [];
  397: 
  398:   for (const block of template.blocks) {
  399:     const cleanBody = block.body.trim();
  400: 
  401:     if (block.isRequired && !cleanBody) {
  402:       issues.push({
  403:         id: `${block.id}-empty-required`,
  404:         level: "error",
  405:         title: "قسم مطلوب فارغ",
  406:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" مطلوب ولا يحتوي على نص.`,
  407:         blockId: block.id,
  408:       });
  409:     }
  410: 
  411:     if (cleanBody.length > 900) {
  412:       issues.push({
  413:         id: `${block.id}-too-long`,
  414:         level: "warning",
  415:         title: "النص طويل",
  416:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" طويل وقد يؤثر على تنسيق صفحة A4.`,
  417:         blockId: block.id,
  418:       });
  419:     }
  420: 
  421:     const usedVariables = extractVariablesFromText(cleanBody);
  422:     const unknownVariables = usedVariables.filter(
  423:       (variable) => !knownVariables.has(variable)
  424:     );
  425: 
  426:     for (const variable of unknownVariables) {
  427:       issues.push({
  428:         id: `${block.id}-unknown-${variable}`,
  429:         level: "error",
  430:         title: "متغير غير معروف",
  431:         description: `القسم "${block.title}" يستخدم المتغير {${variable}} وهو غير موجود في قائمة المتغيرات.`,
  432:         blockId: block.id,
  433:       });
  434:     }
  435: 
  436:     if (block.showWhenVariableExists) {
  437:       const exists = knownVariables.has(block.showWhenVariableExists);
  438: 
  439:       if (!exists) {
  440:         issues.push({
  441:           id: `${block.id}-bad-condition`,
  442:           level: "error",
  443:           title: "شرط ظهور غير صحيح",
  444:           description: `شرط ظهور القسم "${block.title}" يعتمد على متغير غير معروف.`,
  445:           blockId: block.id,
  446:         });
  447:       }
  448:     }
  449:   }
  450: 
  451:   if (!issues.length) {
  452:     issues.push({
  453:       id: "template-ready",
  454:       level: "info",
  455:       title: "القالب جاهز للمعاينة",
  456:       description:
  457:         "لا توجد أخطاء واضحة في النصوص أو المتغيرات. يمكن اعتماد القالب بعد ربط الحفظ والنشر.",
  458:     });
  459:   }
  460: 
  461:   return issues;
  462: }

FILE: lib/report-engine/report-variant-registry.ts
============================================================
    1: export const DEFAULT_REPORT_VARIANT_ID = "official-activity-card" as const;
    2: 
    3: export type ReportVariantId =
    4:   | "official-activity-card"
    5:   | "smart-general-a4";
    6: 
    7: export type ReportVariantConfig = {
    8:   id: ReportVariantId;
    9:   name: string;
   10:   shortName: string;
   11:   description: string;
   12: };
   13: 
   14: export const reportVariants: ReportVariantConfig[] = [
   15:   {
   16:     id: "official-activity-card",
   17:     name: "بطاقة نشاط رسمية",
   18:     shortName: "بطاقة نشاط",
   19:     description: "تقرير رسمي لبرامج النشاط الطلابي بتصميم A4.",
   20:   },
   21:   {
   22:     id: "smart-general-a4",
   23:     name: "تقرير عام ذكي",
   24:     shortName: "تقرير عام",
   25:     description: "تقرير A4 عام يناسب الحالات والتقارير الخاصة.",
   26:   },
   27: ];
   28: 
   29: export function resolveReportVariantId(
   30:   value: string | null | undefined,
   31: ): ReportVariantId {
   32:   if (value === "smart-general-a4") {
   33:     return "smart-general-a4";
   34:   }
   35: 
   36:   return DEFAULT_REPORT_VARIANT_ID;
   37: }
   38: 
   39: export function getReportVariantById(
   40:   id: ReportVariantId | string | null | undefined,
   41: ) {
   42:   const resolvedId = resolveReportVariantId(id);
   43: 
   44:   return (
   45:     reportVariants.find((variant) => variant.id === resolvedId) ||
   46:     reportVariants.find((variant) => variant.id === DEFAULT_REPORT_VARIANT_ID) ||
   47:     reportVariants[0]
   48:   );
   49: }

   99: function normalizeArabicText(value: string) {

  110: function stringifyValue(value: unknown): string {
  111:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
  112: 
  113:   if (
  114:     typeof value === "string" ||
  115:     typeof value === "number" ||
  116:     typeof value === "boolean"
  117:   ) {
  118:     return String(value).trim();
  119:   }
  120: 
  121:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  122:     return value
  123:       .map((item) => stringifyValue(item))
  124:       .filter(Boolean)
  125:       .join("، ");
  126:   }
  127: 
  128:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  129:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  130: 
  131:     for (const key of ["label", "name", "title", "value", "text"]) {
  132:       const text = stringifyValue(record[key]);
  133:       if (text) return text;
  134:     }
  135: 
  136:     try {
  137:       return JSON.stringify(value);
  138:     } catch {
  139:       return "";
  140:     }
  141:   }
  142: 
  143:   return "";
  144: }

  146: function formatDateOnly(value: Date | string | null | undefined) {
  147:   if (!value) return "";
  148: 
  149:   try {
  150:     const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  151: 
  152:     if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
  153:       return String(value);
  154:     }
  155: 
  156:     return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  157:   } catch {
  158:     return String(value);
  159:   }
  160: }

  162: function formatDayName(value: Date | string | null | undefined) {
  163:   if (!value) return "";
  164: 
  165:   try {
  166:     const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  167:

  171: 
  172:     return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ar-SA-u-ca-gregory", {
  173:       weekday: "long",

  176:     return "";
  177:   }

  197: function classifyField(key: string, label: string): SmartReportFieldImportance {
  198:   const text = normalizeArabicText(`${key} ${label}`);
  199: 
  200:   if (
  201:     text.includes("وصف") ||
  202:     text.includes("description") ||
  203:     text.includes("ملخص") ||
  204:     text.includes("summary") ||
  205:     text.includes("نتيجه") ||
  206:     text.includes("result") ||
  207:     text.includes("توصيه")
  208:   ) {
  209:     return "NARRATIVE";

  214:     text.includes("مرفق") ||
  215:     text.includes("evidence") ||
  216:     text.includes("file") ||
  217:     text.includes("image")
  218:   ) {
  219:     return "EVIDENCE_RELATED";
  220:   }
  221:

  223:     return "SIGNATURE_RELATED";
  224:   }
  225: 
  226:   return "DETAIL";
  227: }

  229: function collectWorkflowSnapshotFieldLabels(snapshot: unknown) {
  230:   const labels = new Map<string, string>();
  231: 
  232:   let record: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
  233: 
  234:   if (typeof snapshot === "string") {
  235:     try {
  236:       record = JSON.parse(snapshot) as Record<string, unknown>;
  237:     } catch {
  238:       record = null;
  239:     }
  240:   } else if (snapshot && typeof snapshot === "object") {
  241:     record = snapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
  242:   }
  243: 
  244:   const steps = Array.isArray(record?.steps) ? record.steps : [];
  245: 
  246:   for (const step of steps) {
  247:     if (!step || typeof step !== "object") continue;
  248: 
  249:     const fields = Array.isArray((step as Record<string, unknown>).fields)
  250:       ? ((step as Record<string, unknown>).fields as unknown[])
  251:       : [];
  252: 
  253:     for (const field of fields) {
  254:       if (!field || typeof field !== "object") continue;
  255: 
  256:       const fieldRecord = field as Record<string, unknown>;
  257:       const key = cleanText(fieldRecord.key);
  258:       const label = cleanText(fieldRecord.label);
  259: 
  260:       if (key && label) {
  261:         labels.set(key, label);
  262:       }
  263:     }
  264:   }
  265: 
  266:   return labels;
  267: }

  269: function collectWorkflowSnapshotFields(snapshot: unknown) {

  280:     source = snapshot as Record<string, unknown>;

  403: function collectSmartReportArrayValue(value: unknown): unknown[] {
  404:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  405:     return value;
  406:   }
  407: 
  408:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
  409:     return [];
  410:   }
  411: 
  412:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  413:   const arrayKeys = [
  414:     "values",
  415:     "value",
  416:     "selected",
  417:     "selectedValues",
  418:     "selectedOptions",
  419:     "items",
  420:     "options",
  421:     "answers",
  422:   ];
  423: 
  424:   for (const key of arrayKeys) {
  425:     const candidate = record[key];
  426: 
  427:     if (Array.isArray(candidate)) {
  428:       return candidate;
  429:     }
  430:   }
  431: 
  432:   return [];
  433: }

  435: function getSmartReportOptionLabels(item: WorkflowValueLike) {
  436:   const source = item as any;
  437:   const options = Array.isArray(source.field?.options)
  438:     ? source.field.options
  439:     : [];
  440: 
  441:   const labels = new Map<string, string>();
  442: 
  443:   for (const option of options) {
  444:     const label =
  445:       cleanSmartReportOptionText(option.label) ||
  446:       cleanSmartReportOptionText(option.name) ||
  447:       cleanSmartReportOptionText(option.value) ||
  448:       cleanSmartReportOptionText(option.key) ||
  449:       cleanSmartReportOptionText(option.id);
  450: 
  451:     if (!label) {
  452:       continue;
  453:     }
  454: 
  455:     for (const key of [option.value, option.key, option.id, option.label, option.name]) {
  456:       const cleanKey = cleanSmartReportOptionText(key);
  457: 
  458:       if (cleanKey) {
  459:         labels.set(cleanKey, label);
  460:       }
  461:     }
  462:   }
  463: 
  464:   return labels;
  465: }

  467: function resolveSmartReportItemLabel(
  468:   value: unknown,
  469:   optionLabels: Map<string, string>
  470: ): string {
  471:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") {
  472:     return "";
  473:   }
  474: 
  475:   if (typeof value === "boolean") {
  476:     return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
  477:   }
  478: 
  479:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  480:     return value
  481:       .map((item) => resolveSmartReportItemLabel(item, optionLabels))
  482:       .filter(Boolean)
  483:       .join("، ");
  484:   }
  485: 
  486:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  487:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  488: 
  489:     return (
  490:       resolveSmartReportItemLabel(record.label, optionLabels) ||
  491:       resolveSmartReportItemLabel(record.name, optionLabels) ||
  492:       resolveSmartReportItemLabel(record.value, optionLabels) ||
  493:       resolveSmartReportItemLabel(record.key, optionLabels) ||
  494:       resolveSmartReportItemLabel(record.id, optionLabels)
  495:     );
  496:   }
  497: 
  498:   const text = cleanSmartReportOptionText(value);
  499: 
  500:   return optionLabels.get(text) || text;
  501: }

  645:     "selectedOptions",
  646:     "items",
  647:     "options",
  648:     "answers",
  649:   ];
  650: 
  651:   for (const key of keys) {
  652:     const candidate = record[key];
  653: 
  654:     if (Array.isArray(candidate)) return candidate;
  655:   }
  656: 
  657:   return [];
  658: }
  659: 
  660: function resolveReportOptionItemLabel(
  661:   value: unknown,
  662:   optionLabels: Map<string, string>
  663: ): string {
  664:   if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return "";
  665: 
  666:   if (typeof value === "boolean") return value ? "نعم" : "لا";
  667: 
  668:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  669:     return value
  670:       .map((item) => resolveReportOptionItemLabel(item, optionLabels))
  671:       .filter(Boolean)
  672:       .join("، ");
  673:   }
  674: 
  675:   if (typeof value === "object") {
  676:     const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  677: 
  678:     return (
  679:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.label, optionLabels) ||
  680:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.name, optionLabels) ||
  681:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.text, optionLabels) ||
  682:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.title, optionLabels) ||
  683:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.value, optionLabels) ||
  684:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.key, optionLabels) ||
  685:       resolveReportOptionItemLabel(record.id, optionLabels)
  686:     );
  687:   }
  688: 
  689:   const text = cleanReportOptionText(value);
  690:   return optionLabels.get(text) || text;
  691: }
  692: 
  693: function uniqueReportOptionItems(items: string[]) {
  694:   return Array.from(
  695:     new Set(
  696:       items
  697:         .map((item) => cleanReportOptionText(item))
  698:         .filter(Boolean)
  699:     )
  700:   );
  701: }
  702: 
  703: function resolveReportOptionDisplayValue(
  704:   caseValue: any,
  705:   fieldMap: Map<string, FieldLookupItem>
  706: ): string | string[] {
  707:   const key = caseValue.field?.key || caseValue.fieldKey || "";
  708:   const field = caseValue.field || fieldMap.get(key);
  709:   const optionLabels = buildReportOptionLabelMap(field);
  710:   const raw = caseValue.jsonValue ?? caseValue.value;
  711: 
  712:   const rawArray = getReportRawArrayValue(raw);
  713: 
  714:   if (rawArray.length) {
  715:     const labels = uniqueReportOptionItems(
  716:       rawArray.map((item) => resolveReportOptionItemLabel(item, optionLabels))
  717:     );
  718: 
  719:     return labels.length > 1 ? labels : labels[0] || "";
  720:   }
  721: 
  722:   if (typeof raw === "string") {
  723:     const text = cleanReportOptionText(raw);
  724: 
  725:     if (optionLabels.has(text)) {
  726:       return optionLabels.get(text) || text;
  727:     }
  728: 
  729:     const parts = text
  730:       .split(/\s*(?:،|,|؛|\r?\n)\s*/g)
  731:       .map((item) => item.trim())
  732:       .filter(Boolean);
  733: 
  734:     if (parts.length > 1 && parts.every((part) => optionLabels.has(part))) {
  735:       return uniqueReportOptionItems(
  736:         parts.map((part) => optionLabels.get(part) || part)
  737:       );
  738:     }
  739:   }
  740: 
  741:   return resolveReportOptionItemLabel(raw, optionLabels) || stringifyValue(raw);
  742: }

  744: function normalizeCaseValues(caseEntry: any): CaseValueItem[] {
  745:   const snapshotLabels = collectWorkflowSnapshotFieldLabels(
  746:     caseEntry.workflowSnapshot,
  747:   );
  748:   const activeWorkflowFieldKeys = collectActiveWorkflowFieldKeys(caseEntry);
  749:   const fieldMap = buildReportFieldMap(caseEntry);
  750:   const allowSnapshotFallback = fieldMap.size === 0;
  751: 
  752:   return (caseEntry.values || [])
  753:     .map((item: any) => {
  754:       const key = item.field?.key || item.fieldKey || "";
  755: 
  756:       if (!key) {
  757:         return null;
  758:       }
  759: 
  760:       if (!activeWorkflowFieldKeys.has(key)) {
  761:         return null;
  762:       }
  763: 
  764:       const label =
  765:         cleanText(fieldMap.get(key)?.label) ||
  766:         (allowSnapshotFallback ? snapshotLabels.get(key) : "") ||
  767:         cleanText(item.field?.label) ||
  768:         key ||
  769:         "حقل بدون اسم";
  770: 
  771:       const resolvedValue = resolveReportOptionDisplayValue(item, fieldMap);
  772:       const payloadValue = Array.isArray(resolvedValue)
  773:         ? resolvedValue.filter(Boolean)
  774:         : undefined;
  775:       const value = Array.isArray(resolvedValue)
  776:         ? resolvedValue.filter(Boolean).join("، ")
  777:         : cleanText(resolvedValue);
  778: 
  779:       return {
  780:         key,
  781:         label,
  782:         value,
  783:         ...(payloadValue && payloadValue.length > 1 ? { payloadValue } : {}),
  784:         importance: classifyField(key, label),
  785:       };
  786:     })
  787:     .filter((item: CaseValueItem | null): item is CaseValueItem => {
  788:       if (!item) {
  789:         return false;
  790:       }
  791: 
  792:       return !isTechnicalField(item.key, item.label, item.value);
  793:     });
  794: }

  796: function findByIntent(values: CaseValueItem[], intents: string[]) {
  797:   const normalizedIntents = intents.map(normalizeArabicText);
  798: 
  799:   return (
  800:     values.find((item) => {
  801:       const text = normalizeArabicText(`${item.key} ${item.label}`);
  802:       return normalizedIntents.some((intent) => text.includes(intent));
  803:     }) || null
  804:   );
  805: }

  807: function findTitle(caseEntry: any, values: CaseValueItem[]) {
  808:   const fromCase = String(caseEntry.title || "").trim();
  809: 
  810:   if (fromCase && fromCase !== "بدون عنوان" && fromCase.length < 120) {
  811:     return fromCase;
  812:   }
  813: 
  814:   const titleField = findByIntent(values, [
  815:     "activity title",
  816:     "activity name",
  817:     "program title",
  818:     "program name",
  819:     "عنوان النشاط",
  820:     "اسم النشاط",
  821:     "عنوان البرنامج",
  822:     "اسم البرنامج",
  823:     "الموضوع",
  824:     "title",
  825:   ]);
  826: 
  827:   return titleField?.value || caseEntry.service?.name || "تقرير حالة";
  828: }

  830: function buildReportType(serviceSlug: string): SmartReportType {
  831:   if (serviceSlug === "custom-report") return "SUMMARY_REPORT";
  832: 
  833:   if (serviceSlug.startsWith("activity-programs")) return "ACTIVITY_REPORT";
  834: 
  835:   if (serviceSlug.includes("committees") || serviceSlug.includes("meetings")) {
  836:     return "MEETING_REPORT";
  837:   }
  838: 
  839:   if (serviceSlug.includes("family") || serviceSlug.includes("guardian")) {
  840:     return "FAMILY_COMMUNICATION_REPORT";
  841:   }
  842: 
  843:   if (serviceSlug.includes("follow")) return "STUDENT_FOLLOWUP_REPORT";
  844: 
  845:   return "GENERAL_CASE_REPORT";
  846: }

  848: function makePrimaryField({
  849:   key,
  850:   label,
  851:   value,
  852:   languageMode,
  853:   transformValue = true,
  854: }: {
  855:   key: string;
  856:   label: string;
  857:   value: string;
  858:   languageMode: ReportLanguageMode;
  859:   transformValue?: boolean;
  860: }): SmartReportField {
  861:   return {
  862:     key,
  863:     label: applyReportLanguageModeToText(label, languageMode),
  864:     value: transformValue
  865:       ? applyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(
  866:           value || "غير محدد",
  867:           languageMode,
  868:           key,
  869:           label,
  870:         )
  871:       : value || "غير محدد",
  872:     importance: "PRIMARY",
  873:   };
  874: }

  876: function makeDetailField(
  877:   item: CaseValueItem,
  878:   languageMode: ReportLanguageMode,
  879: ): SmartReportField {
  880:   const value = item.payloadValue && item.payloadValue.length > 1
  881:     ? item.payloadValue.map((entry) =>
  882:         applyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(
  883:           entry,
  884:           languageMode,
  885:           item.key,
  886:           item.label,
  887:         )
  888:       )
  889:     : applyReportLanguageModeToFieldValue(
  890:         item.value || "غير محدد",
  891:         languageMode,
  892:         item.key,
  893:         item.label,
  894:       );
  895: 
  896:   return {
  897:     key: item.key,
  898:     label: applyReportLanguageModeToText(item.label, languageMode),
  899:     value,
  900:     importance: item.importance,
  901:     group: item.importance === "NARRATIVE" ? "وصف وتفاصيل" : "تفاصيل الحالة",
  902:   };
  903: }

  906:   /\.(png|jpe?g|webp|gif|avif)(?:[?#].*)?$/i;

  908: function hasSmartReportImageEvidenceExtension(value: unknown) {
  909:   const text = cleanText(value).replaceAll("\\", "/");
  910: 
  911:   if (!text) return false;
  912: 
  913:   return SMART_REPORT_IMAGE_EVIDENCE_EXTENSION_PATTERN.test(text);

  916: function isImageEvidence(item: any) {
  917:   const evidenceType = cleanText(item?.type).toUpperCase();
  918:   const mimeType = cleanText(item?.mimeType).toLowerCase();
  919: 
  920:   if (evidenceType === "IMAGE") return true;
  921:   if (mimeType.startsWith("image/")) return true;
  922: 
  923:   return [
  924:     item?.fileUrl,
  925:     item?.url,
  926:     item?.imageUrl,
  927:     item?.publicUrl,
  928:     item?.fileName,
  929:     item?.originalName,
  930:     item?.name,
  931:   ].some((value) => hasSmartReportImageEvidenceExtension(value));
  932: }

  934: function normalizeEvidence(caseEntry: any): SmartReportEvidenceItem[] {
  935:   const normalItems: SmartReportEvidenceItem[] = filterValidReportEvidenceItems(
  936:     caseEntry.evidences || [],
  937:   )
  938:     .map((item: any) => ({
  939:       id: item.id,
  940:       title: item.fileName || item.note || "شاهد",
  941:       caption: item.note || undefined,
  942:       url:
  943:         item.fileUrl ||
  944:         item.url ||
  945:         item.imageUrl ||
  946:         item.publicUrl ||
  947:         item.storagePath ||
  948:         undefined,
  949:       type: isImageEvidence(item) ? "IMAGE" : "FILE",
  950:       ...(item.title ? { title: item.title } : {}),
  951:       ...(item.caption ? { caption: item.caption } : {}),
  952:     }));
  953: 
  954:   const caseEvidenceItems: SmartReportEvidenceItem[] = filterValidReportEvidenceItems(
  955:     caseEntry.caseEvidences || [],
  956:   )
  957:     .map((item: any) => ({
  958:       id: item.id,
  959:       title: item.fileName || "شاهد",
  960:       url:
  961:         item.fileUrl ||
  962:         item.url ||
  963:         item.imageUrl ||
  964:         item.publicUrl ||
  965:         item.storagePath ||
  966:         undefined,
  967:       type: isImageEvidence(item) ? "IMAGE" : "FILE",
  968:       ...(item.title ? { title: item.title } : {}),
  969:       ...(item.caption || item.note
  970:         ? { caption: item.caption || item.note }
  971:         : {}),
  972:     }));
  973: 
  974:   const assignmentEvidenceItems: SmartReportEvidenceItem[] = Array.isArray(
  975:     caseEntry.activityAssignment?.submittedEvidenceItems,
  976:   )
  977:     ? filterValidReportEvidenceItems(
  978:         caseEntry.activityAssignment.submittedEvidenceItems,
  979:       )
  980:         .map((item: any, index: number) => ({
  981:           id: item.id || `assignment-evidence-${index + 1}`,
  982:           title: item.fileName || item.title || `شاهد ${index + 1}`,
  983:           caption: item.caption || item.note || undefined,
  984:           url:
  985:             item.fileUrl ||
  986:             item.url ||
  987:             item.imageUrl ||
  988:             item.publicUrl ||
  989:             item.storagePath ||
  990:             undefined,
  991:           type: isImageEvidence(item) ? "IMAGE" : "FILE",
  992:         }))
  993:     : [];
  994: 
  995:   return [...normalItems, ...caseEvidenceItems, ...assignmentEvidenceItems];
  996: }

 1033: function buildSignatures(
 1034:   caseEntry: any,
 1035:   current: CurrentUserLike,
 1036:   languageMode: ReportLanguageMode,
 1037: ): SmartReportSignature[] {
 1038:   const profile = resolveSchoolProfileForReport(caseEntry, current);
 1039:   const serviceSlug = caseEntry.service?.slug || "";
 1040:   const isActivity = isActivityProgramReportService(serviceSlug);
 1041:   const hasActivityAssignment = Boolean(caseEntry.activityAssignment);
 1042:   const transformTitle = (value: string) =>
 1043:     applyReportLanguageModeToText(value, languageMode);
 1044: 
 1045:   const signatures: SmartReportSignature[] = [];
 1046: 
 1047:   signatures.push({
 1048:     key: "principal",
 1049:     label: transformTitle("مدير المدرسة"),
 1050:     signerName: profile?.principalName || "مدير المدرسة",
 1051:     signerTitle: transformTitle("مدير المدرسة"),
 1052:     imageUrl: profile?.principalSignatureUrl || null,
 1053:     required: false,
 1054:   });
 1055: 
 1056:   if (
 1057:     isActivity &&
 1058:     (current.user.role !== "TEACHER" || hasActivityAssignment)
 1059:   ) {
 1060:     signatures.push({
 1061:       key: "activity_leader",
 1062:       label: transformTitle("رائد النشاط"),
 1063:       signerName:
 1064:         profile?.activityLeaderName ||
 1065:         current.user.officialName ||
 1066:         current.user.name,
 1067:       signerTitle: transformTitle("رائد النشاط"),
 1068:       imageUrl: profile?.activityLeaderSignatureUrl || profile?.counselorSignatureUrl || null,
 1069:       required: true,
 1070:     });
 1071:   } else {
 1072:     const isTeacher = current.user.role === "TEACHER";
 1073:     const currentUserRoleLabel = getArabicUserRoleLabel({
 1074:       role: current.user.role,
 1075:       gender: current.user.gender,
 1076:     });
 1077: 
 1078:     signatures.push({
 1079:       key: "counselor",
 1080:       label: isTeacher
 1081:         ? currentUserRoleLabel
 1082:         : transformTitle("الموجه الطلابي"),
 1083:       signerName: current.user.officialName || current.user.name,
 1084:       signerTitle: isTeacher
 1085:         ? currentUserRoleLabel
 1086:         : current.user.jobTitle || transformTitle("الموجه الطلابي"),
 1087:       imageUrl: isTeacher
 1088:         ? current.user.signatureUrl || null
 1089:         : profile?.counselorSignatureUrl ||
 1090:           profile?.activityLeaderSignatureUrl ||
 1091:           null,
 1092:       signedAt: isTeacher
 1093:         ? current.user.signatureSignedAt?.toISOString() || null
 1094:         : null,
 1095:       required: true,
 1096:     });
 1097:   }
 1098: 
 1099:   if (caseEntry.activityAssignment?.teacherName) {
 1100:     signatures.push({
 1101:       key: "teacher",
 1102:       label: transformTitle("توقيع المعلم المنفذ"),
 1103:       signerName:
 1104:         caseEntry.activityAssignment.teacherSignedName ||
 1105:         caseEntry.activityAssignment.teacherName,
 1106:       signerTitle: transformTitle("المعلم المنفذ"),
 1107:       imageUrl:
 1108:         caseEntry.activityAssignment.teacherSignatureUrl ||
 1109:         (current.user.role === "TEACHER"
 1110:           ? current.user.signatureUrl || null
 1111:           : null),
 1112:       signedAt:
 1113:         caseEntry.activityAssignment.teacherSignedAt?.toISOString?.() ||
 1114:         (current.user.role === "TEACHER"
 1115:           ? current.user.signatureSignedAt?.toISOString() || null
 1116:           : null),
 1117:       required: true,
 1118:     });
 1119:   }
 1120: 
 1121:   return signatures;
 1122: }

 1124: function buildNarrative({

 1169: export async function buildSmartReportPayloadForCase({
 1170:   caseId,
 1171:   current,
 1172: }: {
 1173:   caseId: string;
 1174:   current: CurrentUserLike;
 1175: }): Promise<BuildSmartReportPayloadResult> {
 1176:   if (!caseId) {
 1177:     return {
 1178:       ok: false,
 1179:       status: 400,
 1180:       message: "رقم الحالة مطلوب.",
 1181:     };
 1182:   }
 1183: 
 1184:   const isAdmin = current.user.role === "ADMIN";
 1185: 
 1186:   if (!isAdmin && !current.user.schoolAccountId) {
 1187:     return {
 1188:       ok: false,
 1189:       status: 401,
 1190:       message: "يلزم تسجيل الدخول بحساب مدرسة.",
 1191:     };
 1192:   }
 1193: 
 1194:   const caseEntry = await prisma.caseEntry.findFirst({
 1195:     where: {
 1196:       id: caseId,
 1197:       ...buildCaseEntryReportWhereForUser(current.user),
 1198:     },
 1199:     include: {
 1200:       schoolAccount: {
 1201:         include: {
 1202:           profile: true,
 1203:         },
 1204:       },
 1205:       service: true,
 1206:       workflow: {
 1207:         include: {
 1208:           steps: {
 1209:             include: {
 1210:               fields: {
 1211:                 include: {
 1212:                   options: {
 1213:                     orderBy: {
 1214:                       order: "asc",
 1215:                     },
 1216:                   },
 1217:                 },
 1218:                 orderBy: {
 1219:                   order: "asc",
 1220:                 },
 1221:               },
 1222:             },
 1223:             orderBy: {
 1224:               order: "asc",
 1225:             },
 1226:           },
 1227:         },
 1228:       },
 1229:       student: {
 1230:         include: {
 1231:           guardian: true,
 1232:         },
 1233:       },
 1234:       createdBy: true,
 1235:       values: {
 1236:         include: {
 1237:           field: {
 1238:             include: {
 1239:               options: true,
 1240:             },
 1241:           },
 1242:         },
 1243:         orderBy: {
 1244:           createdAt: "asc",
 1245:         },
 1246:       },
 1247:       evidences: {
 1248:         orderBy: {
 1249:           createdAt: "asc",
 1250:         },
 1251:       },
 1252:       caseEvidences: {
 1253:         orderBy: {
 1254:           createdAt: "asc",
 1255:         },
 1256:       },
 1257:       activityAssignment: true,
 1258:     },
 1259:   });
 1260: 
 1261:   if (!caseEntry) {
 1262:     return {
 1263:       ok: false,
 1264:       status: 404,
 1265:       message: "لم يتم العثور على الحالة أو لا تملك صلاحية الوصول لها.",
 1266:     };
 1267:   }
 1268: 
 1269:   const languageMode = getReportLanguageModeFromUserGender(current.user.gender);
 1270:   const workflowFields = (caseEntry.workflow?.steps || []).flatMap(
 1271:     (step: any) => step.fields || [],
 1272:   );
 1273:   let tables = extractSmartReportTables({
 1274:     values: caseEntry.values || [],
 1275:     fields: workflowFields,
 1276:     snapshotFields: collectWorkflowSnapshotFields(caseEntry.workflowSnapshot),
 1277:   });
 1278:   const studentTableRowIds = Array.from(
 1279:     new Set(
 1280:       tables
 1281:         .filter(isStudentDataTable)
 1282:         .flatMap((table) => table.rows.map((row) => cleanText(row.id)))
 1283:         .filter(Boolean),
 1284:     ),
 1285:   );
 1286:   if (studentTableRowIds.length) {
 1287:     const studentGenders = await prisma.student.findMany({
 1288:       where: {
 1289:         id: { in: studentTableRowIds },
 1290:         schoolAccountId: caseEntry.schoolAccountId,
 1291:       },
 1292:       select: { id: true, gender: true },

 1299:         ? {

 1301:             rows: table.rows.map((row) => ({

 1309:                     : null),
 1310:               },
 1311:             })),

 1503:               : "تم إنشاء تقرير خاص من بيانات الحالة.",
 1504:         }
 1505:       : {
 1506:           title: "وصف التنفيذ",
 1507:           body: buildNarrative({
 1508:             title,
 1509:             serviceName,

 1511:             executor: executorText,

 1516:             languageMode,
 1517:           }),
 1518:         },

 1523:     signatures: buildSignatures(caseEntry, current, languageMode),
